titleByLocale.de: Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care
titleByLocale.fr: Partenaire de valeur médicale Cardiologie et soins essentiels

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care
Roche Diagnostics Nederland

We zijn op zoek naar een ervaren Medical Affairs professional om ons team te versterken in de functie van Medical Value Partner Cardiology & Critical Care. In deze functie maak je deel uit van het Medical & Access Chapter en werk je samen met collega's aan de uitdagingen en ontwikkelingen in de gezondheidszorg. In een multidisciplinair team en op een agile werkwijze, draag je bij aan de toegankelijkheid van de diagnostische en digitale innovaties voor de patiënt om het zorgpad en daarmee de patiëntuitkomsten te verbeteren.

Als Medical Value Partner ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en uitvoeren van de medische strategie van Cardiologie en Critical Care. Hiervoor werk je samen met diverse stakeholders, waaronder Key Opinion Leaders binnen cardiologie, interne geneeskunde en anesthesiologie, patiëntenverenigingen, beroepsverenigingen en zorgverzekeraars.
We zoeken iemand met een sterk strategisch en analytisch denkvermogen, creativiteit en een proactieve houding. Je hebt ervaring met evidence generation, het vertalen van bewijslast naar de dagelijkse praktijk, de toepassing van waardegedreven zorg, medische of waardegedreven projecten en het ontwikkelen van gerichte medische educatie. Daarnaast is ervaring met werken in multidisciplinaire teams, stakeholder engagement en kennis van de farmaceutische industrie en/of gezondheidszorg gewenst.

Als persoon ben je een teamspeler, flexibel, resultaatgericht en in staat om prioriteiten te stellen. Je hebt een open mindset en kunt in een dynamische en agile omgeving werken. Daarnaast ben je communicatief sterk en kun je helder en effectief communiceren in zowel Nederlands als Engels.

Je verantwoordelijkheden:

• Het identificeren en creëren van kansen om de patiëntenzorg te verbeteren

• Het bouwen en onderhouden van relevante stakeholder netwerken

• Het genereren van klinische bewijslast in samenwerking met artsen en onderzoekers

• Het organiseren van medische educatie

• Als subject matter expert ben je een (sparring) partner voor interne en externe stakeholders

Je vaardigheden:

• Kennis op het gebied van cardiologie en/of critical care

• Uitstekende communicatie vaardigheden en in staat mensen te verbinden en mobiliseren

• Ervaring met klinische studies, medische educatie en stakeholder engagement

• Relevante medisch wetenschappelijke opleiding (Msc, MD, PharmD, PhD)

• Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in de farmaceutische en/of medical device industrie

Waarom Roche?
Al meer dan 125 jaar werkt Roche aan een gezondere toekomst met één duidelijk doel: “Doing now what patients need next”. Wij geloven dat we de grootste medische uitdagingen alleen kunnen oplossen door intensieve samenwerking met zorgprofessionals en patiënten.
Onze impact gaat echter verder dan de zorg; we nemen ook de volle verantwoordelijkheid voor onze planeet. Zo draaien al onze locaties sinds 2025 op 100% duurzame elektriciteit, een belangrijke mijlpaal in onze ambitie om in 2045 volledig klimaatneutraal (net zero) te zijn. Bij Roche werk je dus niet alleen aan de zorg van morgen, maar ook aan een gezonde, duurzame wereld.

Dit krijg je bij ons:

• Een inspirerende werkomgeving waar plezier en maatschappelijke impact samenkomen.

• Een organisatie waar jouw expertise wordt gewaardeerd en waar je autonoom beslissingen kan nemen binnen je team.

• Werken met een portfolio van innovatieve producten die de cardiologische zorg fundamenteel transformeren.

• Volop ka

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), you will be at the forefront of ensuring the quality and performance of Roche’s Digital Solutions, handling complaints related to Roche’s sequencing and pathology product portfolios.

Joining the Digital Solutions Chapter means working in a highly transversal software environment, giving you the opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies and diverse programming languages for both on-premise and cloud-based software.

Your core mission will be to act as a highly autonomous, deep-dive technical investigator. You masterfully dissect complex, edge-case software failures, bridging the gap between field trouble-shooting and core R&D development teams. While your focus is on root cause analysis, you will not be responsible for the final bug fixes. This role is set within an Agile environment where your innovative ideas and proposals are highly valued, contributing directly to a team focused on continuous improvement.

The Opportunity

• You are accountable for handling complex software complaints for our sequencing and pathology products, like safety issues, and product inquiries for software products (on premise, cloud, mobile, apps,...).

• You will independently manage the entire case lifecycle, from initial creation and classification to in-depth investigation, collaboration with the on-site trouble-shooting team, documentation and final resolution. For cases that cannot be directly resolved, you take ownership of escalating to the development department.

• You act as a senior technical expert for case resolution, using your ability to read and understand complex source code to identify the root cause/causal factor of software malfunctions. You master the Roche internal quality processes and understand their regulatory background to justify decisions.

• You are an interface with Affiliates and Country Organizations. You will be responsible for the timely communication of essential quality-related information and supporting initiatives that enhance our regional partnerships.

• You use your automation and data analytics skills to enhance the case handling process and proactively monitor product performance data

• You serve as a trusted technical proxy for the Principal Engineer when required.

Who You Are

• A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an IT related field (preferred) with knowledge of bioinformatics or genomics. Advanced degrees (Master’s or Ph.D.) are a plus but not required.

• 5+ years of proven track records of working in the area of Bioinformatics or IT support related functions

• Strong IT skills, especially the ability to read and debug complex source code of different programming languages to understand the root cause of reported issues

• Good ability to work independently even when faced with uncertainty.

• Good ability to present technical work to stakeholders, influence and negotiate to push initiatives forwards

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

Locations
This is a primarily onsite position in Tucson, Arizona.

Relocation benefits are not available for this position.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson Arizona is $77,280 and $143,520. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifi

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ), sarai in prima linea nel garantire la qualità e le prestazioni delle soluzioni digitali di Roche, trattando reclami relativi ai portafogli dei prodotti di sequenziamento e patologia di Roche. Unire il Capitolo Soluzioni Digitali significa lavorare in un ambiente software altamente trasversale, dandovi l'opportunità di impegnarsi con tecnologie all'avanguardia e linguaggi di programmazione diversi per il software on-premise e cloud-based. La vostra missione principale sarà di agire come un investigatore tecnico altamente autonomo e profondo. Si distinguono i guasti complessi, bordure i guasti del software, colmare il divario tra i team di sviluppo R&D di campo e risoluzione dei problemi di campo. Mentre la vostra attenzione è sull'analisi della causa principale, non sarete responsabili per le correzioni di bug finali. Questo ruolo è ambientato in un ambiente Agile dove le tue idee e le tue proposte innovative sono altamente apprezzate, contribuendo direttamente a un team focalizzato sul miglioramento continuo. L'opportunità
• Sei responsabile per la gestione di reclami software complessi per i nostri prodotti di sequenziamento e patologia, come problemi di sicurezza e richieste di prodotti software (su premessa, cloud, mobile, applicazioni,...).
• Potrai gestire in modo indipendente l'intero ciclo di vita dei casi, dalla creazione iniziale e classificazione alle indagini approfondite, collaborazione con il team di risoluzione dei problemi in loco, documentazione e risoluzione finale. Per i casi che non possono essere risolti direttamente, si prende la proprietà di aumentare al reparto sviluppo.
• Si agisce come esperto tecnico senior per la risoluzione dei casi, utilizzando la capacità di leggere e comprendere il codice sorgente complesso per identificare la causa principale / fattore causale di malfunzionamenti software. Si padroneggia i processi di qualità interna Roche e capire il loro background normativo per giustificare le decisioni.
• Sei un'interfaccia con affiliati e organizzazioni di paese. Sarete responsabili della comunicazione tempestiva delle informazioni essenziali e delle iniziative di supporto alla qualità che migliorano i nostri partenariati regionali.
• Utilizzi le tue capacità di automazione e analisi dei dati per migliorare il processo di gestione dei casi e monitorare proattivamente i dati sulle prestazioni dei prodotti
• Serve come un proxy tecnico affidabile per l'Ingegnere Principale quando necessario. Chi sei
• Una laurea in Informatica o un campo relativo IT (preferito) con conoscenza di bioinformatica o genomica. I gradi avanzati (Master o Ph.D.) sono un plus ma non richiesto.
• 5+ anni di comprovata traccia di lavoro nell'area della Bioinformatica o funzioni correlate supporto IT
• Forti competenze IT, in particolare la capacità di leggere e debug codice sorgente complesso di diversi linguaggi di programmazione per comprendere la causa principale dei problemi segnalati
• Buona capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente anche di fronte all'incertezza.
• Buona capacità di presentare il lavoro tecnico alle parti interessate, influenzare e negoziare per spingere avanti iniziative
• Forte capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato) Località Questa posizione è principalmente in loco a Tucson, Arizona. Le prestazioni di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa posizione. L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione in base alla posizione principale di Tucson Arizona è $77,280 e $143,520. La retribuzione effettiva sarà determinata in base all'esperienza, alle qualifiche, alla posizione geografica e ad altri fattori legati al lavoro consentiti dalla legge. Un bonus annuale discrezionale può essere disponibile in base alle prestazioni individuali e aziendali. Questa posizione anche qualifi

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Als Senior Software Engineer in Post Market Quality (PMQ) sind Sie an vorderster Front dabei, die Qualität und Leistung der digitalen Lösungen von Roche zu gewährleisten und Beschwerden im Zusammenhang mit den Sequenzierungs- und Pathologie-Produktportfolios von Roche zu bearbeiten. Der Beitritt zum Digital Solutions Chapter bedeutet, in einer hochgradig transversalen Softwareumgebung zu arbeiten und Ihnen die Möglichkeit zu geben, sich mit innovativen Technologien und verschiedenen Programmiersprachen für On-Premise- und Cloud-basierte Software zu beschäftigen. Ihre Kernaufgabe wird es sein, als hoch autonomer, tiefgehender technischer Ermittler zu agieren. Sie sezieren meisterhaft komplexe, Edge-Case-Softwarefehler und schließen die Lücke zwischen der Fehlersuche im Feld und den Kernteams für F & E-Entwicklung. Während Sie sich auf die Ursachenanalyse konzentrieren, sind Sie nicht für die endgültigen Fehlerbehebungen verantwortlich. Diese Rolle spielt in einer agilen Umgebung, in der Ihre innovativen Ideen und Vorschläge hoch geschätzt werden und direkt zu einem Team beitragen, das sich auf kontinuierliche Verbesserung konzentriert. Die Chance
• Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, komplexe Softwarebeschwerden für unsere Sequenzierungs- und Pathologieprodukte wie Sicherheitsprobleme und Produktanfragen für Softwareprodukte (vor Ort, Cloud, Mobile, Apps, ...) zu bearbeiten.
• Sie werden den gesamten Falllebenszyklus unabhängig verwalten, von der anfänglichen Erstellung und Klassifizierung bis hin zur eingehenden Untersuchung, der Zusammenarbeit mit dem Problembehandlungsteam vor Ort, der Dokumentation und der endgültigen Lösung. In Fällen, die nicht direkt gelöst werden können, übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Eskalation an die Entwicklungsabteilung.

titleByLocale.fr: Scientifique en apprentissage automatique - Chimie quantique

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join the small-molecule team within AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD), formerly Prescient Design, at Roche and Genentech’s Computational Sciences Center of Excellence as a Machine Learning Scientist / Senior Machine Learning Scientist in Quantum Chemistry. You will combine machine learning methods and quantum chemistry to build fast, accurate models that power small-molecule drug discovery. You will work with world-class computational and experimental scientists and leverage proprietary datasets and state-of-the-art compute.

The Opportunity

• Create cutting-edge solutions that combine quantum chemistry and machine learning algorithm development to model small-molecule energetics and protein–ligand interactions, from conformation and reactivity to binding affinity and free energy.

• Build synthetic datasets using quantum mechanics and related methods to shape novel research directions in ML.

• Develop deployable pipelines that are robust, scalable and reproducible, and feed directly into molecular-design tools used across Roche.

• Drive scientific impact through publications, open-source releases, and talks at internal and external conferences.

• Collaborate widely with world-class computational and experimental researchers at Roche and with academic partners.

Who you are

• You bring deep machine-learning expertise with a strong theoretical foundation in linear algebra, probability and optimization, and you build models from first principles.

• You have hands-on quantum chemistry experience and fluency in toolkits such as Psi4, PySCF and ORCA, as well as semi-empirical methods like xTB.

• You are fluent in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.

• You hold a PhD or equivalent research depth in machine learning, computational chemistry, chemical engineering or a related quantitative field such as physics or statistics.

• You have a record of scientific excellence evidenced by journal and conference publications or a public portfolio of relevant projects (e.g. hosted on GitHub/GitLab).

Preferred

• Experience in scientific software development, scaling ML training, and applying models to drug discovery.

• Experience generating large-scale synthetic datasets.

Location & Travel Requirements

This position must be based in either Welwyn Garden City in the United Kingdom (preferred) or Basel, Switzerland. Although this can be a hybrid role, there is an expectation of ongoing and sustained site presence, in compliance with local company site requirements.

If building physics-grounded machine learning models that bring better medicines to patients faster is your calling, apply now and help shape the future of small-molecule drug discovery.

• Sviluppare oleodotti dispiegabili robusti, scalabili e riproducibili, e alimentarsi direttamente in strumenti di progettazione molecolare utilizzati in Roche.
• Guidare l'impatto scientifico attraverso pubblicazioni, comunicati open source e colloqui a conferenze interne ed esterne.
• Collaborare ampiamente con ricercatori computazionali e sperimentali di livello mondiale a Roche e con partner accademici. Chi sei:
• Porti una profonda esperienza di machine-learning con una forte base teorica in algebra lineare, probabilità e ottimizzazione, e costruisci modelli dai primi principi.
• Hai esperienza di chimica quantistica pratica e fluidità in strumenti come Psi4, PySCF e ORCA, così come metodi semi-empirici come xTB.
• Sei fluente in Python e moderni framework ML come PyTorch o JAX.
• Ha una profondità di ricerca di dottorato o equivalente nell'apprendimento automatico, nella chimica computazionale, nell'ingegneria chimica o in un campo quantitativo correlato come la fisica o le statistiche.
• Hai un record di eccellenza scientifica evidenziato da pubblicazioni di riviste e conferenze o un portafoglio pubblico di progetti rilevanti (ad esempio ospitato su GitHub/GitLab). Preferito:
• Esperienza nello sviluppo del software scientifico, scalare la formazione ML e applicare modelli alla scoperta della droga.
• Esperienza generando set di dati sintetici su larga scala. Se la costruzione di modelli di machine learning basati sulla fisica che portano farmaci migliori ai pazienti più velocemente è la vostra chiamata, applicare ora e contribuire a modellare il futuro della scoperta di droga di piccola molecola. #ComputationCoE #tech4lifeComputationalScienza #tech4lifeAI Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Description
The Position

At Roche, we are building a scalable and compliant omnichannel engagement ecosystem that enables personalized, data-driven interactions across channels.
As an IT Business Analyst within Omnichannel Orchestration, you will act as the bridge between business stakeholders, affiliate teams, and technology delivery teams. You will play a key role in translating business needs into clear requirements, supporting onboarding and adoption of omnichannel capabilities, and ensuring successful delivery of customer engagement use cases across markets.
A major focus of this role will be supporting the rollout, adoption, and continuous improvement of omnichannel engagement capabilities across Pharma International affiliates.
This role will work closely with Product Owners, Solution Architects, Engineers, Data Teams, and Business Stakeholders, you will help shape requirements, improve processes, and ensure solutions deliver measurable business value.

The Opportunity
Business Analysis & Requirements Management

• Gather, analyze, and document business requirements for omnichannel engagement, customer journeys, audience segmentation, and activation use cases.

• Translate business needs into user stories, process flows, functional requirements, and acceptance criteria.

• Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, and requirement gathering activities with global and affiliate stakeholders.

• Support backlog refinement and prioritization activities with Product Owners and delivery teams.

Affiliate Engagement & Omnichannel Adoption

• Act as a key point of contact for affiliate teams adopting omnichannel capabilities.

• Understand affiliate business processes, pain points, and market-specific requirements.

• Support onboarding activities, capability demonstrations, training sessions, and business readiness efforts.

• Identify opportunities to improve adoption, operational efficiency, and user experience.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Product Owners, Solution Architects, Engineers, Data Teams, and Vendors to ensure business requirements are clearly understood and implemented.

• Support testing, validation, and user acceptance activities.

• Help manage dependencies across business, process, data, and technology workstreams.

Continuous Improvement

• Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for optimization and standardization.

• Contribute to documentation, governance practices, templates, and best practices.

• Support reporting, insights, and measurement activities to evaluate business outcomes and adoption.

Who You Are
You are a delivery-oriented and collaborative leader who is comfortable operating across business and technology domains within large-scale enterprise transformation programs.

Experience

• 5+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Consulting, Product Delivery, CRM, Marketing Technology, Omnichannel Engagement, or Digital Transformation domains.

• Experience gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements and translating them into scalable technology solutions.

• Strong stakeholder management skills with experience working in large-scale enterprise transformation or digital engagement programs.

• Experience operating within Agile delivery environments and collaborating across product, engineering, and business teams.

• Strong understanding of omnichannel engagement, campaign execution, customer journeys, audience segmentation, and activation workflows.

• Familiarity with

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Descrizione del lavoro La posizione A Roche, stiamo costruendo un ecosistema di fidanzamento omnicanale scalabile e conforme che consente interazioni personalizzate e basate sui dati attraverso i canali. Come analista IT Business all'interno di Omnichannel Orchestration, agirai come il ponte tra gli stakeholder aziendali, i team affiliati e i team di distribuzione della tecnologia. Potrai svolgere un ruolo chiave nel tradurre le esigenze aziendali in requisiti chiari, supportando l'integrazione e l'adozione di capacità omnicanale, e garantendo la consegna di casi di utilizzo del customer engagement in tutti i mercati. Un importante focus di questo ruolo sarà sostenere il rollout, l'adozione e il miglioramento continuo delle capacità di coinvolgimento omnicanale attraverso le affiliate di Pharma International. Questo ruolo lavorerà a stretto contatto con Product Owners, Solution Architects, Engineers, Data Teams e Business Stakeholders, aiuterà a modellare i requisiti, migliorare i processi e garantire soluzioni che forniscono un valore aziendale misurabile. L'opportunità Analisi aziendale e gestione dei requisiti
• Raccogliere, analizzare e documentare i requisiti aziendali per l'impegno omnicanale, i viaggi dei clienti, la segmentazione del pubblico e i casi di utilizzo dell'attivazione.
• Tradurre le esigenze aziendali nelle storie degli utenti, flussi di processo, requisiti funzionali e criteri di accettazione.
• Facilita workshop, sessioni di scoperta e attività di raccolta dei requisiti con gli stakeholder globali e affiliati.
• Supporta le attività di perfezionamento e priorità del backlog con i Proprietari del Prodotto e i team di consegna. Affiliato Engagement & Omnichannel Adozione
• Agire come punto chiave di contatto per i team di affiliazione che adottano capacità omnichannel.
• Comprendere processi aziendali di affiliazione, punti di dolore e requisiti specifici di mercato.
• Sostenere le attività di bordo, dimostrazioni di capacità, sessioni di formazione e sforzi di prontezza aziendale.
• Identificare le opportunità per migliorare l'adozione, l'efficienza operativa e l'esperienza degli utenti. Collaborazione trasversale
• Partner con Product Owners, Solution Architects, Engineers, Data Teams e Vendors per garantire che i requisiti aziendali siano chiaramente compresi e implementati.
• Supporta attività di test, validazione e accettazione degli utenti.
• Aiuta a gestire le dipendenze attraverso business, processi, dati e flussi di lavoro di tecnologia. Miglioramento continuo
• Analizzare i processi aziendali e identificare le opportunità di ottimizzazione e standardizzazione.
• Contribuisci a documentazione, pratiche di governance, modelli e best practice.
• Supporta attività di reportistica, approfondimenti e misurazione per valutare i risultati aziendali e l'adozione. Chi sei Sei un leader orientato alla consegna e collaborativo che è comodo operare in settori aziendali e tecnologici all'interno di programmi di trasformazione aziendale su larga scala. Esperienza
• 5+ anni di esperienza in Business Analysis, Consulenza, Consegna del Prodotto, CRM, Tecnologia di Marketing, Engagement omnicanale, o domini di Trasformazione Digitale.
• Prova a raccogliere, analizzare e documentare i requisiti aziendali e traducerli in soluzioni tecnologiche scalabili.
• Forte capacità di gestione degli stakeholder con esperienza di lavoro nella trasformazione aziendale su larga scala o programmi di coinvolgimento digitale.
• Esperienza operativa all'interno di ambienti di consegna Agile e collaborazione tra team di prodotto, ingegneria e business.
• Forte comprensione del coinvolgimento omnicanale, l'esecuzione della campagna, i viaggi dei clienti, la segmentazione del pubblico e i flussi di lavoro di attivazione.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Stellenbeschreibung Die Position Bei Roche bauen wir ein skalierbares und kompatibles Omnichannel-Engagement-Ökosystem auf, das personalisierte, datengesteuerte Interaktionen über Kanäle hinweg ermöglicht. Als IT Business Analyst bei Omnichannel Orchestration fungieren Sie als Brücke zwischen Geschäftsinteressenten, Affiliate-Teams und Technologiebereitstellungsteams. Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Übersetzung von Geschäftsanforderungen in klare Anforderungen, unterstützen das Onboarding und die Einführung von Omnichannel-Funktionen und gewährleisten die erfolgreiche Bereitstellung von Anwendungsfällen für Kundenbindung in allen Märkten. Ein Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle wird die Unterstützung der Einführung, Einführung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Omnichannel-Engagement-Fähigkeiten in Pharma International-Tochtergesellschaften sein. Diese Rolle wird eng mit Product Ownern, Solution Architects, Engineers, Data Teams und Business Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten, Sie werden dabei helfen, Anforderungen zu gestalten, Prozesse zu verbessern und sicherzustellen, dass Lösungen einen messbaren Geschäftswert liefern. Die Chance Business Analyse & Anforderungsmanagement
• Sammeln, analysieren und dokumentieren Sie Geschäftsanforderungen für Omnichannel-Engagement, Customer Journeys, Zielgruppensegmentierung und Aktivierungs-Anwendungsfälle.
• Übersetzen Sie Geschäftsanforderungen in User Stories, Prozessabläufe, funktionale Anforderungen und Akzeptanzkriterien.
• Erleichterung von Workshops, Discovery-Sessions und Aktivitäten zur Anforderungserfassung mit globalen und verbundenen Stakeholdern.
• Unterstützen Sie Backlog-Verfeinerungs- und Priorisierungsaktivitäten mit Product Ownern und Lieferteams. Affiliate Engagement & Omnichannel Adoption
• Handeln Sie als wichtiger Ansprechpartner für Affiliate-Teams, die Omnichannel-Fähigkeiten übernehmen.
• Verstehen Sie Affiliate-Geschäftsprozesse, Schmerzpunkte und marktspezifische Anforderungen.
• Unterstützung von Onboarding-Aktivitäten, Fähigkeitsdemonstrationen, Schulungen und Geschäftsbereitschaftsbemühungen.
• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Akzeptanz, der betrieblichen Effizienz und der Benutzererfahrung. Funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit
• Zusammenarbeit mit Product Ownern, Solution Architects, Engineers, Data Teams und Vendors, um sicherzustellen, dass die Geschäftsanforderungen klar verstanden und umgesetzt werden.
• Unterstützung von Test-, Validierungs- und Benutzerakzeptanzaktivitäten.
• Helfen Sie, Abhängigkeiten über Geschäfts-, Prozess-, Daten- und Technologie-Workstreams hinweg zu verwalten. Kontinuierliche Verbesserung
• Analysieren Sie Geschäftsprozesse und identifizieren Sie Optimierungs- und Standardisierungsmöglichkeiten.
• Tragen Sie zu Dokumentation, Governance-Praktiken, Vorlagen und Best Practices bei.
• Unterstützung von Reporting, Insights und Messaktivitäten zur Bewertung von Geschäftsergebnissen und -akzeptanz. Wer du bist Sie sind eine lieferungsorientierte und kooperative Führungskraft, die in Geschäfts- und Technologiebereichen innerhalb großer Transformationsprogramme für Unternehmen bequem tätig ist. Erfahrung
• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Business Analysis, Consulting, Product Delivery, CRM, Marketing Technology, Omnichannel Engagement oder Digital Transformation.
• Erleben Sie die Erfassung, Analyse und Dokumentation von Geschäftsanforderungen und deren Übersetzung in skalierbare Technologielösungen.
• Starke Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management mit Erfahrung in großen Transformations- oder digitalen Engagement-Programmen.
• Erfahrung in agilen Bereitstellungsumgebungen und in der Zusammenarbeit zwischen Produkt-, Engineering- und Geschäftsteams.
• Starkes Verständnis von Omnichannel-Engagement, Kampagnenausführung, Customer Journeys, Zielgruppensegmentierung und Aktivierungs-Workflows.
• Vertrautheit mit
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Description de l'emploi La position Chez Roche, nous construisons un écosystème d'engagement omnicanal évolutif et conforme qui permet des interactions personnalisées et axées sur les données entre les canaux. En tant qu'analyste d'affaires en TI au sein de Omnichannel Orchestration, vous jouerez le rôle de pont entre les intervenants d'affaires, les équipes affiliées et les équipes de livraison de technologie. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la traduction des besoins de l'entreprise en exigences claires, en soutenant l'embarquement et l'adoption de capacités omnicanales, et en assurant la livraison réussie de cas d'utilisation de l'engagement des clients à travers les marchés. L'un des principaux objectifs de ce rôle sera d'appuyer le déploiement, l'adoption et l'amélioration continue des capacités d'engagement omnicanal dans les filiales de Pharma International. Ce rôle travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les propriétaires de produits, les architectes de solutions, les ingénieurs, les équipes de données et les intervenants d'affaires, vous aiderez à définir les exigences, à améliorer les processus et à garantir que les solutions offrent une valeur opérationnelle mesurable. L'opportunité Analyse opérationnelle et gestion des besoins
• Recueillir, analyser et documenter les exigences opérationnelles pour l'engagement omnicanal, les déplacements des clients, la segmentation du public et les cas d'utilisation d'activation.
• Traduire les besoins des entreprises en histoires d'utilisateurs, flux de processus, exigences fonctionnelles et critères d'acceptation.
• Faciliter les ateliers, les séances de découverte et les activités de collecte d'exigences avec les intervenants mondiaux et affiliés.
• Appuyer les activités de perfectionnement et de hiérarchisation des arriérés auprès des propriétaires de produits et des équipes de livraison. Engagement d'affiliation & Adoption Omnicanal
• Agir comme point de contact clé pour les équipes affiliées qui adoptent des capacités omnicanales.
• Comprendre les processus d'affaires d'affiliation, les points de douleur et les exigences spécifiques au marché.
• Appuyer les activités à bord, les démonstrations de capacités, les séances de formation et les efforts de préparation aux affaires.
• Déterminer les possibilités d'améliorer l'adoption, l'efficacité opérationnelle et l'expérience des utilisateurs. Collaboration interfonctionnelle
• Partenaire avec les propriétaires de produits, les architectes de solutions, les ingénieurs, les équipes de données et les fournisseurs pour s'assurer que les exigences opérationnelles sont bien comprises et mises en œuvre.
• Soutenir les activités de test, de validation et d'acceptation des utilisateurs.
• Aider à gérer les dépendances dans les secteurs des affaires, des processus, des données et de la technologie. Amélioration continue
• Analyser les processus d'affaires et identifier les possibilités d'optimisation et de normalisation.
• Contribuer à la documentation, aux pratiques de gouvernance, aux modèles et aux pratiques exemplaires.
• Appuyer les activités de rapport, d'information et de mesure pour évaluer les résultats opérationnels et l'adoption. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un chef de file axé sur la prestation et la collaboration qui est à l'aise dans les domaines des affaires et de la technologie au sein de programmes de transformation d'entreprise à grande échelle. Expérience
• 5+ ans d'expérience en analyse d'affaires, conseil, livraison de produits, CRM, technologie de marketing, engagement Omnichannel, ou domaines de transformation numérique.
• Expérimenter la collecte, l'analyse et la documentation des exigences opérationnelles et les traduire en solutions technologiques évolutives.
• Fortes compétences en gestion des intervenants avec de l'expérience dans la transformation d'entreprise à grande échelle ou des programmes d'engagement numérique.
• Expérience dans les environnements de livraison Agile et collaboration entre les équipes de produits, d'ingénierie et d'affaires.
• Forte compréhension de l'engagement omnicanal, de l'exécution de la campagne, des parcours clients, de la segmentation du public et des flux de travail d'activation.
• Familiarité avec

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Service Delivery Manager, RDT Onsite Europe West (Engineering Manager) you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

Description of the area

Workforce Enablement (WE) is the home for employee facing products, services, and experiences within RDT. We deliver digital tools, drive adoption, and provide the support necessary to enable the entire workforce, wherever they are, every single day.
The Onsite Enablement organization is the heartbeat of our physical presence. We are the bridge between digital strategy and local execution, ensuring that every site—from R&D labs to corporate hubs—operates with seamless, cutting-edge technology services. As part of this team, you will oversee a team of individual contributors who are the primary points of accountability for onsite service excellence, infrastructure stability, and user experience within their respective sites. Our mission is to provide a "frictionless" workplace where technology empowers our people to focus on what matters most: improving patient lives.
This RDT leader is accountable for the people, budget, and services required to deliver a high quality offering for employees.

Job responsibilities

• Team Member Capability and Career Development 

• Focuses on developing engineering team capabilities that align with the immediate project needs and goals and function's overall vision.

• Encourages team members to self-define their career journey and actively enables development opportunities that align with it.

• Removes roadblocks and sets clear, achievable performance goals.

• Ensures the team develops the right skills and healthy internal dynamics to meet current and future challenges.

• Team Health and Sustainability 

• Maintains a sustainable pace of work for the team, balancing delivery goals with team well-being.

• Cultivates healthy team dynamics and collaboration, ensuring psychological safety and open communication.

• Removes impediments that hinder flow or morale, acting as an escalation point for the team.

• Ensures team members are equipped with the necessary, relevant skills and that roles are clearly defined.

• Product and Service Delivery Leadership ⚙️

• Responsible for co-creating the Product / Service Roadmap from a technical perspective, partnering with the Product Manager who is overall responsible.

• Accountable for the team's end-to-end delivery of features as part of the product development, ensuring alignment with the product roadmap and quality standards.

• Sets clear focus and priorities for the team's delivery work, ensuring alignment with product roadmaps.

• Actively removes impediments and roadblocks to progress, escalating when necessary to protect the team's focus.

• Manages and aligns stakeholders' expectations and needs, providing regular updates on progress and risks.

• Creates efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible across teams and functions.

•

La posizione In qualità di Service Delivery Manager, RDT Onsite Europe West (Engineering Manager) ti concentrerai sullo sviluppo delle funzionalità dei membri del tuo team che si allineano alla visione della funzione. Incoraggiate il vostro team a autodefinire il loro viaggio di carriera e cercare modi per consentire opportunità di sviluppo nella direzione del viaggio. Li supporterete nella rimozione dei blocchi stradali e impostando l'attenzione nella loro gestione delle prestazioni. Assicurati di sviluppare il tuo team con le giuste competenze, dinamiche sane e un ritmo sostenibile. Supporti il software e/o la fornitura di servizi come un focus di impostazione leader, la rimozione di impedimenti, la gestione delle parti interessate e la creazione di efficienze in collaborazione dove possibile. Descrizione della zona Workforce Enablement (WE) è la casa per i dipendenti che affrontano prodotti, servizi e esperienze all'interno di RDT. Forniamo strumenti digitali, adottiamo e forniamo il supporto necessario per consentire l'intera forza lavoro, ovunque si trovino, ogni singolo giorno. L'organizzazione Insite Enablement è il battito cardiaco della nostra presenza fisica. Siamo il ponte tra la strategia digitale e l'esecuzione locale, assicurando che ogni sito, dai laboratori R&D ai hub aziendali, funzioni con servizi tecnologici all'avanguardia. Nell'ambito di questo team, supervisionerai un team di singoli collaboratori che sono i principali punti di responsabilità per l'eccellenza dei servizi in loco, la stabilità delle infrastrutture e l'esperienza degli utenti all'interno dei rispettivi siti. La nostra missione è quella di fornire un luogo di lavoro "a frizione" in cui la tecnologia consente al nostro popolo di concentrarsi su ciò che conta di più: migliorare la vita dei pazienti. Questo leader RDT è responsabile per le persone, budget e servizi necessari per fornire un'offerta di alta qualità per i dipendenti. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Team Member Capability and Career Development 
• Si concentra sullo sviluppo di capacità di team ingegneristici che si allineano alle esigenze e agli obiettivi e alla visione generale della funzione.
• Incoraggia i membri del team a autodefinire il loro viaggio di carriera e consente attivamente opportunità di sviluppo che si allineano con esso.
• Rimuove i blocchi stradali e imposta obiettivi di performance chiari e realizzabili.
• Assicura che il team sviluppi le giuste competenze e dinamiche interne sane per soddisfare le sfide attuali e future.
• Salute e sostenibilità del team
• Mantiene un ritmo di lavoro sostenibile per il team, bilanciando gli obiettivi di consegna con il benessere del team.
• Coltiva dinamiche e collaborazione di team sane, garantendo sicurezza psicologica e comunicazione aperta.
• Rimuove gli impedimenti che ostacolano il flusso o il morale, agendo come punto di escalation per la squadra.
• Assicura che i membri del team siano dotati delle competenze necessarie, pertinenti e che i ruoli siano chiaramente definiti.
• Leadership del prodotto e del servizio ⚙️
• Responsabile per la co-creazione di Product / Service Roadmap da un punto di vista tecnico, collaborando con il Product Manager che è responsabile generale.
• Affidabile per la consegna end-to-end del team di funzionalità come parte dello sviluppo del prodotto, garantendo l'allineamento con la roadmap del prodotto e gli standard di qualità.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As Service Delivery Manager, RDT Onsite Europe West (Engineering Manager) you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

Description of the area

Workforce Enablement (WE) is the home for employee facing products, services, and experiences within RDT. We deliver digital tools, drive adoption, and provide the support necessary to enable the entire workforce, wherever they are, every single day.
The Onsite Enablement organization is the heartbeat of our physical presence. We are the bridge between digital strategy and local execution, ensuring that every site—from R&D labs to corporate hubs—operates with seamless, cutting-edge technology services. As part of this team, you will oversee a team of individual contributors who are the primary points of accountability for onsite service excellence, infrastructure stability, and user experience within their respective sites. Our mission is to provide a "frictionless" workplace where technology empowers our people to focus on what matters most: improving patient lives.
This RDT leader is accountable for the people, budget, and services required to deliver a high quality offering for employees.

Job responsibilities

• Team Member Capability and Career Development 

• Focuses on developing engineering team capabilities that align with the immediate project needs and goals and function's overall vision.

• Encourages team members to self-define their career journey and actively enables development opportunities that align with it.

• Removes roadblocks and sets clear, achievable performance goals.

• Ensures the team develops the right skills and healthy internal dynamics to meet current and future challenges.

• Team Health and Sustainability 

• Maintains a sustainable pace of work for the team, balancing delivery goals with team well-being.

• Cultivates healthy team dynamics and collaboration, ensuring psychological safety and open communication.

• Removes impediments that hinder flow or morale, acting as an escalation point for the team.

• Ensures team members are equipped with the necessary, relevant skills and that roles are clearly defined.

• Product and Service Delivery Leadership ⚙️

• Responsible for co-creating the Product / Service Roadmap from a technical perspective, partnering with the Product Manager who is overall responsible.

• Accountable for the team's end-to-end delivery of features as part of the product development, ensuring alignment with the product roadmap and quality standards.

• Sets clear focus and priorities for the team's delivery work, ensuring alignment with product roadmaps.

• Actively removes impediments and roadblocks to progress, escalating when necessary to protect the team's focus.

• Manages and aligns stakeholders' expectations and needs, providing regular updates on progress and risks.

• Creates efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible across teams and functions.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Head of Technology Accounts and Software Asset Management

The Head of Technology Vendor Management & Software Asset Management will lead RDT’s strategic technology vendor governance and Software Asset Management practice across a complex global technology landscape.

The role covers vendors across software, SaaS, cloud, platforms, on-premise infrastructure, infrastructure services and managed services. It is accountable for creating a transparent, stable, commercially disciplined and risk-managed vendor ecosystem.
This is a senior leadership role with responsibility for a large-scale technology vendor portfolio representing several hundred million CHF in spend and a team of around a dozen professionals.
The role combines vendor governance, SAM, licensing compliance, vendor risk management, service performance, operational stability, commercial oversight and senior stakeholder engagement.

Description of the area

Technology Vendor Management & Software Asset Management ensures that RDT’s critical technology vendors operate within clear standards, controls and performance expectations.
The function owns vendor governance frameworks and the SAM operating model, covering vendor lifecycle management, service performance, risk monitoring, license compliance, spend transparency and value realization.
It partners with RDT functions, IT, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Security, Architecture and Operations to ensure technology vendor relationships are compliant, stable, cost-effective and aligned with enterprise priorities.

Job responsibilities:

• Lead the Technology Vendor Management and Software Asset Management function, including strategy, operating model, standards, governance forums and team development.

• Govern a high-value technology vendor ecosystem across software, SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, platform and managed service providers.

• Define and implement baseline standards for technology vendor management, including SLAs, governance blueprint, escalation model, performance expectations and minimum control requirements.

• Own the SAM roadmap and lifecycle governance across entitlement, deployment, usage, compliance, optimization and remediation.

• Define and implement the technology vendor lifecycle model, from onboarding and classification through performance management, risk monitoring, renewal governance and exit planning.

• Establish dashboards and reporting for RDT leadership covering vendor performance, SAM status, license compliance, risk exposure, operational stability and key actions.

• Lead or coordinate vendor audit defense and remediation of licensing, contractual or compliance deviations.

• Drive software and technology spend optimization through usage analysis, renewal governance, license harvesting, reclaim, rightsizing, contract review and demand alignment.

• Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on vendor risk, software compliance, licensing exposure, operational stability and technology vendor value.

Qualifications:

• 10+ years of experience in Technology Vendor Management, Software Asset Management, IT Asset Management, supplier governance, software licensing, IT sourcing, technology procurement, service provider management or enterprise IT governance.

• Proven experience governing large-scale technology vendor portfolios involving complex contracts, critical vendors, material spend and senior stakeholder accountability.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Capo dei conti tecnologici e della gestione dei beni software Responsabile dei conti tecnologici e della gestione patrimoniale software (Practice Leader) è responsabile per la gestione integrata dei principali account tecnologici (Platform, Cloud e fornitori di software) e della pratica Software Asset Management (SAM). Potrai guidare un team responsabile per ottimizzare la spesa tecnologica, massimizzare il ROI e garantire una rigorosa conformità della licenza attraverso il paesaggio RDT. Questo ruolo richiede un mix distintivo di competenza tecnica negli stack tecnologici moderni e una profonda esperienza nel software di licensing e asset governance. Descrizione dell'Area Asset Management & Technology Accounts gestisce il ciclo di vita dei beni tecnologici di RDT. Questo include la governance dei principali partner tecnologici (ad esempio SAP, AWS, Microsoft) e l'esecuzione dei processi SAM per garantire la conformità e l'ottimizzazione finanziaria. Questa sotto-funzione garantisce che queste partnership di alto livello forniscono il massimo valore attraverso la governance strutturata, la gestione dei rischi e i quadri di miglioramento continuo. Mansioni - SAM Governance: proprio la roadmap funzionale per la gestione del patrimonio software. Assicurare l'intero ciclo di vita dei beni software è gestito per mantenere la conformità e minimizzare il rischio. - Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve come il principale contatto per i partner interni, gestendo attivamente le relazioni e le aspettative circa le prestazioni e i consegnabili della (sub-)funzione. Funziona a stretto contatto con le parti interessate IT e gli utenti interni per identificare, prioritizzare e affrontare le esigenze delle politiche, la loro operativizzazione e controlli associati. - Strategia dell'account tecnologico: Allineare le roadmap della tecnologia con l'architettura moderna (Cloud, AI/ML, SaaS) in ambienti regolamentati. - Asset Compliance: Guidare le valutazioni di rischio di tecnologia a livello aziendale e garantire una tempestiva bonifica dei risultati o delle deviazioni di licenze. - Esecuzione Operativa: implementare e supervisionare strumenti e processi per il monitoraggio dell'utilizzo e del diritto di licenza. - Eccellenza Operativa: Definire e monitorare i KPI/OKR per analizzare le prestazioni del fornitore. Utilizzare i dati per migliorare continuamente e ottimizzare il modello di consegna del servizio. - Team Leadership: Guidare e sviluppare un team di manager di account fornitori altamente performanti. Personale di mentore e garantire l'allineamento delle risorse con i requisiti di progetto RDT. - Influenza e collaborazione: collaborare a stretto contatto con Architettura, Sicurezza e Finanza per garantire che le piattaforme tecnologiche supportino in modo efficiente i processi aziendali critici.
• Requisiti - Istruzione/Esperienza: 10+ anni in IT Asset Management, Technology Sourcing o IT Operations. È richiesta un'esperienza di leadership in team multidisciplinari globali. - Competenze Funzionali: Forte comprensione dei paesaggi tecnologici moderni (Cloud, DevOps, Piattaforme digitali). Conoscenza esperta delle strutture SAM e dei principali modelli di licenza del fornitore. - Leadership: Capacità di condurre attraverso l'influenza e la partnership. Forte capacità di mentore un team tecnico in un ecosistema di stakeholder complesso e globale. Cosa? - Gamma di insalata 23.300 - 43.300 PLN lordo basato sul contratto di lavoro. - Pagamento bonus annuale in base alle tue prestazioni (target 20%). - Indennità di automobile o di automobile. - Bilancio di formazione dedicato (formazione, certificazioni, conferenze, percorsi di carriera diversificati ecc.). - Ricarica venerdì (2 venerdì per trimestre disponibile). - Prenda tempo Programma (fino a 3 mesi di congedo da utilizzare per qualsiasi scopo). - Sovvenzione per le vacanze disponibile. - Posizione Flex (possibilità) Contatto *(Nessun recapito fornito nel testo originale)*

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
Routine Operation:

• Perform the microbiological testing on the samples from incoming raw materials and packaging materials, produced bulks and products, environment monitoring, process validation and cleaning validation, etc. Issue the reliable analytical report in reasonable lead time.

• Adhere to all effective SOPs and safety requirements and document laboratory work consistent with cGMP requirements

• Assist Head of Microbiology lab to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance.

• Presents technical analytical data clearly and concisely data to internal investigations and regulatory inspectors.

• Accomplish the calibration and maintenance of assigned instruments, to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time.

• Report the abnormal status, unexpected results to supervisors with initiative.
● By reporting abnormal status and unexpected results during analysis processing by detailed data and information to alert supervisor to investigate and solve the problem in correct way and in time.

• Maintain laboratory cleanliness and inventory of microbiology supplies

• Supports lean initiatives in the area of lab operations, test method execution, documentation updates and equipment qualification
Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness:

• CCS Support: Support the establishment of the Contamination Control Strategy (CCS) for the aseptic production line.

• Environmental Monitoring (EM): Support EMPQ execution according to the project timeline.

• Microbiology Method Validation: Support the microbiology methods transfer, including supporting the confirmation of cleaning and disinfection processes, and the efficacy of disinfectants.

• Equipment Support: Support the Performance Qualification (PQ) of laboratory equipment and ensure routine operation.

Qualification and Experience 能力与经验
Education/Qualifications
● Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above

Job Required Competencies
● 2 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on microbiology and aseptic processes. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred
● Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance and microbiological testing.
● Experienced in QC new facility startup readiness and operation ramp up is preferred.
● Fluent communications skills in English
● Project management skills are preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Assist Head of Microbiology lab per completare GMP Self-Inspection e la relativa CAPAs per mantenere il livello globale di conformità GMP.

• Mantenere la pulizia del laboratorio e l'inventario delle forniture di microbiologia
• Supporta iniziative magre nel campo delle operazioni di laboratorio, esecuzione dei metodi di prova, aggiornamento della documentazione e qualificazione delle attrezzature Supporto del progetto di ingegneria e la disponibilità di funzionamento:
• Supporto CCS: Supporta la creazione della strategia di controllo delle contaminazioni (CCS) per la linea di produzione asetica.
• Monitoraggio ambientale (EM): Supporta l'esecuzione EMPQ in base alla timeline del progetto.
• Metodo di Microbiologia Validazione: Supporta il trasferimento dei metodi di microbiologia, incluso il supporto alla conferma dei processi di pulizia e disinfezione, e l'efficacia dei disinfettanti.
• Supporto per l'attrezzatura: Sostenere le qualifiche di prestazione (PQ) delle attrezzature di laboratorio e garantire il funzionamento di routine. Qualificazione e esperienza Istruzione/Qualifiche ● Corso di laurea (scienze di vita, microbiologia, o scienze analitiche è preferito) e sopra Competenze richieste ● 2 o più anni di esperienza QC, esperienza QC, con un focus sulla microbiologia e processi asettici. L'esperienza MNC Biopharma è preferita ● Conoscenza sonora delle procedure di controllo della qualità e degli standard legali, con esperienza nella garanzia asettica e test microbiologici. ● Esperienza in QC nuova disponibilità di avvio della struttura e la rampa di funzionamento è preferito. ● Capacità di comunicazione fluida in inglese ● Le competenze di gestione del progetto sono preferite. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro di parità di opportunità.

jobs.title: Digital Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to bring structured thinking, execution, and focus to digitalization in procurement, unlocking new levels of automation and self-service for global operations? As our Digital Enablement Manager, located in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will proactively identify and drive digital opportunities that support our needs and positively impact process efficiency. Acting as a true ambassador for procurement digitization, you will provide strategic thought leadership in a dynamic global environment to ensure digital tools are seamlessly aligned with our overall business objectives.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Digital & Process Management Lead and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You will manage cross-functional relationships across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Category, DOP Delivery, IT, external providers, and internal stakeholders (e.g., process managers and owners).

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role focused on digital enablement, stakeholder advisory, and transformation governance.

• Impact: You drive global operational efficiency, process compliance, and large-scale digital adoption. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Digital Strategy & Roadmap: Developing and governing the digital enablement strategy, setting clear objectives, timelines, and Performance Indicators to monitor the impact of digital tools on procurement outcomes.

• Technology Assessment: Researching and evaluating emerging technologies (AI, Machine Learning, RPA) to enhance procurement processes. Conducting pilot programs to test feasibility and aligning initiatives across functions.

• Stakeholder Advisory & Management: Acting as a trusted advisor to business units and IT, understanding their unique priorities, and fostering an inclusive, collaborative approach to digital transformation.

• AI Pipeline: Spearheading our AI transformation by coordinating and/or building cutting-edge AI solutions in close collaboration with RSS Demand to Pay and Roche Digital Technology (RDT).

• Value Communication: Highlighting the ROI and impact of digital initiatives by developing and delivering data-driven presentations, success stories, and progress reports to senior stakeholders.

• Process Improvement: Conducting thorough analyses of current procurement activities to pinpoint inefficiencies or bottlenecks, using data to prioritize areas for digital intervention and automation.

• Implementation & Adoption: Guiding digitalization projects and solution deployments by creating clear roadmaps. Acting as a liaison with external partners to ensure accurate requirements and promoting seamless adoption by making digitalization "easy to understand for everyone" through targeted training and communication.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to bring structured thinking, execution, and focus to digitalization in procurement, unlocking new levels of automation and self-service for global operations? As our Digital Enablement Manager, located in Sant Cugat, Spain, you will proactively identify and drive digital opportunities that support our needs and positively impact process efficiency. Acting as a true ambassador for procurement digitization, you will provide strategic thought leadership in a dynamic global environment to ensure digital tools are seamlessly aligned with our overall business objectives.

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to the Digital & Process Management Lead and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You will manage cross-functional relationships across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Category, DOP Delivery, IT, external providers, and internal stakeholders (e.g., process managers and owners).

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role focused on digital enablement, stakeholder advisory, and transformation governance.

• Impact: You drive global operational efficiency, process compliance, and large-scale digital adoption. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Digital Strategy & Roadmap: Developing and governing the digital enablement strategy, setting clear objectives, timelines, and Performance Indicators to monitor the impact of digital tools on procurement outcomes.

• Technology Assessment: Researching and evaluating emerging technologies (AI, Machine Learning, RPA) to enhance procurement processes. Conducting pilot programs to test feasibility and aligning initiatives across functions.

• Stakeholder Advisory & Management: Acting as a trusted advisor to business units and IT, understanding their unique priorities, and fostering an inclusive, collaborative approach to digital transformation.

• AI Pipeline: Spearheading our AI transformation by coordinating and/or building cutting-edge AI solutions in close collaboration with RSS Demand to Pay and Roche Digital Technology (RDT).

• Value Communication: Highlighting the ROI and impact of digital initiatives by developing and delivering data-driven presentations, success stories, and progress reports to senior stakeholders.

• Process Improvement: Conducting thorough analyses of current procurement activities to pinpoint inefficiencies or bottlenecks, using data to prioritize areas for digital intervention and automation.

• Implementation & Adoption: Guiding digitalization projects and solution deployments by creating clear roadmaps. Acting as a liaison with external partners to ensure accurate requirements and promoting seamless adoption by making digitalization "easy to understand for everyone" through targeted training and communication.

Who you are

• Reporting Line: Reports directly to our Sourcing Lead and is part of the Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: Leads a global Business Capability Community formed by SMEs. You will manage cross-functional relationships across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Delivery, DOP Sourcing Teams, RSS Demand to Pay, Global Procurement, and external technology providers.

• Role Type: As BCL, you represent DOP`s business interests globally in relevant forums, and you are responsible for the development and continuous improvement of DOP`s procure-to-pay strategy.

• Impact: You drive global operational efficiency, process compliance, and large-scale digital adoption. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Process Design & Strategy: Developing and deploying the DOP roadmap for myBuy, in alignment with functional partners like DIA Global Supply Chain and RSS Demand to Pay.

• Automation & Innovation: Proactively identifying opportunities for process automation and digitalization in close collaboration with Delivery, Category, Digital & Process Management, and RSS Demand to Pay.

• SME Analysis & Governance: Acting as a deep subject matter expert to analyze, elaborate options, and design solutions that resolve process, system, performance indicator, or data concerns, while supporting data and rule definitions.

• Transformation Project Delegation: Serving as a responsible delegate on major corporate initiatives (such as the ASPIRE program; our overarching process and digital transformation) to support global template adoption and evaluate localized change impacts.

• Continuous Improvement: Leading continuous improvement initiatives, managing global requirement alignment, and partnering with fellow BCLs and Business Capability Owners (BCOs) to optimize end-to-end cross-functional performance.

• Community & ARTS Representation: Leading the Business Capability Community of SMEs and representing DOP in communities and Agile Release Trains (ARTs).

• Knowledge Management: Governing the development, structural maintenance, and delivery of global system process doc
