Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Über unser Team Wir bei Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) sind ein Team von rund 200 begeisterten Fachleuten, die sich dafür einsetzen, mit unseren Lieferanten weltweit Wert zu schaffen. Von Standorten auf der ganzen Welt und mit einem vielfältigen und multikulturellen Team beziehen, verwalten wir unsere Lieferantenbasis, entwickeln und führen Kategoriestrategien aus und entwickeln und digitalisieren ständig Prozesse, die es uns ermöglichen, unser Geschäft bestmöglich zu unterstützen, um nachhaltig zu wachsen. Wenn Sie etwas bewirken möchten und Teil eines leistungsstarken und erstklassigen Beschaffungsteams sein möchten, ist dies das Richtige für Sie. Wir sind DOP. Bei Roche tun wir jetzt, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, die globale digitale Prozesslandschaft zu gestalten und die strategische Optimierung von Systemen zu leiten, die unsere globalen End-to-End-Beschaffungsprozesse vorantreiben? Als Business Capability Lead (BCL) mit Sitz in Sant Cugat, Spanien, übernehmen Sie strategische und operative Verantwortung für kritische Segmente der globalen Demand-to-Pay-Prozesslandschaft. In dieser einflussreichen Rolle definieren Sie Prozess-Governance, integrieren komplexe Schnittstellen in Unternehmens-Ökosysteme und dienen als wichtiger Change Agent, um die Einführung der myBuy-Lösung im gesamten Unternehmen zu beschleunigen. myBuy ist die digitale Beschaffungsplattform von Roche, die den Procure-to-Pay-Prozess durch Transparenz, zeitnahe Transaktionen und Automatisierung für unsere Einkaufsaktivitäten verbessern soll.
• Reporting Line: Berichtet direkt an unseren Sourcing Lead und ist Teil des Procurement Center of Excellence (CoE).
• Breiteres Team und Stakeholder: Leitet eine globale Business Capability Community, die von KMU gebildet wird. Sie verwalten funktionsübergreifende Beziehungen zwischen dem DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), CoE LT, DOP Delivery, DOP Sourcing Teams, RSS Demand to Pay, Global Procurement und externen Technologieanbietern.
• Rollentyp: Als BCL vertreten Sie die Geschäftsinteressen von DOP weltweit in relevanten Foren und sind für die Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Procure-to-Pay-Strategie von DOP verantwortlich.
• Auswirkungen: Sie fördern die globale Betriebseffizienz, die Compliance von Prozessen und die groß angelegte digitale Einführung. Insbesondere sind Sie verantwortlich für:
• Prozessdesign & Strategie: Entwicklung und Bereitstellung der DOP-Roadmap für myBuy in Abstimmung mit funktionalen Partnern wie DIA Global Supply Chain und RSS Demand to Pay.
• Automation & Innovation: Proaktive Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten für Prozessautomatisierung und Digitalisierung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Delivery, Category, Digital & Process Management und RSS Demand to Pay.
• KMU-Analyse und -Governance: Als tiefer Fachexperte fungieren, um Optionen zu analysieren, auszuarbeiten und Lösungen zu entwerfen, die Prozess-, System-, Leistungsindikator- oder Datenprobleme lösen und gleichzeitig Daten- und Regeldefinitionen unterstützen.
• Transformationsprojektdelegation: Als verantwortlicher Delegierter bei wichtigen Unternehmensinitiativen (wie dem ASPIRE-Programm, unserem übergreifenden Prozess und der digitalen Transformation) zur Unterstützung der globalen Vorlageneinführung und zur Bewertung der Auswirkungen lokalisierter Veränderungen.
• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Leitung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsinitiativen, Verwaltung der globalen Anforderungsausrichtung und Partnerschaft mit anderen BCLs und Business Capability Ownern (BCOs), um die durchgängige funktionsübergreifende Leistung zu optimieren.
• Community & ARTS Representation: Leitung der Business Capability Community von KMU und Vertretung von DOP in Communities und Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
• Wissensmanagement: Steuerung der Entwicklung, strukturellen Wartung und Lieferung von globalen Systemprozess Doc
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À propos de notre équipe Chez Global Diagnostics Approvisionnement (DOP), nous sommes une équipe d'environ 200 professionnels enthousiastes, engagés à la valeur de la conduite avec nos fournisseurs dans le monde entier. De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécutons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour se développer durablement. Si vous aspirez à faire un impact et voulez faire partie d'une équipe d'approvisionnement de haut niveau et de classe mondiale, c'est pour vous. Nous sommes DOP. Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à concevoir le paysage des processus numériques mondiaux et à diriger l'optimisation stratégique des systèmes qui pilotent nos opérations d'approvisionnement mondial de bout en bout? En tant que chef de file en matière de capacités d'affaires (BCL) situé à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous assumerez la responsabilité stratégique et opérationnelle de segments critiques du paysage mondial des processus de demande à paiement. Dans ce rôle à fort impact, vous définirez la gouvernance des processus, intégrerez des interfaces complexes entre les écosystèmes d'entreprise et servirez d'agent de changement vital pour accélérer l'adoption de la solution myBuy dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise. myBuy est la plateforme d'approvisionnement numérique de Roche, conçue pour améliorer le processus d'approvisionnement à la paye en fournissant la transparence, les transactions en temps opportun et l'automatisation pour nos opérations d'achat.
• Ligne hiérarchique : relève directement de notre responsable d'approvisionnement et fait partie du Centre d'excellence en approvisionnement (CdE).
• Équipe élargie et parties prenantes : dirige une communauté mondiale des capacités d'affaires formée par les PME. Vous gérerez les relations interfonctionnelles entre l'équipe de leadership du DOP (DPLT), le COE LT, la livraison du DOP, les équipes d'approvisionnement du DOP, la demande de paiement du RSS, les fournisseurs de technologie mondiaux et externes.
• Type de rôle: En tant que BCL, vous représentez les intérêts commerciaux de DOP à l'échelle mondiale dans les forums pertinents, et vous êtes responsable du développement et de l'amélioration continue de la stratégie d'achat à paiement de DOP.
• Impact: Vous dirigez l'efficacité opérationnelle mondiale, la conformité des processus et l'adoption numérique à grande échelle. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Conception et stratégie des processus : Élaborer et déployer la feuille de route DOP pour myBuy, en accord avec des partenaires fonctionnels comme DIA Global Supply Chain et RSS Demand to Pay.
• Automatisation et innovation: identifier proactivement les possibilités d'automatisation des processus et de numérisation en étroite collaboration avec la livraison, la catégorie, la gestion numérique et des processus, et la demande de RSS à payer.
• Analyse et gouvernance des PME : agir en tant qu'expert en matière profonde pour analyser, élaborer des options et concevoir des solutions qui résolvent les problèmes de processus, de système, d'indicateur de rendement ou de données, tout en appuyant les définitions des données et des règles.
• Délégation de projet de transformation : Être un délégué responsable des grandes initiatives ministérielles (comme le programme ASPIRE; notre processus global et la transformation numérique) pour appuyer l'adoption de modèles mondiaux et évaluer les impacts du changement localisé.
• Amélioration continue : Diriger des initiatives d'amélioration continue, gérer l'alignement des besoins à l'échelle mondiale et établir des partenariats avec d'autres BCL et propriétaires de capacités d'affaires (BCO) pour optimiser les performances interfonctionnelles de bout en bout.
• Représentation de la communauté et des ARTS : Diriger la communauté des capacités d'affaires des PME et représenter le DOP dans les collectivités et les trains de libération Agile.
• Gestion des connaissances: encadrement du développement, de l'entretien structurel et de la mise en œuvre des processus du système mondial

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。

A 规范诊疗

• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品相关的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识

• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案，运用专业知识，协助合理使用药品，助力生态圈内诊断准确度和治疗规范度的提升

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息

B 学科建设

• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集，并进行总结、分析和反馈

• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议活动，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范

C 疾病全程管理

• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

我们期待这样的您加入:

• 3年以上医药行业工作经验

• 既往有销售/市场/医学经验

• 跨职能工作经验为佳

• 具有卓越合规意识

教育程度/所获资格证书
医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Sourcing Lead - APAC
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
Are you ready to lead the strategic gateway that bridges APAC innovation with global healthcare demand? As our Asia Sourcing Office Lead in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, you will drive global sourcing and operational excellence for DOP. In this role, you will lead a dedicated regional team across APAC, champion digital procurement transformation, and navigate complex global markets to ensure our supply networks remain highly competitive and resilient.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Head of Procurement Centre of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You are accountable for leading, coaching, and developing a global, cross-cultural matrix team of up to 15 Sourcing Managers and one Business Capability Lead. You manage key interfaces across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), DOP Category, DOP Delivery, RSS Demand to Pay, and external suppliers.

• Role Type: A leadership position evenly split between strategic category alignment and tactical sourcing execution, focusing on regional sourcing expertise and talent empowerment.

• Impact: You drive global sourcing excellence, financial value, and digital governance across APAC. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics (PPV, preferred supplier share, cycle times), tracking stakeholder/supplier satisfaction, and managing your team's OPEX budget.

• Asia Sourcing Office Mandate: Finding potential suppliers across Asia, executing initial due diligence, and conducting targeted regional benchmarking.

• Sourcing & Analysis: Overseeing compliant global and regional sourcing, benchmarking (RfX), and detailed procurement analyses alongside NPI and Delivery managers.

• Contracts & SLAs: Ensuring template-based contract execution (CDAs, SOWs), repository health, and defining KPIs to guarantee on-time, in-full (OTIF) portfolio delivery.

• myBuy Governance: Serving as Business Capability Lead (BCL) to drive platform governance, policy, continuous improvement, and knowledge management alongside RSS.

• Conflict & Exposure: Resolving matrix priority and supplier selection conflicts, representing DOP at external events, and delivering monthly/quarterly updates to executive leadership (CoE, Category, Delivery, and DPLT).

Who you are
We look for leaders who can drive high-performance cultures, break down silos, and eliminate operational friction.

• Education: University degree (Business/Life Sciences required); MBA and CIPS certification highly preferred.

• Experience: 5-7+ years in Direct Procurement (Medtech, Automotive, etc.), including 3-5 years within a Shared Service or CoE environment.

• Market Expertise: Strong regional sourcing and NPI experience across complex direct categories (EMS/e-components, Plastics/Packaging, or Biologics/Chemicals).

The Position
We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
Are you ready to lead the strategic gateway that bridges APAC innovation with global healthcare demand? As our Asia Sourcing Office Lead in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, you will drive global sourcing and operational excellence for DOP. In this role, you will lead a dedicated regional team across APAC, champion digital procurement transformation, and navigate complex global markets to ensure our supply networks remain highly competitive and resilient.

• Reporting Line: The position directly reports to the Head of Procurement Centre of Excellence (CoE).

• Wider team and stakeholders: You are accountable for leading, coaching, and developing a global, cross-cultural matrix team of up to 15 Sourcing Managers and one Business Capability Lead. You manage key interfaces across the DOP Leadership Team (DPLT), DOP Category, DOP Delivery, RSS Demand to Pay, and external suppliers.

• Role Type: A leadership position evenly split between strategic category alignment and tactical sourcing execution, focusing on regional sourcing expertise and talent empowerment.

• Impact: You drive global sourcing excellence, financial value, and digital governance across APAC. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Performance & Savings: Driving key metrics (PPV, preferred supplier share, cycle times), tracking stakeholder/supplier satisfaction, and managing your team's OPEX budget.

• Asia Sourcing Office Mandate: Finding potential suppliers across Asia, executing initial due diligence, and conducting targeted regional benchmarking.

• Sourcing & Analysis: Overseeing compliant global and regional sourcing, benchmarking (RfX), and detailed procurement analyses alongside NPI and Delivery managers.

• Contracts & SLAs: Ensuring template-based contract execution (CDAs, SOWs), repository health, and defining KPIs to guarantee on-time, in-full (OTIF) portfolio delivery.

• myBuy Governance: Serving as Business Capability Lead (BCL) to drive platform governance, policy, continuous improvement, and knowledge management alongside RSS.

• Conflict & Exposure: Resolving matrix priority and supplier selection conflicts, representing DOP at external events, and delivering monthly/quarterly updates to executive leadership (CoE, Category, Delivery, and DPLT).

Who you are
We look for leaders who can drive high-performance cultures, break down silos, and eliminate operational friction.

• Experience: 5-7+ years in Direct Procurement (Medtech, Automotive, etc.), including 3-5 years within a Shared Service or CoE environment.

• AI & Digitalization: You have a strong affinity to explore AI-driven solutions broadly, particularly regard

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team
We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity
Are you ready to architect the overarching global procurement strategy and command the end-to-end supplier networks for the electronic components that power our next-generation diagnostic devices? As our Global Category Manager for e-Components in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, you will take ultimate accountability for developing strategies and leading strategic initiatives for this critical spend category. In this role, you will manage top-tier electronic component suppliers, navigate global supply chain complexities, and translate category goals into bottom-line value creation.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the Senior Global Category Lead Electronics & Systems within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Engages directly with cross-functional teams composed of representatives from Category, Delivery, Procurement Center of Excellence, and global business partners. Serves as a key business partner contact point for senior functional and business stakeholders.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role with global category leadership position focused on strategic vision, category development, pipeline building, and relationship ecosystem management

• Impact: You deliver commercial impact by anchoring cost and developing a resilience pipeline of projects, in addition to securing our sustainability priorities. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, supplier data, and business requirements to formulate a formalized, global Category Strategy and initiative pipeline, to be aligned with leaders across the organization.

• Commercial Negotiations: Leading high-value commercial and contractual negotiations for strategic suppliers within the category.

• Supplier Ecosystems: Managing key global suppliers, establishing development and innovation programs, monitoring value targets, and managing supplier risks.

• Guidance & Content: Developing and maintaining category guidance documents to translate strategy into clear, executable content for procurement colleagues and business users.

• Business Partnering: Building deep relationships with senior stakeholders, challenging demand/specifications to maximize value, and managing risk/CSR reviews.

• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching procurement colleagues, providing professional development, managing a shared Associate Category Manager within the team, and tracking budget spend.

Who you are
We look for strategic procurement champions with extensive knowledge of global electronics supply markets and the matrix leadership skills needed to drive complex organizational change.

• Education: University degree required (Business or Life Sciences focus preferred); a post-graduate business-related qualification is preferred.

• Experience: 5+ years of in-depth strategic and operational procurement experience with extensive knowled

En tant que Global Category Manager pour e-Components à Kuala Lumpur, en Malaisie, vous serez responsable de l'élaboration de stratégies et des initiatives stratégiques pour cette catégorie de dépenses critiques. Dans ce rôle, vous gérerez des fournisseurs de composants électroniques de premier ordre, naviguerez dans les complexités de la chaîne d'approvisionnement mondiale et traduireez les objectifs de catégorie en création de valeur de base.
• Ligne hiérarchique : relève directement de l'organisation principale de la catégorie Global Lead Electronics & Systems au sein de la catégorie.
• Équipe élargie et parties prenantes : S'engage directement auprès d'équipes interfonctionnelles composées de représentants de la catégorie, de la livraison, du centre d'excellence en achats et de partenaires commerciaux mondiaux. Il sert de point de contact principal des partenaires commerciaux pour les principaux intervenants fonctionnels et commerciaux.
• Type de rôle : Un participant individuel occupant un poste de dirigeant de catégorie mondiale axé sur la vision stratégique, l'élaboration de catégories, la construction de pipelines et la gestion des rapports écosystémiques
• Impact: Vous produisez un impact commercial en ancrage des coûts et en développant un pipeline de résilience de projets, en plus de garantir nos priorités de durabilité. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Stratégie et pipeline annuel : Rassembler les renseignements sur le marché, les données sur les fournisseurs et les exigences opérationnelles pour formuler un pipeline officiel de la catégorie mondiale et de l'initiative, qui sera aligné sur les dirigeants de l'ensemble de l'organisation.
• Négociations commerciales : Mener des négociations commerciales et contractuelles de grande valeur pour les fournisseurs stratégiques de la catégorie.
• Écosystèmes fournisseurs : Gestion des principaux fournisseurs mondiaux, établissement de programmes de développement et d'innovation, surveillance des objectifs de valeur et gestion des risques pour les fournisseurs.
• Orientation et contenu : Élaborer et tenir à jour des documents d'orientation de catégorie afin de traduire la stratégie en contenu clair et exécutable pour les collègues en approvisionnement et les utilisateurs commerciaux.
• Partenariat d'affaires : Établir des relations étroites avec les intervenants de haut niveau, mettre en doute la demande et les particularités afin de maximiser la valeur et gérer les examens des risques et des RCS.
• Surveillance de l'équipe et du budget : Encadrer les collègues en approvisionnement, assurer le perfectionnement professionnel, gérer un gestionnaire de catégorie associé partagé au sein de l'équipe et suivre les dépenses budgétaires. Qui vous êtes Nous recherchons des champions stratégiques en matière d'approvisionnement qui possèdent une vaste connaissance des marchés mondiaux de l'approvisionnement en électronique et des compétences de leadership matricielle nécessaires pour favoriser un changement organisationnel complexe.
• Études : Diplôme universitaire requis (priorité de l'accent sur les affaires ou les sciences de la vie); une qualification liée aux affaires de troisième cycle est préférée.
• Expérience: 5 ans et plus d'expérience approfondie en matière d'approvisionnement stratégique et opérationnel avec une connaissance approfondie

jobs.title: Sales Specialist Core Lab - Cataluña
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
¿Te apasiona conectar la innovación científica con la eficiencia hospitalaria? Buscamos un/a Sales Specialist Core para liderar y expandir nuestra presencia en el territorio de Cataluña. En este rol, serás el socio estratégico de los laboratorios y centros sanitarios de la región, estableciendo relaciones de confianza profunda y comprendiendo los retos del ecosistema de salud local.
Tu misión será impulsar el éxito del negocio basándote en la innovación de nuestro porfolio de especialidades diagnósticas y en la optimización de los flujos de trabajo de nuestros clientes. Si tienes una mentalidad estratégica, te apasiona el desarrollo de negocio y quieres transformar la atención al paciente a través de diagnósticos de vanguardia, ¡este es tu lugar!

Your Main Responsibilities

• Ejecución y Estrategia Comercial: Implementar los planes de acción y estrategias definidas en tu zona para alcanzar y superar los objetivos anuales, ganando cuota de mercado y cumpliendo con los KPI del negocio.

• Identificación de Retos y Co-creación: Detectar las necesidades tanto de los profesionales del laboratorio como de las direcciones económicas y gerenciales de los centros, proponiendo soluciones diferenciadoras que aporten un valor real.

• Gestión de Stakeholders (360°): Construir y mantener relaciones estrechas con el personal técnico del laboratorio y con áreas clave del hospital (adquisiciones, finanzas y gestión hospitalaria), garantizando la satisfacción del cliente en todo su ciclo de vida.

• Enlace y Colaboración Interna: Tras la firma de los acuerdos, asegurarás que los equipos y reactivos se implementen a la perfección en los laboratorios, colaborando estrechamente con nuestros equipos de soporte técnico y aplicaciones.

• Expertise y Demostraciones Técnicas: Desarrollar un conocimiento profundo del porfolio de Core Lab , realizando presentaciones y demostraciones de producto de alto impacto que resuelvan las dudas de los clientes y destaquen nuestro valor diferencial.

Who You Are (The skills you need)

Buscamos un perfil dinámico, con un fuerte background técnico o comercial en el sector salud y una alta capacidad de influencia.

• Formación: Licenciatura o Grado en Ciencias de la Salud y/o experiencia demostrada en el sector sanitario. Se valorará positivamente la experiencia previa como técnico/a de laboratorio o en el ámbito de la docencia/formación técnica.

• Apertura al Talento Diverso: En Roche creemos en el valor de las perspectivas únicas; por ello, también valoraremos aquellos perfiles que, aun no cumpliendo estrictamente con la formación o experiencia técnica tradicional, aporten un trasfondo comercial relevante y diferencial para la organización.

• Competencias Clave:

• Alta capacidad estratégica y habilidad técnica y de negocio para navegar en entornos hospitalarios complejos.

• Orientación a la consecución de resultados , con autonomía y toma de decisiones ágiles.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación , con capacidad de inspiración e influencia .

• Mentalidad colaborativa, fuerte orientación al trabajo en equipo y apertura para dar y recibir feedback y coaching .

• Un perfil promotor de la innovación y con competencias sólidas en gestión del cambio para acompañar al cliente en su transformación digital y organizativa.

• Idiomas: Dominio del español y catalán; se valorarán conocimientos de inglés .

• Ubicación : Barcelona y alrededores.

What is here for You?

• Propósito Elevado: Trabajar en una compañía líder donde tu actividad diaria impa

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Scientist, Clinical Pharmacology
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Clinical Pharmacology (CP) Scientist is responsible for developing and implementing quantitative Clinical Pharmacology strategies across early to late phases of clinical drug development to ensure that the right drug is administered to the right patient at the right dosing regimen and to deliver an optimal therapeutic benefit/risk profile for the patients. The CP Scientist uses state of the art modeling and simulation tools and is able to implement model-informed drug development strategies to address critical questions that are aligned with project needs. The CP Scientist is an active member of cross-functional drug development teams, and works in close partnership with Pharmacometricians, Biostatisticians, Clinicians, Biomarker Scientists, Toxicologists, Preclinical Pharmacologists, and other function) to support drug development decisions through registration and post-marketing commitments. The Senior/Principal CP Scientist represents CP function on filing teams and fosters effective collaboration and communications with regulatory agencies to support efficient drug development of drug candidates.

Key responsibilities include:

• Leading the design and review of clinical study protocols for the development of novel therapeutic agents with particular focus on China development (all drug and delivery modalities);

• Leading the planning and conduct of PK/PD data analyses and setting strategy to foster the appropriate use of modeling and simulations to inform clinical drug development decisions;

• CP functional representation and leadership at functional and cross-functional China development focused meetings internally and externally (eg. cross-functional teams, department meetings, governance review meetings, scientific conferences, etc.);

• Implementing strategic agility and effective project management to align critical CP deliverables according to the rapidly evolving regulatory and project needs in China;

• Authorship of regulatory documents and meeting background packages to support key clinical development milestones in China;

• Lead CP representation at health-authority meetings in China, and contribute to the planning, implementation and organization of regulatory filings (e.g. IND, BLA, NDA, sNDA);

• Support the global development strategies for clinical pharmacology and M&S as needed.

Technical Skills:
Required:

• The ability to plan, organize, interpret, and/or perform PK/PD data analyses.

• Familiarity with clinical drug development and clinical study design options for development of different drug and delivery modalities.

• Familiarity with quantitative modeling approaches in drug development and working knowledge of relevant modeling software (e.g. NONMEM, WinNonlin, R, SimCYP, GastroPlus, PKSim, Matlab, etc).

• Familiarity with agentic approaches for work streamlining and integrating agent-based workflows to improve efficiency throughout the drug development lifecycle.

• Working knowledge of statistical approaches as they apply to clinical study design and analysis.

Desired:

• Experience in leading regulatory filing strategy as a CP lead to support the totality of CP filing package, dose/regimen justification, and drug labeling is highly desired.

Communication Skills:

• Excellent written communication skills, in order to deliver high quality protocols, publications, and regulatory documents for team and management review.

• Excellent oral communications to make clear presentations and foster effective stakeholder engagemen

• Implementing strategic agility and effective project management to align critical CP deliverables according to the rapidly evolving regulatory and project needs in China;

• Authorship of regulatory documents and meeting background packages to support key clinical development milestones in China;

• Lead CP representation at health-authority meetings in China, and contribute to the planning, implementation and organization of regulatory filings (e.g. IND, BLA, NDA, sNDA);

• Support the global development strategies for clinical pharmacology and M&S as needed.

Technical Skills:
Required:

• The ability to plan, organize, interpret, and/or perform PK/PD data analyses.

• Familiarity with clinical drug development and clinical study design options for development of different drug and delivery modalities.

• Familiarity with quantitative modeling approaches in drug development and working knowledge of relevant modeling software (e.g. NONMEM, WinNonlin, R, SimCYP, GastroPlus, PKSim, Matlab, etc).

• Familiarity with agentic approaches for work streamlining and integrating agent-based workflows to improve efficiency throughout the drug development lifecycle.

• Working knowledge of statistical approaches as they apply to clinical study design and analysis.

Desired:

• Experience in leading regulatory filing strategy as a CP lead to support the totality of CP filing package, dose/regimen justification, and drug labeling is highly desired.

Communication Skills:

• Excellent written communication skills, in order to deliver high quality protocols, publications, and regulatory documents for team and management review.

• Excellent oral communications to make clear presentations and foster effective stakeholder engagemen

The Position
Job description
The Cybersecurity Analyst investigates security incidents, performs vulnerability assessments, and contributes to improving security operations
You will be capable of independent work on defined tasks, independently handling less complex tasks and contributing to various stages of the analysis lifecycle
By taking ownership of delivering well-defined requirements and supporting the design of feasible security solutions, you will proactively identify solution-level issues and maintain a mindset of continuous improvement within the security domain

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities / Scope

• Independently handles less complex tasks and provides input to solution design by defining and managing requirements for small-scale problem areas

• Focuses on understanding the problem domain, recommending solution options, and proactively identifying solution-level issues, gaps, or inefficiencies to improve products or processes

Accountability/Problem Solving

• Takes ownership of delivering well-defined requirements and supporting the design of feasible solutions for specific features or components

• Independently analyzes less complex security technical problems, defines problem scope, contributes to identifying root causes, and provides solutions to a broad range of difficult problems

• Evaluates change and technology impacts with increasing accuracy, diagnoses gaps, and applies analytical and logical reasoning independently to identify discrepancies and challenge assumptions

Stakeholder Management

• Identifies key business, technical, and security stakeholders for assigned tasks, analyzing their needs and interests regarding security posture and risk

• Primarily interacts within security product teams/squads and across Security Operations functions, while establishing rapport and managing realistic security expectations

• Develops and delivers tailored communication for security tasks and incident updates, facilitates meetings, and proactively engages with stakeholders to elicit, clarify, and validate security requirements

Impact/Strategy

• Contributes to projects or workgroups by providing well-analyzed requirements and supporting the design of solutions that align with business objectives within their specified area

• Demonstrates growing autonomy and expertise within their specific domain by translating requirements into a strategic plan with supervision, and may identify opportunities for minor process improvements within their immediate scope

Complexity

• Works on a product or larger contexts, handling requirements and analysis for specific features or components

• Can navigate moderate levels of complexity in requirements and stakeholder landscapes

• Begins to understand sources of influence and analyze business problems/opportunities within this product context, starting to map basic interconnections

Business/Technical ability

• Possesses a working knowledge of the relevant business domain and supporting technologies

• Understands sources of influence, comprehending internal and external factors affecting the problem space, and is capable of identifying and analyzing basic business problems or opportunities holistically

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Working knowledge of relevant business domains and supporting cybersecurity technologies

• Experience in conducting stakeholder interviews, synthesizing requirements, and mapping/analyzing current processes

• Demonstrated ability to independently handle less c

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. • Als Kapitelleiter für das Marketingkapitel sind Sie für die Leitung, Überwachung und Entwicklung eingehender Marketingstrategien verantwortlich, um den Patienten kontinuierliche Verbesserungen und einen Mehrwert zu bieten, eine kommerzielle Partnerschaft mit den externen Stakeholdern aufzubauen und dadurch einen breiteren Patientenzugang zu beschleunigen.

• Sie werden der Katalysator und das Vorbild sein, um das Team zu führen, den Standard der Marketingfähigkeit im Zeitalter der KI zu erhöhen, um die Kommerzialisierung zu fördern.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is based in the Regional Customer Support Center which is dedicated to providing excellence while helping laboratory personnel using our products. We operate with a holistic approach, which means that we take care of our product portfolio from the idea through development and market launch to phase-out. The outstanding variety of technologies applied in this area offers you great learning opportunities.

Technical Support Specialist ( Slovak & Czech language)

Locations: Warsaw, Prague or Bratislava (Your choice!)

Are you ready to transition from technical expertise to life-changing impact? Our Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is the intellectual engine behind laboratory excellence in Central Europe. We are looking for a Czech and/or Slovak-speaking talent who is hungry for knowledge, enjoys problem-solving, and is ready to master the world’s most advanced diagnostic technologies.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The Opportunity:

More Than Just Support This isn't a typical helpdesk role. This is an engineering and application consultancy position where you become the "guardian" of diagnostic accuracy.

• Master the Complexity: You will work with high-end IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) systems that combine robotics, complex biochemistry, and advanced IT.

• Continuous Growth: We provide an intensive, world-class training program. We don’t expect you to know everything on day one, but we expect you to be the one who never stops asking "why?".

• Agile Impact: Join a team where your proactivity isn't just welcomed – it's required. You will prevent issues before they happen, using digital twins and remote diagnostic tools.

Who You Are:

• Education: You have a degree in Engineering, IT, Biochemistry, Lab Diagnostics or equivalent. More importantly, you have a "detective’s mind" for troubleshooting.

• Language Power: You are a native or C1/C2 speaker of Czech and/or Slovak . Your English is strong enough to lead you through international trainings and global technical forums.

• The "Lab-to-Office" Bridge: If you’ve worked in a clinical lab and feel you’ve outgrown your current walls, we want your diagnostic logic. We will teach you the engineering; you bring the passion for science.

• Resilience & Ambition: You are someone who sees a complex technical error not as a problem, but as a challenge to be conquered.

What Roche Offers You:

• Autonomy: A hybrid work model in Warsaw, Prague, or Bratislava.

• Unmatched Portfolio: Access to technologies that are setting the standard for the next decade of healthcare.

The role is an 18 - month contract via an external agency.

F or the secondary locations the compensation data will be provided during the first interview.

INTERESED? APPLY!

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche? Check out our blog!
https://diagnostics.roc

Operiamo con un approccio olistico, il che significa che ci occupiamo del nostro portafoglio prodotti dall'idea attraverso lo sviluppo e il lancio di mercato a phase-out. Il nostro Centro Assistenza Clienti Regionale (RCSC) è il motore intellettuale dietro l'eccellenza di laboratorio in Europa Centrale. Stiamo cercando un talento ceco e/o slovacco che ha fame di conoscenza, gode di problem solving, ed è pronto a padroneggiare le tecnologie diagnostiche più avanzate del mondo. A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici dell'ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi. Si tratta di una posizione di consulenza ingegneristica e applicativa in cui si diventa il "guardiano" dell'accuratezza diagnostica.
• Master the Complexity: lavorerai con sistemi IVD (In-Vitro Diagnostics) di fascia alta che combinano robotica, biochimica complessa e IT avanzato.
• Crescita continua: forniamo un programma intensivo di formazione di livello mondiale. Non ci aspettiamo che tu sappia tutto il primo giorno, ma ci aspettiamo che tu sia quello che non smette mai di chiedere "perché?".
• Agile Impact: Unisciti a un team in cui la tua proattività non è solo accolta – è necessario. Impedirai i problemi prima che accadano, utilizzando gemelli digitali e strumenti di diagnostica a distanza. Chi sei?
• Istruzione: Hai una laurea in Ingegneria, IT, Biochimica, Diagnostica di laboratorio o equivalente. Più importante, si dispone di una "tendenza" per la risoluzione dei problemi.
• Language Power: Sei un madrelingua o C1/C2 di ceco e/o slovacco . Il vostro inglese è abbastanza forte da condurvi attraverso allenamenti internazionali e forum tecnici globali.
• Il Ponte "Lab-to-Office": Se hai lavorato in un laboratorio clinico e senti di aver superato le pareti attuali, vogliamo la tua logica diagnostica. Vi insegneremo l'ingegneria; portate la passione per la scienza.
• Resilience & Ambition: Tu sei qualcuno che vede un complesso errore tecnico non come un problema, ma come una sfida da conquistare. Cosa Roche ti offre:
• Autonomia: Un modello di lavoro ibrido a Varsavia, Praga, o Bratislava.
• Portfolio senza precedenti: Accesso alle tecnologie che fissano lo standard per il prossimo decennio di assistenza sanitaria. Il ruolo è un contratto di 18 - mese tramite un'agenzia esterna. F o le posizioni secondarie i dati di compensazione saranno forniti durante la prima intervista. Interessato? APPLY! The Position
We are looking for a Product Manager at Roche Diagnostics Central Asia and Caucasian countries.

Location: Kazakhstan, Almaty

The Position
Foodlicious ist unser Tagesgeschäft
Aus der Taverne Roche ist in über 30 Jahren ein erfolgreiches Gastronomieunternehmen im Bereich der Gemeinschaftsgastronomie entstanden. Die Tavero AG ist eine 100% Tochtergesellschaft der F. Hoffmann-La Roche. An den Standorten Basel und Kaiseraugst beschäftigen wir rund 350 Mitarbeitende aus über 41 Nationen.
Unser Angebot umfasst sowohl Staff Restaurants, die vielfältigen Genuss bieten, als auch Fine Dining Restaurants mit gehobener Küche und exzellentem Service. Darüber hinaus gibt es Restaurants mit Köstlichkeiten aus aller Welt, Kaffee in allen Varianten, gezaubert von unseren Baristi, sowie die höchstgelegenen Lounges der Schweiz – traumhafte Afterwork-Spots über den Dächern der Stadt. Grab'n'Go-Angebote von Sushi bis Burger und der erste und einzige Club in der Geschichte von Roche ergänzen unser Angebot.
Zusätzlich bieten wir unseren Gästen Sitzungszimmer- und Eventcatering für bis zu 1.500 Personen an. Die öffentlichen Gastronomien, das Schöpfli im Park und das Chez Jeannot im Museum Tinguely, runden unser Angebot ab.

Wir suchen per sofort eine:n Chef de Partie, Tournant für die Tavero AG in Basel.

Deine Aufgaben

• Abwechselnder Arbeitseinsatz auf allen Posten in den Betrieben Gäste- und Direktionsrestaurant Panorama, Lounge 47, Pebbels Lounge, Schöpfli und Science Club

• Termingerechte Bereitstellung und Produktion aller Angebotskomponenten

• Zubereitung nach Rezeptur, inkl. Degustation und kontinuierlichem Verbesserungsprozess

• Ideenreichtum und Kreativität sind deine Antreiber

• Du bringst die Liebe zum Beruf auf den Teller

• Selbstständiges Führen eines Postens

• Erstellen der benötigten Mise en Place und verantwortlich für den reibungslosen Ablauf auf deinem Posten

• Einhalten von Hygienebestimmungen (TQM / HACCP)

• Wirtschaftlicher und korrekter Umgang mit Lebensmittel bei der Lagerung und/sowie bei deren Verarbeitung

• Sichere Warenbewirtschaftung sowie interne und externe Bestellungen tätigen

• Arbeitszeiten in der Regel zwischen 6.00 und 22.00 Uhr, mit Ausnahmen auch Abendeinsätze möglich

Dein Profil

• Du hast eine abgeschlossene Kochausbildung (EFZ) und verfügst über mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung (exkl. Ausbildungsjahre) in der gehobenen Gastronomie

• Du hast einschlägige Erfahrungen in allen Küchenbereichen

• Du entwickelst gerne neue Rezepte und bist kreativ in der Angebotsplanung

• Du bist ein Organisationstalent und hast ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Du besitzt ein Durchsetzungsvermögen

• Du hast eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise und übernimmst Verantwortung

• Teamfähigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich

• Du hast Kenntnisse der Schweizer Lebensmittelgesetzgebung

• Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, um deine Kunden kompetent beraten zu können

• In einer digitalen Welt wünschen wir uns zudem, einen sicheren Umgang mit Computerprogrammen (MS Office)

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to spearhead the long-term category roadmap and command our high-value IT supplier landscape that drives the functioning of our Diagnostics Instruments? As our Global Category Manager for IT Software & Hardware in Sant Cugat, Spain (or in Indianapolis, U.S.), you will take ultimate accountability for developing strategies and leading strategic initiatives for this rapidly evolving spend category. In this role, you will manage tier-one global technology providers, negotiate complex commercial frameworks, and translate category goals into bottom-line value creation.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the Global Category Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Engages directly with cross-functional teams composed of representatives from Category, Delivery, Procurement Center of Excellence, and global business partners. Serves as a key business partner contact point for senior functional and business stakeholders.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role with global category leadership position focused on strategic vision, category development, pipeline building, and relationship ecosystem management

• Impact: You deliver commercial impact by anchoring cost and developing a resilience pipeline of projects, in addition to securing our sustainability priorities. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, supplier data, and business requirements to formulate a formalized, global Category Strategy and initiative pipeline, to be aligned with leaders across the organization.

• Commercial Negotiations: Leading high-value commercial and contractual negotiations for strategic suppliers within the category.

• Supplier Ecosystems: Managing key global suppliers, establishing development and innovation programs, monitoring value targets, and managing supplier risks.

• Guidance & Content: Developing and maintaining category guidance documents to translate strategy into clear, executable content for procurement colleagues and business users.

• Business Partnering: Building deep relationships with senior stakeholders, challenging demand/specifications to maximize value, and managing risk/CSR reviews.

• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching procurement colleagues, providing professional development, managing a shared Associate Category Manager within the team, and tracking budget spend.

Who you are

We look for strategic procurement champions with extensive knowledge of global IT Hardware and off-the-shelf software supply markets and the matrix leadership skills needed to drive complex organizational change.

• Education: University degree required (Business or Life Sciences focus preferred); a post-graduate business-related qualification is preferred.

• Experience: 5+ years of in-depth strategic and operational procu

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove si è apprezzati, accettati e rispettati per chi si è, permettendo di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. È così che ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e di garantire a tutti l'accesso all'assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Da luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team multiculturale, siamo fonte, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo e eseguiamo strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente processi & digitalizzati che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se ami fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di Procurement ad alte prestazioni e di livello mondiale, questo è per te. Siamo DOP.

A Roche, ora facciamo quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno.

L'opportunità Sei pronto a guidare la roadmap a lungo termine della categoria e a gestire il nostro panorama di fornitori IT di alto valore che guida il funzionamento dei nostri strumenti diagnostici? Come nostro responsabile globale della categoria per il software IT e l'hardware a Sant Cugat, Spagna (o a Indianapolis, Stati Uniti), prenderai la responsabilità ultima per lo sviluppo di strategie e iniziative strategiche leader per questa categoria di spesa in rapida evoluzione. In questo ruolo, gestirai fornitori di tecnologia globali di livello uno, negozierai quadri commerciali complessi e tradurrai obiettivi di categoria in creazione di valore di base.

- Reporting Line: Direttamente reporting al Global Category Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT all'interno dell'organizzazione Category. - Wider Team e Stakeholder: Si occupa direttamente di team interfunzionali composti da rappresentanti di Category, Delivery, Procurement Center of Excellence e partner commerciali globali.

- Tipo di ruolo: un ruolo individuale di GPM con una posizione di leadership globale incentrata sulla visione strategica, sviluppo di categorie, costruzione di condotte e gestione dell'ecosistema di relazione - Impatto: si ottiene un impatto commerciale ancorando i costi e sviluppando un oleodotto di resilienza dei progetti, oltre a garantire le nostre priorità di sostenibilità. In particolare, si è responsabili per:

Responsabilità - Strategia e Conduttura Annuale: Riprendere informazioni di mercato, dati sui fornitori e requisiti aziendali per formulare una strategia e un'iniziativa di categoria formalizzate e globali, da allineare con i leader di tutta l'organizzazione. - Negoziati commerciali: negoziati commerciali e contrattuali di alto valore per i fornitori strategici della categoria. - Ecosistemi di fornitori: Gestione dei fornitori chiave a livello globale, creazione di programmi di sviluppo e innovazione, monitoraggio degli obiettivi di valore e gestione dei rischi dei fornitori.

- Guida e contenuto: sviluppare e mantenere documenti di orientamento di categoria per tradurre la strategia in contenuti chiari ed eseguibili per i colleghi di appalti e gli utenti aziendali. - Partnering di imprese: creare relazioni profonde con gli stakeholder più anziani, sfidare la domanda/specifiche per massimizzare il valore e gestire le valutazioni rischio/RSI. - Soprintendenza al team e al budget: allenare i colleghi di appalti, fornire sviluppo professionale, gestire un responsabile di categoria di saloni condivisi all'interno del team e monitorare la spesa di bilancio.

Chi sei Cerchiamo campioni di approvvigionamento strategico con una vasta conoscenza dei mercati globali di fornitura di hardware IT e software off-the-shelf e le competenze di leadership matrice necessarie per guidare cambiamenti organizzativi complessi.

Requisiti - Istruzione: Laurea richiesta (preferibile per le scienze aziendali o della vita); è preferibile una qualifica post-laurea relativa alle imprese. - Esperienza: 5+ anni di approfondimento strategico e operativo

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, für wen Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat, heute und für Generationen.

Über unser Team Wir von Global Diagnostics Procurement (DOP) sind ein Team von rund 200 begeisterten Fachleuten, die sich weltweit für die Wertschöpfung unserer Lieferanten einsetzen. Von Standorten auf der ganzen Welt und mit einem vielfältigen und multikulturellen Team, beziehen wir unsere Lieferantenbasis, leiten unsere Kategorienstrategien und entwickeln und führen sie ständig weiter und digitalisieren Prozesse, die es uns ermöglichen, unser Geschäft nachhaltig zu unterstützen. Wenn Sie einen Einfluss ausüben wollen und Teil eines leistungsstarken und erstklassigen Beschaffungsteams sein wollen, ist dies für Sie. Wir sind DOP.

Bei Roche tun wir jetzt, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen.

Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, die langfristige Kategorie Roadmap zu leiten und unsere hochwertige IT-Zuliefererlandschaft zu beherrschen, die die Funktion unserer Diagnoseinstrumente fördert? Als Global Category Manager für IT-Software und Hardware in Sant Cugat, Spanien (oder in Indianapolis, USA), werden Sie ultimative Rechenschaftspflicht für die Entwicklung von Strategien und führenden strategischen Initiativen für diese sich schnell entwickelnde Ausgabekategorie übernehmen. In dieser Rolle werden Sie globale Technologieanbieter in der Kategorie 1 verwalten, komplexe kommerzielle Rahmenbedingungen verhandeln und Kategorieziele in die Bottom-Line-Wertschöpfung übersetzen.

- Reporting Line: Direkte Berichte an die Global Category Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT innerhalb der Category Organisation. - Das Team und die Mitarbeiter von "Wider und die Mitarbeiter": Verlobt sich direkt mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, die sich aus Vertretern der Kategorie, Lieferung, Beschaffungszentrum für Exzellenz und globalen Geschäftspartnern zusammensetzen.

- Rollentyp: Eine individuelle Rolle des Beitragsgebers mit globaler Führungsposition in der Kategorie, die sich auf strategische Vision, Kategorieentwicklung, Pipeline-Building und Beziehungsökosystemmanagement konzentriert - Auswirkungen: Sie erzielen wirtschaftliche Auswirkungen durch die Verankerung von Kosten und die Entwicklung einer Resilienz-Pipeline von Projekten, zusätzlich zur Sicherung unserer Nachhaltigkeitsprioritäten. Insbesondere sind Sie verantwortlich für:

Verantwortung - Strategie & Jährliche Pipeline: Zusammentragen von Marktinformationen, Lieferantendaten und Geschäftsanforderungen, um eine formalisierte, globale Kategorie Strategie und Initiative Pipeline zu formulieren, die mit führenden Unternehmen in der gesamten Organisation abgestimmt werden soll. - Kommerzielle Verhandlungen: Führende kommerzielle und vertragliche Verhandlungen für strategische Lieferanten innerhalb der Kategorie. - Lieferanten Ecosystems: Managing Key Global Lieferanten, Aufbau von Entwicklungs- und Innovationsprogrammen, Überwachung von Wertzielen und Management von Lieferantenrisiken.

- Beratung & Inhalt: Entwicklung und Pflege von Leitfäden für die Kategorie, um Strategie in klare, ausführbare Inhalte für Beschaffungskollegen und Business-Nutzer zu übersetzen. - Business Partnering: Aufbau tiefer Beziehungen zu hochrangigen Stakeholdern, anspruchsvolle Nachfrage/Spezifikationen zur Maximierung des Wertes und Management von Risiko/CSR-Reviews. - Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching von Beschaffungskollegen, professionelle Entwicklung, Verwaltung eines geteilten Associate Category Managers im Team und Verfolgung von Budgetausgaben.

Wer Sie sind Wir suchen strategische Beschaffungs-Champions mit umfassenden Kenntnissen der globalen IT-Hardware- und Software-Versorgungsmärkte und den für den komplexen organisatorischen Wandel erforderlichen Führungskompetenzen der Matrix.

- Ausbildung: Hochschulabschluss erforderlich (vorzugsweise Schwerpunkt Business oder Life Sciences); eine betriebswirtschaftliche Qualifikation nach dem Studium wird bevorzugt. - Erfahrung: 5+ Jahre umfassende strategische und operative Erfahrung

De partout dans le monde et avec une équipe diversifiée et multiculturelle, nous approvisionnons, gérons notre base de fournisseurs, développons et exécuteons des stratégies de catégorie et développons et numérisons constamment des processus qui nous permettent de soutenir au mieux notre entreprise pour qu'elle se développe durablement.

Chez Roche, on fait maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin.

La possibilité Êtes-vous prêt à diriger la feuille de route de la catégorie à long terme et commander notre gamme de fournisseurs de TI de haute valeur qui conduit au fonctionnement de nos instruments de diagnostic? En tant que notre gestionnaire de catégorie mondiale pour les logiciels et matériels informatiques à Sant Cugat, en Espagne (ou à Indianapolis, aux États-Unis), vous serez responsable ultimement de l'élaboration de stratégies et des initiatives stratégiques pour cette catégorie de dépenses en évolution rapide.

- Ligne de rapport : relève directement de la catégorie mondiale Capex-chef / Services d'ingénierie / TI au sein de l'organisation de la catégorie. - Équipe plus large et intervenants : Arrangements avec des équipes interfonctionnelles composées de représentants de la catégorie, de la prestation, du centre d'excellence en acquisitions et de partenaires commerciaux mondiaux.

- Type de rôle : Un rôle de coopérateur individuel avec un poste de leadership de catégorie mondiale axé sur la vision stratégique, le développement de catégories, la construction de pipelines et la gestion des relations écosystémiques - Impact : Vous produisez un impact commercial en ancreant les coûts et en développant un pipeline de résilience de projets, en plus de garantir nos priorités en matière de durabilité.

Responsabilités - Stratégie et pipeline annuel : Recueillir des renseignements sur les marchés, des données sur les fournisseurs et des exigences opérationnelles pour formuler un pipeline officiel de la catégorie mondiale et d'initiative, qui sera aligné sur les dirigeants de l'organisation. - Négociations commerciales : Mener des négociations commerciales et contractuelles de grande valeur pour les fournisseurs stratégiques de la catégorie. - Écosystèmes fournisseurs : gérer les principaux fournisseurs mondiaux, établir des programmes de développement et d'innovation, surveiller les objectifs de valeur et gérer les risques pour les fournisseurs.

- Orientation et contenu : Élaborer et tenir à jour des documents d'orientation de catégorie pour traduire la stratégie en contenu clair et exécutable pour les collègues et les utilisateurs d'entreprises en matière d'approvisionnement. - Partenariats commerciaux : établir des relations étroites avec les intervenants supérieurs, mettre en question la demande/les spécificités afin de maximiser la valeur et gérer les examens des risques et des RCS. - Surveillance de l'équipe et du budget : Coaching des collègues en matière d'approvisionnement, fournir du perfectionnement professionnel, gérer un gestionnaire de catégorie associé partagé au sein de l'équipe et suivre les dépenses budgétaires.

Qui vous êtes Nous recherchons des champions stratégiques en matière d'approvisionnement qui possèdent une vaste connaissance des marchés mondiaux de matériel informatique et de logiciels hors de gamme et des compétences de leadership matriciel nécessaires pour mener des changements organisationnels complexes.

Exigences - Éducation : Diplôme universitaire requis (priorité de l'orientation des sciences de la vie ou des affaires); une qualification liée aux affaires post-universitaire est préférée. - Expérience : 5 ans et plus de cours stratégiques et opérationnels approfondis

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

This position is located in Pathology and Applied Safety Science, a department within the Pharmaceutical Sciences function. We drive the non-clinical safety assessment of drug candidates from small molecules to complex biological products during the discovery and development phases at Roche.

The Opportunity

As an engaged Digital Pathologist, you will play a pivotal role in the development, validation, and implementation of pathology investigations and the application of computational pathology approaches for translational safety assessment. Your primary responsibility will be to propose, conduct, and report computational toxicologic pathology approaches to understand mechanisms of toxicity, leveraging modern tools to maximise scientific insights, drive innovation, and advance our therapeutic pipeline. You will support the automation of pathology algorithms, workflows, and platforms, remaining accountable for the scientific delivery of pathology data to inform risk assessment across projects ranging from small molecules to complex biological products.

• Core Portfolio Toxicologic Pathology : Provide expert pathology support in preclinical development, aligning toxicity study designs with current science and regulatory guidelines. Conduct qualitative and quantitative (histo)pathologic evaluations for discovery and development toxicology studies, including GLP-compliant studies. Peer-review histopathologic data and interpretations from internal or CRO pathologists per established SOPs. Integrate clinical pathology data (haematology, clinical chemistry) with histopathology findings for a holistic, mechanistic interpretation of toxicity. Deliver clear, concise test result interpretations and author pathology sections for Research Reports, regulatory filings (e.g., IND/CTA), and governance presentations.

• Algorithm Architecture & Image Analysis Deployment : Propose, build, test, and implement custom image analysis solutions and algorithms to automate cell and biomarker quantification on scanned tissue. Oversee the integration of ML and non-ML software to detect, segment, and score complex tissue morphologies. All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. Questa posizione si trova in Patologia e Scienze della Sicurezza Applicata, un dipartimento all'interno della funzione Scienze Farmaceutiche. Noi guidiamo la valutazione di sicurezza non ciclica dei candidati alla droga da piccole molecole a prodotti biologici complessi durante le fasi di scoperta e sviluppo a Roche. L'opportunità Come un Patologo Digitale impegnato, si svolgerà un ruolo cardine nello sviluppo, nella convalida e nell'implementazione di indagini patologiche e nell'applicazione di approcci di patologia computazionale per la valutazione della sicurezza traduttiva. La vostra responsabilità primaria sarà quella di proporre, condurre e riferire approcci di patologia tossicologica computazionale per comprendere meccanismi di tossicità, sfruttando strumenti moderni per massimizzare le intuizioni scientifiche, guidare l'innovazione e avanzare la nostra pipeline terapeutica. Sosterrete l'automazione di algoritmi di patologia, flussi di lavoro e piattaforme, rimanendo responsabili per la consegna scientifica dei dati di patologia per informare la valutazione del rischio attraverso progetti che vanno da piccole molecole a prodotti biologici complessi.
• Patologia Tossicologica Core Portfolio: Fornire un supporto di patologia esperto nello sviluppo preclinico, allineare i progetti di studio tossicologico con le attuali linee guida scientifiche e regolamentari. Condurre valutazioni qualitative e quantitative (sito)patologiche per la scoperta e lo sviluppo di studi tossicologici, compresi gli studi conformi al GLP. Peer-review dati e interpretazioni istopatologiche dai patologi interni o CRO per i SOP consolidati. Integra i dati di patologia clinica (ematologia, chimica clinica) con i risultati di istopatologia per un'interpretazione olistica e meccanistica della tossicità. Fornire chiare e concise interpretazioni dei risultati dei test e sezioni di patologia dell'autore per i Rapporti di ricerca, i documenti normativi (ad esempio, IND/CTA) e le presentazioni di governance.
• Deployment: Proporre, costruire, testare e implementare soluzioni e algoritmi di analisi delle immagini personalizzate per automatizzare la quantificazione delle celle e dei biomarcatori sui tessuti scansionati. Controllare l'integrazione di software ML e non-ML per rilevare, segmentare e segnare morfologie di tessuto complesse. Estrarre caratteristiche spaziali altamente dimensionali e metriche quantitative da multisala o standard IHC e ISH diapositive. Trasformazione comp

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

This position is located in Pathology and Applied Safety Science, a department within the Pharmaceutical Sciences function. We drive the non-clinical safety assessment of drug candidates from small molecules to complex biological products during the discovery and development phases at Roche.

The Opportunity

As an engaged Digital Pathologist, you will play a pivotal role in the development, validation, and implementation of pathology investigations and the application of computational pathology approaches for translational safety assessment. Your primary responsibility will be to propose, conduct, and report computational toxicologic pathology approaches to understand mechanisms of toxicity, leveraging modern tools to maximise scientific insights, drive innovation, and advance our therapeutic pipeline. You will support the automation of pathology algorithms, workflows, and platforms, remaining accountable for the scientific delivery of pathology data to inform risk assessment across projects ranging from small molecules to complex biological products.

• Core Portfolio Toxicologic Pathology : Provide expert pathology support in preclinical development, aligning toxicity study designs with current science and regulatory guidelines. Conduct qualitative and quantitative (histo)pathologic evaluations for discovery and development toxicology studies, including GLP-compliant studies. Peer-review histopathologic data and interpretations from internal or CRO pathologists per established SOPs. Integrate clinical pathology data (haematology, clinical chemistry) with histopathology findings for a holistic, mechanistic interpretation of toxicity. Deliver clear, concise test result interpretations and author pathology sections for Research Reports, regulatory filings (e.g., IND/CTA), and governance presentations.

• Algorithm Architecture & Image Analysis Deployment : Propose, build, test, and implement custom image analysis solutions and algorithms to automate cell and biomarker quantification on scanned tissue. Oversee the integration of ML and non-ML software to detect, segment, and score complex tissue morphologies. Extract high-dimensional spatial features and quantitative metrics from multiplexed or standard IHC and ISH slides. Transform comp
