Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

• Roche Diagnostics Pakistan is looking for a Product Manager, internally titled as Manager Business Innovation Molecular. Reporting to the Team Lead- Business Innovation, this position will see you developing specific marketing plans for products within the organization, interprets and translate scientific clinical data into commercial implications. You will analyze data and make strategic recommendations while providing marketing insight and direction to optimize new product launches.

• This is a permanent and individual contributor position based in Karachi, within our Diagnostics business.

Your Opportunity

• Conceptualize, lead, execute and/or coordinate all activities related to product launches, product promotions, scientific training and for the Sales team, Customer & market analyses, co-creation and implementation of marketing plans and management of allocated A& P budget.

• Co-create with Medical, Sales teams, Clinical Value Marketing promotional, educational, access and partnership initiatives or business model solutions, which support faster adoption of Diagnostics solutions according to clinical guidelines and protocols

• Partner with relevant internal and external stakeholders to develop and communicate unique value propositions for our Diagnostics portfolio

• Identify strategic partners (public or private organizations) which can facilitate improved Patient Access – e.g. MoH, telehealth/teleconsultation system providers, insurance and financial institutions, patient coaching providers, NGOs, Hospitals etc.

• Co-develop the marketing plan based on robust market insights and analytics and informed by regular key Customer visits with Medical & Sales

• Source & analyze (including the development of business cases) market insight for new product launch potential, competitor intelligence, hospital procurement policies, pricing, etc.

• Leverage globally developed campaigns and brand assets to deploy locally translated promotional/educational materials for new and existing products, including brochures, leaflets, detailing materials, presentations, Lead HCP and Institutional marketing efforts for product promotion. including disease education

• Maintain strong disease and product knowledge; support internal and external customer education programs and product training

• Lead KOL engagement and speaker programs

• Leverage Medical and Scientific studies to create content for patients, HCPs and Institutions

• Drive shift in engaging HCPs on digital marketing platforms

• Conduct double visits with the Sales team to shape actionable content and format for the product training and promotional campaigns

• Coordinate with Medical to establish relevant presence and engagement for strategic events (symposia, conferences, etc.)

• Collaborate seamlessly with the rest of the Sales, Medical and other functions to deliver on the company’s objectives

• Ensure full compliance with Roche policies, coordinate with Quality & Regulatory functions, and secure timely and proper approval & documentation of activities and assets according to SOPs including the local customization process

• Contribute to actionable training & progress of the Sales Team by feedback & feed forward and sharing Customer Insight

• Implement Globally developed/validated tools and assets, customized for local use as applicable

• Track and consolidate relevant analytics and ROI KPIs

• Adopt

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons.
• Roche Diagnostics Pakistan est à la recherche d'un gestionnaire de produits, intitulé en interne comme gestionnaire d'innovation commerciale moléculaire. Relevant de l'équipe responsable - Innovation en affaires, ce poste vous permettra d'élaborer des plans de marketing spécifiques pour les produits au sein de l'organisation, d'interpréter et de traduire les données cliniques scientifiques en implications commerciales. Vous analyserez les données et formulerez des recommandations stratégiques tout en offrant une vision et une orientation marketing pour optimiser les lancements de nouveaux produits.
• Il s'agit d'une position contributive permanente et individuelle basée à Karachi, dans notre activité Diagnostics. Votre opportunité
• Conceptualisez, dirigez, exécutez et/ou coordonnez toutes les activités liées au lancement de produits, à la promotion de produits, à la formation scientifique et à l'équipe de vente, aux analyses de clients et de marchés, à la co-création et à la mise en oeuvre de plans de marketing et à la gestion du budget A & P alloué.
• Co-créer avec des équipes médicales, commerciales, marketing de valeur clinique des initiatives promotionnelles, éducatives, d'accès et de partenariat ou des solutions de modèles d'affaires, qui soutiennent l'adoption plus rapide de solutions diagnostiques selon les lignes directrices et protocoles cliniques
• Partenaire avec les intervenants internes et externes concernés pour élaborer et communiquer des propositions de valeur uniques pour notre portefeuille de diagnostics
• Identifier les partenaires stratégiques (organismes publics ou privés) qui peuvent faciliter l'amélioration de l'accès des patients (p. ex., le ministère de la Santé, les fournisseurs de systèmes de télésanté et de téléconsultation, les institutions financières et d'assurance, les fournisseurs d'encadrement des patients, les ONG, les hôpitaux, etc.).
• Co-développer le plan marketing basé sur de solides perspectives de marché et d'analyse et éclairé par des visites régulières de clients clés avec Medical & Sales
• Source et analyse (y compris l'élaboration d'analyses de rentabilisation) aperçu du marché pour le nouveau potentiel de lancement de produits, renseignements sur les concurrents, politiques d'approvisionnement des hôpitaux, prix, etc.
• Tirer parti des campagnes et des atouts de la marque au niveau mondial pour déployer du matériel promotionnel/éducatif traduit localement pour les produits nouveaux et existants, y compris des brochures, des dépliants, des documents détaillés, des présentations, des efforts de promotion des produits par le plomb HCP et des institutions. y compris l'éducation aux maladies
• Maintenir une solide connaissance des maladies et des produits; appuyer les programmes internes et externes de sensibilisation des clients et la formation des produits
• Engagement des chefs de file et programmes de conférenciers
• Tirer parti des études médicales et scientifiques pour créer du contenu pour les patients, les HCP et les institutions
• Intensification de la participation des PCH aux plateformes de marketing numérique
• Effectuer des visites doubles avec l'équipe des ventes pour façonner le contenu actionnable et le format des campagnes de formation et promotion des produits
• Coordonner avec Medical pour établir la présence et l'engagement pertinents pour les événements stratégiques (symposia, conférences, etc.)
• Collaborer en douceur avec le reste des ventes, des fonctions médicales et autres pour réaliser les objectifs de la société.
• Assurer le plein respect des politiques de Roche, la coordination avec les fonctions de qualité et de réglementation, et assurer l'approbation et la documentation opportunes et appropriées des activités et des biens conformément aux SOP, y compris le processus local de personnalisation
• Contribuer à la formation pratique et à l'avancement de l'équipe des ventes en faisant part de vos commentaires et de vos commentaires et en partageant le point de vue des clients
• Mettre en œuvre des outils et des actifs développés ou validés à l'échelle mondiale, adaptés à l'usage local, selon le cas
• Suivre et consolider les analyses pertinentes et les ICR ROI

jobs.title: Territory Manager – Foundation Medicine
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Your Opportunity

​ Accelerate Your Career in Precision Medicine If you are looking to transition from traditional medical sales into the frontier of genomic innovation, this permanent role offers the perfect platform for your professional evolution. As part of the Foundation Medicine Inc. (FMI) team within Roche Diagnostics Pakistan, this role is based in Lahore and will cover the Central and North regions. Reporting directly to the Business Manager for FMI, you won't just be managing a territory—you will be building a market, expanding your strategic business acumen, and establishing yourself as a leading expert in comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP).

• The primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche : Own your territory and build high-level partnerships by serving as the trusted, expert face of Foundation Medicine (FMI) for prominent Oncologists, Pathologists, and multidisciplinary tumor boards across the Central and North regions.

• Responsible for Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs : Champion the scientific adoption of FMI's cutting-edge genomic testing portfolio, directly influencing personalized healthcare pathways.

• Disease landscape understanding and products knowledge : Sharpen your scientific expertise by mastering complex molecular oncology, precision diagnostics, and genomic data to consult confidently with top-tier medical experts.

• Responsibility of Roche’s products through their lifecycle and support its appropriate use : Step up to the challenge of managing regional commercial targets, honing your data-driven territory planning and execution skills.

• Broad understanding of his/her therapeutic area and its respective future pipeline, such that they can work on future-based solutions: Grow into a strategic leader by collaborating directly with the FMI Business Manager to co-create regional business blueprints, analyze market dynamics, and map long-term institutional accounts.

• Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community : Develop sophisticated problem-solving skills as you work across complex hospital ecosystems to streamline genomic testing workflows from sample to report.

• Awareness of disease Diagnosis : Position yourself as a thought leader by educating clinicians on the paradigm-shifting value of comprehensive genomic profiling over traditional testing.

• HCP education (pre-approved & post-approved products) : Expand your professional presentation and leadership skills by driving scientific roundtables, medical meetings, and clinical case reviews.

• Patients’ Access to available funds e.g PBM/SSP & others : Gain valuable experience in healthcare market access by exploring and leveraging institutional funding and patient support avenues.

• Proactive communication with HCPs on PSP : Drive impactful patient-centric solutions by ensuring healthcare providers are fully aware of programs designed to maximize testing accessibility.

• PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem: Develop high-level "systems thinking" capabilities by embedding FMI testing into standard hospital clinical protocols.

• Responsible to repor

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. La tua opportunità Accelera la tua carriera in medicina di precisione Se stai cercando di passare dalle vendite mediche tradizionali alla frontiera dell'innovazione genomica, questo ruolo permanente offre la piattaforma perfetta per la tua evoluzione professionale. Nell'ambito del team Foundation Medicine Inc. (FMI) all'interno di Roche Diagnostics Pakistan, questo ruolo è basato in Lahore e coprirà le regioni centrali e nord. Segnalando direttamente al Business Manager per FMI, non solo gestirai un territorio – costruirai un mercato, espanderai il tuo acume strategico aziendale e ti stabilirai come un esperto leader nella profilazione genomica completa (CGP).
• Il punto di contatto primario (ma non esclusivo) tra le parti interessate e Roche: Possedere il proprio territorio e costruire partnership di alto livello servendo come il volto di fiducia, esperto di medicina della Fondazione (FMI) per oncologi di spicco, patologi, e schede tumorali multidisciplinari in tutte le regioni del Centro e del Nord.
• Responsabile per i prodotti Roche attraverso il loro ciclo di vita e supporta il loro uso appropriato, che include la condivisione dei loro meriti con HCP: Campione dell'adozione scientifica del portafoglio di test genomici all'avanguardia di FMI, influenzando direttamente percorsi sanitari personalizzati.
• Conoscenza del paesaggio delle malattie e dei prodotti: Affilare le tue competenze scientifiche masterizzando oncologia molecolare complessa, diagnostica di precisione e dati genomici per consultare con fiducia esperti medici di alto livello.
• Responsabilità dei prodotti Roche attraverso il loro ciclo di vita e sostenere il suo uso appropriato: salire alla sfida di gestire gli obiettivi commerciali regionali, affinare le vostre capacità di pianificazione e esecuzione del territorio.
• Ampia comprensione della sua area terapeutica e della sua rispettiva futura pipeline, tale da poter lavorare su soluzioni future: Crescere in un leader strategico collaborando direttamente con FMI Business Manager per co-creare progetti di business regionali, analizzare le dinamiche di mercato e mappare conti istituzionali a lungo termine.
• Partner con stakeholder di viaggio del paziente per rimuovere i blocchi stradali e sbloccare le possibilità per fornire valore per i pazienti e la comunità: Sviluppare sofisticate capacità di problem solving mentre lavori in ecosistemi ospedalieri complessi per ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro di test genomici dal campione al report.
• Consapevolezza della malattia Diagnosi: Posizionati come leader di pensiero educando i medici sul valore di cambiamento del paradigma della profilazione genomica completa sul test tradizionale.
• Istruzione HCP (prodotti pre-approvati e post-approvati) : Espandi le tue capacità professionali di presentazione e leadership guidando tavole rotonde scientifiche, riunioni mediche e recensioni di casi clinici.
• I pazienti’ Accesso ai fondi disponibili, ad esempio PBM/SSP & altri: Ottieni una preziosa esperienza nell'accesso al mercato sanitario esplorando e sfruttando i finanziamenti istituzionali e i viali di supporto dei pazienti.
• Comunicazione proattiva con HCP su PSP: Soluzioni impattanti per il paziente-centric assicurando ai fornitori di servizi sanitari la piena consapevolezza dei programmi progettati per massimizzare l'accessibilità ai test.
• PJP agisce come un pensatore di sistema con la capacità di identificare lo scopo condiviso tra le parti interessate e lo sfrutta per co-creare soluzioni con le parti interessate nell'ecosistema: Sviluppare capacità di "sistemi di pensiero" di alto livello incorporando i test FMI nei protocolli clinici ospedalieri standard.
• Responsabile del repo

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Votre opportunité Accélérez votre carrière en médecine de précision Si vous cherchez à passer de la vente médicale traditionnelle à la frontière de l'innovation génomique, ce rôle permanent offre la plateforme parfaite pour votre évolution professionnelle. Dans le cadre de l'équipe de la Fondation Médecine Inc. (FMI) au sein de Roche Diagnostics Pakistan, ce rôle est basé à Lahore et couvrira les régions du Centre et du Nord. Sous l'autorité directe du chef d'entreprise de l'IMF, vous ne gérerez pas seulement un territoire : vous créerez un marché, élargirez votre sens stratégique des affaires et vous établirez comme un expert de premier plan en profilage génomique complet (CGP).
• Point de contact principal (mais non exclusif) entre les parties prenantes et Roche : Possédez votre territoire et établissez des partenariats de haut niveau en servant de visage expert de la Fondation Médecine (FMI) pour les Oncologues, les pathologistes et les conseils tumoraux multidisciplinaires de toutes les régions du Centre et du Nord.
• Responsable des produits Roches tout au long de leur cycle de vie et soutient leur utilisation appropriée, qui inclut le partage de leurs mérites avec les HCP : Championne de l'adoption scientifique du portefeuille de tests génomiques de pointe du FMI, influençant directement les parcours de soins personnalisés.
• Connaissance du paysage des maladies et des produits : Approfondissez votre expertise scientifique en maîtrisant l'oncologie moléculaire complexe, les diagnostics de précision et les données génomiques pour consulter en toute confiance des experts médicaux de haut niveau.
• Responsabilité des produits Roches tout au long de leur cycle de vie et soutien de son utilisation appropriée : Déploiez le défi de la gestion des objectifs commerciaux régionaux, perfectionnez vos compétences de planification et d'exécution de territoire axées sur les données.
• Compréhension étendue de son domaine thérapeutique et de son avenir, de sorte qu'ils puissent travailler sur des solutions basées sur l'avenir: Devenez un chef de file stratégique en collaborant directement avec le gestionnaire d'entreprise de l'IMF pour créer des plans d'affaires régionaux, analyser la dynamique du marché et cartographier les comptes institutionnels à long terme.
• Partenaires avec les intervenants du cheminement des patients pour supprimer les barrages routiers et débloquer les possibilités de fournir de la valeur pour les patients et la communauté : Développer des compétences sophistiquées de résolution de problèmes lorsque vous travaillez à travers des écosystèmes hospitaliers complexes pour rationaliser les processus de test génomique de l'échantillon à rapport.
• Sensibilisation à la maladie Diagnostic : Positionnez-vous comme un leader de la pensée en éduquant les cliniciens sur la valeur changeante du profil génomique global par rapport aux tests traditionnels.
• Formation HCP (produits pré-approuvés et post-approuvés) : Élargissez votre présentation professionnelle et vos compétences en leadership en conduisant des tables rondes scientifiques, des réunions médicales et des examens de cas cliniques.
• Patients Accès aux fonds disponibles, p. ex. PBM/SSP et autres : acquérir une expérience précieuse en matière d'accès au marché des soins de santé en explorant et en tirant parti du financement institutionnel et des possibilités de soutien aux patients.
• Communication proactive avec les PSC sur les PSP : Conduire des solutions axées sur le patient en veillant à ce que les fournisseurs de soins de santé soient pleinement conscients des programmes conçus pour maximiser l'accessibilité aux tests.
• Le PJP agit comme un penseur système capable d'identifier des objectifs communs entre les intervenants et d'en tirer parti pour créer des solutions avec les intervenants de l'écosystème : Développer des capacités de « réflexion système » de haut niveau en intégrant les tests de l'IMF dans des protocoles cliniques hospitaliers standard.
• Responsable de la représentation

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
全方位数据支撑与项目落地与运营支持

• 协同各治疗领域负责伙伴，支持项目推进过程中的核心活动筹备、高标准会议组织及相关材料撰写，确保执行工具与流程物料高效准备。

• 协同各治疗领域负责伙伴，建立并维护“总部-区域”高效沟通机制，支持关键信息的区域穿透、答疑与对齐。确保总部业务策略在全国执行层面的一致性与精准交付。

项目全生命周期推进与执行闭环

• 建立并维护项目进度看板，动态追踪各区域、各环节的执行达成。针对进度滞后或异常节点，建立常态化预警与催办机制，及时协同内外部资源清除流程壁垒。

• 协助统筹跨领域的项目流与执行资源，合理规划各项落地任务的上线节奏与执行密度，通过“错峰控流”避免一线产能过载，确保团队精力聚焦与项目高质量交付。

运营机制建设与反馈链路闭环

• 制定团队的年度/季度/月度运营日历，统筹大客户拜访、大客户业务回顾及创新项目推进的整体节奏，建立高效规范的团队运营秩序。

• 通过问卷调查、深度访谈、区域例会等多维形式，高频、系统性地收集区域一线的定性与定量反馈，客观透视策略在落地过程中的真实偏差与卡点，助力总部的策略迭代。

组织资产萃取与知识沉淀

• 深度挖掘并萃取标杆成功经验，将其转化为结构化、可复制的落地工具包和SOP，推动模式的快速复制。

• 负责新业极团队资产库、案例库的运营与升级，确保组织智慧与核心资产的系统性留存与沉淀。

Leadership Competencies领导者胜任力

• 医药行业市场推广、准入、咨询、商务管理等相关岗位5年以上工作经验

• 出色的统筹、沟通、运营、协调能力

• 较强的独立分析和解决问题能力

• 数据和人际敏感度和学习能力

Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 主要职责/责任
Job Required Competencies岗位所需胜任力

• 较强的逻辑思维和运营规划能力、具有典型成长性思维、复杂项目管理能力、跨部门沟通与团队管理

• 熟练掌握甘特图、看板管理、RACI模型等项目管理工具。具备极强的目标倒推意识与“闭环思维”，善于在多任务并行的环境下理清优先级，推进项目节点的按时交付。

• 文字功底扎实，逻辑清晰，能够高效制作高质量的商务PPT、会议纪要及SOP手册；在多任务并行的环境下，展现出极强的条理性和时间管理能力。

• 具备高度的责任心、原则性与抗压能力。面对繁琐的日常运营事务和多方协同压力，对流程细节有极致追求，敢于在关键节点预警催办。

• 具备出色的定性与定量信息收集能力。能够通过问卷、访谈等工具深入一线听取真实声音，透视执行偏差，并形成结构化的复盘报告反馈总部。

• 具备敏锐的经验捕捉能力，善于将一线零散、碎片化、感性的高绩效个案，转化为结构化、体系化、可复制的工具包或SOP。

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Security & Resilience: Integrate cutting-edge SAST/DAST tools (SonarQube, Mayhem) to ensure our medical software is impenetrable.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Business Architect, you will define and maintain the architectural vision and strategy for the Roche organization, ensuring alignment with business goals and supporting the adoption and implementation of Roche’s Reference Architecture. Acting as the authority and guardian of the Reference Architecture, you will create comprehensive solutions, promote best practices, and ensure architecture components and building blocks are reusable, scalable, and align with established standards. Through collaboration across the organization, you will lead efforts to integrate applications and systems effectively, drive innovation, and uphold the architectural integrity of Roche's customer-facing products. Furthermore, you will play a key role in advancing Roche’s common platform strategy by contributing to its scalability, reliability, interoperability, and alignment with the needs of digital medical products and engineering teams.
Your tasks and Responsibilities

• Architectural Guardianship: Define and maintain the Architecture roadmap and Reference Architecture, ensuring all solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with the Roche Ecosystem strategy.

• Strategy & Integration: Lead the delivery of actionable technology strategies and blueprints, guiding the integration of applications using standard building blocks and reusable components.

• Platform Leadership: Drive "platform-first" approaches, identifying technical gaps and developing innovative solutions for data interoperability and event-driven frameworks.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Engineers, Product Managers, and Sales/Medical teams to support strategic outcomes and ensure consistent technological implementation across customer-facing products.

• Quality & Risk Management: Analyze non-functional requirements (security, performance, scalability) and establish governance to reduce duplication and improve system robustness.

Who you are

• Education & Experience: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering, with at least 10+ years of experience in business/reference architecture and shared platform strategies.

• Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of platform strategies, architectural governance, APIs, and shared services models. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and frameworks like TOGAF or SAFe is highly valued.

• Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare standards such as FHIR and HL7 , along with expertise in compliance-based design and industry regulations.

• Soft Skills: Advanced consulting and communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional, global environments and translate business goals into technical roadmaps.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Quality & Risk Management: Analizzare i requisiti non funzionali (sicurezza, prestazioni, scalabilità) e stabilire la governance per ridurre la duplicazione e migliorare la robustezza del sistema. Chi sei
• Istruzione e esperienza: Laurea o Master in Informatica o Ingegneria, con almeno 10 anni di esperienza in business/reference architettura e strategie di piattaforma condivise.
• Esperienza tecnica: profonda conoscenza delle strategie di piattaforma, governance architettonica, API e modelli di servizi condivisi. Esperienza con piattaforme cloud (AWS, Azure, o GCP) e framework come TOGAF o SAFe è altamente apprezzata.
• Conoscenza del settore: familiarità con gli standard sanitari come FHIR e HL7 , insieme alle competenze nella progettazione e regolamentazioni del settore conformi.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant qu'architecte d'affaires, vous définirez et conserverez la vision et la stratégie architecturales de l'organisation Roche, en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs commerciaux et en soutenant l'adoption et la mise en oeuvre de l'architecture de référence Roches. En tant qu'autorité et gardienne de l'architecture de référence, vous créerez des solutions globales, promouvoirez les meilleures pratiques et veillerez à ce que les éléments d'architecture et les éléments de construction soient réutilisables, évolutifs et conformes aux normes établies. Grâce à la collaboration dans l'ensemble de l'organisation, vous dirigerez les efforts visant à intégrer efficacement les applications et les systèmes, à stimuler l'innovation et à préserver l'intégrité architecturale des produits destinés aux clients de Roche. De plus, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'avancement de la stratégie commune de la plateforme Roches en contribuant à son évolutivité, sa fiabilité, son interopérabilité et son alignement sur les besoins des produits médicaux numériques et des équipes d'ingénierie. Vos tâches et responsabilités
• Architectural Guardianship: Définir et maintenir la feuille de route et l'architecture de référence de l'architecture, en veillant à ce que toutes les solutions soient évolutives, fiables et alignées sur la stratégie de l'écosystème Roche.
• Stratégie et intégration : Diriger la mise en oeuvre de stratégies et de plans technologiques concrets, guider l'intégration des applications à l'aide de blocs de construction standard et de composants réutilisables.
• Leadership de la plate-forme : Conduire des approches « en première plate-forme », cerner les lacunes techniques et élaborer des solutions novatrices pour l'interopérabilité des données et les cadres axés sur les événements.
• Collaboration avec les intervenants : Partenariat avec les ingénieurs, les gestionnaires de produits et les équipes des ventes et des services médicaux afin d'appuyer les résultats stratégiques et d'assurer une mise en oeuvre technologique uniforme des produits destinés aux clients.
• Qualité et gestion des risques : analyser les exigences non fonctionnelles (sécurité, performance, évolutivité) et établir une gouvernance pour réduire les doubles emplois et améliorer la robustesse du système. Qui vous êtes
• Éducation et expérience: Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique ou en génie, avec au moins 10 ans d'expérience en architecture d'affaires/de référence et stratégies de plateforme partagées.
• Expertise technique : Connaissance approfondie des stratégies des plateformes, de la gouvernance architecturale, des API et des modèles de services partagés. L'expérience avec les plateformes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et les frameworks comme TOGAF ou SAFe est très appréciée.
• Connaissance du secteur : Connaissance des normes de soins de santé telles que FHIR et HL7 , ainsi que de l'expertise dans la conception fondée sur la conformité et les règlements de l'industrie.
• Compétences souples : Compétences de conseil et de communication avancées, avec une capacité prouvée de collaborer dans des environnements interfonctionnels et mondiaux et de traduire les objectifs des entreprises en feuilles de route techniques. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

jobs.title: Finance Enterprise Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Mission Statement
Finance Enterprise Partner is a critical role to maximize Revenue and Profitability by acting as a Co-driver and Guardian of the business.
The role's core mission is to provide a holistic, forward-looking financial view of the Japanese In-Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) market, enabling leaders to make faster, better strategic decisions.
Finance Enterprise Partner is not a support function but an active co-pilot of business performance, sitting at the intersection of finance, strategy, and commercial execution to establish a profit-driven company culture to achieve long-term company ambition.

Core Responsibilities
Finance Enterprise Partner will mainly focus on three core pillars:

1. Financial Planning & Analysis
[Planning & Forecasting]

• Lead & facilitate the rolling forecast events: drive annual budget, monthly forecast, and mid-term planning, ensuring strict alignment with commercial strategy.

• Design and maintain comprehensive financial models: incorporate volume, price, product mix and cost assumptions to ensure robust and agile financial planning.

[Performance Monitoring & Visualization]

• Drive performance reviews with clear and actionable visualization: produce executive-level dashboards and visualize performance by portfolio, product, and segment to foster shared understanding and clarify current financial positioning for next actions.

• Own the Gross Margin bridge analysis and prepare financial commentary, KPI scorecards, and forward-looking outlooks to clearly explain variances between actuals, budget, and prior periods with clear business narratives.

[Business Insights & Scenario Planning]

• Provide actionable business insights: proactively identify risks and opportunities in P&L and bring data-driven recommendations, focusing on actionable strategies beyond mere analysis. Translate macro market trends (pricing pressure, tender cycles, aging demographics) into quantified financial impact and scenario analysis.

2. Advanced management decision support
[Strategic Profitability Management]

• Evaluate and challenge current strategies for new and existing businesses. Conduct product-level and customer-level margin analysis to identify revenue growth opportunities, surface dilutive contracts, and prioritize high-value segments.

[Financial modeling for Complex Deals]

• Partner on strategic deals: build deal-level financial models, ROI analyses, pricing frameworks, and risk-adjusted projections. Participate in key customer strategic business reviews, providing top management with value-added financial insights and suggestions, bringing financial credibility to commercial discussions.

[Smart Risk Taking & Problem Solving]

• Enable "Smart Risks" for complex business cases: establish a collaborative system with business members to advance tough and highly complex business cases. Maximize value by providing expert quantitative analysis, consultation, and improvement proposals that drive strategic decisions.

3. Foster Profit-Driven Culture & Establish Organizational Governance
[Profit-Driven Culture]

• Foster financial acumen across the organization: contribute to profitability improvement and cultural change by embedding a mindset where all employees routinely engage in activities for profit improvement as their own responsibility.

[Cross-Functional Value Creation]

• Drive cross-functional financial initiatives: partner with Supply Chain, Commercial Operations, Finance Excellence and other groups to model the financial impa

jobs.title: Senior/Principal Scientist - NMR Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

NMR Expert in pRED-pCMC Analytical Chemistry

In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicine. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.
This role is situated within the preclinical Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (pCMC) department, part of the Small Molecule Research organization in pRED Therapeutic Modalities (TMo). We pave the path for drug candidates from early research to development in a diverse, ambitious, and innovative environment. Collaborating actively with our discovery and development partners, we leverage cutting-edge technologies and scientific excellence to transform molecules into future medicines. As CMC experts, we bring a rich diversity of technical expertise in chemistry, formulation design, material science, and analytical chemistry, pioneering advancements in small molecules, peptides, and nucleic acid-based medicines.

The Opportunity

We are offering a unique opportunity for a hands-on NMR Expert in our Analytical Molecular Characterization group. As a Centre of Excellence for Analytics, we provide state-of-the-art methods and services for determining chemical structures, purities, and impurities, supporting portfolio projects throughout the entire value chain. In this role you plan, run and report NMR experiments for structure elucidation and inter- and intra-molecular interaction studies.

• Innovative Analytics: By applying cutting-edge analytics you support synthesis and formulation development enabling fast progress for projects, and identification of possible challenges.

• Method Development: You develop and implement new NMR experiments and give input for future developments of our NMR group.

• Scientific Excellence: You enhance scientific excellence by identifying relevant industry trends, and building and maintaining academic partnerships.

• Strategic Vision: You contribute deep scientific insights to shape the mid- and long-term strategy for NMR within the Roche portfolio. Working alongside the NMR group and the Leadership Team, you guide the translation of your strategic input into actionable team strategies.

• Collaboration and Relationship Building: You foster trustful relationships and effective collaboration with internal discovery and technical development teams as well as with external partners.

Who You Are

• Educational Background: Masters with a minimum of 5 years or PhD in analytical chemistry or related fields with a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in the industry.

• Technical Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of NMR analytics and its applications paired with a deep understanding of the technical and theoretical basis beyond the standard experiments for liquid and solid state NMR. Experience with other methods for biophysical characterization is a plus.

• Proven Experience: Hands on expertise in structure elucidation and interaction studies by NMR for synthetic oligonucleotides and/or peptides. Demonstrated expertise on higher order structure studies and aggregation studies.

• Mindset: You possess an open-minded and highly proactive, "just-do-it" approach. You enjoy problem-solving and developing new ways

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni su Roche

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, dove sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per chi sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Così ci proponiamo di prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l'accesso alla sanità oggi e per le generazioni future. Entra a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Esperto di chimica analitica pRED-pCMC

Nell'organizzazione di ricerca farmaceutica e sviluppo precoce di Roche (pRED), realizziamo farmaci trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie non soddisfatte del mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in medicina. Insieme, creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono autorizzati e ispirati a portare avanti a velocità straordinarie innovazioni che cambiano la vita.

Questo ruolo si trova all'interno del dipartimento di Chimica, Produzione e Controlli (pCMC), parte dell'organizzazione di Ricerca Molecola in Modalità terapeutiche pRED (TMo). Apriamo il percorso per i candidati alla ricerca precoce e allo sviluppo in un ambiente diversificato, ambizioso e innovativo. Iliamo attivamente con i nostri partner di scoperta e sviluppo, sfruttiamo tecnologie all'avanguardia e l'eccellenza scientifica per trasformare le molecole in farmaci futuri.

Come esperti CMC, offriamo una ricca varietà di competenze tecniche in chimica, progettazione di formulazione, scienza dei materiali e chimica analitica, progressi pionieristici in piccole molecole, peptidi e farmaci a base di acido nucleico.

L'opportunità

Offriamo un'opportunità unica per un esperto NMR pratico nel nostro gruppo di caratterizzazione molecolare analitica. Come centro di eccellenza per l'analisi, forniamo metodi e servizi all'avanguardia per determinare strutture chimiche, purità e impurità, supportando progetti di portafoglio per tutta la catena del valore. In questo ruolo pianifichi, gestisci e riporti esperimenti NMR per la chiarificazione della struttura e studi di interazione inter- e intra-molecolare.

- Analisi innovativa: applicando analisi all'avanguardia, supporti lo sviluppo di sintesi e formulazione consentendo rapidi progressi per i progetti e individuando possibili sfide. - Sviluppo del metodo: Sviluppi e implementi nuovi esperimenti NMR e dai input per gli sviluppi futuri del nostro gruppo NMR. - Eccellenza scientifica: Migliora l'eccellenza scientifica individuando le tendenze del settore e costruendo e mantenendo partnership accademiche.

- Visione strategica: Lei contribuisce a profonde conoscenze scientifiche per definire la strategia a medio e lungo termine per NMR all'interno del portafoglio Roche. Lavorando insieme al gruppo NMR e al Team di Leadership, Lei guida la traduzione del Suo input strategico in strategie di team attuabili. - Il 21a e il Relationship Building: Lei promuove rapporti di fiducia ed efficace collaborazione con i team di scoperta interna e di sviluppo tecnico così come con i partner esterni.

Chi sei

- Background didattico: Master con un minimo di 5 anni o dottorato in chimica analitica o campi correlati con un minimo di 3 anni di esperienza professionale nel settore. - Esperti tecnici: Conoscenza completa dell'analisi NMR e delle sue applicazioni abbinata ad una profonda comprensione della base tecnica e teorica oltre agli esperimenti standard per NMR a stato liquido e solido. L'esperienza con altri metodi per la caratterizzazione biofisica è un plus.

- Esperienza di Proven: Mani sulla competenza in strutture di chiarificazione e di interazione studi da NMR per oligonucleotidi sintetici e / o peptidi. Esperti dimostrato su studi di struttura di ordine superiore e studi di aggregazione. - Mente: Si dispone di un approccio aperto e altamente proattivo, "just-do-it". Godete di problem-solving e lo sviluppo di nuovi modi

descriptionByLocale.de:
Über Roche

Bei Roche können Sie sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, für wen Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell gedeihen können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat, heute und für Generationen.

Die Position

NMR Experte für pRED-pCMC Analytische Chemie

In der Roche-Organisation Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development (pRED) stellen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten her, um einige der härtesten ungedeckten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse der Welt zu bewältigen. Bei pRED sind wir durch unsere Mission, Wissenschaft in Medizin zu verwandeln, vereint. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine Kultur, die von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut geprägt ist, in der unsere talentierten Menschen dazu befähigt und inspiriert sind, mit großer Geschwindigkeit außergewöhnliche lebensverändernde Innovationen hervorzubringen.

Diese Rolle liegt in der präklinischen Abteilung Chemie, Manufacturing und Controls (pCMC), die Teil der Organisation Small Molecule Research in pRED-Treastic Modalities (TMo) ist. Wir ebnen den Weg für Arzneimittelkandidaten von der frühen Forschung bis zur Entwicklung in einem vielfältigen, ehrgeizigen und innovativen Umfeld. In Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Entdecker- und Entwicklungspartnern nutzen wir modernste Technologien und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz, um Moleküle in zukünftige Medikamente zu verwandeln.

Als CMC-Experten bringen wir eine reiche Vielfalt an technischer Expertise in Chemie, Formulierungsdesign, Materialwissenschaft und analytischer Chemie, bahnbrechende Fortschritte in kleinen Molekülen, Peptiden und nukleinsäurebasierten Arzneimitteln mit.

Die Gelegenheit

Wir bieten eine einzigartige Gelegenheit für einen NMR-Experten in unserer Gruppe für analytische molekulare Charakterisierung. Als Exzellenzzentrum für Analytik bieten wir modernste Methoden und Dienstleistungen zur Bestimmung chemischer Strukturen, Reinheiten und Verunreinigungen an, die Portfolioprojekte in der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette unterstützen. In dieser Funktion planen, leiten und berichten Sie NMR-Experimente für Strukturerklärungs- und inter- und intramoleculare Interaktionsstudien.

- Innovative Analytics: Mit der Anwendung modernster Analysen unterstützen Sie die Entwicklung von Synthese- und Formulierungstechnologien, die schnelle Fortschritte bei Projekten und die Identifizierung möglicher Herausforderungen ermöglichen. - Methodenentwicklung: Sie entwickeln und implementieren neue NMR-Experimente und geben Input für zukünftige Entwicklungen unserer NMR-Gruppe. - Wissenschaftliche Exzellenz: Sie steigern wissenschaftliche Exzellenz durch die Ermittlung relevanter Branchentrends und den Aufbau und die Pflege akademischer Partnerschaften.

- Strategische Vision: Sie tragen tiefe wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse bei, um die mittel- und langfristige Strategie für NMR im Roche-Portfolio zu gestalten. Sie begleiten die NMR-Gruppe und das Leadership-Team und leiten die Umsetzung Ihrer strategischen Beiträge in umsetzbare Teamstrategien. - Zusammenarbeit und Beziehungsaufbau: Sie fördern vertrauensvolle Beziehungen und eine effektive Zusammenarbeit mit internen Entdeckungs- und technischen Entwicklungsteams sowie mit externen Partnern.

Wer du bist

- Pädagogischer Hintergrund: Master mit mindestens 5 Jahren oder Doktortitel in analytischer Chemie oder verwandten Bereichen mit mindestens 3 Jahren Berufserfahrung in der Branche. - Technische Expertise: Umfassende Kenntnisse der NMR-Analysen und deren Anwendungen gepaart mit einem tiefen Verständnis der technischen und theoretischen Grundlage über die Standardexperimente für flüssigen und festen Zustand NMR. Erfahrung mit anderen Methoden für biophysikalische Charakterisierung ist ein Plus.

- Bewährte Erfahrung: Hands on Expertise in Struktur- und Interaktionsstudien von NMR für synthetische Oligonucleotide und/oder Peptide. Nachweisene Expertise in Strukturstudien höherer Ordnung und Aggregationsstudien. - Mindset: Sie besitzen einen aufgeschlossenen und hochproaktiven "Just-do-it"-Ansatz. Sie genießen die Problemlösung und entwickeln neue Wege
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À propos de Roche

Chez Roche, vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassés pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies et à assurer que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir.

La position

Expert en chimie analytique pRED-pCMC

Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED) de Roche, nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. ChezPRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médecine. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont habilités et inspirés à faire avancer rapidement une innovation extraordinaire qui change la vie.

Ce rôle est situé dans le département de chimie, fabrication et contrôles précliniques (pCMC), qui fait partie de l'organisme de recherche Small Molecule dans les modalités thérapeutiques pRED (TMo). Nous préparons la voie des candidats à la recherche précoce au développement dans un environnement diversifié, ambitieux et innovant. En collaborant activement avec nos partenaires de découverte et de développement, nous tirons parti des technologies de pointe et de l'excellence scientifique pour transformer les molécules en médicaments futurs.

En tant qu'experts du CMC, nous apportons une riche diversité d'expertise technique en chimie, en conception de formulation, en science des matériaux et en chimie analytique, en progrès pionniers dans les petites molécules, les peptides et les médicaments à base d'acide nucléique.

Les possibilités

Nous offrons une occasion unique pour un expert pratique en RMN dans notre groupe de caractérisation moléculaire analytique. En tant que Centre d'excellence en analyse, nous fournissons des méthodes et des services de pointe pour déterminer les structures chimiques, les puretés et les impuretés, soutenant des projets de portefeuille dans toute la chaîne de valeur.

- Analyse innovante : En appliquant des analyses de pointe, vous soutenez le développement de synthèse et de formulation permettant de progresser rapidement pour les projets et de cerner les défis possibles. - Développement de méthodes : Vous développez et mettez en œuvre de nouvelles expériences RMN et vous donnez votre avis sur les développements futurs de notre groupe RMN. - Excellence scientifique : Vous améliorez l'excellence scientifique en identifiant les tendances pertinentes de l'industrie et en établissant et en maintenant des partenariats universitaires.

- Vision stratégique : Vous contribuez à la mise en place de la stratégie à moyen et long terme de RMN dans le portefeuille Roche. En collaboration avec le groupe RMN et l'équipe de leadership, vous guidez la traduction de votre apport stratégique en stratégies d'équipes concrètes. - Collaboration et établissement de relations : Vous favorisez des relations de confiance et une collaboration efficace avec les équipes de découverte interne et de développement technique ainsi qu'avec des partenaires externes.

Qui vous êtes

- Expériences pédagogiques : Maîtrise avec un minimum de 5 ans ou doctorat en chimie analytique ou dans des domaines connexes avec un minimum de 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans l'industrie. - Expertise technique : Connaissance complète de l'analyse RMN et de ses applications jumelées à une compréhension approfondie de la base technique et théorique au-delà des expériences standard pour la RMN à l'état liquide et solide.

- Expérience éprouvée : Expertise sur l'eluciation de la structure et les études d'interaction par RMN pour les oligonucléotides et/ou les peptides synthétiques. Expertise démontrée sur les études de structure et d'agrégation de l'ordre supérieur. - Mindset : Vous possédez une approche ouverte et hautement proactive, « juste-do-it ».

jobs.title: Project Change Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Change Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization. Are you a project management and project change management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be working with the Marketing Technologies organization and its solution teams . You will be responsible for successful project change delivery and translating the technical vision into practical user adoption and rollout plans. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Change Management Strategy : Creating, owning and implementing a holistic change management strategy - including engagement, readiness and adoption - in close alignment with the respective solution owner. Drive behavioral change and technology adoption to ensure effective knowledge transfer, user readiness, and the seamless adoption of new functionalities.

• Change Monitoring : Actively monitor the adoption of technical functionalities across the ecosystem. Continuously identify opportunities to enhance product usability and platform capabilities by collaborating directly with Solution Owners, users and the wider ecosystem.

• Enablement and Readiness : Drive end-to-end user adoption by defining readiness frameworks, managing cross-solution engagement strategies, and delivering practical enablement materials that empower stakeholders to autonomously execute new business processes

• Adoption Support & Feedback Loop : Serve as the primary adoption contact for usability questions. Act as the ‘voice of the user’, understanding their business needs, guiding them on how the technology solves those needs, and translating affiliate pain points into actionable feedback for the Solution Owners.

• Content Consistency : Ensure the creation, accuracy, and consistency of learning content, aligning it closely with broader communication campaigns, and global engagement activities. Providing feedback and ensuring adoption of training material.

Capability Building
Be an active member of the RSS Project Management Organization by

• Continuously improving the project management and project change management capabilities, service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics

• Supporting the development of upskilling content and toolkits for our team

• Actively managing your own development

• Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your RSS colleagues

Who You Are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes

• University degree with 5+ years of experience in project management and project change management.

• Proven experience in change management principles , methodologies, and applying instructional design to adult learning portfolios.

Allora tu sei il candidato che stiamo cercando. In questo ruolo lavorerai con l'organizzazione Marketing Technologies e i suoi team di soluzione . Sarete responsabili per il successo della consegna dei cambiamenti di progetto e la traduzione della visione tecnica nell'adozione pratica degli utenti e piani di rollout. Il vostro lavoro comprenderà, ma non sarà limitato a: Engagement Delivery
• Strategia di gestione del cambiamento: Creazione, gestione e attuazione di una strategia di gestione del cambiamento olistico - incluso impegno, disponibilità e adozione - in stretta allineamento con il rispettivo proprietario della soluzione. Guidare il cambiamento comportamentale e l'adozione della tecnologia per garantire un trasferimento di conoscenze efficace, la disponibilità degli utenti e l'adozione senza soluzione di continuità di nuove funzionalità.
• Monitoraggio dei cambiamenti: monitorare attivamente l'adozione di funzionalità tecniche in tutto l'ecosistema. Identificare costantemente le opportunità per migliorare l'usabilità del prodotto e le capacità della piattaforma collaborando direttamente con i proprietari di soluzioni, gli utenti e l'ecosistema più ampio.
• Abilitazione e prontezza: Guida l'adozione end-to-end degli utenti definendo i framework di prontezza, gestendo le strategie di coinvolgimento trasversale e fornendo materiali pratici di abilitazione che consentono agli stakeholder di eseguire autonomamente nuovi processi aziendali
• Supporto & Feedback Loop: Servire come primo contatto di adozione per le domande di usabilità. Agire come la ‘voce dell’utente’, comprendere le proprie esigenze aziendali, guidandoli su come la tecnologia risolve tali esigenze, e traducendo i punti di dolore della filiale in feedback attuabile per i proprietari della soluzione.
• Consistency: Garantire la creazione, l'accuratezza e la coerenza dei contenuti di apprendimento, allinearlo strettamente con le più ampie campagne di comunicazione e le attività di coinvolgimento globale. Fornire feedback e garantire l'adozione di materiale formativo. Capability Building Diventa membro attivo dell'Organizzazione per la gestione dei progetti RSS
• Migliorare costantemente la gestione del progetto e le capacità di gestione dei cambiamenti di progetto, le offerte di servizi e il coinvolgimento della comunità sfruttando gli ultimi sviluppi e le dinamiche di mercato
• Sostenere lo sviluppo di contenuti e toolkit upskilling per il nostro team
• Gestione attiva del proprio sviluppo
• Applicare i tuoi insegnamenti durante gli impegni e condividerli con i tuoi colleghi RSS Chi sei Possiedi le seguenti qualifiche, esperienza e attributi personali
• Laurea universitaria con 5+ anni di esperienza nella gestione dei progetti e nella gestione dei cambiamenti di progetto.
• Esperienza comprovata nei principi di gestione dei cambiamenti, nelle metodologie e nell'applicazione del design didattico ai portafogli di apprendimento per adulti.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a highly skilled Cybersecurity Engineer responsible for protecting our digital footprint at the endpoint level. Our team manages critical security products across the enterprise, including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Application Control, and Secure Data Erasure.
Our team consists of deep subject matter experts in cybersecurity and we are looking for a driven, technically rigorous Security Engineer to join us. Your primary mission will be to maintain and evolve our security tools, bringing a modern, automation-first development mindset to our operational security practices to ensure optimal performance.

Job Responsibilities

• Maintenance at scale: Configure, deploy, and maintain our global Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solution across thousands of endpoints (Windows, macOS, and Linux) to ensure peak performance.

• Application Control Governance: Design, implement, and fine-tune Application Control policies (e.g., AppLocker, WDAC, or third-party equivalents) to ensure only trusted executables, scripts, and libraries run within our environment, balancing security with user productivity.

• Optimization: Continuous evaluation to minimize false positives, optimize system performance, and improve the overall signal-to-noise ratio.

• Secure Data Erasure Lifecycle: Support the maintenance and auditing of our enterprise-grade secure data wiping services.

• Automation: Leverage a development mindset to build scripts, tools, and API integrations that automate repetitive engineering tasks and deployment processes.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with other senior cybersecurity experts, translating their deep security requirements into scalable, automated technical solutions.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3+ years of proven, hands-on experience managing EDR solutions (e.g., Cortex XDR, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint) in a large-scale enterprise environment.

• Proficiency in written and spoken English (C1 or above level).

Technical Skills

• Security Foundations: Good fundamental understanding of enterprise cybersecurity, specifically around endpoint security (EDR/XDR platforms like Cortex XDR), application whitelisting, and secure data handling.

• Application Control Expertise: Strong practical experience designing, rolling out, and maintaining Application Control/Whitelisting strategies across complex organizational structures.

• OS Internals: Strong understanding of operating system architectures, processes, memory management and filesystems (Windows, Linux, macOS).

• Analytical Mindset: Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to dive into complex system logs to trace issues back to their root cause.

• Automation & Deployment: Hands-on experience with configuration management and deployment tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, SCCM, Microsoft Intune, Jamf).

• Development Best Practices: Solid understanding of software development lifecycles (SDLC), version control (Git), and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

Additional Qualifications

• The "Builder" Mentality: You look at a manual, repetitive IT task and immediately think about how to write a script to do it better and faster.

• Problem Solver: Capable of troubleshooting complex deployment failures across varied endpoint environments.

• Adaptable: Comfortable working in a high

Responsabilités professionnelles
• Maintenance à l'échelle : Configurez, déployez et maintenez notre solution globale de détection et de réponse de point d'arrivée (EDR) sur des milliers de paramètres (Windows, macOS et Linux) pour assurer des performances maximales.

AppLocker, WDAC ou équivalents tiers) pour s'assurer que seuls les exécutables de confiance, les scripts et les bibliothèques fonctionnent dans notre environnement, en conciliant la sécurité et la productivité des utilisateurs.

• Cycle de vie d'effacement sécurisé des données: Soutenir la maintenance et l'audit de nos services d'essuyage sécurisé des données de qualité entreprise.
• Automatisation : Tirer parti d'un état d'esprit de développement pour construire des scripts, des outils et des intégrations API qui automatisent les tâches d'ingénierie répétitives et les processus de déploiement.
• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Partenaire avec d'autres experts en cybersécurité, traduisant leurs exigences de sécurité profondes en solutions techniques évolutives et automatisées. Compétences Éducation / Expérience

• 3 ans et plus d'expérience éprouvée en gestion de solutions EDR (par exemple Cortex XDR, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint) dans un environnement d'entreprise à grande échelle.
• Compétence en anglais écrit et parlé (niveau C1 ou supérieur). Compétences techniques
• Fondations de la sécurité : Bonne compréhension fondamentale de la cybersécurité des entreprises, en particulier autour de la sécurité des terminaux (plates-formes EDR/XDR comme Cortex XDR), de la liste blanche des applications et du traitement sécurisé des données.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Project Management. Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology. You will work with solutions teams for Marketing Technologies who are tasked to deliver strategic transformation while sustaining and evolving ongoing solution operations. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Project Management & Coordination : Coordinate daily project execution across the solution area by facilitating ceremonies (scrums, sprint planning), maintaining product backlogs, and actively managing action and decision logs.

• Inbound Funnel Control & Prioritization : Act as the primary project point of contact to capture, structure, and funnel heavy volumes of cross-program requests, ensuring the product teams maintain adequate focus on prioritized objectives.

• Cross-Program Coordination : Coordinate with other programs and incoming functional demands. Actively plan, track, and facilitate complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with overarching strategic timelines.

• Dependency & Interface Management : Actively manage and track end-to-end dependencies - both internal and external - while refining handover interfaces between product owners and other functions.

• Portfolio Transparency & Consistency : Provide structural project management to maintain project standards, ensuring clear, transparent, and connected tracking of the product's initiative portfolio for leadership visibility.

• Performance Reporting : Establish and drive consistent project KPI tracking and status reporting across the specific product area to ensure schedule and budget adherence across all parallel initiatives.

• Project Management capability development : Serve as a subject matter expert, providing project management delivery coaching to the product teams to embed "one way of project delivery" across the organization.

Capability Building
Be an active member of the Project Management Chapter by

• Continuously improve the project management capabilities , service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics

• Supporting the development of upskilling content and toolkits for our team

• Actively managing your own development

• Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your chapter colleagues

Who You Are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes

• University degree with 5+ years of project management experience; a background in bu

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) intende "trasformare il modo in cui opera Roche". Come organizzazione globale di oltre 3.500 colleghi, possiamo consentire a Roche di operare in un ambiente di business competitivo e in continua evoluzione. Forniamo ai nostri partner servizi e soluzioni aziendali end-to-end, consentendo loro di concentrarsi sulle attività incentrate sui pazienti. Abbracciando una mentalità OneRoche, facciamo leva sulla nostra rete globale situata a Budapest (Ungheria), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), e i nostri altri siti per rimanere clienti-centric 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7 e co-creare soluzioni insieme. L'opportunità Come Project Manager sarete parte dell'organizzazione di gestione del progetto RSS e riferire al capo Piombo per la gestione dei progetti. Sei un appassionato di project management e vuoi fornire i migliori servizi di gestione dei progetti di classe ai partner di Roche? Allora tu sei il candidato che stiamo cercando. In questo ruolo sarete responsabili per la consegna del progetto di successo utilizzando una metodologia di gestione agile o tradizionale del progetto. Potrai lavorare con i team di soluzioni per Marketing Technologies che sono incaricati di fornire una trasformazione strategica, supportando e evolvendo le operazioni di soluzione in corso. Il vostro lavoro comprenderà, ma non sarà limitato a: Engagement Delivery
• Project Management & Coordination: Coordinare l'esecuzione giornaliera del progetto in tutta l'area della soluzione facilitando cerimonie (scrums, pianificazione sprint), mantenendo i backlog del prodotto e gestendo attivamente i registri delle azioni e delle decisioni.
• Inbound Funnel Control & Prioritization: Atto come punto di contatto principale del progetto per catturare, strutturare e imbuto volumi pesanti di richieste cross-program, assicurando che i team di prodotto mantengano sufficiente attenzione sugli obiettivi prioritari.
• Coordinamento cross-Program: Coordinamento con altri programmi e richieste funzionali in arrivo. Pianificare, tracciare e facilitare iniziative complesse e multi-stakeholder, garantendo un'integrazione e un allineamento senza soluzione di continuità con tempi strategici overarching.
• Gestione delle dipendenze e delle interfacce: gestione attiva e monitoraggio delle dipendenze end-to-end - sia interne che esterne - mentre raffinazione delle interfacce di handover tra i proprietari dei prodotti e altre funzioni.
• Portfolio Transparency & Consistency: Fornire la gestione dei progetti strutturali per mantenere gli standard di progetto, assicurando un monitoraggio chiaro, trasparente e connesso del portafoglio di iniziative del prodotto per la visibilità della leadership.
• Performance Reporting: Stabilire e guidare il monitoraggio costante del progetto KPI e la segnalazione dello stato attraverso l'area specifica del prodotto per garantire la pianificazione e l'aderenza del budget in tutte le iniziative parallele.
• Sviluppo delle capacità di gestione del progetto: Servire come esperto di materia tematica, fornire la consegna di project management ai team di prodotti per incorporare "un modo di consegna del progetto" in tutta l'organizzazione. Capability Building Essere un membro attivo del Capitolo Project Management
• Migliorare costantemente le capacità di gestione del progetto, le offerte di servizio e il coinvolgimento della comunità sfruttando gli ultimi sviluppi e le dinamiche di mercato
• Sostenere lo sviluppo di contenuti e toolkit upskilling per il nostro team
• Gestione attiva del proprio sviluppo
• Applicare i tuoi insegnamenti durante gli impegni e condividerli con i tuoi colleghi del capitolo Chi sei Possiedi le seguenti qualifiche, esperienza e attributi personali
• Laurea universitaria con 5+ anni di esperienza di gestione del progetto; uno sfondo in bu

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing a OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.

The Opportunity
As Project Change Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization. Are you a project management and project change management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.

In this role you will be working with the Marketing Technologies organization and its solution teams . You will be responsible for successful project change delivery and translating the technical vision into practical user adoption and rollout plans. Your work will include but will not be limited to:

Engagement Delivery

• Change Management Strategy : Creating, owning and implementing a holistic change management strategy - including engagement, readiness and adoption - in close alignment with the respective solution owner. Drive behavioral change and technology adoption to ensure effective knowledge transfer, user readiness, and the seamless adoption of new functionalities.

• Change Monitoring : Actively monitor the adoption of technical functionalities across the ecosystem. Continuously identify opportunities to enhance product usability and platform capabilities by collaborating directly with Solution Owners, users and the wider ecosystem.

• Enablement and Readiness : Drive end-to-end user adoption by defining readiness frameworks, managing cross-solution engagement strategies, and delivering practical enablement materials that empower stakeholders to autonomously execute new business processes

• Adoption Support & Feedback Loop : Serve as the primary adoption contact for usability questions. Act as the ‘voice of the user’, understanding their business needs, guiding them on how the technology solves those needs, and translating affiliate pain points into actionable feedback for the Solution Owners.

• Content Consistency : Ensure the creation, accuracy, and consistency of learning content, aligning it closely with broader communication campaigns, and global engagement activities. Providing feedback and ensuring adoption of training material.

Capability Building
Be an active member of the RSS Project Management Organization by

• Continuously improving the project management and project change management capabilities, service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics

• Supporting the development of upskilling content and toolkits for our team

• Actively managing your own development

• Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your RSS colleagues

Who You Are
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes

• University degree with 5+ years of experience in project management and project change management.

• Proven experience in change management principles , methodologies, and applying instructional design to adult learning portfolios.

• Capability to constantly challenge the status quo and successfully influence stakeholders to implement key change initiatives.

• Profound understanding and experience of key financial processes (Month End Closing, Annual Closing, Budgeting, Forecasting and Actual Performance Monitoring) and financial accounting principles.

• Demonstrated problem-solving abilities, effective communication skills, and a growth mindset.

• Actively seeking input and building relationships with other stakeholders in the ecosystem.
