The Position
As Finance Excellence Partner (FxP) you collaborate with Commercial Finance colleagues across Diagnostics and beyond geographical boundaries in a networked team, to streamline finance operations by simplifying, standardizing, automating, and utilising insights for enhanced decision making. You also collaborate closely with local Finance Enterprise Partners, finance colleagues across the global Roche finance network and local commercial business partners. You contribute to fostering a culture of innovation and experimentation as well as drive automation and digitalization across finance.

Your key responsibilities
Your main responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Being the liaison to various stakeholders across the global Roche finance network (e.g. local Finance Enterprise Partners, Roche Shared Service Center, Finance Excellence Partner chapter) on several major finance processes (Month End Closing, Budget, Forecasting, Performance Tracking).

• Leveraging technology and automation to drive digitalization as well as exploring and applying new technologies and tools in the fields of automation and Artificial Intelligence.

• Ownership of reporting solutions (sales, P&L, Headcount, Balance sheet) and providing key insights to local commercial affiliate on major KPIs.

• Identifying and implementing opportunities for efficiency gains, promoting continuous improvement through standardised processes and tools in order to be brilliant at the basics.

• Collaborating closely with Finance Enterprise Partners and internal commercial stakeholders to enable increased customer experience and business impact along the customer journey.

• Acting as an enabler for the adaption of the new ways of working by shifting from affiliate focused finance operations towards an above country-cluster level

Your profile

• Ability to work and thrive in a networked environment, cross-departments, stakeholders, hierarchies and geographies in order to work successfully across affiliates, sub-regions and regions with an enterprise perspective combined with an agile mindset.

• Capability to constantly challenge the status quo and successfully influence stakeholders to implement key change initiatives.

• Profound understanding and experience of key financial processes (Month End Closing, Annual Closing, Budgeting, Forecasting and Actual Performance Monitoring) and financial accounting principles.

• Demonstrated problem-solving abilities, effective communication skills, and a growth mindset.

• Actively seeking input and building relationships with other stakeholders in the ecosystem.

• Robust analytical skills, including business process improvement expertise.

• A strong business understanding to drive innovation effectively.

• An inclusive and collaborative approach to how you work.

• Growth mindset and living the Roche Operating Principles.

• English and French - written and spoken.

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
En tant que partenaire d'excellence en finances (FxP), vous collaborez avec des collègues des Finances commerciales à travers Diagnostics et au-delà des frontières géographiques au sein d'une équipe en réseau pour rationaliser les opérations financières en simplifiant, en standardisant, en automatisant et en utilisant les idées pour améliorer la prise de décisions. Vous collaborez également étroitement avec les partenaires financiers locaux, vos collègues financiers du réseau financier mondial Roche et vos partenaires commerciaux locaux. Vous contribuez à favoriser une culture d'innovation et d'expérimentation ainsi qu'à stimuler l'automatisation et la numérisation à travers les finances.

Vos principales responsabilités
Vos principales responsabilités comprennent notamment :

• Assurer la liaison avec diverses parties prenantes du réseau financier mondial de Roche (p. ex., les partenaires financiers locaux, le centre de services partagés de Roche, le chapitre des partenaires d'excellence financière) sur plusieurs grands processus financiers (fin du mois, budget, prévision, suivi des performances).

• Tirer parti de la technologie et de l'automatisation pour conduire la numérisation ainsi que d'explorer et d'appliquer de nouvelles technologies et outils dans les domaines de l'automatisation et de l'intelligence artificielle.

• Propriété des solutions de déclaration (ventes, P&L, compte de résultat, bilan) et fourniture de renseignements clés aux filiales commerciales locales sur les principaux ICR.

• Collaborer étroitement avec Finance Enterprise Partners et les parties prenantes commerciales internes pour accroître l'expérience client et l'impact commercial tout au long du parcours client.

• Agir comme un catalyseur pour l'adaptation des nouvelles méthodes de travail en passant d'une activité financière axée sur les filiales à une activité au-dessus de la catégorie de pays

Votre profil

• Capacité de travailler et de prospérer dans un environnement en réseau, entre les ministères, les intervenants, les hiérarchies et les géographies afin de travailler avec succès entre les affiliés, les sous-régions et les régions avec une perspective d'entreprise combinée à une mentalité agile.

• Capacité de défier constamment le statu quo et d'influencer avec succès les intervenants pour mettre en oeuvre des initiatives clés de changement.

• Compréhension approfondie et expérience des principaux processus financiers (fin de mois, clôture annuelle, budgétisation, prévision et surveillance du rendement réel) et principes comptables financiers.

• Capacités démontrées de résolution de problèmes, compétences de communication efficaces, et un état d'esprit de croissance.

• Recherche active de commentaires et établissement de relations avec d'autres intervenants de l'écosystème.

• Compétences analytiques solides, y compris l'amélioration des processus opérationnels.

• Une solide compréhension des entreprises pour stimuler efficacement l'innovation.

• Une approche inclusive et collaborative de votre façon de travailler.

• L'état d'esprit de croissance et les principes opérationnels de Roche.

• Anglais et français - écrit et parlé.

jobs.title: Global SHE Compliance Expert
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Global SHE Compliance Expert

The Opportunity

At Roche, we believe that operational excellence and sustainable action go hand in hand. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical requirements and organizational objectives, ensuring that our compliance systems effectively support our global license to operate. You will join a forward-thinking global team dedicated to maintaining the highest safety, health, and environmental standards.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead System Ownership: Act as the Global Product Owner for safety, health, and environmental (SHE) compliance systems, monitoring corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) and driving consistent application across global sites.

• Define Strategic Requirements: Document process features, user stories, and requirements in technical platforms to guide digital development teams effectively.

• Develop Compliance Standards: Create, revise, and update global internal compliance standards and process documents to reflect evolving regulatory landscapes.

• Drive Risk Insights: Monitor global compliance updates, identify potential gaps, and partner with regional experts to proactively mitigate operational risks.

• Optimize Data Analytics: Utilize data analytics tools to transform SHE compliance data into actionable trend reports and insights for leadership reviews.

• Foster Collaboration: Act as a central point of contact across corporate governance lines, advising site-level SHE officers and compliance managers to support system adoption.

Who You Are

You bring a unique blend of technical curiosity, analytical precision, and collaborative spirit. You are passionate about translating complex regulatory requirements into structured digital processes and thriving in an environment built on ethics and transparency.
Qualifications:

• University degree in Engineering, Legal, Data/Computer Science, IT, or a related technical discipline.

• Proven experience in a similar role (such as technical compliance, IT/digital data consultancy, or operational risk management) within a multinational matrix environment.

• Demonstrated track record in data architecture, compliance analytics, or digital system infrastructure.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams in fluent English.

• Familiarity with global compliance standards (e.g., ISO 14001, ISO 45001) or specific focus areas like occupational health and environmental protection is a distinct advantage.

In exchange we provide you with

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (2 office days/week). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community , where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. That’s what makes us Roche.

jobs.title: PHCS Emerging Biopharma Partnering Manager

titleByLocale.fr: PHCS Gestionnaire des partenariats en biopharmaceutiques émergents

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. PHCS Emerging Biopharma Partnering Manager, (Emerging Biopharma, Path Labs) will lead the PHCS's new business development activities for Path Labs and is accountable for Roche's Global Personalized Healthcare Solutions new incremental revenue related to the Path Lab portfolio. The successful candidate in this role will be responsible for identifying, driving and creating relationships with new and existing emerging biopharma partners. This role is primarily responsible for sourcing and onboarding new biopharma partners and developing strategic plans to create a qualifi ed pipeline of opportunities to drive sustainable revenue and growth. This role will report to the Head of the PHCS Pharma Partnering team at Roche Diagnostics Solutions and will be expected to work collaboratively across the organization to achieve results. Customers are pharmaceutical and/or therapeutic device companies that partner with Roche Diagnostics for their pharma services and companion diagnostic projects. We seek a highly motivated, collaborative individual with a strong drive to succeed who enjoys building, infl uencing, and working with a diverse team.

The Opportunity:

• Leads new business development for the Emerging Biopharma Partnering effort, contracts management activities for the Path Lab Customer Area portfolio serving global customers.

• Establishes objectives and develops business strategies needed to increase the penetration of external (i.e. non-Roche Group) emerging biopharma accounts.

• Develops, maintains and executes a strong pipeline of new business and qualifi ed leads across all different diagnostic testing modalities.

• Maintains a good understanding of the trends in the pharmaceutical industry and how they impact the companion diagnostic business. Leverages these insights to support the strategic plan of the organization.

• Conducts research on emerging business trends and economic requirements of the pharmaceutical industry and researches, screens and recommends key target companies for business alliance.

• Works with Project and CAP/CLIA Lab leadership to ensure projects can be fully supported and delivered on quality and time.

• Closely collaborates with all functions (e.g. legal, regulatory, development) to align our partnership activities with the capabilities of the organization.

• Travel: Estimated 25%

Who You Are:

• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Life Science

• You hold a minimum of 6-8 years of experience in sales, partnering, or new business development activities.

• You have a proven track record in achieving company goals through the creation of strategic partnerships, including pre-contract negotiations and post-contract alliance management.

• You possess experience with the establishment of contracts, development of pricing strategies and monitoring contract fulfi llment

• Working knowledge of worldwide pharmaceutical and in vitro diagnostic markets, including product development strategies, regulatory environment, relevant technologies and global commercialization.

• You have a high-level understanding of the different diagnostic testing modalities and ability to advise partners on the best technological options.

• You bring a strong background and knowledge

PHCS Emerging Biopharma Partnering Manager, (Emerging Biopharma, Path Labs) guiderà le nuove attività di sviluppo commerciale del PHCS per Path Labs ed è responsabile per le soluzioni sanitarie personalizzate globali di Roche nuove entrate incrementali relative al portafoglio Path Lab. Il candidato di successo in questo ruolo sarà responsabile per l'identificazione, la guida e la creazione di relazioni con nuovi e esistenti partner biofarmaci emergenti. Questo ruolo è in primo luogo responsabile dell'approvvigionamento e dell'imbarco di nuovi partner biofarmaci e dello sviluppo di piani strategici per creare una pipeline di opportunità per guidare ricavi e crescita sostenibili. Questo ruolo si riferirà al responsabile del team PHCS Pharma Partnering di Roche Diagnostics Solutions e sarà previsto di lavorare in collaborazione attraverso l'organizzazione per raggiungere i risultati. I clienti sono aziende di dispositivi farmaceutici e/o terapeutici che collaborano con Roche Diagnostics per i loro servizi farmaceutici e i progetti diagnostici dei compagni. Cerchiamo un individuo altamente motivato e collaborativo con un forte sforzo per avere successo che gode di costruzione, infl uencing, e lavorare con un team diverso. L'opportunità:
• Conduce un nuovo sviluppo aziendale per lo sforzo di Emerging Biopharma Partnering, attività di gestione dei contratti per il portafoglio Path Lab Customer Area che serve clienti globali.
• Stabilisce obiettivi e sviluppa strategie di business necessarie per aumentare la penetrazione di conti biofarmaci emergenti esterni (cioè non-Roche Group).
• Sviluppa, mantiene ed esegue una forte conduttura di nuovi business e qualifi ed conduce attraverso tutte le diverse modalità di test diagnostici.
• Mantiene una buona comprensione delle tendenze nell'industria farmaceutica e come influiscono sul business diagnostico del compagno. Leva queste informazioni per sostenere il piano strategico dell'organizzazione.
• Conduce la ricerca sulle tendenze di business emergenti e i requisiti economici dell'industria farmaceutica e delle ricerche, schermi e raccomanda le aziende di punta chiave per l'alleanza aziendale.
• Funziona con la leadership di Project e CAP/CLIA Lab per garantire che i progetti possano essere pienamente supportati e consegnati in qualità e tempo.
• Collabora strettamente con tutte le funzioni (ad esempio legali, regolamentari, di sviluppo) per allineare le nostre attività di partnership con le capacità dell'organizzazione.
• Viaggi: stimato 25% Chi sei?
• Hai una laurea in Scienze della Vita
• Hai un minimo di 6-8 anni di esperienza in vendite, partner, o nuove attività di sviluppo aziendale.
• Hai una comprovata esperienza nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali attraverso la creazione di partenariati strategici, tra cui i negoziati precontrattuali e la gestione delle alleanze post-contrattuali.
• Possiedi esperienza con la creazione di contratti, lo sviluppo di strategie di prezzi e il controllo del contratto fulfi llment
• Conoscenze di lavoro dei mercati farmaceutici e diagnostici in vitro in tutto il mondo, comprese le strategie di sviluppo del prodotto, l'ambiente normativo, le tecnologie rilevanti e la commercializzazione globale.
• Hai una comprensione di alto livello delle diverse modalità di test diagnostici e la capacità di consigliare i partner sulle migliori opzioni tecnologiche.
• Porti uno sfondo forte e una conoscenza

• Eng mit allen Funktionen (z. B. Recht, Regulierung, Entwicklung) zusammenarbeitet, um unsere Partnerschaftsaktivitäten an den Fähigkeiten der Organisation auszurichten.

• Sie verfügen über mindestens 6-8 Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Vertrieb, Partnerschaft oder neue Geschäftsentwicklung.
• Sie haben eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Erreichung der Unternehmensziele durch die Schaffung strategischer Partnerschaften, einschließlich Vorvertragsverhandlungen und Nachvertragsallianzmanagement.

• Sie haben ein hohes Verständnis für die verschiedenen diagnostischen Testmodalitäten und die Fähigkeit, Partner zu den besten technologischen Optionen zu beraten.

The Position
As an Expert within the Information Security & Privacy Advisory (ISPA) team, you move beyond "checking boxes" to become a strategic partner for global Engineering hubs. You will lead high-impact security and privacy risk assessments, ensuring Roche’s most ambitious digital projects—from GenAI to cloud-native platforms—are resilient, "Secure by Design," and compliant with global regulations.

The Team
The Information Security & Privacy Advisory (ISPA) team serves as the strategic bridge between IT, business, and legal functions at Roche. Our mission is to ensure that Roche’s digital landscape—from cutting-edge GenAI platforms to global enterprise solutions—is secure by design and compliant with international standards. We act as a global center of excellence that translates complex regulatory requirements into actionable security architecture, providing the expert guidance necessary to navigate a rapidly evolving global risk landscape.

Key Responsibilities

• High-Risk Advisory: Lead Security Expert Reviews (SER) for complex architectures, performing deep-dive technical and privacy evaluations to identify and mitigate residual risks.

• Privacy: Bridge the gap between IT, Legal, and Data Protection Officers. Translate complex legal mandates (GDPR, CCPA etc.) into actionable technical and organizational controls.

• Information Security: Contribute to Security Design Patterns and Technical Baselines for emerging technologies like Generative AI and Cloud-native ecosystems.

• Risk Governance: Utilize ServiceNow IRM to ensure the integrity and traceability of security advisory, delivering data-driven, consistent, and audit-ready results.

• Peer Excellence: Foster a "Four-Eye" quality culture through peer reviews and collective knowledge exchange within a global team of experts.

Who You Are

Our Ideal Mindset: A proactive Expert & Influencer who brings deep industry experience to an established team. You have the confidence to lead initiatives independently while thriving in an environment of collective knowledge exchange.

Qualifications:

• Experience: 5–10 years in Information Security/GRC, with a proven track record in Information Risk Assessments and DPIAs in complex, global environments.

• Technical Savvy: Deep understanding of Security Architecture and the ability to translate "Legal-speak" into "Engineering-speak."

• Regulatory Mastery: Expert knowledge of international privacy frameworks (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, etc.) and security standards (ISO 27001, NIST).

• System Proficiency: Experienced in using ServiceNow IRM to execute and document risk assessments, utilizing the platform to ensure consistent, high-quality, and transparent security guidance.

La position
En tant qu'expert au sein de l'équipe de l'Information Security & Privacy Advisory (ISPA), vous allez au-delà des « cases à cocher » pour devenir un partenaire stratégique pour les centres d'ingénierie mondiaux. Vous dirigerez des évaluations des risques liés à la sécurité et à la protection de la vie privée, en veillant à ce que les projets numériques les plus ambitieux de Roche — de GenAI aux plateformes natives du cloud — soient résilients, « Secure by Design » et conformes aux réglementations mondiales.

L'équipe
L'équipe d'avis en matière de sécurité de l'information et de protection des renseignements personnels (ISPA) sert de pont stratégique entre les fonctions informatiques, commerciales et juridiques de Roche. Notre mission est de veiller à ce que le paysage numérique de Roche – des plateformes GenAI de pointe aux solutions d'entreprise mondiales – soit sécurisé par la conception et conforme aux normes internationales. Nous agissons en tant que centre mondial d'excellence qui traduit des exigences réglementaires complexes en une architecture de sécurité réalisable, fournissant les conseils d'experts nécessaires pour naviguer dans un paysage de risque mondial en évolution rapide.

Principales responsabilités

• Avis à risque élevé : Examens d'experts en matière de sécurité (ERR) pour des architectures complexes, réalisation d'évaluations techniques et de protection de la vie privée pour déterminer et atténuer les risques résiduels.

• Vie privée : combler l'écart entre les agents informatiques, juridiques et de protection des données. Traduire des mandats juridiques complexes (RGPD, CCPA, etc.) en contrôles techniques et organisationnels réalisables.

• Sécurité de l'information : contribuer à la conception de la sécurité et aux points de référence techniques pour les technologies émergentes comme l'IA et les écosystèmes natifs du nuage.

• Gouvernance des risques : Utiliser le serviceMaintenant, la GIR assure l'intégrité et la traçabilité des avis de sécurité, fournit des résultats fondés sur les données, cohérents et prêts à l'audit.

• Excellence des pairs : Favoriser une culture de qualité « quatre ans » grâce à des examens par les pairs et à l'échange collectif de connaissances au sein d'une équipe mondiale d'experts.

Qui vous êtes

Notre esprit idéal : un expert et un influenceur proactif qui apporte une expérience industrielle profonde à une équipe établie. Vous avez la confiance de diriger des initiatives indépendamment tout en florissant dans un environnement d'échange collectif de connaissances.

Qualifications

• Expérience : de 5 à 10 ans dans le domaine de la sécurité de l'information/CRG, avec une expérience éprouvée dans les évaluations des risques liés à l'information et les EIDD dans des environnements complexes et mondiaux.

• Savvy technique : Compréhension approfondie de l'architecture de sécurité et capacité de traduire "Legal-speak" en "Engineering-speak".

• Maîtrise réglementaire : Connaissances spécialisées des cadres internationaux de protection de la vie privée (RGPD, CCPA, HIPAA, etc.) et des normes de sécurité (ISO 27001, NIST).

• Compétence du système : Expérience de l'utilisation de la GIR ServiceNow pour exécuter et documenter les évaluations des risques, en utilisant la plateforme pour assurer des conseils de sécurité cohérents, de haute qualité et transparents.

• Études : Diplôme en informatique ou en droit. Les certifications comme CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CIPP/E, CIPM ou ISO27001 sont très appréciées.

• C o munification : Compétences exceptionnelles en gestion des intervenants avec la capacité de susciter un consensus au sein d'une organisation mondiale.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, afin que nous puissions livrer le chant de la vie

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In this role, you will lead a team of Reward Analysts covering the Compensation area while at the same time you will be actively driving and collaborating on technical improvements and innovation. As a Team Lead in Global Chapter Services, you are part of the PR&R chapter and are leading a global team that covers the following areas:

• Technical, system-related activities: Configuration of the Workday Job Catalog, eligibility rules, grades, grade profiles, bonus plans, allowances etc. and active support of our Annual Performance and Compensation round as well as involvement in projects

• Executive Compensation: A dedicated role in your team, is collaborating with the Reward Partner for executive compensation for the preparation of compensation proposals for offers as well as related system configuration

• Stock: Process support for the Roche Connect program, including requirements gathering and testing of the technical solution, custom object loads and daily monitoring during enrolment period. Audit- and integration-related checks of reports, exception logs and related data maintenance in collaboration with other teams in P&C.

We expect this leader to have a strong passion and expertise in people leadership paired with experience in total rewards and technology. The opportunity:

• Building an engaging culture to both attract and retain top talent, coaching team members regarding their individual development, career plan and fostering a growth mindset

• Connecting your team members located across multiple locations through regular team meetings, sharing of wider information and ensuring equity in opportunities

• Through frequent check-ins, ensuring that ongoing dialog occurs on the topics of Career, Capabilities, Connections and Contributions; and developing the team members’ knowledge, skills, competency, etc. in order to retain and develop talented staff

• Understanding and supporting the team in their day-to-day activities related to technology (e.g. Workday Job Catalog configuration), reporting and auditing as well as providing Tier 2 support during the annual review process

• Connecting the dots with bigger technology initiatives and strategic projects (including AI) with the drive to push the team out of their comfort zone to improve processes

• Being a trusted partner to leaders and partners in the chapters, leading others through complex P&C topics by understanding the philosophies, approaches, global policies and systems-relevant configurations of relevant topics

• ​Developing and managing strong partnerships with key internal organizations and stakeholders as well as external vendors to co-create technology solutions and drive continuous improvements to increase productivity, quality and efficiency locally and globally

• Being an escalation point for related topics to your area of responsibility

• Proven experiences in the area of Compensation / Compensation technology (e.g. Workday, WTW) in m

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
In questo ruolo, guiderai un team di Reward Analysts che coprono l'area Compensation, mentre allo stesso tempo guiderai e lavorerai attivamente sui miglioramenti tecnici e sull'innovazione. Come Team Lead in Global Chapter Services, fai parte del capitolo PR&R e guida un team globale che copre le seguenti aree:

• Attività tecniche e relative al sistema: Configurazione del Workday Job Catalog, regole di idoneità, gradi, profili di grado, piani di gratifica, indennità ecc. e supporto attivo del nostro Annual Performance and Compensation round così come il coinvolgimento in progetti

• Compensazione esecutiva: Un ruolo dedicato nel vostro team, sta collaborando con il Reward Partner per la compensazione esecutiva per la preparazione di proposte di compensazione per le offerte e la relativa configurazione di sistema

• Stock: Supporto di processo per il programma Roche Connect, compresi i requisiti di raccolta e test della soluzione tecnica, carichi oggetti personalizzati e monitoraggio giornaliero durante il periodo di iscrizione. Controlli relativi all'audit e all'integrazione di report, registri delle eccezioni e relativa manutenzione dei dati in collaborazione con altri team di P&C.

Ci aspettiamo che questo leader abbia una forte passione e competenza nella leadership delle persone accoppiata con esperienza in ricompense e tecnologia totali. Cerchiamo una persona che ha la capacità di motivare, supportare e allenare il team, mentre allo stesso tempo lavora attivamente con i proprietari di prodotti tecnologici e i partner di ricompensa sulle nostre soluzioni tecnologiche e AI.

L'opportunità:

• Dimostrare una forte attenzione alla guida di futuri miglioramenti tecnici attraverso sia la leadership diretta che matrice degli specialisti Analisti di Premi Tecnici e dei team di progetto più ampi, garantendo al contempo la consegna di alta qualità nell'area Compensazione Stock e Executive attraverso il supporto dedicato e l'addestramento di questi colleghi specializzati

• Costruire una cultura coinvolgente per attrarre e mantenere i migliori talenti, allenare i membri del team per quanto riguarda il loro sviluppo individuale, il piano di carriera e promuovere una mentalità di crescita

• Collegare i membri del team situati in più sedi attraverso riunioni di team regolari, condivisione di informazioni più ampie e garantire l'equità nelle opportunità

• Attraverso controlli frequenti, assicurando che il dialogo continuo si verifichi sui temi di Carriera, Capacità, Connessioni e Contributi; e sviluppando le conoscenze, competenze, competenze dei membri del team, ecc al fine di mantenere e sviluppare personale di talento

• Comprendere e sostenere il team nelle loro attività quotidiane relative alla tecnologia (ad esempio la configurazione di Workday Job Catalog), reporting e auditing e fornire supporto Tier 2 durante il processo di revisione annuale

• Collegare i punti con più grandi iniziative tecnologiche e progetti strategici (inclusa l'IA) con l'obiettivo di spingere il team fuori dalla loro zona di comfort per migliorare i processi

• Essendo un partner affidabile per leader e partner nei capitoli, guidando gli altri attraverso complessi argomenti P&C comprendendo le filosofie, gli approcci, le politiche globali e le configurazioni di sistemi rilevanti

• Sviluppo e gestione di partnership forti con le principali organizzazioni interne e le parti interessate, nonché fornitori esterni per co-creare soluzioni tecnologiche e migliorare continuamente la produttività, la qualità e l'efficienza a livello locale e globale

• Essere un punto di escalation per argomenti correlati alla vostra area di responsabilità

Chi sei:

• Esperienze provate nell'area della tecnologia Compensation / Compensation (ad esempio Workday, WTW) in m

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
In dieser Funktion leiten Sie ein Team von Reward Analysten, das den Vergütungsbereich abdeckt, während Sie gleichzeitig aktiv an technischen Verbesserungen und Innovationen arbeiten. Als Team Lead in Global Chapter Services sind Sie Teil des PR&R-Kapitels und leiten ein globales Team, das folgende Bereiche abdeckt:

• Technische, systembezogene Aktivitäten: Konfiguration des Workday Job Catalogs, Förderregeln, Noten, Notenprofile, Bonuspläne, Zulagen etc. und aktive Unterstützung unserer Jahresleistungs- und Vergütungsrunde sowie Beteiligung an Projekten

• Executive Compensation: Eine engagierte Rolle in Ihrem Team, ist die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Reward Partner für Executive Compensation für die Erstellung von Vergütungsvorschlägen für Angebote sowie die damit verbundene Systemkonfiguration

• Lagerbestand: Prozessunterstützung für das Roche Connect-Programm, einschließlich Anforderungserfassung und Test der technischen Lösung, benutzerdefinierte Objektladungen und tägliche Überwachung während des Anmeldezeitraums. Audit- und integrationsbezogene Überprüfungen von Berichten, Ausnahmeprotokollen und der damit verbundenen Datenpflege in Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Teams in P&C.

Wir erwarten, dass diese Führungskraft eine starke Leidenschaft und Expertise in der Führung von Menschen hat, gepaart mit Erfahrung in totalen Belohnungen und Technologie. Wir suchen eine Person, die in der Lage ist, das Team zu motivieren, zu unterstützen und zu coachen, während sie gleichzeitig aktiv mit Technology Product Ownern und Reward Partnern an unseren Technologie- und KI-Lösungen arbeitet.

Die Gelegenheit:

• Demonstrieren Sie einen starken Fokus darauf, zukünftige technische Verbesserungen durch direkte und Matrix-Führung der spezialisierten Technical Reward Analysten und breiteren Projektteams voranzutreiben und gleichzeitig eine qualitativ hochwertige Lieferung im Bereich Stock and Executive Compensation durch engagierte Unterstützung und Coaching dieser spezialisierten Kollegen sicherzustellen.

• Aufbau einer ansprechenden Kultur, um Top-Talente zu gewinnen und zu halten, Coaching-Teammitglieder in Bezug auf ihre individuelle Entwicklung, Karriereplan und Förderung einer Wachstumsmentalität

• Verbinden Sie Ihre Teammitglieder an mehreren Standorten durch regelmäßige Teambesprechungen, den Austausch umfassenderer Informationen und die Gewährleistung von Chancengerechtigkeit

• Durch häufige Check-ins, um sicherzustellen, dass ein fortlaufender Dialog zu den Themen Karriere, Fähigkeiten, Verbindungen und Beiträge stattfindet; und das Wissen, die Fähigkeiten, die Kompetenz der Teammitglieder usw. zu entwickeln, um talentierte Mitarbeiter zu halten und zu entwickeln

• Verständnis und Unterstützung des Teams bei seinen täglichen Aktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit Technologie (z. B. Konfiguration des Workday-Jobkatalogs), Reporting und Auditing sowie Tier 2-Unterstützung während des jährlichen Überprüfungsprozesses

• Verbinden der Punkte mit größeren Technologieinitiativen und strategischen Projekten (einschließlich KI) mit dem Antrieb, das Team aus seiner Komfortzone zu drängen, um Prozesse zu verbessern

• Ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner für Führungskräfte und Partner in den Kapiteln sein, andere durch komplexe P&C-Themen führen, indem sie die Philosophien, Ansätze, globalen Richtlinien und systemrelevanten Konfigurationen relevanter Themen verstehen

• Entwicklung und Verwaltung starker Partnerschaften mit wichtigen internen Organisationen und Stakeholdern sowie externen Anbietern, um gemeinsam Technologielösungen zu entwickeln und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben, um Produktivität, Qualität und Effizienz lokal und global zu steigern

• Als Eskalationspunkt für verwandte Themen in Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich

Wer du bist:

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrungen im Bereich Compensation / Compensation Technology (z.B. Workday, WTW) in m
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez une équipe d'analystes de récompenses couvrant le secteur de la rémunération, tout en menant activement et en collaborant sur les améliorations techniques et l'innovation. En tant que chef d'équipe dans les services de chapitre mondial, vous faites partie du chapitre PR&R et dirigez une équipe mondiale qui couvre les domaines suivants :

• Activités techniques liées au système: Configuration du Catalogue des emplois de la journée de travail, règles d'admissibilité, grades, profils de grade, plans de bonus, indemnités, etc. et soutien actif de notre ronde annuelle de performance et de rémunération ainsi que participation à des projets

• Rémunération des cadres: Un rôle dédié dans votre équipe, collabore avec le Reward Partner pour la rémunération des cadres pour la préparation des propositions de rémunération pour les offres ainsi que la configuration du système connexe

• Stock : Support des processus pour le programme Roche Connect, y compris la collecte et l'essai des exigences de la solution technique, les charges sur mesure et la surveillance quotidienne pendant la période d'inscription. Vérification et intégration des rapports, des registres d'exception et de la maintenance des données connexes en collaboration avec d'autres équipes de P&C.

Nous nous attendons à ce que ce leader ait une forte passion et une solide expertise dans le leadership des personnes jumelées à l'expérience dans les récompenses totales et la technologie. Nous recherchons une personne capable de motiver, de soutenir et d'entraîner l'équipe, tout en travaillant activement avec les propriétaires de produits technologiques et les partenaires de récompense sur nos solutions de technologie et d'IA.

L'occasion :

• Mettre fortement l'accent sur les améliorations techniques futures grâce à la direction directe et matricielle des analystes spécialisés des récompenses techniques et des équipes de projet plus larges, tout en assurant une prestation de haute qualité dans le domaine des stocks et de la rémunération des cadres grâce à l'appui et à l'encadrement dévoués de ces collègues spécialisés

• Bâtir une culture engageante pour attirer et retenir les meilleurs talents, coacher les membres de l'équipe en ce qui concerne leur perfectionnement individuel, planifier leur carrière et favoriser un état d'esprit de croissance

• Relier les membres de votre équipe situés dans plusieurs endroits au moyen de réunions régulières d'équipes, de partage d'informations plus larges et d'assurer l'équité des possibilités

• Au moyen d'enregistrements fréquents, s'assurer que le dialogue se poursuit sur les sujets de la carrière, des capacités, des liens et des contributions; et développer les connaissances, les compétences, les compétences, etc. des membres de l'équipe afin de conserver et de développer du personnel talentueux

• Comprendre et soutenir l'équipe dans ses activités quotidiennes liées à la technologie (p. ex. configuration du catalogue d'emplois de jour de travail), à l'établissement de rapports et à la vérification, ainsi qu'à l'appui de niveau 2 pendant le processus d'examen annuel

• Connecter les points avec des initiatives technologiques plus importantes et des projets stratégiques (y compris l'IA) avec la volonté de pousser l'équipe hors de sa zone de confort pour améliorer les processus

• Être un partenaire de confiance pour les dirigeants et les partenaires dans les chapitres, diriger les autres à travers des sujets complexes de P&C en comprenant les philosophies, les approches, les politiques mondiales et les configurations pertinentes des sujets pertinents

• Développer et gérer des partenariats solides avec les principales organisations et parties prenantes internes ainsi qu'avec des fournisseurs externes afin de co-créer des solutions technologiques et d'améliorer continuellement la productivité, la qualité et l'efficacité au niveau local et mondial

• Être un point d'escalade pour des sujets liés à votre domaine de responsabilité

Qui vous êtes :

• Expériences éprouvées dans le domaine de la technologie de la rémunération (p. ex. journée de travail, WTW) en m

jobs.title: Sales Account Executive - Diagnostics

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The primary objective of a Clinician Promotion Specialist is to increase the usage of all products and tests within their responsibility area by visiting health professionals in the region for promotional purposes.

Key duties and responsibilities include:

• Product Promotion: Conducting product promotions for clinicians and distributors within the target audience.

• Feedback Management: Evaluating feedback received regarding products and communicating with relevant departments within the company to provide responses.

• Planning: Preparing and executing daily, weekly, and monthly visit plans based on defined visit frequencies for the target audience.

• Content Delivery: Conveying approved content to clinicians to ensure an increase in product consumption.

• Stock Control: Performing stock control of products at distributors and monitoring circulation.

• Events: Participating in congresses and symposiums.

• Analysis: Conducting sector and competitor analysis to monitor developments, gather market information, interpret it, and report regularly

Who are you?

• Bachelor's Degree in medicine, biology, chemistry preferably

• 1-2 years’ experience of medical representative

• Strong communication and presentation skills

• At least intermediate level of English, fluent Kazakh and Russian language.

• Willing to frequent travel

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
L'obiettivo primario di uno Specialista di Promozione Clinica è quello di aumentare l'utilizzo di tutti i prodotti e test all'interno della loro area di responsabilità visitando professionisti sanitari nella regione per scopi promozionali.

Tra i compiti principali e le responsabilità figurano:

• Promozione prodotto: Condurre promozioni di prodotti per medici e distributori all'interno del target di riferimento.

• Gestione dei feedback: Valutazione dei feedback ricevuti per quanto riguarda i prodotti e comunicare con i dipartimenti rilevanti all'interno della società per fornire risposte.

• Pianificazione: Preparazione ed esecuzione di piani di visita giornalieri, settimanali e mensili basati su frequenze di visita definite per il pubblico di destinazione.

• Consegna dei contenuti: Conveying contenuto approvato ai medici per garantire un aumento del consumo di prodotto.

• Controllo delle scorte: Esecuzione del controllo delle scorte dei prodotti ai distributori e monitoraggio della circolazione.

• Eventi: Partecipazione a congressi e simposio.

• Analisi: Condurre il settore e l'analisi dei concorrenti per monitorare gli sviluppi, raccogliere informazioni di mercato, interpretarlo e segnalare regolarmente

Chi sei?

• Laurea in medicina, biologia, chimica preferibilmente

• 1-2 anni di esperienza del rappresentante medico

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e presentazione

• Almeno livello intermedio di lingua inglese, fluente kazako e russa.

• Volontà a frequenti viaggi

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datore di lavoro di parità di opportunità.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Vice President, Global Head Multiple Sclerosis and Neuroimmunology Product Development Clinical Science (PDC) and Disease Area Head (DAH) serves as the senior-most expert of Multiple Sclerosis and Neuroimmunology within PDC and has ultimate ownership and accountability of the DA’s clinical development strategy. This individual is responsible for defining, leading, and overseeing the late stage strategic vision, including the clinical development strategy of Multiple Sclerosis and Neuroimmunology, and for providing inspirational leadership to the respective PDC Clinical Science team executing that strategy. Leveraging experience and mastery in influencing across a large, matrixed enterprise this individual provides disease area and development expertise to cross-functional life cycle teams, is the primary point of contact for business development activities in the specified DA, drives the implementation of a comprehensive end-to-end clinical development strategy, guides early and late-stage portfolio asset development and teams, and actively participates in and/or chairs relevant governance bodies. The GDAH is a critical cross-functional connector, working in close collaboration with the Roche Group Research and Early Development organizations, Roche Diagnostics, Pharma Partnering, Pharma Technical Operations, and Global Pharma Strategy teams.

Key Responsibilities

Global Strategy and Leadership

• Spearhead the assigned Disease Area in partnership with the GPS Disease Area Head (DAH). Together with the GPS DAH, establish and lead a fit-for-purpose DA Team with DA leaders from across the Roche Group.

• Together with the GPS DAH, this role is accountable for the definition and execution of the global end-to-end DA strategy, collaborating with Roche Group Research and Early Development organizations, Roche Diagnostics, and Global Pharma Strategy teams to provide disease area and technical expertise.

• Establish DA goals that serve the overarching strategic priorities, and ensure end-to-end prioritization of activities and implementation excellence.

• Represent late-stage development and contribute to the overall portfolio strategy with internal and external stakeholders, such as Research, Early Development, Roche Diagnostics, Medical Affairs, Commercial, Regulatory and Pharma Partnering senior leaders as well as health authorities, therapeutic area societies, patient advocacy groups, and key opinion leaders.

• Lead and/or define, in collaboration with functions across the drug development value chain, and in alignment with the DA strategy, asset strategies, clinical development plans, target product profiles, and clinical development stage transition decision criteria to ensure alignment with the DA strategy and achievement of the internal criteria (i.e. the Bar) for scientific rigor, patient benefit, and value.

• Serve as a standing member of development and business boards, and as PD co-chair of development boards, as assigned, to provide strategic development review and advice, go/no-go recommendations, and guidance towards maximising drug development efficiency and acceptable phase 3 PTS (probability of technical success).

• Be an active member of the therapeutic area leadership team, contributing to the definition and execution of the therapeutic area strategy with an enterprise mindset.

Clinical Development Accountability

• Responsible and accountable for global clinical development. Lead the Global Development Leaders (GDLs), Medical Directors

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il Vice Presidente, Global Head Multiple Sclerosis and Neuroimmunology Product Development Clinical Science (PDC) and Disease Area Head (DAH) serve come il più anziano esperto di Sclerosi Multipla e Neuroimmunologia all'interno del PDC e ha la proprietà e la responsabilità della strategia di sviluppo clinico del DA. Questo individuo è responsabile per la definizione, la guida e la supervisione della visione strategica di fase tardiva, tra cui la strategia di sviluppo clinico di Sclerosi Multipla e Neuroimmunologia, e per fornire una leadership ispiratrice al rispettivo PDC Clinical Science team che esegue tale strategia. Sfruttando l'esperienza e la padronanza nell'influenza di un'impresa di grandi dimensioni, matrice, questo individuo fornisce competenze nell'area delle malattie e nello sviluppo a team di ciclo di vita interfunzionali, è il punto primario di contatto per le attività di sviluppo aziendale nel DA specificato, guida l'implementazione di una strategia di sviluppo clinico end-to-end completa, guida lo sviluppo e i team di asset di portafoglio di fase iniziale e partecipa attivamente a e/o sedie organismi di governance rilevanti. Il GDAH è un connettore interfunzionale critico, che lavora in stretta collaborazione con le organizzazioni Roche Group Research e Early Development, Roche Diagnostics, Pharma Partnering, Pharma Technical Operations e Global Pharma Strategy Team.

Principali responsabilità

Strategia globale e leadership

• Dirigere l'Area Malattia assegnata in collaborazione con il Responsabile Area Malattia GPS (DAH). Insieme al DAH GPS, istituisci e guida un DA Team fit-for-purpose con i leader DA di tutta la Roche Group.

• Insieme al DAH GPS, questo ruolo è responsabile per la definizione e l'esecuzione della strategia globale end-to-end DA, collaborando con le organizzazioni Roche Group Research e Early Development, Roche Diagnostics e Global Pharma Strategy team per fornire area malattia e competenze tecniche.

• Stabilire gli obiettivi DA che servono le priorità strategiche di overarching e garantire la priorità end-to-end delle attività e l'eccellenza di attuazione.

• Rappresentare lo sviluppo del tardo-stadio e contribuire alla strategia globale del portafoglio con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni, come la ricerca, lo sviluppo precoce, Roche Diagnostics, Affari medici, Commerciali, Regolatori e Pharma Partnering senior leader, così come le autorità sanitarie, le società di area terapeutica, i gruppi di advocacy dei pazienti e i leader di opinione chiave.

• Guidare e/o definire, in collaborazione con le funzioni della catena del valore dello sviluppo del farmaco, e in allineamento con la strategia DA, le strategie di asset, i piani di sviluppo clinico, i profili di prodotto di destinazione e i criteri di decisione di transizione della fase di sviluppo clinico per garantire l'allineamento con la strategia DA e il raggiungimento dei criteri interni (cioè il Bar) per il rigore scientifico, il beneficio del paziente e il valore.

• Servire come membro in piedi dello sviluppo e dei comitati aziendali, e come co-presidente del PD dei comitati di sviluppo, come assegnato, per fornire la revisione e la consulenza strategica di sviluppo, raccomandazioni di go/no-go, e la guida per massimizzare l'efficienza di sviluppo della droga e la fase accettabile 3 PTS (probabilità del successo tecnico).

• Essere un membro attivo del team di leadership area terapeutica, contribuendo alla definizione e all'esecuzione della strategia area terapeutica con una mentalità aziendale.

Contabilità dello sviluppo clinico

• Responsabile e responsabile dello sviluppo clinico globale. Guidare i Leader dello Sviluppo Globale (GDL), Direttori medici

Der Vice President, Global Head Multiple Sklerose and Neuroimmunology Product Development Clinical Science (PDC) und Disease Area Head (DAH) ist der älteste Experte für Multiple Sklerose und Neuroimmunologie innerhalb der PDC und hat die ultimative Verantwortung für die klinische Entwicklungsstrategie der DA. Diese Person ist verantwortlich für die Definition, Führung und Überwachung der strategischen Vision im Spätstadium, einschließlich der klinischen Entwicklungsstrategie von Multipler Sklerose und Neuroimmunologie, und für die inspirierende Führung des jeweiligen PDC Clinical Science-Teams, das diese Strategie ausführt. Durch die Nutzung von Erfahrung und Beherrschung bei der Beeinflussung eines großen, matrixförmigen Unternehmens bietet diese Person funktionsübergreifenden Life-Cycle-Teams Krankheitsgebiets- und Entwicklungsexpertise, ist der primäre Ansprechpartner für Geschäftsentwicklungsaktivitäten in der angegebenen DA, treibt die Umsetzung einer umfassenden klinischen End-to-End-Entwicklungsstrategie voran, leitet die frühe und späte Phase der Portfolio-Asset-Entwicklung und -Teams und beteiligt sich aktiv an und / oder leitet relevante Governance-Gremien. Der GDAH ist ein wichtiger funktionsübergreifender Konnektor, der in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams der Roche Group Research and Early Development, Roche Diagnostics, Pharma Partnering, Pharma Technical Operations und Global Pharma Strategy arbeitet.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

Globale Strategie und Führung

• Speerspitze der zugewiesenen Disease Area in Partnerschaft mit dem GPS Disease Area Head (DAH). Zusammen mit dem GPS DAH ein passendes DA-Team mit DA-Führungskräften aus der gesamten Roche-Gruppe aufzubauen und zu leiten.

• Zusammen mit dem GPS DAH ist diese Rolle für die Definition und Umsetzung der globalen End-to-End-DA-Strategie verantwortlich, indem sie mit Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisationen der Roche Group, Roche Diagnostics und Global Pharma Strategy-Teams zusammenarbeitet, um Krankheitsbereich und technisches Know-how bereitzustellen.

• Legen Sie DA-Ziele fest, die den übergreifenden strategischen Prioritäten dienen, und gewährleisten Sie die End-to-End-Priorisierung von Aktivitäten und hervorragende Umsetzung.

• Repräsentieren Sie die Entwicklung im Spätstadium und tragen Sie zur Gesamtportfoliostrategie mit internen und externen Stakeholdern bei, z. B. Research, Early Development, Roche Diagnostics, Medical Affairs, Commercial, Regulatory and Pharma Partnering Senior Leaders sowie Gesundheitsbehörden, Therapeutic Area Societys, Patientenvertretungsgruppen und wichtigen Meinungsführern.

• Führen und/oder definieren Sie in Zusammenarbeit mit Funktionen in der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette der Arzneimittelentwicklung und in Übereinstimmung mit der DA-Strategie Asset-Strategien, klinische Entwicklungspläne, Zielproduktprofile und Entscheidungskriterien für die klinische Entwicklungsphase, um die Abstimmung mit der DA-Strategie und das Erreichen der internen Kriterien (d. h. der Bar) für wissenschaftliche Strenge, Patientennutzen und Wert zu gewährleisten.

• Als ständiges Mitglied der Entwicklungs- und Business Boards und als PD Co-Vorsitzender der Entwicklungsboards, wie zugewiesen, um strategische Entwicklungsüberprüfung und Beratung, Go / No-Go-Empfehlungen und Anleitung zur Maximierung der Effizienz der Arzneimittelentwicklung und akzeptable Phase 3 PTS (Wahrscheinlichkeit des technischen Erfolgs) zu bieten.

• Seien Sie ein aktives Mitglied des Führungsteams des therapeutischen Bereichs und tragen Sie zur Definition und Umsetzung der Strategie des therapeutischen Bereichs mit einer unternehmerischen Denkweise bei.

Klinische Entwicklung Verantwortlichkeit

Cette personne est chargée de définir, de diriger et de superviser la vision stratégique en retard, y compris la stratégie de développement clinique de la sclérose en plaques et de la neuroimmunologie, et de fournir un leadership inspirant à l'équipe des sciences cliniques de PDC qui exécute cette stratégie. Tirer parti de l'expérience et de la maîtrise dans l'influence d'une grande entreprise matricielle, cette personne fournit une expertise en matière de maladies et de développement aux équipes interfonctionnelles du cycle de vie, est le principal point de contact pour les activités de développement des affaires dans l'AD spécifié, dirige la mise en œuvre d'une stratégie complète de développement clinique de bout en bout, guide le développement des actifs et des équipes de portefeuille en début et en fin de cycle, et participe activement aux organes de gouvernance pertinents ou préside ceux-ci. Le GDAH est un connecteur interfonctionnel essentiel, travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les organismes Roche Group Research and Early Development, Roche Diagnostics, Pharma Partnering, Pharma Technical Operations et Global Pharma Strategy.

Stratégie mondiale et leadership

• Avec le GPS DAH, ce rôle est responsable de la définition et de l'exécution de la stratégie globale de DE de bout en bout, en collaboration avec des organismes de recherche et de développement précoce de Roche Group, Roche Diagnostics et des équipes de la Global Pharma Strategy pour fournir un domaine de maladie et une expertise technique.

• Établir des objectifs d'évaluation environnementale qui servent les priorités stratégiques globales et assurer la priorité de bout en bout des activités et l'excellence de la mise en oeuvre.

• Représenter le développement tardif et contribuer à la stratégie globale du portefeuille avec les intervenants internes et externes, comme la recherche, le développement précoce, Roche Diagnostics, les affaires médicales, le commerce, la réglementation et la pharmacie.

• Diriger et/ou définir, en collaboration avec des fonctions dans toute la chaîne de valeur du développement des médicaments, et en conformité avec la stratégie de l'AD, les stratégies d'actif, les plans de développement clinique, les profils de produits cibles et les critères de décision de transition de l'étape du développement clinique afin d'assurer l'harmonisation avec la stratégie de l'AD et l'atteinte des critères internes (c.-à-d. le Barreau) pour la rigueur scientifique, les avantages pour le patient et la valeur.

• À titre de membre permanent des conseils de développement et des conseils d'administration, et de coprésident des conseils de développement de la DP, tel qu'il a été désigné, pour fournir des conseils et des conseils en matière de développement stratégique, des recommandations d'aller-retour et des directives visant à maximiser l'efficacité de la mise au point de médicaments et des STP de phase 3 acceptables (probabilité de réussite technique).

Responsabilité en matière de développement clinique

jobs.title: Data Transfer Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Data Transfer Engineer within the Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) team, you will be responsible for owning the high-speed data transfer services that feed our advanced compute environments. With the introduction of our industry-leading AI Factory, the ability to move massive, petabyte-scale datasets rapidly and securely is more critical than ever. You will own the deployment, configuration, and ongoing optimization of specialized Data Transfer Appliances that bridge our traditional HPC clusters with our next-generation AI infrastructure. By ensuring seamless, high-bandwidth data mobility and aggressively eliminating network and I/O bottlenecks, you will play a foundational role in ensuring that our researchers can train complex AI models and execute large-scale computational science workloads without friction.

Description of the area

Hosting and Infrastructure (HI) provides mission-critical on-premise infrastructure, cloud hosting, connectivity, and technology products that enable all functions at every Roche site to develop, innovate, connect, and deliver compliant digital products across the Roche Enterprise.
The Value Streams - Accelerated Compute Engineering (ACE) Team is focused on driving both customer success and platform success by acting as a center of excellence and delivery for the High Performance Compute and AI Infrastructure supporting AI and HPC use cases across Roche. This team facilitates seamless onboarding and adoption for business vertical customers needing accelerated compute—helping those infrastructure consumers with needs optimized for high availability, seamless data transfer, flexibility, speed, and the rapidly changing needs of AI—helping achieve rapid time-to-value.

Job Responsibilities

Pipeline Architecture & Management

• Own the end-to-end deployment and lifecycle management of specialized Data Transfer Appliances.

• Identify and resolve systemic network and I/O bottlenecks to maximize throughput between storage tiers and compute nodes.

Technical Operations & Optimization

• Manage integration with various storage architectures, including Object Storage, NAS (NFS), and parallel file systems such as GPFS.

• Implement automation for on-site deployment and configuration of our factory-built and tuned Data Transfer appliances using Ansible, Kickstart, or Red Hat Satellite to ensure scalable and reproducible environments.

Performance & Monitoring

• Analyze system logs, kernel messages, and network statistics to proactively monitor the health and performance of the data transfer fabric.

• Define and track success metrics for data mobility, providing insights to leadership on infrastructure utilization and performance trends.

User Enablement & Support Experience .

• Explore innovative approaches to drive more frictionless consumption of our Data Transfer appliances, e.g, Agentic AI and MCP

• Develop user-facing documentation, scripts, and tools that simplify complex data movement tasks for the broader scientific community.

• Provide high-level technical support, isolating complex issues across storage, network, and application layers in a collaborative, cross-functional manner.

Who You Are

Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s or an advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a similar technical discipline.

• Proven experience in managing large-scale Linux environments (RHEL/rebuilds) with deep proficiency in CLI tools (grep, awk, sed, etc.).

• Demonstrated experience in high-performance computing (HPC

The Position
Job description
At Roche, protecting our critical information assets and systems is foundational to delivering life-changing medicines. As the IT Security Risk & Audit Specialist, you will move beyond standard checklists to manage and coordinate the end-to-end security risk lifecycle. You will bridge the gap between technical security engineering and executive risk posture, assuring our global systems and third-party ecosystems remain resilient against an evolving threat landscape.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Risk Assessment: Support comprehensive security risk assessments and audits using frameworks like NIST CSF and ISO 27001 to identify vulnerabilities in systems, cloud services, and emerging technologies.

• Third-Party Cyber Risk Management: Execute security, privacy and quality evaluations of global vendors, focusing on supply chain integrity, data sovereignty, and breach notification capabilities. Follow up with the vendors on open finding and their remediation status.

• Audit Assurance: Support internal and external security audits and provide guidance on remediation findings

• Continuous Compliance Monitoring: Design and implement automated tools to monitor the effectiveness of security controls in real-time, moving the organization toward data-driven monitoring. Monitor security compliance on critical systems and vendors.

• OT & Manufacturing Protection: Support the evaluation of the security posture of Manufacturing and Operational Technology (OT) environments to ensure high availability and protection against industrial cyber threats

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• University Degree: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related technical field (Master’s preferred).

• Professional Experience: 3+ years in a dedicated Security Risk or Audit or Compliance role within a global enterprise, specifically handling Hybrid-Cloud and OT/IoT environments.

• Certifications: Active CISSP, CISM or CISA is highly preferred; CRISC, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor certifications are a significant plus

Technical Skills

• Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, NIST CSF), data protection and privacy regulations such as GDPR or HIPAA.

• Familiar with health authority regulations, systems financial controls, software development lifecycle, computer systems validation, infrastructure qualification, and ITIL processes

• Audit & Control Automation: Experience in translating manual security controls into automated, data-driven monitoring requirements (Continuous Controls Monitoring, ITGC).

• Analytical & Project Management: Strong ability to support complex assessments and drive the optimization of risk monitoring tools.

Additional Qualifications

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills to manage stakeholder expectations, facilitate meetings, and act as an independent communicator

• A continuous improvement mindset with the capability to apply analytical and logical reasoning to challenge assumptions and identify discrepancies

La posizione
Descrizione del lavoro
A Roche, proteggere i nostri asset e i nostri sistemi di informazione critica è fondamentale per fornire farmaci che cambiano la vita. Come IT Security Risk & Audit Specialist, si muoverà oltre le liste di controllo standard per gestire e coordinare il ciclo di vita di rischio di sicurezza end-to-end. Potrai colmare il divario tra ingegneria della sicurezza tecnica e postura del rischio esecutivo, assicurando che i nostri sistemi globali e gli ecosistemi di terze parti rimangano resilienti contro un paesaggio di minaccia in evoluzione.

Descrizione della zona
Responsabilità del lavoro

• Valutazione del rischio: Supporta valutazioni e audit dei rischi di sicurezza complete utilizzando framework come NIST CSF e ISO 27001 per identificare le vulnerabilità nei sistemi, nei servizi cloud e nelle tecnologie emergenti.

• Gestione dei rischi informatici di terze parti: Esegui le valutazioni di sicurezza, privacy e qualità dei fornitori globali, concentrandosi sull'integrità della supply chain, sulla sovranità dei dati e sulle capacità di notifica della violazione. Seguire con i fornitori sulla scoperta aperta e il loro stato di bonifica.

• Audit Assurance: Supporta controlli di sicurezza interni ed esterni e fornisce indicazioni sui risultati di bonifica

• Monitoraggio continuo della conformità: progettare e implementare strumenti automatizzati per monitorare l'efficacia dei controlli di sicurezza in tempo reale, spostando l'organizzazione verso il monitoraggio guidato dai dati. Monitorare la conformità della sicurezza su sistemi e fornitori critici.

• OT & Manufacturing Protection: Supporta la valutazione della postura di sicurezza degli ambienti Manufacturing and Operational Technology (OT) per garantire elevata disponibilità e protezione contro le minacce informatiche industriali

Qualifiche
Istruzione / Esperienza

• Laurea: laurea in Cybersecurity, Informatica, o un campo tecnico correlato (preferito da Master).

• Esperienza professionale: 3+ anni in un ruolo dedicato di Rischio di Sicurezza o Audit o Compliance all'interno di un'impresa globale, in particolare la gestione di ambienti Ibridi-Cloud e OT/IoT.

• Certificazioni: Active CISSP, CISM o CISA è altamente preferito; le certificazioni CRISC o ISO 27001 Lead Auditor sono un vantaggio significativo

Competenze tecniche

• Conoscenza degli standard di sicurezza (ISO 27001, NIST CSF), protezione dei dati e normative sulla privacy come GDPR o HIPAA.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
At Roche, protecting our critical information assets and systems is foundational to delivering life-changing medicines. As the IT Security Risk & Audit Specialist, you will move beyond standard checklists to manage and coordinate the end-to-end security risk lifecycle. You will bridge the gap between technical security engineering and executive risk posture, assuring our global systems and third-party ecosystems remain resilient against an evolving threat landscape.

Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Risk Assessment: Support comprehensive security risk assessments and audits using frameworks like NIST CSF and ISO 27001 to identify vulnerabilities in systems, cloud services, and emerging technologies.

• Third-Party Cyber Risk Management: Execute security, privacy and quality evaluations of global vendors, focusing on supply chain integrity, data sovereignty, and breach notification capabilities. Follow up with the vendors on open finding and their remediation status.

• Audit Assurance: Support internal and external security audits and provide guidance on remediation findings

• Continuous Compliance Monitoring: Design and implement automated tools to monitor the effectiveness of security controls in real-time, moving the organization toward data-driven monitoring. Monitor security compliance on critical systems and vendors.

• OT & Manufacturing Protection: Support the evaluation of the security posture of Manufacturing and Operational Technology (OT) environments to ensure high availability and protection against industrial cyber threats

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• University Degree: Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related technical field (Master’s preferred).

• Professional Experience: 3+ years in a dedicated Security Risk or Audit or Compliance role within a global enterprise, specifically handling Hybrid-Cloud and OT/IoT environments.

• Certifications: Active CISSP, CISM or CISA is highly preferred; CRISC, or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor certifications are a significant plus

Technical Skills

• Knowledge of security standards (ISO 27001, NIST CSF), data protection and privacy regulations such as GDPR or HIPAA.

• Familiar with health authority regulations, systems financial controls, software development lifecycle, computer systems validation, infrastructure qualification, and ITIL processes

• Audit & Control Automation: Experience in translating manual security controls into automated, data-driven monitoring requirements (Continuous Controls Monitoring, ITGC).

• Analytical & Project Management: Strong ability to support complex assessments and drive the optimization of risk monitoring tools.

Additional Qualifications

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills to manage stakeholder expectations, facilitate meetings, and act as an independent communicator

• A continuous improvement mindset with the capability to apply analytical and logical reasoning to challenge assumptions and identify discrepancies

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can
