descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Roche beginnt ein spannendes neues strategisches Kapitel und erweitert unsere Präsenz auf den kardiometabolischen Therapiebereich - ein Bereich, in dem Sie eine zentrale Rolle spielen werden. Wir suchen nach ambitionierten, wachstumsorientierten Fachleuten, die sich unserem Pipeline Acceleration Team anschließen, um die Zukunft dieses therapeutischen Raums zu gestalten. In dieser Rolle werden Sie maßgeblich an der Gestaltung unserer lokalen und nationalen Strategie beteiligt sein und unseren klinischen Ansatz durch eine wirkungsvolle Zusammenarbeit mit Key Opinion Leaders direkt beeinflussen. Dies ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, an der Gründung eines Projekts mit erheblichem Expansionspotenzial teilzunehmen; Wenn der neue Bereich wächst, haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Ihre Verantwortung zu entwickeln, Ihre Auswirkungen zu skalieren und Ihre Karriere neben unserem Team auszubauen.

Zweck
Erhöhung des Pflegestandards, langfristige wissenschaftliche Partnerschaften mit Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) und Forschern. Dies ist eine Chance zu definieren, wie wir Innovationen für Patienten im kardiometabolischen Raum bringen.
Ziele

• Handeln Sie als Schlüsselarchitekt unseres medizinischen Fußabdrucks: Passen Sie die nationale Strategie für Ihr Territorium an und verfeinern Sie sie und gewährleisten Sie regionale medizinische Exzellenz.

• Sammeln von Erkenntnissen und Erkennen von Lücken mit einem soliden Verständnis der Umwelt und ihrer Entwicklung.

• Gestalten Sie das medizinische Ökosystem: Identifizieren und implementieren Sie maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die den sich entwickelnden Bedürfnissen von Patienten und HCPs gerecht werden, und positionieren Sie Roche an der Spitze des Feldes.

• Strategische Autonomie: Führen Sie die regionale medizinische Strategie mit der Autonomie, um die nationale Entscheidungsfindung zu beeinflussen.

Berichterstattung
Direkt mit dem Pipeline Acceleration Team Lead verbunden, um eine hohe Sichtbarkeit und strategische Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten.
Zusammenarbeit
Sie werden ein Kernmitglied unseres Therapeutic Area Core Teams sein. Ihre Stimme wird von Bedeutung sein - Sie werden ein wichtiger Teilnehmer an lokalen strategischen Meetings sein und sicherstellen, dass die Erkenntnisse aus dem Feld direkt unsere organisatorische Roadmap informieren.

Wichtigste Aufgaben und Tätigkeiten

• Territory Medical Plan (TMP) Ownership: Über die Ausführung hinaus übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Gestaltung und Implementierung des TMP Ihrer Region. Von der Evidenzerzeugung über die medizinische Ausbildung bis hin zur Unterstützung klinischer Studien sind Sie der strategische Leiter für Ihr Gebiet.

• Das Verständnis und die Überwachung der Landschaft, die Identifizierung von Lücken und die Generierung der Erkenntnisse, die erforderlich sind, um unsere Strategie aufzubauen und anzupassen.

• Strategic Insight Generation: Proaktives Profilieren von KOLs und Zentren, um neue Möglichkeiten für die wissenschaftliche Zusammenarbeit aufzudecken und komplexe Daten in umsetzbare Strategien umzuwandeln.

• Expert Knowledge Exchange: Dienen Sie als das wissenschaftliche Gesicht von Roche. Führen Sie hochrangige Börsen in unserem Portfolio und unserer Forschungspipeline und bieten Sie Expertenwissen zu wissenschaftlichen Fragen.

• Beeinflussen Sie die medizinische Landschaft, indem Sie lokale Möglichkeiten zur Evidenzerzeugung identifizieren und von Forschern initiierte Studien (IIS) unterstützen und eng mit den medizinischen Managern zusammenarbeiten.

• Medical Leadership & Education: Champion wissenschaftlichen Wissens durch die Organisation von High-Impact klinischen Sitzungen und Präsentation von Daten auf großen Kongressen und Symposien.

Anforderungen und Kompetenzen

• Bildung: Universitätsabschluss in Gesundheitswissenschaften. (MBA / Post-Graduate sind hoch geschätzt).

• Erfahrung: Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in Feld medizinische Rollen, insbesondere im kardiometabolischen Raum (Adipositas / Diabetes Erfahrung ist ein Schlüsselfaktor).

• Sprachen: Hohe Englischkenntnisse.

• Basis: Madrid.

• Kompetenzen: Strategisches analytisches Denken, fundiertes technisches Know-how, Einfluss auf Fähigkeiten zum Aufbau eines Konsenses, funktionsübergreifende Agilität und
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Roche se lance dans un nouveau chapitre stratégique passionnant, en élargissant notre empreinte dans la zone thérapeutique cardiométabolique – un domaine où vous jouerez un rôle central. Nous sommes à la recherche de professionnels ambitieux et axés sur la croissance pour rejoindre notre équipe d'accélération du pipeline afin de construire l'avenir de cet espace thérapeutique. Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l'élaboration de notre stratégie locale et nationale et influerez directement sur notre approche clinique grâce à une collaboration à fort impact avec les leaders clés de l'opinion. C'est une occasion unique de se joindre à la création d'un projet avec un potentiel d'expansion important; à mesure que le nouveau secteur augmentera, vous aurez la capacité d'évoluer vos responsabilités, d'accroître votre impact et de développer votre carrière aux côtés de notre équipe.

Objet
Améliorer la qualité des soins, les partenariats scientifiques à long terme avec les leaders clés de l'opinion et les chercheurs. C'est une chance de définir comment nous apportons l'innovation aux patients dans l'espace cardiométabolique.
Objectifs

• Agir en tant qu'architecte clé de notre empreinte médicale : Adapter et affiner la stratégie nationale pour votre territoire, en assurant l'excellence médicale régionale.

• Recueillir des idées et identifier les lacunes, avec une bonne compréhension de l'environnement et de son évolution.

• Former l'écosystème médical : Identifier et mettre en œuvre des solutions adaptées aux besoins changeants des patients et des HCP, en plaçant Roche à l'avant-garde du domaine.

• Autonomie stratégique : Diriger la stratégie médicale régionale avec l'autonomie pour influencer la prise de décision nationale.

Rapports
Directement relié au chef d'équipe de l'accélération du pipeline, assurant une visibilité élevée et un alignement stratégique.
Collaboration
Vous serez un membre de base de notre équipe de base de la zone thérapeutique. Votre voix aura de l'importance, vous serez un participant clé aux réunions stratégiques locales, en veillant à ce que les informations sur le terrain éclairent directement notre feuille de route organisationnelle.

Principales responsabilités et activités

• Territory Medical Plan (TMP) Propriété : Au-delà de l'exécution, vous serez propriétaire de la conception et de la mise en œuvre du TMP de votre région. De la génération de preuves à l'éducation médicale et au soutien des essais cliniques, vous êtes le chef de file stratégique pour votre territoire.

• Comprendre et surveiller le paysage, cerner les lacunes et générer les idées nécessaires pour élaborer et adapter notre stratégie.

• Strategic Insight Generation : Profil proactif KOLs et centres pour découvrir de nouvelles opportunités de collaboration scientifique, transformant des données complexes en stratégies réalisables.

• Échange de connaissances d'experts : servir de visage scientifique à Roche. Diriger des échanges de haut niveau sur notre portefeuille et notre pipeline de recherche, en fournissant des conseils d'experts sur les questions scientifiques.

• Influencer le paysage médical en identifiant les possibilités de production de preuves locales et en appuyant les études entreprises par les chercheurs, en collaboration étroite avec les gestionnaires médicaux.

• Leadership médical & Education : Championne les connaissances scientifiques en organisant des séances cliniques à haut impact et en présentant des données lors de grands congrès et colloques.

Exigences et compétences

• Éducation : Diplôme universitaire en sciences de la santé. (Les diplômes MBA/post-graduate sont très appréciés).

• Expérience : Expérience éprouvée dans les rôles médicaux de terrain, en particulier dans l'espace cardiométabolique (l'expérience d'Obésité/Diabètes est un atout clé).

• Langues : Haute maîtrise de l'anglais.

• Base : Madrid.

• Compétences : réflexion analytique stratégique, expertise technique profonde, influence des compétences pour construire un consensus, agilité interfonctionnelle,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Senior ERP Systems Engineer (ERP FinOps and License Manager) leads the strategic financial governance, cost optimization, and license/credit/subscription utilization for the organization's global ERP and SAP environments. This role bridges the gap between IT, Finance, and Procurement to ensure the company remains fully compliant with vendor licensing rules while actively eliminating overspending, cloud waste, and token consumption leakages. Acting as both an analyst and a strategic advisor, you will govern holistically software assets alongside utility-based consumption models (such as SAP Private and Public Cloud subscriptions, entitlements and AI Units). By turning complex system-utilization data into actionable cost-containment frameworks, you will maximize the long-term return on investment (ROI) for the entire enterprise application ecosystem.
Description of the area
The RDT ERP Systems Management is the foundational custodian of the organization’s enterprise application landscape. We oversee the stability, security, compliance, and lifecycle evolution of critical global templates (including SAP S/4HANA Digital Core and legacy environments). Within this area, the FinOps and License Management becomes the intersection of platform license integrity and corporate financial efficiency. Moving away from manual legacy tracking, this role leverages system usage telemetry, automation tools, and predictive data modeling to govern entitlements, optimize utility-based cloud consumption (such as SAP RISE, SaaS portfolio (SAP and non-SAP), and BTP/Generative and Agentic AI pipelines), and maintain permanent audit readiness in a highly regulated corporate landscape.

Job Responsibilities

• Scope (Content Leadership) & Accountability/Problem Solving:

• SAP License Management & Compliance: Leads the commercial and administrative governance of the software asset lifecycle. Analyzes user entitlements based on role assignments, and platform transaction profiles to assign the most cost-effective SAP license types (such as e.g. Full Use Equivalents in RISE engine related metrics, or other types of entitlements).

• AI Token & Consumption Governance: Establishes and owns the tracking framework for SAP AI Units across global sub-accounts. Defines usage guardrails, maps expenditures to active business pilots/use cases, and implements hard quota limits in the BTP Cockpit to prevent unoptimized models or runaway testing loops from generating contract overages.

• Audit Readiness & True-Ups: Establishes permanent compliance guardrails and drives the execution of periodic system measurement huddles. Reconciles software entitlements against real-time consumption data to guarantee successful official vendor audits and minimize corporate financial risk.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Descrizione del lavoro
Il Senior ERP Systems Engineer (ERP FinOps and License Manager) guida la governance finanziaria strategica, l'ottimizzazione dei costi e l'utilizzo della licenza/credit/subscription per gli ambienti globali dell'organizzazione ERP e SAP. Questo ruolo colma il divario tra IT, Finance e Procurement per garantire che l'azienda rimanga pienamente conforme alle regole di licenza del fornitore, eliminando attivamente le perdite di consumo di overspending, cloud e token. Agendo sia come analista che come consulente strategico, governerai risorse software olistiche insieme ai modelli di consumo basati su utilità (come gli abbonamenti SAP Private e Public Cloud, i diritti e le unità AI). Trasformando i dati complessi di utilizzo del sistema in framework di contenimento dei costi attuabili, massimizzerai il ritorno a lungo termine sugli investimenti (ROI) per l'intero ecosistema delle applicazioni aziendali.
Descrizione della zona
RDT ERP Systems Management è il custode fondamentale del paesaggio di applicazione aziendale dell'organizzazione. Superiamo la stabilità, la sicurezza, la conformità e l'evoluzione del ciclo di vita dei modelli globali critici (compresi gli ambienti SAP S/4HANA Digital Core e legacy). All'interno di questo settore, il FinOps e la Gestione licenze diventano l'intersezione dell'integrità della licenza della piattaforma e dell'efficienza finanziaria aziendale. Allontanandosi dal monitoraggio manuale dell'eredità, questo ruolo sfrutta la telemetria di utilizzo del sistema, gli strumenti di automazione e la modellazione dei dati predittivi per governare i diritti, ottimizzare il consumo cloud basato sull'utilità (come SAP RISE, il portafoglio SaaS (SAP e non-SAP), e BTP/Generative e Agentic AI pipelines), e mantenere la disponibilità di audit permanente in un panorama aziendale altamente regolamentato.

Responsabilità del lavoro

• Scope (Content Leadership) & Accountability/Problem Solving:

• SAP License Management & Compliance: conduce la governance commerciale e amministrativa del ciclo di vita del software. Analizza i diritti dell'utente in base alle assegnazioni dei ruoli e ai profili delle transazioni della piattaforma per assegnare i tipi di licenze SAP più convenienti (ad esempio Full Use Equivalents in metriche correlate ai motori RISE, o altri tipi di diritti).

• AI Token & Consum Governance: Stabilisce e possiede il framework di tracciamento per le unità SAP AI attraverso i sottoconti globali. Definisce l'uso guardrails, mappa le spese per i piloti/i casi d'uso attivi di business, e implementa i limiti di quote dure nel BTP Cockpit per prevenire modelli o cicli di test non idonei a generare overage di contratto.

• Audit Readiness & True-Ups: Stabilisce controlli di conformità permanenti e guida l'esecuzione di errori di misura del sistema periodico. Reconcili diritti del software contro i dati di consumo in tempo reale per garantire i controlli ufficiali dei fornitori e minimizzare il rischio finanziario aziendale.

• Cloud FinOps Execution: supervisiona le operazioni finanziarie (FinOps) degli ambienti cloud, tracciando il costo totale di proprietà (TCO), il budget di asset software multimilionario e le previsioni di rotolamento. Monitora le tendenze di spesa (ad esempio, tracciando i profili di memorizzazione dei dati, o modelli di consumo di SaaS) per progettare le spese non necessarie per i bilanci di esecuzione stabili.

• Software Asset Management Tooling: valuta le esigenze e coordina l'utilizzo efficace della toolbox di gestione patrimoniale del software aziendale.

• Stakeholder Management: dimostra una forte comprensione degli ecosistemi delle parti interessate e delle loro esigenze, eccellendo nei negoziati e nelle partnership per ottenere benefici reciproci. Fornisce una direzione chiara a obiettivi a medio-lungo termine e o

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Siamo nell'EGF

Presso il sito Management Mannheim/Penzberg, siamo un buon 1.300 specialisti per una vasta gamma di infrastrutture e servizi professionali, che forniscono per i siti di Mannheim e Penzberg. In un ambiente dinamico, promuoviamo una collaborazione senza soluzione di continuità tra business unit e funzioni, offriamo soluzioni innovative e migliorare l'ambiente di lavoro dei dipendenti nei siti di Mannheim e Penzberg, dove formiamo attivamente il futuro.

Responsabilità | Questo è ciò che vi aspetta
Assumendo il ruolo che Lei è responsabile per garantire la funzionalità, l'efficacia dei costi e la disponibilità tecnica di impianti di processo e di costruzione, nonché il supporto di importanti misure di manutenzione e ottimizzazione. Inoltre, si prenderanno le seguenti attività interessanti:

• Plant Support & Engineering in Production: Lei sostiene l'operatore in partnership nell'adempimento dei suoi obblighi di operatore per l'edificio, l'ingegneria edile e l'ingegneria di processo impianti ausiliari. Come interfaccia affidabile e consulente esperto, si assicura che i requisiti per la sicurezza degli impianti, la sicurezza del traffico, la sicurezza ambientale e professionale (SHE) siano implementati e rispettati in pratica.

• Strategia di manutenzione: coordina e controlla le misure di manutenzione in termini di costi, scadenze e qualità e gestisci strategie appropriate con i dati attuali direttamente nel sistema SAP.

• Affidabilità & Monitoraggio: Attraverso studi di affidabilità, analisi causa radice e monitoraggio delle piante e dell'energia, si riduce i tempi di fermo e aumenta continuamente la disponibilità tecnica e l'efficienza energetica.

• Gestione del progetto: Lei progetta di costruire e di elaborare misure di ingegneria indipendentemente e di controllare progetti tecnici o sottoprogetti secondo lo stato attuale dell'arte.

• Gestione del bilancio: Lei sostiene la pianificazione finanziaria e di bilancio per i servizi tecnici, tiene d'occhio gli sviluppi dei costi e avvia proattivamente adeguate contromisure in caso di deviazioni.

• Lifecycle & Documentation: Garantisci una documentazione tecnica senza soluzione di continuità e aggiornata e mantieni preziosi dati durante l'intero ciclo di vita degli asset.

Qualificazioni | Questo è ciò che porti

• Hai completato con successo una laurea (Dipl.-Ing. FH / Bachelor / Master) nel campo dell'ingegneria meccanica, dell'ingegneria dei processi, dell'ingegneria della fornitura o di una qualifica simile.

• Si porterà diversi anni di esperienza professionale nella costruzione, il funzionamento o la manutenzione di strutture tecniche o in operazioni di costruzione.

• Hai una conoscenza approfondita delle tecnologie di processo e di costruzione, manutenzione e comprensione dei quadri normativi (ad esempio GMP, GEP e SHE).

• Hai un'alta affinità IT e un'esperienza pratica nel trattare con SAP e sistemi di manutenzione.

• Si parla inglese negoziabile e generalmente hanno eccellenti capacità di comunicazione. Come giocatore di squadra, si è in grado di lavorare efficacemente con diversi stakeholder e comunicare relazioni complesse in modo comprensibile.

Finora tanto bene? Possiamo fare di meglio.
Vi offriamo una vasta gamma di migliori vantaggi nelle nostre sedi. Solo con voi possiamo migliorare la vita dei pazienti:innen.

Si rende Roche unico con il vostro contributo. Ecco perché offriamo benefici straordinari che si può godere.

The Position
We in the EGF

At the Management Mannheim/Penzberg site, we are a good 1,300 specialists for a wide variety of infrastructure and professional services, which they provide for the Mannheim and Penzberg sites. In a dynamic environment, we promote seamless collaboration across business units and functions, offer innovative solutions and improve the working environment of employees at the Mannheim and Penzberg sites – where we actively shape the future.

Responsibility | This is what awaits you
Taken over in the role You are responsible for ensuring the functionality, cost-effectiveness and technical availability of process and building facilities as well as the support of relevant maintenance and optimization measures. In addition, you will take on the following exciting tasks:

• Plant Support & Engineering in Production: You support the operator in partnership in the fulfilment of his operator obligations for the building, the building engineering and the process engineering ancillary plants. As a reliable interface and expert consultant, you ensure that requirements for plant safety, traffic safety, environmental and occupational safety (SHE) are optimally implemented and adhered to in practice.

• Maintenance strategy: You coordinate and control maintenance measures in terms of costs, deadlines and quality and manage appropriate strategies with current data directly in the SAP system.

• Reliability & Monitoring: Through reliability studies, root cause analyses as well as plant and energy monitoring, you reduce downtime and continuously increase technical availability and energy efficiency.

• Project management: You plan building and process engineering measures independently and control technical projects or sub-projects according to the current state of the art.

• Budget management: You support financial and budget planning for technical services, keep an eye on cost developments and proactively initiate suitable countermeasures in the event of deviations.

• Lifecycle & Documentation: You ensure seamless, up-to-date technical documentation and maintain valuable data throughout the entire asset lifecycle.

Qualifications | This is what you bring

• You have successfully completed a degree (Dipl.-Ing. FH / Bachelor / Master) in the field of mechanical engineering, process engineering, supply engineering or a comparable qualification.

• You will bring several years of professional experience in the construction, operation or maintenance of technical facilities or in building operations.

• You have in-depth knowledge of process and building technology, maintenance and understanding of regulatory frameworks (e.g. GMP, GEP and SHE).

• You have a high IT affinity as well as practical experience in dealing with SAP and maintenance systems.

• You speak negotiable English and generally have excellent communication skills. As a team player, you are able to work effectively with different stakeholders and communicate complex relationships in an understandable way.

So far so good? We can do better.
We offer you a wide range of top benefits at our locations. Only with you can we improve the lives of patients:innen.

You make Roche unique with your contribution. That’s why we offer extraordinary benefits that you can enjoy.

Prise en charge dans le rôle Vous êtes responsable d'assurer la fonctionnalité, la rentabilité et la disponibilité technique des installations de processus et de construction ainsi que le soutien des mesures d'entretien et d'optimisation pertinentes. En outre, vous assumerez les tâches passionnantes suivantes:

• Vous avez une grande affinité informatique ainsi qu'une expérience pratique dans le traitement des systèmes SAP et de maintenance.

• Relevant clinical, scientific, or clinical trial/development experience in same/similar therapeutic area required

• Experience publishing results of a scientific study in a peer-reviewed journal is preferred

• Regulatory: Knowledge of medical aspects of GCP (Good Clinical Practice), ICH (International Conference on Harmonisation of Technical Requirements for Registration of Pharmaceuticals for Human Use), FDA, EMA, and other relevant guidelines and regulations is preferred

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Are you passionate about driving scientific strategies that transform clinical practice and improve patients' lives? We are looking for a Medical Affairs Lead to define and execute the comprehensive medical strategy for Roche Diagnostics Spain.
In this high-impact role, you will serve as the primary liaison between the scientific community, international expert networks, and Roche’s global medical teams. Your mission will be to lead evidence generation, shape the scientific positioning of our diagnostic solutions, and act as a key internal strategic partner—ensuring that science and clinical excellence guide our business decisions.

Your Main Responsibilities

• Integrated Medical Strategy & Leadership: Develop and execute integrated medical plans across key therapeutic areas, aligning local priorities in Spain with Roche’s global medical strategy.

• KOL Engagement & Scientific Partnerships: Lead engagement with a broad national network of Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and Tier-1 international experts. You will foster long-term scientific partnerships and capture high-quality clinical insights to inform strategic decision-making.

• Evidence Generation & Early Adoption: Drive the generation of required medical evidence (both company-sponsored and Investigator-Initiated Studies) in alignment with strategic priorities, enabling the early adoption of Roche’s technologies into clinical practice guidelines and consensus statements.

• Medical Education & Capability Building: Design and deliver medical education and training programs for field teams, enhancing scientific communication, technical accuracy, and engagement effectiveness.

• Cross-Functional Strategic Partnership: Provide scientific leadership and influence decision-making across internal stakeholders (Marketing, Market Access, Sales, and Medical), ensuring accuracy, regulatory compliance, and alignment with the overall medical strategy.

Who You Are

We are looking for a candidate with a strong scientific background, business acumen, and proven leadership through influence.

• Education: Degree in Life Sciences (MD, MSc, PhD).

• Professional Experience: 2 to 5 years of experience in evidence generation and project management within the healthcare sector (Medtech, IVD, or Pharma).

• Capabilities & Core Skills:

• Strategic Mindset: Ability to translate complex scientific data into actionable value propositions.

• Leadership & Drive: Results-oriented with a strong commitment to operational excellence.

• Effective & Assertive Communication: Skilled in tailoring complex technical messages for diverse audiences—from scientific boards to senior management.

• Collaboration & Teamwork: Strong interpersonal skills for cross-functional collaboration within a matrix organization.

• Languages: High level of English and Spanish (essential for daily interaction with global medical teams and international networks).

• Location : Sant Cugat, Barcelona.

What is here for You?

• Real Impact on Healthcare: A high-visibility role where your strategic input and evidence generation projects directly contribute to transforming diagnostic solutions and personalized healthcare.

• Global Exposure: Direct collaboration with global leadership teams, cross-border projects, and international expert panels.

• Culture of Innovation & Development: A dynamic, flexible, and collaborative environment that fosters continuous learning, autonomy, and professional growth.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together,

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Sei appassionato di guidare strategie scientifiche che trasformano la pratica clinica e migliorano la vita dei pazienti? Stiamo cercando un medico portare a definire ed eseguire la strategia medica completa per Roche Diagnostics Spagna.
In questo ruolo di alto impatto, servirai come collegamento primario tra la comunità scientifica, le reti di esperti internazionali e le squadre mediche globali di Roche. La vostra missione sarà di guidare la generazione delle prove, modellare il posizionamento scientifico delle nostre soluzioni diagnostiche e agire come partner strategico interno chiave, assicurando che la scienza e l'eccellenza clinica guidano le nostre decisioni aziendali.

Le tue responsabilità principali

• Strategia medica integrata & Leadership: Sviluppare ed eseguire piani medici integrati in aree terapeutiche chiave, allineare le priorità locali in Spagna con la strategia medica globale di Roche.

• KOL Engagement & Scientific Partnerships: il principale impegno con una vasta rete nazionale di leader delle opinioni chiave (KOLs) e esperti internazionali Tier-1. Adottiamo partenariati scientifici a lungo termine e catturerete intuizioni cliniche di alta qualità per informare il processo decisionale strategico.

• Generazione delle prove e adozione anticipata: guidare la generazione di prove mediche richieste (sia studi sponsorizzati dall’azienda che studi avviati da investitori) in linea con le priorità strategiche, consentendo l’adozione precoce delle tecnologie di Roche nelle linee guida della pratica clinica e nelle dichiarazioni di consenso.

• Medical Education & Capability Building: Progettare e fornire programmi di educazione medica e formazione per le squadre di campo, migliorare la comunicazione scientifica, la precisione tecnica e l'efficacia di impegno.

• Partenariato strategico interdisciplinare: fornire leadership scientifica e influenzare il processo decisionale tra gli stakeholder interni (Marketing, Market Access, Vendite e Medico), assicurando accuratezza, conformità normativa e allineamento con la strategia medica generale.

Chi sei

Stiamo cercando un candidato con un forte background scientifico, acume aziendale, e la leadership comprovata attraverso l'influenza.

• Istruzione: Laurea in Scienze della Vita (MD, MSc, PhD).

• Esperienza professionale: da 2 a 5 anni di esperienza nella generazione delle prove e nella gestione dei progetti nel settore sanitario (Medtech, IVD o Pharma).

• Capacità e competenze principali:

• Strategic Mindset: Capacità di tradurre dati scientifici complessi in proposizioni di valore attuabili.

• Leadership & Drive: orientata ai risultati con un forte impegno per l'eccellenza operativa.

• Efficace & Assertive Communication: Abilitato nella sartoria di messaggi tecnici complessi per il pubblico diverso — dai consigli scientifici alla gestione senior.

• Collaborazione e lavoro di squadra: forti competenze interpersonali per la collaborazione interfunzionale all'interno di un'organizzazione di matrice.

• Lingue: alto livello di inglese e spagnolo (essenziale per l'interazione quotidiana con le squadre mediche globali e le reti internazionali).

• Posizione: Sant Cugat, Barcellona.

Cosa c'è qui per te?

• Real Impact on Healthcare: Un ruolo ad alta visibilità in cui i progetti strategici di input e generazione di prove contribuiscono direttamente alla trasformazione di soluzioni diagnostiche e di assistenza sanitaria personalizzata.

• Esposizione globale: collaborazione diretta con i team di leadership globali, i progetti transfrontalieri e i pannelli esperti internazionali.

• Cultura dell'innovazione e dello sviluppo: un ambiente dinamico, flessibile e collaborativo che favorisce l'apprendimento continuo, l'autonomia e la crescita professionale.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme,

• Integrierte medizinische Strategie und Führung: Entwicklung und Durchführung integrierter medizinischer Pläne in wichtigen therapeutischen Bereichen, wobei die lokalen Prioritäten in Spanien an der globalen medizinischen Strategie von Roche ausgerichtet werden.

• KOL Engagement & Scientific Partnerships: Führen Sie das Engagement mit einem breiten nationalen Netzwerk von Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) und internationalen Tier-1-Experten. Sie fördern langfristige wissenschaftliche Partnerschaften und erfassen qualitativ hochwertige klinische Erkenntnisse, um strategische Entscheidungen zu treffen.

• Evidenzgenerierung und frühzeitige Adoption: Die Generierung der erforderlichen medizinischen Nachweise (sowohl vom Unternehmen als auch von den Forschern initiierte Studien) in Übereinstimmung mit strategischen Prioritäten fördern und die frühzeitige Einführung der Roche-Technologien in die Leitlinien für die klinische Praxis und Konsenserklärungen ermöglichen.

• Medical Education & Capability Building: Entwerfen und liefern medizinische Ausbildung und Trainingsprogramme für Außendienstteams, die wissenschaftliche Kommunikation, technische Genauigkeit und Engagement-Effektivität zu verbessern.

• Funktionale strategische Partnerschaft: Bereitstellung wissenschaftlicher Führung und Einflussnahme auf die Entscheidungsfindung bei internen Stakeholdern (Marketing, Marktzugang, Vertrieb und Medizin), Gewährleistung von Genauigkeit, Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften und Ausrichtung auf die medizinische Gesamtstrategie.

Wer du bist

Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit einem starken wissenschaftlichen Hintergrund, Geschäftssinn und bewährter Führung durch Einfluss.

• Ausbildung: Abschluss in Life Sciences (MD, MSc, PhD).

• Berufserfahrung: 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Evidenzgenerierung und Projektmanagement im Gesundheitswesen (Medtech, IVD oder Pharma).

• Fähigkeiten und Kernkompetenzen:

• Strategisches Mindset: Fähigkeit, komplexe wissenschaftliche Daten in umsetzbare Wertvorstellungen zu übersetzen.

• Leadership & Drive: Ergebnisorientiert mit starkem Engagement für operative Exzellenz.

• Effektive und durchsetzungsfähige Kommunikation: Geschickt in der Anpassung komplexer technischer Botschaften für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen - von wissenschaftlichen Gremien bis hin zur Geschäftsleitung.

• Collaboration & Teamwork: Starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten für die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit innerhalb einer Matrixorganisation.

• Sprachen: Hohes Englisch- und Spanischniveau (wesentlich für die tägliche Interaktion mit globalen medizinischen Teams und internationalen Netzwerken).

• Standort: Sant Cugat, Barcelona.

Was ist für dich da?

• Echte Auswirkungen auf das Gesundheitswesen: Eine hoch sichtbare Rolle, bei der Ihre strategischen Input- und Evidenzerzeugungsprojekte direkt zur Transformation von Diagnoselösungen und personalisierter Gesundheitsversorgung beitragen.

• Global Exposure: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Führungsteams, grenzüberschreitenden Projekten und internationalen Expertengremien.

• Kultur der Innovation und Entwicklung: Eine dynamische, flexible und kollaborative Umgebung, die kontinuierliches Lernen, Autonomie und berufliches Wachstum fördert.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam,
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Êtes-vous passionné par les stratégies scientifiques qui transforment la pratique clinique et améliorent la vie des patients? Nous sommes à la recherche d'un guide médical pour définir et exécuter la stratégie médicale globale pour Roche Diagnostics Espagne.
Dans ce rôle à fort impact, vous serez la principale liaison entre la communauté scientifique, les réseaux internationaux d'experts et les équipes médicales mondiales de Roche. Votre mission sera de diriger la production de preuves, de façonner le positionnement scientifique de nos solutions diagnostiques et d'agir en tant que partenaire stratégique interne clé – en assurant que la science et l'excellence clinique guident nos décisions d'affaires.

Vos principales responsabilités

• Stratégie Médicale Intégrée & Leadership: Élaborer et exécuter des plans médicaux intégrés dans des domaines thérapeutiques clés, en alignant les priorités locales en Espagne avec la stratégie médicale globale de Roche.

• Engagement de la KOL et partenariats scientifiques : Mener la collaboration avec un vaste réseau national de chefs d'opinion clés (KOL) et d'experts internationaux de niveau 1. Vous favoriserez des partenariats scientifiques à long terme et saisirez des connaissances cliniques de grande qualité pour éclairer la prise de décisions stratégiques.

• Génération de preuves et adoption précoce : Conduire la production de preuves médicales requises (à la fois parrainées par l'entreprise et entreprises de recherche) en conformité avec les priorités stratégiques, permettant l'adoption précoce des technologies Roches dans les lignes directrices de pratique clinique et les énoncés de consensus.

• Éducation médicale et renforcement des capacités : Concevoir et offrir des programmes d'éducation médicale et de formation pour les équipes de terrain, améliorer la communication scientifique, la précision technique et l'efficacité de l'engagement.

• Partenariat stratégique interfonctionnel : Fournir un leadership scientifique et influencer la prise de décisions entre les intervenants internes (Marché, Accès aux marchés, Ventes et Services médicaux), assurer l'exactitude, la conformité réglementaire et l'alignement sur la stratégie médicale globale.

Qui vous êtes

Nous recherchons un candidat ayant une solide expérience scientifique, un sens des affaires et un leadership éprouvé grâce à l'influence.

• Études : Diplôme en sciences de la vie (MD, maîtrise, doctorat).

• Expérience professionnelle: 2 à 5 ans d'expérience dans la production de preuves et la gestion de projets dans le secteur de la santé (Medtech, IVD, Pharma).

• Capacités et compétences de base :

• Mindset stratégique : Capacité de traduire des données scientifiques complexes en propositions de valeur réalisables.

• Leadership & Drive : axé sur les résultats, avec un engagement ferme envers l'excellence opérationnelle.

• Communication efficace et décisive : Compétence pour adapter des messages techniques complexes à divers publics, des conseils scientifiques aux cadres supérieurs.

• Collaboration et travail d'équipe : Fortes aptitudes interpersonnelles pour la collaboration interfonctionnelle au sein d'une organisation matricielle.

• Langues: Anglais et espagnol de haut niveau (essentiel pour une interaction quotidienne avec les équipes médicales mondiales et les réseaux internationaux).

• Lieu : Sant Cugat, Barcelone.

Qu'est-ce qui te prend ?

• Impact réel sur les soins de santé : Un rôle de grande visibilité où vos projets stratégiques d'apport et de production de preuves contribuent directement à transformer des solutions diagnostiques et des soins de santé personnalisés.

• Exposition mondiale : Collaboration directe avec des équipes mondiales de direction, des projets transfrontaliers et des groupes d'experts internationaux.

• Culture d'innovation et de développement : Un environnement dynamique, flexible et collaboratif qui favorise l'apprentissage continu, l'autonomie et la croissance professionnelle.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
ロシュのパーパスである ”Doing now what patients need next” 、Healthcare Excellence (HCE)　本部のビジョン「RDKKのビジネスを支え、日本の医療課題解決への道を切り拓いていく」を具現化するため、薬事グループは、薬事許認可プロセスマネジメントを通じて許認可を取得/維持することで、我々の検査に患者がアクセスできる環境を確保します。

【職務内容】
弊社製品（免疫・生化学・遺伝子・病理検査関連の試薬、機器、プログラムなど）の薬事申請担当者として、HCE本部の他3グループ（クオリティーマネジメント、メディカルアフェアーズ、アクセス／ポリシーアフェアーズ）と連携しながら、以下の業務を行っていただきます。

• 製品導入関連部署（Global Regulatory Team、ビジネスチームなど）と連携して、合理的な薬事導入戦略を立案する。

• PMDA相談等の実施、行政（厚労省、PMDA）担当者、Global担当者との折衝を通して、論理的かつ合理的な体外診断用医薬品、医療機器（プログラム医療機器を含む）の製造販売の許認可申請および取得、並びに許認可の維持を遂行する。

• 社内での薬事関連業務（変更管理、包材・各種資料の確認など）の遂行。

【求める経験】

• 経験年数とともに職責を広げ、業務を自律的・主体的に進め、成果を上げた経験。

• 体外診断用医薬品あるいは医療機器における薬事申請業務の経験（3年程度ある方を歓迎します）。

【求める知識・スキル・マインドセット】

• 薬事関連法規に関する一般的な知識。

• 生化学、生物学、免疫学、微生物学、工学、農学又は薬学に関連する学位（同等もしくはそれ以上でも可）。生化学・免疫・遺伝子・病理検査、プログラム医療機器に関する知識があれば尚可。

• 生化学、生物学、免疫学、微生物学、工学、農学又は薬学系の科学技術論文、データの解釈ができるスキル。

• 読み書きする英語力は必須。加えて日常会話程度の英語力（ビジネスレベルであれば尚可）。

• 論理的な思考力および文章構成力。

• 日常業務に限らず各種プロジェクトにおいても職務グレードによらず、業務/プロジェクトを自律的・主体的に進めることができるオーナーシップ。

• 関連部署とのコミュニケーション力、調整能力。

• 薬事スペシャリストとしてのパッション。

• 薬事スペシャリストの視点に加え、HCE本部や全社的な視野を持って製品上市に向けた出口戦略を考えられる全体最適の視点。そこから自身の役割を正しく理解し、成果を追求できる実行力。

【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】

Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方
Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方
Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方
Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方

海外関連部署を含め、他部門とのコミュニケーションを積極的に取り、建設的な発想を論理的、合理的な思考で実現することができる方を求めています。
ヘルスケアのリーディングカンパニーで薬事スペシャリストとして活躍できるポジションです。ロシュ・グローバルとの繋がりも密接であり、グローバルなキャリアを望む方にも、社内留学制度など、グローバル・キャリア・パスをサポートする体制が整備されています。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容　（雇い入れ直後）：Regulatory Affairs Specialist
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり

就業場所 （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする
給与
　　 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～　※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
　　 時間外固定手当：月51,936円　（時間外労働の有無に関わらず、20時間分の固定残業代として支給）
　　 ＜補足＞ ■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、営業手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）
コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生・その他
社会保険&#xff

• 薬事関連法規に関する一般的な知識。

• 生化学、生物学、免疫学、微生物学、工学、農学又は薬学に関連する学位（同等もしくはそれ以上でも可）。生化学・免疫・遺伝子・病理検査、プログラム医療機器に関する知識があれば尚可。

• 生化学、生物学、免疫学、微生物学、工学、農学又は薬学系の科学技術論文、データの解釈ができるスキル。

• 読み書きする英語力は必須。加えて日常会話程度の英語力（ビジネスレベルであれば尚可）。

Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方
Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方
Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方
Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方

海外関連部署を含め、他部門とのコミュニケーションを積極的に取り、建設的な発想を論理的、合理的な思考で実現することができる方を求めています。
ヘルスケアのリーディングカンパニーで薬事スペシャリストとして活躍できるポジションです。ロシュ・グローバルとの繋がりも密接であり、グローバルなキャリアを望む方にも、社内留学制度など、グローバル・キャリア・パスをサポートする体制が整備されています。

（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり

就業場所 （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
（変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～ ※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。

jobs.title: Application Specialist - Molecular Solutions
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The application specialist is responsible for responding to customers’ needs and expectations with high quality scientific answers, to contribute to customer long term loyalty, ensuring immediate and proper scientific support to customers (incl. providing instrument training and troubleshooting, settlement of scientific problems and timely update on new methods, techniques and Product Bulletins), and documenting all calls, activities on the CRM System.

This is a field-based role.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide high-level scientific support and operator training to customers.

• Handle all calls received from customers that relate to CPS and troubleshoot them to provide instant solutions to reagent and software problems due to customer complaints.

• Escalate unsolved cases to 2nd level support CIR, and/or GCS with complete case explanation.

• Ensure follow-up until the issue has been resolved and the customer is satisfied.

• Provide scientific documentation to customers.

• Document all his activities in Rexis/Lightning/ NFSS.

• Deliver best in class support utilizing appropriate systems and processes and providing a consistent and high level of support to customers.

• Continuing development of application skills to ensure resilience in the support of all CPS products.

• Proactively propose and implement activities aligned with customer satisfaction surveys and on-going customer and business area feedback.

• Ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner and guarantee the activity reporting at the CRM (Rexis) software and appropriate escalation of product issues to management center and ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner.

Who you are:

• PhD in Medical Laboratory Sciences, Chemistry, Histopathology, Biology or Biochemistry or related field - Mandatory

• Good knowledge and experience in pathology/molecular solutions.

• Minimum 3 year of experience in Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS).

• Fluent in English (oral and written).

• Technical vocabulary & terminology.

• Advanced computer skills (Windows and Microsoft Office).

• Experience in laboratory practice and/or experience in the use of automated laboratory equipment (Roche instruments preferably).

• Experience in laboratory manual practice and chemicals handling.

• Verbal and written communication skills.

• Planning, administration and decision making.

• Work well in a team environment.

• Service/Customer oriented.

• Creativity & well critical thinking with a proactive mindset.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Sales Data and Systems Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position
As Sales Data and Systems Specialist , you will be the driving force behind our data-driven growth strategies, transforming raw data into actionable intelligence that fuels sales performance. You will be collaborating across departments to ensure data accuracy, integration, and accessibility, empowering the entire organization to make informed decisions. Your sharp analytical skills will be instrumental in uncovering key market insights and identifying profitable opportunities, with a particular focus on expanding our market presence. This role will be part of Diagnostics Team.

The Opportunity

• Sales Performance Optimization: Develop and maintain insightful sales dashboards, ensuring data accuracy to drive informed decision-making.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner effectively with Finance, Marketing, and other departments to leverage data-driven insights for strategic decision-making.

• Data Integrity and Compliance: Meticulously manage sales data and ensure adherence to all relevant compliance and regulatory standards.

• Market Intelligence: Stay informed about market trends and competitor landscape, translating insights into actionable strategies.

• Strategic Planning: Contribute to strategic planning by providing insights into sales data, product portfolio analysis, and customer performance trends.

• Documentation and Process Improvement: Ensure meticulous documentation and continuously improve processes based on market insights.

• Team Collaboration: Coordinate requirements and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure successful bid submissions.

• Centralized Data Management: Manage and maintain a centralized sales data repository and project tracker for effective team collaboration.

Who you are:

• Bachelor’s Degree

• 3+ years of experience in sales reporting, data analysis, and project management, with a preference for experience in the medical device or diagnostics industry.

• You are proficient in sales reporting tools (Microsoft and G Suite) and other data analytics platforms. You have strong skills in creating impactful presentations, spreadsheets, and proposals.

Roche is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.

pRED Cardiovascular & Metabolism, Immunology (CMI), located in Basel, Switzerland, focuses on the discovery and early development of innovative treatments for specific diseases that affect the lives of millions. In the cardiovascular and metabolism area, we are developing cutting-edge therapies to treat metabolic diseases.

The Position
The Cardio-Renal Discovery Area Leader is a newly created and premier scientific leadership role within the CVRM therapeutic area, acting as the principal architect of the early-stage pipeline in cardiovascular and renal diseases. The focus is on pioneering novel cardiovascular and renal discovery programs and advancing them from target assessment through preclinical candidate selection . This role emphasizes deep, mechanistic disease expertise, leading an elite team of translational scientists and discovery biologists to interrogate the complex, interconnected biology of the cardiorenal axis.
This role reports directly to the Discovery Head of CVRM. Key interactions include presenting high-level portfolio strategies to the Leadership Team and governance boards, as well as maintaining deep collaborative relationships with world-renowned scientists and academic networks in cardiology and nephrology.

As a leader in CMI, you act as a catalyst for innovation, championing an enterprise mindset that prioritizes long-term scientific impact. You cultivate an environment of high performance and psychological safety, empowering elite teams of translational scientists to interrogate complex cardiorenal biology. Your leadership is defined by an unwavering commitment to integrity, courage, and passion, driving the organization to deliver transformative breakthroughs for patients.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Novel Target Identification: Drive scientific strategy to validate disease-modifying targets across CV and renal segments.

• Mechanistic Subspecialties: Champion programs targeting advanced mechanisms like myocardial energetics and podocyte injury.

• Modality-Agnostic Innovation: Lead teams across small molecules, RNA-based therapeutics, and advanced biologics.

• Phenotypic & Human-Centric Screening: Oversee 3D cardiac organoids and kidney-on-a-chip models.

• Preclinical-to-Clinical Translation: Accountability for scientific integrity of preclinical pharmacology and design architecture for transitioning leads into IND/CTA-enabling packages.

• Scouting & Due Diligence: Serve as technical authority for evaluating external assets and biotech platforms.

• Scientific Eminence: Cultivate collaborative relationships with academic research networks and consortia.

Who You Are
You will bring 10+ years of progressive biopharmaceutical industry or premier academic translation experience, with a documented history of driving CV/renal assets from early concept to successful IND/CTA filing and FIH readiness.

Qualifications & Experience:

• Education Level: PhD, MD, or MD/PhD in Cardiovascular Physiology, Renal Physiology, Pharmacology, Molecular Biology, or a h

Insieme, creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità.

pRED Cardiovascular & Metabolism, Immunology (CMI), situato a Basilea, Svizzera, si concentra sulla scoperta e lo sviluppo precoce di trattamenti innovativi per malattie specifiche che influiscono sulla vita di milioni di persone. Nella zona cardiovascolare e metabolismo, stiamo sviluppando terapie all'avanguardia per il trattamento delle malattie metaboliche.

La posizione
Il Cardio-Renal Discovery Area Leader è un neo creato e primo ruolo di leadership scientifica all'interno dell'area terapeutica CVRM, che funge da principale architetto del primo stadio pipeline in malattie cardiovascolari e renali. L'attenzione è rivolta ai nuovi programmi di scoperta cardiovascolare e renale e avanzandoli dalla valutazione dell'obiettivo attraverso la selezione dei candidati preclinici . Questo ruolo enfatizza la profonda e meccanistica esperienza della malattia, che conduce un team di élite di scienziati traduttivi e biologi alla scoperta per interrogare la complessa e interconnessa biologia dell'asse cardiorenale.

Colti un ambiente di alte prestazioni e sicurezza psicologica, che consente alle squadre elite di scienziati traduttivi di interrogare la biologia cardiorenale complessa. La vostra leadership è definita da un continuo impegno per l'integrità, il coraggio e la passione, guidando l'organizzazione a fornire scoperte trasformative per i pazienti.

Le tue responsabilità chiave includono:

• Sottospecialità meccanicistiche: programmi campione che mirano a meccanismi avanzati come l'energetica miocardica e lesioni podocyte.

• Modality-Agnostic Innovation: Lead team attraverso piccole molecole, terapeutici basati su RNA e biologiche avanzate.

• Screening Phenotypic & Human-Centric: supervisionare i organoidi cardiaci 3D e i modelli renali-on-a-chip.

• Preclinical-to-Clinical Translation: La responsabilità per l'integrità scientifica della farmacologia preclinica e dell'architettura progettuale per la transizione porta in pacchetti abilitanti IND/CTA.

• Scouting & Due Diligence: Servire come autorità tecnica per la valutazione di beni esterni e piattaforme biotech.

• Eminenza scientifica: coltivare relazioni collaborative con reti di ricerca accademiche e consorzi.

Chi sei
Si porterà 10+ anni di progressiva industria biofarmaceutica o esperienza di traduzione accademica premier, con una storia documentata di guidare CV / attività renali dal concetto iniziale al successo IND / CTA di archiviazione e la disponibilità FIH.

jobs.title: Power Platform Architect
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description

As a Microsoft Power Platform Architect, you will demonstrate proven expertise in the platform’s foundation and component technologies. You will guide the platform team in making the platform available to the broader enterprise, so that citizen developers and federated application teams can create business value by leveraging the platform. You will effectively translate organizational goals into a robust technical roadmap, guiding the strategic direction for a secure, compliant, and scalable low-code ecosystem. You will create governance frameworks and provide best practices to empower developers. In addition, you will design the automated administration of the platform, leveraging AI, so that tasks like monitoring platform capacity and user licensing do not need to be done manually. You will act as a technical leader for the platform team, while at the same time collaborating with the global architect community and the technical experts responsible for other Microsoft components.

Job Responsibilities

• Content Leadership: Treats platform services as internal products with clear documentation, lifecycle management, and stakeholder feedback loops. Designs and documents components of shared technology platforms (e.g., CI/CD, observability, DLP policies) while creating proof of concepts, reference implementations, automation scripts, and platform tooling. Closely follows Microsoft’s Power Platform roadmap and general developments in the low-code, no-code and AI space to identify opportunities and challenges within Roche.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Takes ownership of ambiguous tasks and topics in the "grey zone" and successfully drives small to medium (S/M) initiatives at the platform level. These initiatives may include the implementation of platform level initiatives, such as the deployment of the Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit or other automations to support platform administrations. Challenges the status quo, skillfully navigates group dynamics, and fosters good collaboration, knowledge sharing, coaching, and mentoring.

• Stakeholder Management: Prioritizes and communicates with stakeholders effectively. Leads the platform team to ensure that platform is fit for use, socializes the platform to prospective internal customers, and represents the platform within architect communities. Maintains a bigger picture view informed by Microsoft’s roadmap and general low-code, no-code, and AI trends. Understands how various platform components fit into the overall organizational strategy and goals.

• Impact/Strategy: Acts as a technical mentor and aligns development plans with the global strategy. Gives speeches and shares knowledge in internal events (e.g., DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live) and gets involved in initiatives or tasks reaching outside of the regular project scope.

• Complexity: Operates at the platform level with a direct impact on the platform team’s technical decisions and an indirect impact on the decisions of citizen developers, professional developers, and business use case owners. Records decisions in architecture decision records and other formal documentation.

• Business / Technical ability: Possesses a deep understanding of the broader technical landscape beyond the specific component being worked on. Formulates and implements technical strategies aligned with organizational objectives, investing time and energy in initiatives that boost automation and innovation while maintaining the highest engineer

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Descrizione del lavoro

In qualità di Microsoft Power Platform Architect, dimostrerai una comprovata esperienza nelle tecnologie di base e componenti della piattaforma. Potrai guidare il team della piattaforma nel rendere la piattaforma disponibile per l'impresa più ampia, in modo che gli sviluppatori di cittadini e i team di applicazioni federati possono creare valore aziendale sfruttando la piattaforma. Tradurrete efficacemente gli obiettivi organizzativi in una robusta roadmap tecnica, guidando la direzione strategica per un ecosistema sicuro, conforme e scalabile a basso codice. Potrai creare framework di governance e fornire le migliori pratiche per potenziare gli sviluppatori. Inoltre, si progetta l'amministrazione automatizzata della piattaforma, sfruttando l'IA, in modo che le attività come la capacità della piattaforma di monitoraggio e le licenze degli utenti non devono essere fatte manualmente. Potrai fungere da leader tecnico per il team di piattaforma, mentre allo stesso tempo collabora con la comunità di architetti globale e gli esperti tecnici responsabili di altri componenti Microsoft.

Responsabilità del lavoro

• Leadership dei contenuti: Tratta i servizi della piattaforma come prodotti interni con chiara documentazione, gestione del ciclo di vita e loop di feedback degli stakeholder. Progetta e documenta componenti di piattaforme tecnologiche condivise (ad esempio, CI/CD, osservabilità, politiche DLP) creando la prova di concetti, implementazioni di riferimento, script di automazione e strumenti di piattaforma. Seguire la roadmap di Microsoft Power Platform e gli sviluppi generali nello spazio a basso codice, no-code e AI per identificare opportunità e sfide all'interno di Roche.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: prende la proprietà di compiti e argomenti ambigui nella "grande zona" e guida con successo iniziative da piccole a medie (S/M) a livello della piattaforma. Queste iniziative possono includere l'implementazione di iniziative a livello di piattaforma, come l'implementazione del Center of Excellence (CoE) Starter Kit o altre automazioni per supportare le amministrazioni delle piattaforme. Sfida lo status quo, naviga abilmente dinamiche di gruppo, e favorisce una buona collaborazione, condivisione di conoscenze, coaching e mentoring.

• Stakeholder Management: Priorizza e comunica con gli stakeholder in modo efficace. Guida il team della piattaforma per garantire che la piattaforma sia adatta all'uso, socializza la piattaforma per potenziali clienti interni, e rappresenta la piattaforma all'interno delle comunità di architetti. Mantiene una visione d'immagine più grande informata dalla roadmap di Microsoft e dalle tendenze generali di basso codice, no-code e AI. Comprende come i vari componenti della piattaforma si adattano alla strategia e agli obiettivi organizzativi generali.

• Impact/Strategy: agisce come mentore tecnico e allinea i piani di sviluppo con la strategia globale. Fornisce discorsi e condivide conoscenze in eventi interni (ad esempio, DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live) e si impegna in iniziative o compiti che raggiungono al di fuori del normale ambito di progetto.

• Complessità: Funziona a livello della piattaforma con un impatto diretto sulle decisioni tecniche del team della piattaforma e un impatto indiretto sulle decisioni degli sviluppatori di cittadini, degli sviluppatori professionali e dei proprietari di case di uso aziendale. Registra le decisioni nei registri delle decisioni di architettura e di altra documentazione formale.

• Business / Capacità tecnica: Possede una profonda comprensione del paesaggio tecnico più ampio oltre la componente specifica su cui si lavora. Formula e implementa strategie tecniche allineate agli obiettivi organizzativi, investendo il tempo e l'energia in iniziative che incrementano l'automazione e l'innovazione mantenendo al contempo il più alto ingegnere

• Responsabilisation/Résoudre les problèmes : S'approprier des tâches et des sujets ambigus dans la « zone grise » et mener avec succès des initiatives petites à moyennes (S/M) au niveau de la plateforme. Comprend comment les divers éléments de la plateforme s'inscrivent dans la stratégie et les objectifs organisationnels globaux.

• Impact/Stratégie : agit comme mentor technique et harmonise les plans de développement avec la stratégie mondiale. Donne des discours et partage des connaissances dans des événements internes (p. ex., DevOps Days, Tech Talk, Tech Live) et s'implique dans des initiatives ou des tâches qui dépassent la portée régulière du projet.

• Complexité : Fonctionne au niveau de la plate-forme avec un impact direct sur l'équipe de la plate-forme. Documents sur les décisions en matière d'architecture et autres documents officiels.

• Capacités d'affaires / techniques: Possède une compréhension profonde du paysage technique plus large au-delà de la composante spécifique sur laquelle on travaille. Formuler et mettre en œuvre des stratégies techniques alignées sur les objectifs organisationnels, investir du temps et de l'énergie dans des initiatives qui stimulent l'automatisation et l'innovation tout en maintenant le plus haut ingénieur

jobs.description:

The Position
Deine Abteilung

Wir sind ein internationales Team, das gemeinsam an der Entwicklung von Antikörpern und Antigenen für verschiedene diagnostische Assays und Testverfahren arbeitet. Wir sind innovativ und beschäftigen uns intensiv mit der Erforschung und Etablierung neuer, optimierter zell- und molekularbiologischer Verfahren zur Entwicklung und Herstellung diagnostischer Antikörper und Antigene. Your department

We are an international team working together on the development of antibodies and antigens for various diagnostic assays and test methods. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
这是一个可以让你成长为更优秀的专业人才的大好机会，你未来可以通过以下工作职责获得多方面能力的提升：

客户管理
• 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士（HCP）观念、学术需求 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息
• 传递相应疾病领域的科学进展，促进医生制定规范治疗方案
• 传递罗氏产品的关键信息，提高罗氏产品认知，并收集反馈
• 传递疾病领域诊断相关信息，助力生态圈内患者诊断率提升

学科建设
• 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点 通过搭建头部医院交流或跨院培训、教育会议进行医生/科室教育 逐步搭建规范化的诊疗平台

计划管理
• 规划相应生态圈的学术推广计划，和协作同事协商达成最终方案，并进行实施。
• 组织和支持区域专家会议
• 了解医生观念、需求、会议安排；制定会议及覆盖计划；执行会议计划；回访收集反馈
• 按公司规定合理制定预算，并按计划实施完成，确保资源的合理和有效利用

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
• 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变，实现规范化诊疗 和患者解决方案经理协同合作，关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
• 成为产品和疾病领域的专家 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持
• 主动地与生态圈内外团队成员进行合作和分享，以整合资源，提升团队能力

你需要具备哪些条件才能加大申请这个岗位的竞争力呢？
岗位所需胜任力
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 较高的沟通能力和高效的执行能力
• 正确的思维和行为 (使命驱动，合作共赢，成长性思维)

工作年限
• 3年以上医药行业工作经验
• 既往有学术推广/市场/医学经验
• 跨职能工作经验为佳

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche RDT Diagnostics, we believe every patient deserves the best possible treatment. To
achieve this, our RDT DIA R&D teams must operate with clinical precision and agile efficiency. We are seeking a Technical Lead to bridge the gap between complex DIA R&D business needs and cutting-edge technology. In this role, you will be the architectural and technical lead for our Portfolio and Project

Management (PPM) ecosystem. You won't just be "managing software", you will be designing the digital backbone that allows Roche to prioritize the right life-saving innovations and bring them to market faster.

The Opportunity

• Stakeholder Partnership - Act as the primary technical consultant for RDT DIA R&D PPM to optimize workflows through automation and data-driven insights

• PPM Solution Leadership - Lead Planisware configuration implementation, translating core business requirements into actionable configurations validated through strategic PoCs

• Solution Design - Translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and compliant cloud-based architectures (SaaS/PaaS)

• Custom Built Solution Leadership - Oversee design and implementation of custom solutions, i.e., RDT DIA PPM Portal, ROMA, DP360, etc.

• Lifecycle Management - Oversee the evolution of the PPM toolset (e.g., Planisware, Jira, or custom solutions) to ensure they remain "fit-for-purpose"

• Data Governance - Ensure the integrity and flow of R&D data across the ecosystem to provide a "single source of truth" for executive decision-making

• Solution Strategy - Define the end-to-end technical vision for the RDT DIA R&D PPM landscape, ensuring seamless integration between financial planning, resource management, and stage-gate execution

Who You Are
You are a strategic thinker who thrives at the intersection of DIA PPM business processes, modern PPM software, and data engineering. You understand that in Diagnostics, "speed to market" is a healthcare imperative.

• Communication - Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical senior leadership

• Agile Mindset - Comfort working within SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) or similar agile methodologies

• Experience - 5+ years of experience configuring PPM solutions with a focus on Planisware

• Experience - 7+ years in Solution Design, with a specific focus on Portfolio and Project Management (PPM) or Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems

• Domain Knowledge - Previous experience in Life Sciences, Diagnostics, or Pharmaceuticals is highly preferred. Familiarity with GxP and CSV (Computer System Validation) is a major plus

• Technical Stack - Experience with enterprise PPM tools (e.g., Planisware, Planview, etc.)

• Strong understanding of integration patterns (APIs, Data Mesh/Products, and Middleware)

• Familiarity with Cloud platforms (AWS or Azure)

• Solid collaboration and influencing skills with a proven ability to lead and inspire

• Strong analytical, logical problem-resolution skills

Why Roche?

• Impact - Your work directly supports the development of diagnostic tests that affect millions of lives

• Innovation - You will have access to the latest technology and a culture that encourages experimentation

• Growth - A global environment with extensive opportunities for cross-functional career movement

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position,

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
A Roche RDT Diagnostics, crediamo che ogni paziente meriti il miglior trattamento possibile. A
raggiungere questo obiettivo, i nostri team RDT DIA R&D devono operare con precisione clinica ed efficienza agile. Stiamo cercando un lead tecnico per colmare il divario tra le complesse esigenze aziendali DIA R&D e la tecnologia all'avanguardia. In questo ruolo, sarete il capo architettonico e tecnico per il nostro Portfolio e Progetto

Gestione (PPM) ecosistema. Non sarà solo "gestire il software", si sta progettando la spina dorsale digitale che permette Roche per priorizzare le innovazioni salvavita giuste e portarli al mercato più velocemente.

L'opportunità

• Stakeholder Partnership - Agite come consulente tecnico primario per RDT DIA R&D PPM per ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro attraverso l'automazione e le informazioni basate sui dati

• Leadership della soluzione PPM - implementazione della configurazione di Lead Planisware, traducendo i requisiti aziendali fondamentali in configurazioni attuabili convalidate tramite PoC strategici

• Solution Design - Traduci i complessi requisiti aziendali in architetture basate su cloud scalabili, sicure e conformi (SaaS/PaaS)

• Leadership della soluzione personalizzata - supervisiona la progettazione e l'implementazione di soluzioni personalizzate, cioè, RDT DIA PPM Portal, ROMA, DP360, ecc.

• Gestione del ciclo di vita - Superare l'evoluzione degli strumenti PPM (ad esempio, Planisware, Jira, o soluzioni personalizzate) per garantire che rimangano "adattati per scopi"

• Gestione dei dati - Assicurare l'integrità e il flusso dei dati R&D in tutto l'ecosistema per fornire una "unica fonte di verità" per il processo decisionale esecutivo

• Solution Strategy - Definire la visione tecnica end-to-end per il paesaggio RDT DIA R&D PPM, garantendo un'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità tra pianificazione finanziaria, gestione delle risorse e esecuzione delle porte

Chi sei
Sei un pensatore strategico che prospera all'incrocio dei processi aziendali DIA PPM, moderno software PPM e ingegneria dei dati. Capisci che in Diagnostics, "velocità al mercato" è un imperativo sanitario.

• Comunicazione - Capacità di spiegare complessi trade-off tecnici alla leadership non tecnologica senior

• Agile Mindset - Comfort lavorando all'interno di SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) o simili metodologie agili

• Esperienza - 5+ anni di esperienza nella configurazione delle soluzioni PPM con un focus su Planisware

• Esperienza - 7+ anni in Solution Design, con un focus specifico sui sistemi Portfolio e Project Management (PPM) o Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)

• Conoscenza del dominio - L'esperienza precedente in Scienze della vita, Diagnostica o Farmaceutici è altamente preferita. La familiarità con GxP e CSV (Computer System Validation) è un vantaggio importante

• Tecnica Stack - Esperienza con strumenti PPM aziendali (ad esempio, Planisware, Planview, ecc.)

• Forte comprensione dei modelli di integrazione (API, Data Mesh/Products e Middleware)

• Familiarità con piattaforme Cloud (AWS o Azure)

• Solida collaborazione e influenzando le competenze con una comprovata capacità di guidare e ispirare

• Forte analitica, logica capacità di risoluzione dei problemi

Perché Roche?

• Impatto - Il vostro lavoro supporta direttamente lo sviluppo di test diagnostici che interessano milioni di vite

• Innovazione - Avrai accesso alle ultime tecnologie e a una cultura che incoraggia la sperimentazione

• Crescita - Un ambiente globale con ampie opportunità per il movimento di carriera interfunzionale

Pronti a fare il passo successivo? Ci piacerebbe sentirti. Applicare ora per esplorare questa eccitante opportunità!

L'opportunité

• Partenariat avec les intervenants - Agir en tant que principal consultant technique pour la R-D R-D R-D R-D R-D pour optimiser les flux de travail grâce à l'automatisation et aux données

• Leadership de la solution PPM - Mise en oeuvre de la configuration du planisware principal, transformant les exigences opérationnelles fondamentales en configurations exploitables validées au moyen de programmes stratégiques

• Solution Design - Traduire des exigences opérationnelles complexes en architectures cloud évolutives, sécurisées et conformes (SaaS/PaaS)
