jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
​
IT Semantic Engineer - RDT Data Platforms

Description of the area

The IT Semantic Engineer is responsible for leading, designing, developing, and maintaining our enterprise-level semantic hub. This platform serves as the foundational data layer bridging the gap between vast enterprise knowledge and advanced AI systems.
In this role, you will integrate diverse data and metadata sources into a unified knowledge graph, design common ontologies to expose disparate datasets uniformly, build robust APIs and integration protocols for AI consumption. The ultimate goal is to provide high-precision enterprise context to AI assistants and intelligent agents—grounding their responses, enabling reliable workflow execution, and eliminating AI hallucinations.

The Opportunity:

• Scope / Content Leadership : Leads the design, build, and maintenance of scalable data pipelines and graph architectures. Independently drives data integration projects from ingestion to semantic transformation, establishing unified enterprise ontologies.

• Accountability / Problem Solving: Solves complex data modeling, ingestion, and querying challenges. Evaluates, benchmarks, and optimizes the performance of data access tools to ensure AI systems fetch enterprise context efficiently, accurately, and with minimal latency.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborates directly with data owners, domain experts, and AI application teams to thoroughly understand business requirements. Translates complex business use cases into robust schemas and standardized data endpoints.

• Impact / Strategy: Drives the technical evolution of the hub’s delivery architecture. Implements robust strategies for distributed data indexing, orchestration, and access, while embedding FAIR principles (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) across all workflows.

• Complexity / Product Size : Manages a highly interconnected, large-scale enterprise knowledge system. Integrates complex, multi-source metadata systems into a uniform layer, navigating advanced infrastructure and enterprise gateway patterns to maintain seamless, automated deployments.

Who you are:

Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience handling enterprise-scale data engineering projects and managing complex semantic web systems and knowledge graphs.

• Experience configuring, deploying, and maintaining infrastructure components in a Kubernetes environment using GitOps automation.

• Experience working with validated or qualified platforms (GxP) is a plus.

Technical Skills

• Experience: Senior-level experience in data engineering, software engineering, or semantic web engineering with strong Python coding skills, a proven track record of autonomous delivery, and a focus on knowledge graphs or AI system enablement.

• Semantic & Graph Technologies: Hands-on experience with Graph databases (Ontotext GraphDB preferred, Neo4j) and core semantic web standards (RDF, OWL, SPARQL and ontology design).

• APIs & AI Protocols: Deep understanding of GraphQL API design and hands-on experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to expose data tools to LLMs.

• DevOps & Infrastructure: Experience configuring, deploying, and managing containerized workloads within enterprise Kubernetes (Rancher/RKE2) environments.

• GitOps & CI/CD: Expert proficiency in Git-based workflows using trunk-based development, automated deployments via ArgoCD, and application packaging with Helm charts.

• Security & Networking: Solid practical understanding of secrets management

• Accountability / Problem Solving: Solves complesse modellazione dei dati, ingestione e querying sfide. Valuta, benchmark e ottimizza le prestazioni degli strumenti di accesso ai dati per garantire ai sistemi AI il contesto aziendale in modo efficiente, preciso e con latenza minima.

• Stakeholder Management: Collabora direttamente con i proprietari di dati, gli esperti di dominio e i team di applicazioni AI per comprendere a fondo i requisiti aziendali. Traduce complessi casi di uso aziendale in schemi robusti e endpoint dati standardizzati.

• Impatto / Strategia: Guida l'evoluzione tecnica dell'architettura di consegna del hub. Implementa strategie robuste per l'indicizzazione dei dati distribuiti, l'orchestrazione e l'accesso, integrando i principi FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) in tutti i flussi di lavoro.

• Complessità / dimensione del prodotto: gestisce un sistema di conoscenza aziendale altamente interconnesso e su larga scala. Integra sistemi di metadati complessi e multi-source in uno strato uniforme, navigando modelli avanzati di infrastruttura e gateway enterprise per mantenere implementazioni automatizzate e senza soluzione di continuità.

Chi sei:

Istruzione / Esperienza

• Dimostrata esperienza di gestione di progetti di ingegneria dei dati su scala aziendale e gestione di complessi sistemi web semantici e grafici di conoscenza.

• Configurazione, distribuzione e manutenzione di componenti infrastrutturali in un ambiente Kubernetes utilizzando l'automazione GitOps.

• L'esperienza di lavoro con piattaforme convalidate o qualificate (GxP) è un plus.

Competenze tecniche

• Esperienza: Esperienza di livello superiore nell'ingegneria dei dati, nell'ingegneria del software o nell'ingegneria web semantica con forti capacità di codifica Python, un'esperienza comprovata di consegna autonoma, e un focus sui grafici di conoscenza o l'attivazione del sistema AI.

• Semantic & Graph Technologies: esperienza manuale con database Graph (preferito Ontotext GraphDB, Neo4j) e standard web semantici core (RDF, OWL, SPARQL e ontology design).

• APIs & AI Protocols: Profonda comprensione della progettazione API di GraphQL e esperienza pratica con il Protocollo di Contesto Modello (MCP) per esporre gli strumenti di dati a LLM.

• DevOps & Infrastructure: Configurazione, distribuzione e gestione dei carichi di lavoro containerizzati negli ambienti enterprise Kubernetes (Rancher/RKE2).

• GitOps & CI/CD: La competenza degli esperti nei flussi di lavoro basati su Git utilizzando lo sviluppo basato sul tronco, le implementazioni automatizzate tramite ArgoCD e l'imballaggio delle applicazioni con i grafici Helm.

• Sicurezza e rete: solida comprensione pratica della gestione dei segreti
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
​
IT Semantic Engineer - RDT Data Platforms

Description of the area

The IT Semantic Engineer is responsible for leading, designing, developing, and maintaining our enterprise-level semantic hub. This platform serves as the foundational data layer bridging the gap between vast enterprise knowledge and advanced AI systems.
In this role, you will integrate diverse data and metadata sources into a unified knowledge graph, design common ontologies to expose disparate datasets uniformly, build robust APIs and integration protocols for AI consumption. The ultimate goal is to provide high-precision enterprise context to AI assistants and intelligent agents—grounding their responses, enabling reliable workflow execution, and eliminating AI hallucinations.

The Opportunity:

• Scope / Content Leadership : Leads the design, build, and maintenance of scalable data pipelines and graph architectures. Independently drives data integration projects from ingestion to semantic transformation, establishing unified enterprise ontologies.

• Accountability / Problem Solving: Solves complex data modeling, ingestion, and querying challenges. Evaluates, benchmarks, and optimizes the performance of data access tools to ensure AI systems fetch enterprise context efficiently, accurately, and with minimal latency.

• Stakeholder Management: Collaborates directly with data owners, domain experts, and AI application teams to thoroughly understand business requirements. Translates complex business use cases into robust schemas and standardized data endpoints.

• Impact / Strategy: Drives the technical evolution of the hub’s delivery architecture. Implements robust strategies for distributed data indexing, orchestration, and access, while embedding FAIR principles (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) across all workflows.

• Complexity / Product Size : Manages a highly interconnected, large-scale enterprise knowledge system. Integrates complex, multi-source metadata systems into a uniform layer, navigating advanced infrastructure and enterprise gateway patterns to maintain seamless, automated deployments.

Who you are:

Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience handling enterprise-scale data engineering projects and managing complex semantic web systems and knowledge graphs.

• Experience configuring, deploying, and maintaining infrastructure components in a Kubernetes environment using GitOps automation.

• Experience working with validated or qualified platforms (GxP) is a plus.

Technical Skills

• Experience: Senior-level experience in data engineering, software engineering, or semantic web engineering with strong Python coding skills, a proven track record of autonomous delivery, and a focus on knowledge graphs or AI system enablement.

• Semantic & Graph Technologies: Hands-on experience with Graph databases (Ontotext GraphDB preferred, Neo4j) and core semantic web standards (RDF, OWL, SPARQL and ontology design).

• APIs & AI Protocols: Deep understanding of GraphQL API design and hands-on experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to expose data tools to LLMs.

• DevOps & Infrastructure: Experience configuring, deploying, and managing containerized workloads within enterprise Kubernetes (Rancher/RKE2) environments.

• GitOps & CI/CD: Expert proficiency in Git-based workflows using trunk-based development, automated deployments via ArgoCD, and application packaging with Helm charts.

• Security & Networking: Solid practical understanding of secrets management

Die Position
​
IT Semantic Engineer - RDT Datenplattformen

Beschreibung des Gebiets

Der IT Semantic Engineer ist verantwortlich für die Leitung, das Design, die Entwicklung und die Wartung unseres semantischen Hubs auf Unternehmensebene. Diese Plattform dient als grundlegende Datenschicht, die die Lücke zwischen umfangreichem Unternehmenswissen und fortschrittlichen KI-Systemen schließt.
In dieser Rolle integrieren Sie verschiedene Daten- und Metadatenquellen in einen einheitlichen Wissensgraphen, entwerfen gemeinsame Ontologien, um unterschiedliche Datensätze einheitlich darzustellen, erstellen robuste APIs und Integrationsprotokolle für den KI-Verbrauch. Das ultimative Ziel ist es, KI-Assistenten und intelligenten Agenten einen hochpräzisen Unternehmenskontext zu bieten - die Erdung ihrer Antworten, die zuverlässige Ausführung von Workflows und die Beseitigung von KI-Halluzinationen.

Die Gelegenheit:

• Scope / Content Leadership: Leitet das Design, den Aufbau und die Wartung skalierbarer Datenpipelines und Graphenarchitekturen. Führt Datenintegrationsprojekte unabhängig von der Aufnahme bis zur semantischen Transformation und etabliert einheitliche Unternehmensontologien.

• Stakeholder Management: Arbeitet direkt mit Datenbesitzern, Domänenexperten und KI-Anwendungsteams zusammen, um die Geschäftsanforderungen gründlich zu verstehen. Übersetzt komplexe Business Use Cases in robuste Schemata und standardisierte Datenendpunkte.

• Impact / Strategie: Betreibt die technische Entwicklung der Auslieferungsarchitektur des Hubs. Implementiert robuste Strategien für die Indexierung, Orchestrierung und den Zugriff auf verteilte Daten, während FAIR-Prinzipien (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) in alle Workflows integriert werden.

• GitOps & CI/CD: Expertenkenntnisse in Git-basierten Workflows mit trunk-basierter Entwicklung, automatisierten Bereitstellungen über ArgoCD und Anwendungsverpackung mit Helm-Diagrammen.

Ingénieur sémantique IT - Plateformes de données RDT

Intégre des systèmes de métadonnées complexes et multisources dans une couche uniforme, en naviguant sur les modèles d'infrastructure avancée et de passerelle d'entreprise pour maintenir des déploiements automatisés et sans faille.

Qui vous êtes :

Éducation / Expérience

• Expérience démontrée dans la gestion de projets d'ingénierie des données à l'échelle de l'entreprise et la gestion de systèmes Web sémantiques complexes et de graphiques de connaissances.

• Découvrez la configuration, le déploiement et la maintenance des composants d'infrastructure dans un environnement Kubernetes grâce à l'automatisation GitOps.

• L'expérience de travail avec des plateformes validées ou qualifiées (GxP) est un plus.

Compétences techniques

• Expérience : Expérience de niveau supérieur en ingénierie de données, en génie logiciel ou en génie web sémantique avec de solides compétences de codage Python, une expérience éprouvée de la prestation autonome, et un accent sur les graphiques de connaissances ou l'activation du système d'IA.

• Technologies sémantiques et graphiques: Expérience pratique avec les bases de données graphiques (Ontotext GraphDB préféré, Neo4j) et les normes web sémantiques de base (RDF, OWL, SPARQL et conception d'ontologie).

• API et protocoles d'IA: Compréhension approfondie de la conception de l'API de GraphQL et expérience pratique avec le Model Context Protocol (MCP) pour exposer les outils de données aux LLM.

• DevOps & Infrastructure: Expérimentez la configuration, le déploiement et la gestion des charges de travail conteneurisées dans les environnements Kubernetes (Rancher/RKE2).

• GitOps & CI/CD: Compétence d'expert dans les flux de travail basés sur Git en utilisant le développement basé sur le tronc, déploiements automatisés via ArgoCD, et packaging d'applications avec des cartes Helm.

• Sécurité et réseautage: Une bonne compréhension pratique de la gestion des secrets

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. From robust sample isolation and preparation tools to novel sequencing technology and advanced bioinformatics, we are developing differentiated, highly integrated end-to-end solutions for next-generation sequencing, resulting in a sample in, result out workflow.

This hands-on role focuses on solving mechanical challenges for our next-generation platforms. You will be responsible for conceptualizing, designing, building, and testing electro-mechanical, pneumatic, thermal, fluidic, and consumable solutions that ensure system performance, reliability, and longevity. As a technical authority, you will drive innovation and define solutions for novel DNA sequencing and automation challenges.

The Opportunity & Responsibilities:

• You will drive the research and development of various sub-systems, encompassing electro-mechanical, pneumatic, thermal, fluidic, and consumable technologies.

• You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and manage critical technical interfaces.

• You will own sub-systems through verification, integration, and troubleshooting, working closely with System Integration engineers.

• You will lead cross-functional design reviews to drive alignment and resolve technical trade-offs.

• You will manage design deliverable timelines and contribute to overall project planning.

• You will create and maintain comprehensive design documentation.

• You will contribute to technical strategy, providing data-driven recommendations on architecture and technology.

• You will present progress, data, and design trade-offs to stakeholders, clearly articulating the impact of engineering decisions.

This is an onsite position based in Santa Clara, CA.
Relocation benefits are not offered for this role.

Who You Are:
(Required)

• You have a degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline, with relevant industry experience (minimum 7+ years for a Bachelor's, 4+ years for a Master's, or 3+ years for a PhD).

• You have demonstrated hands-on experience designing, developing, and testing complex electro-mechanical, pneumatic, thermal, or fluidic assemblies, preferably for life science or diagnostic instrumentation.

• You are highly proficient in SolidWorks for detailed design and the creation of manufacturing drawings.

• You have demonstrated experience designing components for a variety of manufacturing processes (e.g., machining, sheet metal, injection molding, 3D printing).

• You have demonstrated problem-solving skills; ability to troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and chemistry interfaces.

• You are proficient with machine shop tools, measurement equipment, and rapid prototyping (e.g., CNC mills/lathes, laser cutters, 3D printers).

• You have experience solving unique or unpredictable problems that might have an impact on the goals and objectives as set by the organization

Preferred:

• You have an advanced degree in Mechanical Engineer, or a closely related discipline

• You have a high level of proficiency with Python for device control and data acquisition.

• You have experience with simulation tools (CFD, FEA) to guide design decisions.

• You have experience developing next-generation sequencing (NGS) or genomics instrumentation.

•

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
A Roche, stiamo lavorando per rendere il sequenziamento di prossima generazione abbastanza semplice e accessibile per uso di routine. Accelerando la ricerca clinica, razionalizzando i flussi di lavoro e espandendo i menu di analisi, stiamo ampliando l'accesso ai dati genomici e abbassando le barriere all'adozione. Dai robusti strumenti di isolamento e preparazione dei campioni alle nuove tecnologie di sequenziamento e alla bioinformatica avanzata, stiamo sviluppando soluzioni end-to-end differenziate e altamente integrate per la sequenziamento di nuova generazione, con un risultato di campionamento, risultato fuori flusso di lavoro.

Questo ruolo pratico si concentra sulla risoluzione di sfide meccaniche per le nostre piattaforme di nuova generazione. Sarete responsabili di concettualizzare, progettare, costruire e testare soluzioni elettromeccaniche, pneumatiche, termiche, fluidiche e di consumo che garantiscono prestazioni del sistema, affidabilità e longevità. Come autorità tecnica, guiderai l'innovazione e definirai soluzioni per nuove sfide di sequenziamento e automazione del DNA.

Le opportunità e le responsabilità:

• Aziona la ricerca e lo sviluppo di vari sottosistemi, che comprendono tecnologie elettromeccaniche, pneumatiche, termiche, fluidiche e di consumo.

• Collaborerai con team interfunzionali per definire e gestire interfacce tecniche critiche.

• Possiederai sottosistemi attraverso la verifica, l'integrazione e la risoluzione dei problemi, lavorando a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri di System Integration.

• Condurrai recensioni di progettazione interfunzionali per guidare l'allineamento e risolvere i trade-off tecnici.

• Potrai gestire le linee temporali di progettazione e contribuire alla pianificazione generale del progetto.

• Si creerà e manterrà la documentazione completa di progettazione.

• Contribuirai alla strategia tecnica, fornendo raccomandazioni basate sui dati sull'architettura e la tecnologia.

• Verrà presentato il progresso, i dati e i trade-off di progettazione agli stakeholder, articolando chiaramente l'impatto delle decisioni di ingegneria.

Questa è una posizione in loco con base a Santa Clara, CA.
I vantaggi di trasferimento non sono offerti per questo ruolo.

Chi sei?
(richiesto)

• Hai una laurea in ingegneria meccanica, o una disciplina strettamente correlata, con esperienza di settore rilevante (minimo 7+ anni per un Bachelor, 4+ anni per un Master, o 3+ anni per un dottorato).

• Hai dimostrato esperienza pratica progettando, sviluppando e testando complessi assemblaggi elettromeccanici, pneumatici, termici o fluidici, preferibilmente per la scienza della vita o la strumentazione diagnostica.

• Sei molto competente in SolidWorks per il design dettagliato e la creazione di disegni di produzione.

• Hai dimostrato esperienza nella progettazione di componenti per una varietà di processi produttivi (ad esempio, lavorazione, lamiera, stampaggio ad iniezione, stampa 3D).

• Hai dimostrato capacità di problem solving; capacità di risolvere problemi hardware complesso, software e interfacce di chimica.

• Siete abili con macchine utensili, apparecchiature di misura e prototipazione rapida (ad esempio, fresatori / torni CNC, frese laser, stampanti 3D).

• Hai esperienza di risolvere problemi unici o imprevedibili che potrebbero avere un impatto sugli obiettivi e gli obiettivi fissati dall'organizzazione

Preferito:

• Hai una laurea avanzata in Ingegnere meccanico, o una disciplina strettamente correlata

• Hai un alto livello di competenza con Python per il controllo dei dispositivi e l'acquisizione dei dati.

• Hai esperienza con strumenti di simulazione (CFD, FEA) per guidare le decisioni di progettazione.

• Avete esperienza nello sviluppo di sequenziamento di prossima generazione (NGS) o strumentazione genomica.

•

Durch die Beschleunigung der klinischen Forschung, die Rationalisierung von Workflows und die Erweiterung der Assay-Menüs erweitern wir den Zugang zu genomischen Daten und senken die Akzeptanzbarrieren. Von robusten Werkzeugen für die Probenisolierung und -vorbereitung bis hin zu neuartigen Sequenzierungstechnologien und fortschrittlicher Bioinformatik entwickeln wir differenzierte, hochintegrierte End-to-End-Lösungen für die Sequenzierung der nächsten Generation, die zu einem Workflow für die Probeneingabe führen.

Diese praktische Rolle konzentriert sich auf die Lösung mechanischer Herausforderungen für unsere Plattformen der nächsten Generation. Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, elektromechanische, pneumatische, thermische, fluidische und verbrauchbare Lösungen zu konzipieren, zu entwerfen, zu bauen und zu testen, die Systemleistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Langlebigkeit gewährleisten. Als technische Autorität werden Sie Innovationen vorantreiben und Lösungen für neuartige DNA-Sequenzierung und Automatisierungsherausforderungen definieren.

Die Chancen und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Sie werden die Forschung und Entwicklung verschiedener Subsysteme vorantreiben, darunter elektromechanische, pneumatische, thermische, fluidische und Verbrauchstechnologien.

• Sie arbeiten mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um kritische technische Schnittstellen zu definieren und zu verwalten.

• Sie besitzen Subsysteme durch Verifizierung, Integration und Fehlersuche und arbeiten eng mit Systemintegrationsingenieuren zusammen.

• Sie führen funktionsübergreifende Design-Reviews durch, um die Ausrichtung zu fördern und technische Kompromisse zu lösen.

• Sie verwalten die Lieferzeiten und tragen zur Gesamtprojektplanung bei.

• Sie erstellen und pflegen eine umfassende Designdokumentation.

• Sie werden zur technischen Strategie beitragen und datengesteuerte Empfehlungen zu Architektur und Technologie geben.

• Sie präsentieren den Stakeholdern Fortschritt, Daten und Design-Kompromisse und artikulieren die Auswirkungen von Engineering-Entscheidungen.

Dies ist eine Position vor Ort mit Sitz in Santa Clara, CA.
Umzugsvorteile werden für diese Rolle nicht angeboten.

Wer Du bist:
(erforderlich)

• Sie haben einen Abschluss in Maschinenbau oder eine eng verwandte Disziplin mit einschlägiger Branchenerfahrung (mindestens 7+ Jahre für einen Bachelor, 4+ Jahre für einen Master oder 3+ Jahre für einen PhD).

• Sie haben praktische Erfahrung beim Entwerfen, Entwickeln und Testen komplexer elektromechanischer, pneumatischer, thermischer oder fluidischer Baugruppen gezeigt, vorzugsweise für die Biowissenschaft oder diagnostische Instrumente.

• Sie sind sehr kompetent in SolidWorks für detailliertes Design und die Erstellung von Fertigungszeichnungen.

• Sie haben Erfahrung mit dem Entwerfen von Komponenten für eine Vielzahl von Herstellungsprozessen (z. B. Bearbeitung, Blech, Spritzgießen, 3D-Druck) nachgewiesen.

• Sie haben gezeigt, Problemlösung Fähigkeiten; Fähigkeit zur Fehlersuche komplexe Hardware, Software und Chemie-Schnittstellen.

• Sie beherrschen Werkzeugmaschinen, Messgeräte und Rapid Prototyping (z. B. CNC-Fräsen / Drehmaschinen, Laserschneider, 3D-Drucker).

• Sie haben Erfahrung in der Lösung einzigartiger oder unvorhersehbarer Probleme, die sich auf die von der Organisation festgelegten Ziele auswirken könnten

Bevorzugt:

• Sie haben einen fortgeschrittenen Abschluss in Maschinenbauingenieur oder eine eng verwandte Disziplin

• Sie haben ein hohes Maß an Kenntnissen mit Python für Gerätesteuerung und Datenerfassung.

• Sie haben Erfahrung mit Simulationswerkzeugen (CFD, FEA), um Designentscheidungen zu leiten.

• Sie haben Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Next-Generation-Sequenzierung (NGS) oder Genomikinstrumentierung.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Chez Roche, nous travaillons à rendre le séquençage de la prochaine génération assez simple et accessible pour une utilisation courante. En accélérant la recherche clinique, en rationalisant les workflows et en élargissant les menus d'essais, nous élargissons l'accès aux données génomiques et abaissons les obstacles à l'adoption. Des outils d'isolement et de préparation d'échantillons robustes aux nouvelles technologies de séquençage et à la bioinformatique avancée, nous développons des solutions de bout en bout différenciées et hautement intégrées pour le séquençage de prochaine génération, ce qui donne lieu à un échantillon dans le flux de travail.

Ce rôle pratique se concentre sur la résolution des défis mécaniques pour nos plateformes de nouvelle génération. Vous serez responsable de conceptualiser, concevoir, construire et tester des solutions électromécaniques, pneumatiques, thermiques, fluides et consommables qui garantissent la performance, la fiabilité et la longévité du système. En tant qu'autorité technique, vous piloterez l'innovation et définirez des solutions pour les nouveaux défis de séquençage et d'automatisation de l'ADN.

La possibilité et les responsabilités :

• Vous dirigerez la recherche et le développement de divers sous-systèmes, comprenant des technologies électromécaniques, pneumatiques, thermiques, fluides et consommables.

• Vous posséderez des sous-systèmes grâce à la vérification, l'intégration et le dépannage, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs de l'intégration du système.

• Vous gérerez les délais d'exécution de la conception et contribuerez à la planification globale du projet.

• Vous allez créer et maintenir une documentation de conception complète.

• Vous contribuerez à la stratégie technique en fournissant des recommandations axées sur les données sur l'architecture et la technologie.

• Vous présenterez les progrès, les données et les compromis de conception aux intervenants, en articulant clairement l'impact des décisions d'ingénierie.

C'est une position sur place basée à Santa Clara, CA.
Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas offertes pour ce rôle.

Qui vous êtes :
(Requis)

• Vous avez un diplôme en génie mécanique, ou une discipline étroitement liée, avec une expérience pertinente de l'industrie (minimum 7+ ans pour un baccalauréat, 4+ ans pour une maîtrise, ou 3+ ans pour un doctorat).

• Vous avez démontré votre expérience pratique en concevant, développant et testant des assemblages électromécaniques, pneumatiques, thermiques ou fluidiques complexes, de préférence pour les sciences de la vie ou les instruments de diagnostic.

• Vous êtes très compétent en SolidWorks pour la conception détaillée et la création de dessins de fabrication.

• Vous avez démontré votre expérience dans la conception de composants pour une variété de procédés de fabrication (par exemple, usinage, tôle, moulage par injection, impression 3D).

• Vous avez démontré des compétences en résolution de problèmes; la capacité de dépanner des interfaces matérielles, logicielles et chimiques complexes.

• Vous êtes compétent avec les outils d'atelier de machines, l'équipement de mesure et le prototypage rapide (p. ex., les moulins/lattes CNC, les coupeurs laser, les imprimantes 3D).

• Vous avez l'expérience de résoudre des problèmes uniques ou imprévisibles qui pourraient avoir une incidence sur les buts et objectifs fixés par l'organisation

Préféré:

• Vous avez un diplôme avancé en ingénieur mécanique, ou une discipline étroitement liée

• Vous avez un haut niveau de compétence avec Python pour le contrôle des appareils et l'acquisition de données.

• Vous avez de l'expérience avec les outils de simulation (CFD, FEA) pour guider les décisions de conception.

• Vous avez l'expérience de développer des séquençages de prochaine génération (NGS) ou des instruments génomiques.

jobs.title: Senior Bioinformatics Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity
As a Bioinformatics Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and implement features for the bioinformatics components and pipelines that are used in Roche Sequencing products. You will be part of a team working in a fast paced environment, developing cutting-edge, distributed, scale-out Next-Generation Sequencing data analysis software to ensure the highest possible software quality for gene sequencing research and disease diagnostics.

Work closely with experimental teams to understand their requirements and translate them into functional software, implementing those solutions directly within an existing research code repository. Collaborate with research and algorithm experts, accelerating bioinformatics techniques using GPU hardware. You will navigate and contribute to a large code base, applying your knowledge of advanced bioinformatics techniques (such as alignment methods and other sequence analysis algorithms) and neural nets to continuously improve the quality and feature sets of the software products.

Who You Are

• B.S. or M.S. or PhD in Computational Biology or Bioinformatics or Biomedical engineering or related field.

• 5+ years of experience in working with NGS data and data analysis pipelines.

• Strong expertise in Python, including numerical computing and data science libraries, alongside familiarity with C/C++.

• Demonstrated experience developing, maintaining, or refactoring within a large code base or existing research code repository.

• Understanding of core bioinformatics techniques, including alignment methods, as well as neural nets.

• Experience collaborating with experimental teams to gather requirements and implement technical solutions.

• Thrives in a fast paced environment, showing a self-driven, detail oriented, and analytical approach with a proven ability to learn quickly.

• Proficiency in GCP, AWS and Linux Shell environments.

• Be a team player, customer focused with excellent interdisciplinary collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Practical experience utilizing GPU-accelerated C/C++ libraries or knowledge of GPUs and CUDA.

• Experience with CI/CD tools and concepts.

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $145,300-$269,800 . Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.
Benefits

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
L'opportunità
In qualità di Ingegnere di Software Bioinformatics, disegnare, sviluppare e implementare funzionalità per i componenti e le pipeline di bioinformatica utilizzati nei prodotti Roche Sequencing. Sarete parte di un team che lavora in un ambiente veloce, sviluppando all'avanguardia, distribuito, scala-out software di analisi di dati di Sequencing Next-Generation per garantire la più alta qualità software possibile per la sequenziazione genica della ricerca e la diagnostica delle malattie.

Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team sperimentali per comprendere i loro requisiti e tradurli in software funzionale, implementando tali soluzioni direttamente all'interno di un repository di codice di ricerca esistente. Collabora con esperti di ricerca e algoritmi, accelerando le tecniche di bioinformatica utilizzando l'hardware GPU. Potrai navigare e contribuire a una grande base di codice, applicando la tua conoscenza di tecniche di bioinformatica avanzate (come metodi di allineamento e altri algoritmi di analisi delle sequenze) e reti neurali per migliorare continuamente la qualità e le caratteristiche dei prodotti software.

Chi sei

• B.S. o M.S. o PhD in Biologia Computazionale o Bioinformatica o ingegneria biomedica o campo correlato.

• 5+ anni di esperienza nel lavoro con data e data analysis pipeline NGS.

• Forte competenza in Python, tra cui le librerie di calcolo numerico e di scienza dei dati, insieme alla familiarità con C/C++.

• Esperienza dimostrata nello sviluppo, nel mantenimento o nella ristrutturazione di una grande base di codice o di un repository di codice di ricerca esistente.

• Comprensione delle tecniche di bioinformatica di base, compresi i metodi di allineamento, così come le reti neurali.

• Esperienza di collaborazione con team sperimentali per raccogliere requisiti e implementare soluzioni tecniche.

• Thrives in un ambiente veloce, mostrando un approccio auto-driven, orientato ai dettagli e analitico con una comprovata capacità di imparare rapidamente.

• Proficienza negli ambienti GCP, AWS e Linux Shell.

• Sii un giocatore di squadra, il cliente si è concentrato con eccellenti capacità di collaborazione interdisciplinare.

Qualificazioni predestinate

• Esperienza pratica che utilizza librerie C/C++ accelerate dalla GPU e CUDA.

• Esperienza con strumenti e concetti CI/CD.

I vantaggi di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa pubblicazione.

L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione in base alla posizione primaria della California è di $145,300-$269,800 . La retribuzione effettiva sarà determinata in base all'esperienza, alle qualifiche, alla posizione geografica e ad altri fattori legati al lavoro consentiti dalla legge. Un bonus annuale discrezionale può essere disponibile in base alle prestazioni individuali e aziendali. Questa posizione si qualifica anche per i benefici dettagliati al link sottostante.
Vantaggi

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. È la nostra politica e la nostra pratica di impiegare, promuovere e trattare in altro modo tutti i dipendenti e i richiedenti sulla base del merito, delle qualifiche e delle competenze. La politica della società vieta la discriminazione illecita

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Section Head, Medicinal Chemistry
The Medicinal Chemistry Department at the China Innovation Center of Roche (CICoR) in Shanghai is a community of drug hunters specializing in synthetic chemistry, medicinal chemistry, and chemical biology. In partnership with our disease therapeutic areas and technology functions, our mission is to translate disease-relevant biological hypotheses into innovative small molecule therapeutics for indications with high unmet medical needs, including oncological, autoimmune, inflammatory, cardiovascular, and metabolic disorders.
• We offer a unique platform to impact small molecule drug discovery through your combined scientific acumen and leadership capabilities.

Key
• Responsibilities
In this role, you will:
● Lead internal and external chemistry teams (CRO) on small molecule drug discovery programs, leveraging advanced technologies to establish SAR and SPR profiles for potency, DMPK, and safety.
● Formulate comprehensive project strategies—including target compound profile, hit generation approaches, screening cascade, decision matrices, and patent strategies—collaborating within cross-functional teams and aligning with site-wide disease and technology strategies.
● Steer drug discovery campaigns and facilitate vital go/no-go decisions for project progression, prioritization, or termination from hit generation through to clinical candidate nomination.
● Foster robust collaborative networks with project team peers to successfully advance candidate molecules, acting decisively and adaptively in a dynamic setting.
● Take on the development and execution of new diseases or technological areas as assigned.
● Provide subject matter expertise to evaluate novel target or technology opportunities and support due diligence initiatives when requested.
● Serve as Section Head, directing a group of highly skilled medicinal chemists (minimum of 8, primarily PhDs) for their performance and career development, reporting directly to the Head of Medicinal Chemistry at CICoR.

• Profile
We are seeking an experienced medicinal chemist holding a PhD in organic chemistry, medicinal chemistry or chemical biology with over 8 years of professional experience within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, or equivalent academic tenure.

● Prendere lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione di nuove malattie o aree tecnologiche assegnate.
● Fornire competenze di materia soggetto per valutare nuove opportunità di obiettivo o tecnologia e sostenere le iniziative di due diligence quando richiesto.
● Servire come capo sezione, dirigere un gruppo di chimici medicinali altamente qualificati (minimo di 8, principalmente PhD) per la loro performance e lo sviluppo di carriera, segnalando direttamente al capo della chimica medica presso CICoR.

Candidato
• Profilo
Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto farmacista che tiene un dottorato in chimica organica, chimica medica o biologia chimica con oltre 8 anni di esperienza professionale all'interno dell'industria farmaceutica o biotecnologia, o equivalente tenore accademico.
Obbligo

● Eccellente capacità di risoluzione dei problemi, con la passione per la coltivazione di soluzioni creative e innovative per raggiungere obiettivi di progetto e impatto sull'azionamento.
● Agilità di apprendimento elevata e uno stile operativo flessibile, con la capacità di costruire ambienti di team interdipendenti e collaborativi che avanzano programmi con urgenza.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Sektionsleiter, Medizinische Chemie
Die Abteilung für Medizinische Chemie am China Innovation Center of Roche (CICoR) in Shanghai ist eine Gemeinschaft von Drogenjägern, die sich auf synthetische Chemie, medizinische Chemie und chemische Biologie spezialisiert haben. In Partnerschaft mit unseren krankheitstherapeutischen Bereichen und Technologiefunktionen ist es unsere Mission, krankheitsrelevante biologische Hypothesen in innovative niedermolekulare Therapeutika für Indikationen mit hohem ungedecktem medizinischen Bedarf zu übersetzen, einschließlich onkologischer, autoimmuner, entzündlicher, kardiovaskulärer und metabolischer Störungen.
• Wir bieten eine einzigartige Plattform, um die Entdeckung von niedermolekularen Medikamenten durch Ihren kombinierten wissenschaftlichen Scharfsinn und Ihre Führungsqualitäten zu beeinflussen.

Schlüssel
• Zuständigkeiten
In dieser Rolle werden Sie:
Führen Sie interne und externe Chemieteams (CRO) bei Programmen zur Wirkstoffforschung für kleine Moleküle und nutzen Sie fortschrittliche Technologien, um SAR- und SPR-Profile für Potenz, DMPK und Sicherheit zu erstellen.
● Formulieren Sie umfassende Projektstrategien - einschließlich Zielverbindungsprofil, Hit-Generierungsansätze, Screening-Kaskade, Entscheidungsmatrizen und Patentstrategien - und arbeiten Sie in funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen und richten Sie sich an standortweiten Krankheits- und Technologiestrategien aus.
● Steuerung von Wirkstoffforschungskampagnen und Erleichterung wichtiger Go / No-Go-Entscheidungen für Projektfortschritt, Priorisierung oder Beendigung von der Hit-Generation bis zur klinischen Kandidatennominierung.
● Förderung robuster Kooperationsnetzwerke mit Kollegen aus dem Projektteam, um Kandidatenmoleküle erfolgreich voranzubringen und in einem dynamischen Umfeld entscheidend und adaptiv zu handeln.
● Übernehmen Sie die Entwicklung und Ausführung neuer Krankheiten oder technologischer Bereiche wie zugewiesen.
● Bereitstellung von Fachkenntnissen zur Bewertung neuer Ziel- oder Technologiemöglichkeiten und Unterstützung von Due-Diligence-Initiativen auf Anfrage.
● Dienen Sie als Abteilungsleiter und leiten Sie eine Gruppe von hochqualifizierten medizinischen Chemikern (mindestens 8, hauptsächlich PhDs) für ihre Leistung und Karriereentwicklung und berichten Sie direkt an den Leiter der medizinischen Chemie am CICoR.

Kandidat
• Profil
Wir suchen einen erfahrenen medizinischen Chemiker mit einem Doktortitel in organischer Chemie, medizinischer Chemie oder chemischer Biologie mit über 8 Jahren Berufserfahrung in der Pharma- oder Biotech-Industrie oder einer gleichwertigen akademischen Amtszeit.
erforderlich
• Qualifikationen
Sie besitzen:
● Ein umfassendes Verständnis der Methoden und wissenschaftlichen Disziplinen der Wirkstoffforschung für kleine Moleküle, ergänzt durch fundierte Kenntnisse in spezifischen therapeutischen Bereichen (z. B. onkologische, Autoimmun-, Entzündungs-, Herz-Kreislauf- oder Stoffwechselerkrankungen) und Technologieplattformen (z. B. kovalente Medikamente, induzierte Nähe, ADCs).
● Eine nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Erreichung von Meilensteinen von der Zielvalidierung bis hin zur klinischen Kandidatenauswahl für ein First-in-Class (FIC)-Ziel, bei der kritische Projektentscheidungen mit einem ausgewogenen Verhältnis von wissenschaftlicher Strenge und sofortiger Ausführung verwaltet werden.
● Ausgezeichnete Problemlösungsfähigkeiten, mit einer Leidenschaft für die Kultivierung kreativer, innovativer Lösungen, um die Projektziele zu erreichen und die Wirkung zu steigern.
Hohe Lernflexibilität und ein flexibler Betriebsstil, mit der Fähigkeit, voneinander abhängige, kollaborative Teamumgebungen aufzubauen, die Programme dringend voranbringen.
Herausragende Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, die es Ihnen ermöglichen, Stakeholder auf allen Ebenen zu beeinflussen, inklusive zu arbeiten und Programmstrategien, Risiken und Minderungsmaßnahmen für Führungs- und Führungsgremien effektiv zu präsentieren.
● Die Fähigkeit, einzelne Projekte mit einer breiteren Portfoliostrategie auszurichten, Dämon
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Chef de section, Chimie médicale
Le département de chimie médicinale du China Innovation Center de Roche (CICoR) de Shanghai est une communauté de chasseurs de drogues spécialisée dans la chimie synthétique, la chimie médicinale et la biologie chimique. En partenariat avec nos domaines thérapeutiques de la maladie et nos fonctions technologiques, notre mission est de traduire les hypothèses biologiques de la maladie en thérapies de petite molécule innovantes pour les indications avec des besoins médicaux élevés non satisfaits, y compris les troubles oncologiques, auto-immuns, inflammatoires, cardiovasculaires et métaboliques.
• Nous offrons une plate-forme unique pour impacter la découverte de médicaments à petites molécules grâce à votre acuité scientifique combinée et vos capacités de leadership.

Clé
• Responsabilités
Dans ce rôle, vous :
● Diriger les équipes de chimie interne et externe (ORC) sur les programmes de découverte de médicaments à petites molécules, en tirant parti des technologies de pointe pour établir des profils de R-S et de RPS pour l'activité, le DMPK et l'innocuité.
● Formuler des stratégies globales de projet, y compris le profil des composés cibles, les approches de génération de succès, la cascade de dépistage, les matrices de décision et les stratégies de brevets, en collaboration avec les équipes interfonctionnelles et en alignement avec les stratégies de lutte contre les maladies et la technologie à l'échelle du site.
● Mener des campagnes de découverte de médicaments et faciliter la prise de décisions vitales pour la progression du projet, l'établissement des priorités ou l'abandon du projet, de la génération à la nomination de candidats cliniques.
● Favoriser l'établissement de solides réseaux de collaboration avec les pairs de l'équipe de projet pour faire progresser les molécules candidates, en agissant de façon décisive et adaptative dans un contexte dynamique.
● S'occuper de la mise au point et de l'exécution de nouvelles maladies ou de nouveaux domaines technologiques.
● Fournir une expertise en la matière pour évaluer de nouvelles cibles ou possibilités technologiques et appuyer les initiatives de diligence raisonnable sur demande.
● Diriger un groupe de chimistes médicinaux hautement qualifiés (minimum de 8, principalement des doctorats) pour leur rendement et leur perfectionnement professionnel, relevant directement du chef de la chimie médicinale au CICoR.

Candidat
• Profil
Nous recherchons un chimiste médicinal expérimenté titulaire d'un doctorat en chimie organique, chimie médicinale ou biologie chimique avec plus de 8 ans d'expérience professionnelle au sein de l'industrie pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique, ou un mandat universitaire équivalent.
Requis
• Compétences
Vous possédez :
● Une compréhension globale des méthodes de découverte de médicaments à petites molécules et des disciplines scientifiques, complétée par des connaissances approfondies dans des domaines thérapeutiques spécifiques (p. ex. maladies oncologiques, auto-immunes, inflammatoires, cardiovasculaires ou métaboliques) et des plateformes technologiques (p. ex. médicaments covalents, proximité induite, CAD).
● Une expérience éprouvée de la réalisation d'étapes allant de la validation de la cible jusqu'à la sélection de candidats cliniques pour une cible de première classe, la gestion des décisions critiques de projet avec un équilibre de rigueur scientifique et l'exécution rapide.
● Excellentes capacités de résolution de problèmes, avec une passion pour cultiver des solutions créatives et innovantes pour atteindre les objectifs du projet et stimuler l'impact.
● Une grande agilité d'apprentissage et un style opérationnel souple, avec la capacité de créer des environnements d'équipe interdépendants et collaboratifs qui font progresser les programmes avec urgence.
● Compétences exceptionnelles en communication et en relations interpersonnelles, vous permettant d'influencer les intervenants à tous les niveaux, de travailler de façon inclusive et de présenter efficacement des stratégies de programme, des risques et des mesures d'atténuation aux organismes de leadership et de gouvernance.
● La capacité d'aligner les projets individuels sur une stratégie de portefeuille plus large, démon

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate cloud-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.

As a Cloud Security Engineer, you will be part of the Information Systems Security team at Roche. You will join a global team of 40 engineers with expertise spanning Cloud Security, Endpoint Protection, Network Security, and Remote Access Management. This is an incredible opportunity to jumpstart your career, learn from senior experts, and grow your skills in a world-class enterprise security environment.

In the role of Cloud Security Engineer, you will integrate into the Information Systems Security division at Roche. You will be part of a global collective of 40 technical specialists whose proficiency encompasses Cloud Security, Endpoint Protection, Network Security, and Remote Access Management. This position offers a premier chance to launch your professional journey, gaining insights from seasoned experts and refining your capabilities within a sophisticated enterprise security framework

• Drive through all stages of the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and discussions with the Product Owner/Customer to the implementation and deployment of the security features, controls as code, and implement security policies and remediation processes using CI/CD.

​
3. Operational Excellence & Visibility

• Work with the Cloud SecDevops Engineering team to collaborate with stakeholders, customers, and external teams to improve Security posture of the Platform.

• Be part of the technical solution team focusing on maintaining service since they are live by measuring and monitoring availability and overall system health and improving the reliability of the IT Infrastructure

​

• Si concentra sulle priorità, pietre miliari e consegnabili secondo la direzione del team di gestione dei prodotti e dei requisiti di sicurezza.

​
3. Eccellenza operativa e visibilità

• Lavorare con il team Cloud SecDevops Engineering per collaborare con stakeholder, clienti e team esterni per migliorare la postura di sicurezza della piattaforma.

• Partecipa al team di soluzioni tecniche che si concentra sul mantenimento del servizio in quanto sono live misurando e monitorando la disponibilità e la salute generale del sistema e migliorando l'affidabilità delle Infrastrutture IT

Qualificazione
Istruzione / Esperienza

• Sfondo educativo: laurea in Informatica, sicurezza dell'informazione, tecnologia dell'informazione, o una disciplina tecnica correlata, o equivalente esperienza di base (ad esempio, programmi intensivi di formazione cloud/security).

• Esperienza professionale: 1+ anni di esperienza fondamentale nella sicurezza informatica, nell'amministrazione cloud o nello sviluppo del software (i forti progetti accademici o stage saranno anche considerati).

• Metodologia Agile: Esperienza o familiarità lavorando all'interno di una struttura del team Agile/Scrum.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Network Security product makes Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through actionable, policy-driven processes. The capabilities we provide enable Roche to identify, inspect, and mitigate cloud-based risks, manage regulatory compliance, and oversee egress/ingress traffic across all layers. Our solutions are primarily instantiated through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. We work closely with Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to provide enterprise visibility into Roche’s network security posture.

As a Cloud Security Engineer, you will be part of the Information Systems Security team at Roche. You will join a global team of 40 engineers with expertise spanning Cloud Security, Endpoint Protection, Network Security, and Remote Access Management. This is an incredible opportunity to jumpstart your career, learn from senior experts, and grow your skills in a world-class enterprise security environment.
Job description

In the role of Cloud Security Engineer, you will integrate into the Information Systems Security division at Roche. You will be part of a global collective of 40 technical specialists whose proficiency encompasses Cloud Security, Endpoint Protection, Network Security, and Remote Access Management. This position offers a premier chance to launch your professional journey, gaining insights from seasoned experts and refining your capabilities within a sophisticated enterprise security framework

Responsibilities

1. Architecture & Design

• Collaboratively, develop and improve the security features and engineering capabilities for the Roche Cloud Platform (automatic deployment pipelines, secure controls and guardrails, abstraction layers to ease Cloud adoption, delegation capabilities to enable self-service functionality to end customers, etc.).

• Contribute, based on Security Epics, to the Cloud SecDevOps Engineering team on technical implementations and decisions and provide software security architecture and insight for propositions, product designs and service enhancements.

​
2. Product Lifecycle & Evolution

• Drive through all stages of the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and discussions with the Product Owner/Customer to the implementation and deployment of the security features, controls as code, and implement security policies and remediation processes using CI/CD.

• Focuses on priorities, milestones and deliverables as per direction of the product management team and Security Requirements.

​
3. Operational Excellence & Visibility

• Work with the Cloud SecDevops Engineering team to collaborate with stakeholders, customers, and external teams to improve Security posture of the Platform.

• Be part of the technical solution team focusing on maintaining service since they are live by measuring and monitoring availability and overall system health and improving the reliability of the IT Infrastructure

Qualification
Education / Experience

• Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent foundational experience (e.g., intensive cloud/security training programs).

• Professional Experience: 1+ years of foundational experience in IT security, cloud administration, or software development (strong academic projects or internships will also be considered).

• Agile Methodology: Experience or familiarity working within an Agile/Scrum team structure.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position
Please note that this role offers a fixed-term contract (up until Aug 31, 2027).

The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity.

As a Finance and Accounting Team Lead you will coordinate complete, stringent and timely finance and accounting tasks the department's scope covers and proactively seek opportunities to allow more effective cooperation between teams / team members regardless of country / functional assignments.

In this role, you will focus on:

• Leading people management activities including goal setting, recruitment, and performance evaluation

• Ensuring the service quality in the responsible area

• Proactively and constructively managing change initiatives

• Fostering relationships with stakeholders in the respective business area

• Providing and organizing assistance to other teams or team members facing workload or expertise challenges

• Fostering a collaborative team environment where everyone thrives

Who you are
We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have:

• University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline

• ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage

• 5+ years of working experience in related field

• Proficiency in relevant accounting software preferably SAP and MS office tools

• Strong communication skills, expressing ideas and expectations in a clear and concise manner

• Ability to work comfortably in a dynamic, changing and growing environment

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average. We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Si prega di notare che questo ruolo offre un contratto a tempo determinato (fino al 31 agosto 2027).

Il Dipartimento Record to Report (R2R) è un'organizzazione globale di oltre 650 professionisti esperti di finanza che lavorano insieme per fornire servizi finanziari e soluzioni per Roche in tutta la regione EMEA. I nostri servizi riguardano la gestione finanziaria, la chiusura di fine periodo, la contabilità di capitale e di locazione, il credito e i crediti, la finanza di produzione e la rendicontazione divisionale, assicurando la conformità a 263 entità di reporting in 96 paesi con gli standard contabili (IFRS, GAAP) e fornendo garanzia di integrità finanziaria.

Come capo di un team di finanza e contabilità si coordinano i compiti completi, rigorosi e tempestivi di finanza e contabilità il campo di applicazione del dipartimento copre e proattivamente cercare opportunità per consentire una cooperazione più efficace tra team / membri del team indipendentemente dal paese / compiti funzionali.

In questo ruolo, ti concentrerai su:

• Leader attività di gestione delle persone tra cui l'impostazione degli obiettivi, il reclutamento e la valutazione delle prestazioni

• Garantire la qualità del servizio nell'area responsabile

• Proattivamente e costruttivamente gestendo iniziative di cambiamento

• Promuovere i rapporti con le parti interessate nella rispettiva area aziendale

• Fornire e organizzare assistenza ad altre squadre o membri del team che affrontano le sfide del carico di lavoro o delle competenze

• Promuovere un ambiente di team collaborativo dove tutti prosperano

Chi sei
Stiamo cercando qualcuno che è auto motivato, davvero appassionato del suo lavoro e capisce che fornire un servizio di alta qualità è fondamentale per l'organizzazione. Come membro del team ideale siete open-minded, dedicato a fare la differenza e aperto allo sviluppo costante. Inoltre, avete:

• Laurea universitaria, preferibilmente in Finanza / Contabilità disciplina relativa

• ACCA o altre qualifiche professionali contabili saranno un vantaggio aggiunto

• 5+ anni di esperienza lavorativa nel campo relativo

• Proficienza del software di contabilità rilevante preferibilmente SAP e strumenti di ufficio MS

• Forte capacità di comunicazione, esprimendo idee e aspettative in modo chiaro e conciso

• Capacità di lavorare comodamente in un ambiente dinamico, mutevole e in crescita

• Proficienza in inglese

In cambio vi forniamo:

• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.

• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.

• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media. Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.

• Una comunità globale inclusiva, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto focalizzata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità di condividere la tua opinione.

Si prega di leggere la Informativa sulla privacy dei dati per ulteriori informazioni su come gestiamo i vostri dati personali relativi al processo di reclutamento: https://go.roche.com/dpn4candidates

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a

• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die Ideen und Erwartungen klar und prägnant ausdrücken

• Fähigkeit, in einer dynamischen, sich verändernden und wachsenden Umgebung bequem zu arbeiten

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Veuillez noter que ce rôle offre un contrat à durée déterminée (jusqu'au 31 août 2027).

Le département Record to Report (R2R) est une organisation mondiale de plus de 650 professionnels des finances expérimentés qui travaillent ensemble pour fournir des services et des solutions financiers à Roche dans toute la région de l'EMEA. Nos services couvrent la gestion financière, la clôture d'exercices, la comptabilité des immobilisations et des contrats de location-acquisition, les crédits et créances, les finances manufacturières et les rapports divisionnaires, la conformité de 263 entités déclarantes dans 96 pays aux normes comptables (IFRS, GAAP) et l'assurance de l'intégrité financière.

En tant que responsable de l'équipe des finances et de la comptabilité, vous coordonnerez les tâches financières et comptables complètes, rigoureuses et opportunes que couvre le champ d'application du ministère et chercherez de façon proactive des occasions de permettre une coopération plus efficace entre les équipes et les membres de l'équipe, peu importe les affectations de pays ou de fonctions.

Dans ce rôle, vous vous concentrerez sur :

• Diriger les activités de gestion du personnel, y compris l'établissement d'objectifs, le recrutement et l'évaluation du rendement

• Assurer la qualité des services dans le domaine responsable

• Gestion proactive et constructive des initiatives de changement

• Favoriser les relations avec les intervenants dans le secteur d'activité respectif

• Fournir et organiser de l'aide à d'autres équipes ou membres d'équipe confrontés à des problèmes de charge de travail ou d'expertise

• Favoriser un environnement d'équipe collaborative où tout le monde prospère

Qui vous êtes
Nous sommes à la recherche de quelqu'un qui est motivé par lui-même, vraiment passionné par son travail et comprend que la prestation d'un service de haute qualité est cruciale pour l'organisation. En tant que membre idéal de l'équipe, vous êtes ouvert d'esprit, dévoué à faire la différence et ouvert à un développement constant. De plus, vous avez :

• Diplôme universitaire, de préférence en Finance / Comptabilité discipline connexe

• ACCA ou autres qualifications professionnelles en comptabilité seront un avantage supplémentaire

• 5 ans et plus d'expérience professionnelle dans un domaine connexe

• Compétence en logiciels comptables pertinents de préférence SAP et outils de bureau MS

• Fortes compétences en communication, exprimant des idées et des attentes de manière claire et concise

• Capacité de travailler confortablement dans un environnement dynamique, en évolution et en croissance

• Compétence en anglais

En échange, nous vous fournissons:

• Possibilités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage. Nous offrons des possibilités de développement constant, des cours de langues gratuits et de formation, la possibilité d'affectations internationales, des changements de position internes et la possibilité de façonner votre propre carrière.

• Excellents avantages : Forfait salaire et cafétéria compétitif, bonus annuel, Services médicaux privés, Programme d'aide aux employés, All You Can Move Sportpass, occasion de coaching / mentorat, programme de copains, bâtiments d'équipe, fête de vacances.

• Flexibilité : Nous soutenons également la flexibilité pour vous aider à trouver votre équilibre. Le bureau à domicile est généralement disponible (habituellement 2 jours/semaine en moyenne). Nous créons l'opportunité de la liberté dans le travail, où votre vie privée et professionnelle coexistent en harmonie.

• Une communauté mondiale inclusive, où nous apprenons les uns des autres. Chez Roche, nous coopérons, débattons, prenons des décisions, célébrons les succès et nous amusons en équipe. Notre leadership est très concentré sur les gens, créant une culture forte et inclusive, donc vous avez toujours la chance de partager votre opinion.
