Ihre Hauptaufgabe besteht darin, das funktionale "Warum" hinter Geschäftsanforderungen zu erforschen und zu definieren, um sicherzustellen, dass jede technologische Lösung auf einer Grundlage klar abgebildeter Prozesse und validierter organisatorischer Anforderungen basiert.

Dokumentiert und entwickelt die Architektur während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus und richtet sich an der Architekturgemeinschaft für Governance aus. En résolvant des problèmes techniques complexes, en menant d'autres à travers des défis difficiles, en définissant des architectures de référence et en s'adaptant à l'ensemble de la communauté de l'architecture pour la gouvernance, vous assurerez des implémentations robustes du PGI qui apportent une valeur ajoutée à l'organisation. Vous conserverez la vision et la feuille de route pour des solutions multiples, fournirez une supervision technique aux équipes de produits, et évaluerez les nouvelles technologies pour améliorer continuellement les solutions existantes et gérer la dette technique.

Description de la zone

Notre paysage dans le secteur des comptes créditeurs intègre SAP ECC et S/4HANA avec diverses plateformes d'approvisionnement pour soutenir le cycle de vie de la facturation à la paye. Nous assurons un traitement sans faille de la réception des factures et des processus d'approbation financière conformes jusqu'à la livraison réussie des instructions de paiement à la solution du Trésor.
Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la navigation de la transition des environnements hérités vers les normes ERP modernes, assurant la résilience et l'évolutivité de l'intégration au fur et à mesure que nous réaménagerons notre paysage ERP mondial grâce au programme ASPIRE.
Vous servirez d'interface critique pour traduire les exigences opérationnelles en langage technique/informatique. Votre mission principale est d'explorer en profondeur et de définir le « pourquoi » fonctionnel derrière les demandes d'affaires, en veillant à ce que chaque solution technologique soit construite sur une base de processus clairement cartographiés et de besoins organisationnels validés.

L'opportunité

• Portée / (Le leadership du contenu) : Concevoir des solutions qui répondent aux exigences du produit, aux priorités opérationnelles et aux normes d'entreprise dans le contexte de la solution Comptes créditeurs. Gère les exigences non fonctionnelles (NFR) et les exigences d'ajustement. Documente et évolue l'architecture tout au long du cycle de vie du produit et s'harmonise avec la communauté de l'architecture pour la gouvernance. Applique les cadres dans un contexte complexe ou multiple de solution ou de produit.

• Responsabilité/Résoudre les problèmes : Selfs et conduit d'autres à résoudre des problèmes complexes; utilise la pensée analytique sophistiquée pour exercer le jugement et identifier des solutions innovantes. Maintenir la vision, la feuille de route et le paysage actuel de la zone des comptes créditeurs. Évaluer et consulter les répercussions et les dépendances des initiatives sur les capacités, les risques et le contexte d'application. Crée des modèles de données conceptuelles et logiques, des taxonomies, des ontologies et des voies d'intégration pour le produit. Définir et piloter les architectures de référence, les modèles, les NFR et les fonctions de fitness, en veillant à ce que les documents de décision d'architecture (ADR) soient enregistrés et publiés pour plusieurs solutions ou le produit. Incite les tendances technologiques externes et évalue la faisabilité, y compris les évaluations des fournisseurs.

• Gestion des parties prenantes : Communique clairement les concepts difficiles et négocie avec d'autres pour adopter un point de vue différent. Permet le partage de l'information dans le produit complet.

• Impact/Stratégie : Développe et maintient la feuille de route technologique du produit. Fournit une supervision technique, des conseils et des consultations sur des technologies spécifiques aux équipes de produits. Améliorer les solutions existantes, gérer la dette technique,

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Digital Technology (RDT) for People & Culture (P&C) acts as the "Capability Factory" for Roche. We are a team of business-minded technologists who play "offense"—moving beyond supporting systems to architecting a high-performance digital chassis. We aim to amplify human potential by creating a zero-effort, intelligent ecosystem where technology simplifies complexity and empowers every Roche employee to do their best work.

The Workforce area drives Roche’s operational excellence across People, Finance, and Compliance. We manage everything from Payroll and People Relations to the technical architecture for Total Rewards. Our goal is to transform transactional HR into an invisible, zero-effort experience—combining rigorous global compliance with intelligent, automated systems to deliver a stable, high-value service ecosystem.

Disclosure Note: The position is open on a fixed-term basis for 3 years.

The Opportunity

The HRIS Systems Specialist ( Technical Systems Administrator for Payroll, Time, Benefits and other rewards systems) , acts as a hands-on technical problem solver who takes ownership of ambiguous tasks, challenges the status quo, and acts as a technical mentor while fostering strong collaboration across teams. In this role, you will lead small to medium initiatives, prioritize effectively with stakeholders, and maintain a "bigger picture" view of how various components align with the overall strategy.

You will perform deep technical analysis of system and access issues across Roche’s complex network, design and implement technical solutions directly or guide third-party vendor partners and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to execute them. You will analyze complex business problems to recommend automated solutions, identify and implement process improvements, and optimize system configurations for peak efficiency.

Operating across Roche’s multi-payroll matrix—which spans multiple global solutions including Workday Payroll connections, Strada, CHRIS, Ramco, and Deloitte—you will combine technical troubleshooting with strong stakeholder management, stepping into business meetings to turn operational challenges into robust technical fixes. By developing comprehensive test strategies, leading cross-functional teams, and designing system integrations, you will leverage a deep understanding of the broader technical landscape to drive high-quality outcomes.

• Scope & Problem Solving: Takes ownership of ambiguous, unowned tasks and drives small-to-medium initiatives at the project or squad level. Performs hands-on technical analysis on system access, interface failures, and workflow bugs to deliver immediate and long-term technical solutions.

• Stakeholder Management: Prioritizes effectively and maintains a big-picture view to align technical components with broader product goals. Steps into business meetings actively to represent RDT, translate complex operational issues into clear technical choices, and provide actionable solutions.

• Impact & Strategy: Mentors team members, aligns development with global strategy, and actively shares knowledge through talks, internal events, and cross-functional initiatives.

• Complexity & Scale: Operates at the product or site level to shape technical decisions, improve ways of working, and lead cross-functional teams across a complex multi-vendor payroll environment (Workday Payroll connections, Strada, CHRIS, Ramco, Deloitte).

• Business & Technical Expertise: Leverages broad technica

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Roche Digital Technology (RDT) per People & Culture (P&C) funge da "Capability Factory" per Roche. Siamo un team di tecnologi business-minded che giocano "offensiva" - andando oltre i sistemi di supporto per l'architettura di un telaio digitale ad alte prestazioni. Il nostro obiettivo è amplificare il potenziale umano creando un ecosistema intelligente e senza sforzo, in cui la tecnologia semplifica la complessità e consente a ogni dipendente Roche di fare il loro lavoro migliore.

L’area di Workforce guida l’eccellenza operativa di Roche attraverso People, Finance e Compliance. Gestiamo tutto da Payroll e People Relations all'architettura tecnica per Total Rewards. Il nostro obiettivo è quello di trasformare le risorse umane transazionali in un'esperienza invisibile e zero-sforzo, combinando una rigorosa conformità globale con sistemi intelligenti e automatizzati per offrire un ecosistema di servizi stabile e ad alto valore.

Nota di divulgazione: La posizione è aperta su base fissa per 3 anni.

L'opportunità

L'Amministratore dei Sistemi Tecnici per Payroll, Time, Benefits e altri sistemi di premi, prende la proprietà di compiti ambigui, sfida lo status quo e agisce come mentore tecnico, promuovendo una forte collaborazione tra team. In questo ruolo, si porterà piccole a medie iniziative, priorità efficacemente con gli stakeholder, e mantenere una visione "grande immagine" di come i vari componenti si allineano con la strategia generale. Analizzerai problemi di business complessi per consigliare soluzioni automatizzate, identificare e implementare miglioramenti di processo, e ottimizzare le configurazioni di sistema per la massima efficienza. Sviluppando strategie di test complete, leader team interfunzionali, e la progettazione di integrazioni di sistema, si leverà una profonda comprensione del paesaggio tecnico più ampio per guidare risultati di alta qualità.

• Scope & Problem Solving: prende la proprietà di compiti ambigui e distanziati e guida iniziative di piccolo-medio a livello di progetto o squadra. Sfida lo status quo, favorisce la collaborazione e progetta/implementa soluzioni di sistema automatizzate, integrazioni e miglioramenti dei processi.

• Stakeholder Management: Priorizza efficacemente e mantiene una visione di grande immagine per allineare i componenti tecnici con obiettivi di prodotto più ampi.

• Impact & Strategy: i membri del team Mentors, allineano lo sviluppo con la strategia globale, e condividono attivamente la conoscenza attraverso colloqui, eventi interni e iniziative interfunzionali.

• Complessità & Scala: Funziona a livello del prodotto o del sito per modellare le decisioni tecniche, migliorare i modi di lavorare e guidare squadre interfunzionali.

• Business & Technical Expertise: Leverages fornisce una vasta conoscenza tecnica per guidare l'innovazione mantenendo alta qualità ingegneristica.

• Responsabilità giornaliere: Supporta e ottimizza i sistemi di ricompensa attraverso analisi di processo, implementazione dell'interfaccia, test/QA, gestione degli incidenti, configurazione e consulenza tecnica.

Chi sei

• Iniziativa & Leadership: Proven track record di possedere compiti ambigui, guidando progetti di piccola a media, e leader team interfunzionali per risolvere problemi complessi.

• Strategia tecnica & Esecuzione: profonda conoscenza del panorama tecnico più ampio, con competenze nella progettazione di soluzioni automatizzate, integrazioni di sistema e configurazioni ottimizzate.

• Problem Solving & QA: Forte capacità analitiche per semplificare i processi aziendali, sfidare lo status quo e sviluppare strategie e piani di test completi.

• Mentorship & Collaboration: Esperienza che agisce come mentore tecnico, guidando eventi di condivisione della conoscenza interna, e navigati

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Roche Digital Technology (RDT) for People & Culture (P&C) fungiert als "Capability Factory" für Roche. Wir sind ein Team von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die "Offense" spielen - über unterstützende Systeme hinaus zu einem leistungsstarken digitalen Chassis. Unser Ziel ist es, das menschliche Potenzial zu steigern, indem wir ein intelligentes Ökosystem schaffen, in dem Technologie die Komplexität vereinfacht und es jedem Roche-Mitarbeiter ermöglicht, seine beste Arbeit zu leisten.

Der Bereich Workforce treibt Roches operative Exzellenz in den Bereichen People, Finance und Compliance voran. Wir verwalten alles von Payroll und People Relations bis hin zur technischen Architektur für Total Rewards. Unser Ziel ist es, transaktionales HR in eine unsichtbare Erfahrung ohne Anstrengung zu verwandeln - eine Kombination aus strenger globaler Compliance mit intelligenten, automatisierten Systemen, um ein stabiles, hochwertiges Service-Ökosystem zu liefern.

Disclosure Note: Die Position ist auf einer befristeten Basis für 3 Jahre offen.

Die Chance

Der Technical Systems Administrator für Payroll-, Time-, Benefits- und andere Belohnungssysteme übernimmt die Verantwortung für mehrdeutige Aufgaben, fordert den Status quo heraus und fungiert als technischer Mentor, während er eine starke Zusammenarbeit zwischen den Teams fördert. In dieser Rolle leiten Sie kleine bis mittlere Initiativen, priorisieren effektiv mit den Stakeholdern und behalten ein "größeres Bild" darüber, wie verschiedene Komponenten mit der Gesamtstrategie übereinstimmen. Sie analysieren komplexe Geschäftsprobleme, um automatisierte Lösungen zu empfehlen, Prozessverbesserungen zu identifizieren und zu implementieren und Systemkonfigurationen für maximale Effizienz zu optimieren. Durch die Entwicklung umfassender Teststrategien, die Leitung funktionsübergreifender Teams und die Gestaltung von Systemintegrationen nutzen Sie ein tiefes Verständnis der breiteren technischen Landschaft, um qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

• Scope & Problemlösung: Übernimmt die Verantwortung für mehrdeutige, uneigennützige Aufgaben und treibt kleine bis mittlere Initiativen auf Projekt- oder Squad-Ebene voran. Fordert den Status quo heraus, fördert die Zusammenarbeit und entwickelt/implementiert automatisierte Systemlösungen, Integrationen und Prozessverbesserungen.

• Stakeholder Management: Priorisiert effektiv und behält eine große Sicht, um technische Komponenten mit breiteren Produktzielen auszurichten.

• Impact & Strategy: Mentoring der Teammitglieder, richtet die Entwicklung an der globalen Strategie aus und teilt ihr Wissen aktiv durch Vorträge, interne Veranstaltungen und funktionsübergreifende Initiativen.

• Komplexität & Skalierung: Funktioniert auf Produkt- oder Standortebene, um technische Entscheidungen zu treffen, Arbeitsweisen zu verbessern und funktionsübergreifende Teams zu leiten.

• Business & Technical Expertise: Nutzen Sie breites technisches Wissen, um Innovationen voranzutreiben und gleichzeitig eine hohe technische Qualität zu gewährleisten.

• Tägliche Verantwortlichkeiten: Unterstützt und optimiert Belohnungssysteme durch Prozessanalyse, Schnittstellenimplementierung, Testen/QA, Incident Management, Konfiguration und technische Beratung.

Wer du bist

• Initiative & Leadership: Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei mehrdeutigen Aufgaben, der Förderung kleiner bis mittlerer Projekte und der Leitung funktionsübergreifender Teams zur Lösung komplexer Probleme.

• Technische Strategie & Ausführung: Tiefes Wissen über die breitere technische Landschaft, mit Know-how in der Entwicklung automatisierter Lösungen, Systemintegrationen und optimierten Konfigurationen.

• Problemlösung & QA: Starke analytische Fähigkeiten, um Geschäftsprozesse zu rationalisieren, den Status quo in Frage zu stellen und umfassende Teststrategien und -pläne zu entwickeln.

• Mentoring & Collaboration: Erfahrung als technischer Mentor, Antrieb interner Wissensaustauschveranstaltungen und Navigati

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
La technologie numérique Roche (RDT) pour les personnes et la culture (P&C) agit comme « usine de capacité » pour Roche. Nous sommes une équipe de technologues d'affaires qui jouent "offense" – allant au-delà des systèmes de support à l'architecture d'un châssis numérique haute performance. Nous visons à amplifier le potentiel humain en créant un écosystème intelligent et sans effort où la technologie simplifie la complexité et habilite chaque employé de Roche à faire son meilleur travail.

Le secteur de la main-d'oeuvre stimule l'excellence opérationnelle de Roche dans les secteurs des personnes, des finances et de la conformité. Nous gérons tout de la paie et des relations humaines à l'architecture technique de Total Rewards. Notre objectif est de transformer les RH transactionnelles en une expérience invisible et sans effort, combinant une conformité mondiale rigoureuse avec des systèmes intelligents et automatisés pour fournir un écosystème de service stable et de grande valeur.

Note de divulgation : Le poste est ouvert à durée déterminée pendant trois ans.

L'opportunité

L'administrateur des systèmes techniques pour la paie, le temps, les avantages et d'autres systèmes de récompenses, s'approprie des tâches ambiguës, conteste le statu quo et agit comme mentor technique tout en favorisant une collaboration solide entre les équipes. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez des initiatives de petite à moyenne taille, vous prioriserez efficacement les intervenants et vous garderez une vue d'ensemble de la façon dont les divers éléments s'harmonisent avec la stratégie globale. Vous analyserez des problèmes d'affaires complexes pour recommander des solutions automatisées, identifier et mettre en œuvre des améliorations de processus, et optimiser les configurations du système pour une efficacité maximale. En élaborant des stratégies d'essai exhaustives, en dirigeant des équipes interfonctionnelles et en concevant des intégrations de systèmes, vous tirerez profit d'une compréhension approfondie du paysage technique plus large pour obtenir des résultats de haute qualité.

• Portée et résolution des problèmes : prend en charge des tâches ambiguës et non détenues et conduit des initiatives petites à moyennes au niveau du projet ou de l'équipe. Défis du statu quo, favorise la collaboration, et conçoit et met en oeuvre des solutions de systèmes automatisés, des intégrations et des améliorations de processus.

• Gestion des intervenants : Privilégier efficacement et maintenir une vue d'ensemble afin d'aligner les composantes techniques sur les objectifs plus généraux du produit.

• Impact & Strategy: Mentors membres de l'équipe, harmonise le développement avec la stratégie mondiale, et partage activement les connaissances au moyen de conférences, d'événements internes et d'initiatives interfonctionnelles.

• Complexité et échelle : Fonctionne au niveau du produit ou du site pour façonner les décisions techniques, améliorer les méthodes de travail et diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles.

• Expertise commerciale et technique: Tire parti de connaissances techniques étendues pour stimuler l'innovation tout en maintenant une qualité d'ingénierie élevée.

• Responsabilités quotidiennes : Soutient et optimise les systèmes de récompenses par l'analyse des processus, la mise en oeuvre de l'interface, les essais/AQ, la gestion des incidents, la configuration et la consultation technique.

Qui vous êtes

• Initiative et leadership : Expérience éprouvée de la possession de tâches ambiguës, de la conduite de projets de petite à moyenne dimension et de la direction d'équipes interfonctionnelles pour résoudre des problèmes complexes.

• Stratégie technique et exécution : Connaissance approfondie du paysage technique élargi, avec une expertise dans la conception de solutions automatisées, d'intégrations de systèmes et de configurations optimisées.

• Résolution des problèmes et QA : Des compétences analytiques solides pour rationaliser les processus opérationnels, remettre en question le statu quo et élaborer des stratégies et des plans d'essai complets.

• Mentorat et collaboration : Expérience en tant que mentor technique, conduite d'événements internes de partage des connaissances et navigation

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.
As The Supply Chain Manager (SCM), you will be accountable and responsible for the end-to-end supply chain management and processes in Roche Vietnam including issues management, logistics operations, 3PL/4PL management, order management, transportation and deliveries of goods to customers. You will ensure that the Roche Quality Standards are applied throughout the supply chain processes. You will fully embrace and translate global and regional Supply Chain vision and strategic direction into business-aligned action plans and will lead the implementation of those strategies and action plans.

Your opportunities

• You will drive and maintain high quality Supply Chain services to our customers, both internal and external, proactively working with relevant stakeholders to ensure availability of products on a timely basis and at optimized quantity levels.

• You will provide governance and ensure adherence to all supply chain policies, procedures, and activities to maximize the efficiency, effectiveness, resilience, and cost effectiveness of the Roche Vietnam's Supply Chain processes, including materials planning and control, import and export, customs clearance, inventory management, warehousing, transport and distribution.

• You will ensure execution of end to end tasks of the Supply Chain process are fully monitored and controlled. You will supervise daily Supply Chain operational details, manage daily customer order processing and related customer service support, ensuring On Time In Full KPIs are adhered to and address customer logistics related complaints and drive actions to improve customer satisfaction.

• You will manage 3PL/4PL providers to ensure requirements are aligned with Global Logistics Quality Standards, challenge and work closely with 3PL/4PL providers to ensure fulfillment of their duties, carry out periodic performance reviews of all 3PL/4PL service providers to facilitate their service improvements.

• You will take proactive approach in optimizing stock levels and minimize write-offs resulting from expired/overstocking, manage bottleneck/supply issues with customers by managing customers’ expectations and work closely with Product Managers for stock allocation in the market. You will drive S&OP Process.

• You will drive continuous improvement by seeking opportunities to change business processes for efficiency improvement and cost optimization, obtain buy in from stakeholders and ensure implementation of improvement plans internally within SCM and with 3PL/4PL providers are tracked and monitored

• You will collaborate cross functionally within the affiliate and globally and with 3PL/4PL providers to resolve operational challenges

• Ensure that global directives, as well as local regulations are known by relevant stakeholders within the affiliate and that local procedures fulfilling these requirements are established and followed and that the necessary training is given.

• You will lead, direct, evaluate, and develop the Supply Chain team’s skills and knowledge and motivate the team.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Our Ophthalmology team in Basel focuses on discovering novel therapeutic approaches for major eye diseases, encompassing dry AMD/geographic atrophy and neovascular forms, as well as diabetic retinopathy, and other retinal vascular diseases. We are seeking a highly motivated Discovery Scientist with specialized expertise in the neural retina and retinal pathology, including processes such as inflammation, vascular dysfunction, ischemia, fibrosis, and neurodegeneration, to drive our early-stage drug discovery efforts.

The opportunity:

In this role, your key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Target Identification & Validation: Utilize and establish advanced in vitro and in vivo models of ocular disease, and leverage available patient sample datasets to identify, validate, and characterize novel therapeutic drug targets.

• Therapeutic Approach Development: I dentify and evaluate optimal therapeutic modalities for selected targets.

• Project Leadership: Independently lead and manage drug discovery projects from target initiation through early clinical development stages (up to Phase II readiness).

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with interdisciplinary teams across pRED (including bioinformatics, safety, and translational medicine) to advance pipeline programs.

• External Collaboration: Initiating and leading external collaboration projects to bolster internal efforts. Manage CRO activities, including project design, timelines, and quality of deliverables.

• Scientific Communication: Present research findings at internal decision-making meetings, author high-impact publications in top-tier peer-reviewed journals, and represent Roche at international scientific conferences.

• Discovery Lab Management: Support and coordinate safety, health, and environmental processes in the lab.

You who are:

• You hold a PhD in Biology, Neuroscience, Biochemistry, or a related life sciences discipline.

• You have completed a Postdoctoral Fellowship in Vision Research, Neural Retina, Ophthalmology, or a closely related field.

• You bring comprehensive knowledge of neural retina biology and the mechanisms underlying retinal disease pathogenesis, together with a proven track record of conducting experiments using models of ocular angiogenesis, fibrosis, inflammation, or neurodegeneration.

• You have direct hands-on experience in animal handling and/or ocular procedures, OR demonstrated expertise in developing novel 2D/3D model systems, such as organoids or organ-on-a-chip. You also bring experience in cell/tissue culture, -omics technologies, and/or basic bioinformatic tools.

• You demonstrate excellent organizational skills, rigorous record-keeping, exceptional oral and written English communication, and a strong collaborative mindset in a fast-paced environment.

• You bring 2–3 years of additional professional experience in academic or industry drug discovery settings, together with a proven track record of leading research projects and cross-functional project teams and a strong publication record in top-tier vision or scientific journals.

• You have an established professional network within the global ophthalmology research community.

At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il nostro team di oftalmologia a Basilea si concentra sulla scoperta di nuovi approcci terapeutici per le principali malattie oculari, che comprendono atrofia e forme neovascolari a secco, così come retinopatia diabetica e altre malattie vascolari retinali. Stiamo cercando uno scienziato altamente motivato Discovery con competenza specializzata nella retina neurale e patologia retinica, tra cui processi come l'infiammazione, disfunzione vascolare, ischemia, fibrosi e neurodegenerazione, per guidare i nostri sforzi di scoperta della droga di fase precoce.

L'opportunità:

In questo ruolo, le tue responsabilità chiave includono, ma non sono limitate a:

• Identificazione e convalida del bersaglio: Utilizzare e stabilire modelli avanzati in vitro e in vivo di malattia oculare, e sfruttare i dataset campione dei pazienti disponibili per identificare, convalidare e caratterizzare nuovi obiettivi terapeutici della droga.

• Sviluppo dell'approccio terapeutico: dentifico e valuto le modalità terapeutiche ottimali per gli obiettivi selezionati.

• Leadership del progetto: guidare e gestire in modo indipendente i progetti di scoperta della droga dall'avvio del bersaglio attraverso le prime fasi di sviluppo clinico (fino alla prontezza della fase II).

• Collaborazione interdisciplinare: Partner con team interdisciplinari attraverso pRED (compresa la bioinformatica, la sicurezza e la medicina traduttiva) per avanzare programmi di pipeline.

• Collaborazione esterna: avviare e condurre progetti di collaborazione esterna per rafforzare gli sforzi interni. Gestisci le attività CRO, tra cui la progettazione del progetto, le linee temporali e la qualità dei prodotti.

• Comunicazione scientifica: I risultati attuali della ricerca in riunioni decisionali interne, autore di pubblicazioni ad alto impatto in riviste peer-reviewed di alto livello, e rappresentano Roche in conferenze scientifiche internazionali.

• Discovery Lab Management: Supporto e coordinate di sicurezza, salute e processi ambientali in laboratorio.

Voi che siete:

• Hai un dottorato in Biologia, Neuroscienze, Biochimica, o una disciplina relativa delle scienze della vita.

• Hai completato una Fellowship Postdoctoral in Vision Research, Neural Retina, Ophthalmology, o un campo strettamente correlato.

• Porti una conoscenza completa della biologia della retina neurale e dei meccanismi che stanno alla base della patogenesi della malattia retina, insieme ad una comprovata traccia di esperimenti con modelli di angiogenesi oculare, fibrosi, infiammazione o neurodegenerazione.

• Hai un'esperienza diretta nella gestione degli animali e/o nelle procedure oculari, O dimostrato esperienza nello sviluppo di nuovi sistemi di modelli 2D/3D, come organoidi o organ-on-a-chip. Porti anche l'esperienza nella cultura cellulare/materiale, tecnologie -omics e/o strumenti bioinformatici di base.

• Lei dimostra eccellenti capacità organizzative, scritture discografiche rigorose, eccezionale comunicazione orale e scritta inglese, e una forte mentalità collaborativa in un ambiente frenetico.

• Porti 2–3 anni di esperienza professionale aggiuntiva in ambienti di scoperta di farmaci accademici o di settore, insieme a un comprovato track record di progetti di ricerca e team di progetto interfunzionali e un forte record di pubblicazione in top-tier vision o riviste scientifiche.

• Hai una rete professionale consolidata all'interno della comunità globale di ricerca di oftalmologia.

A Roche, ci proponiamo di offrire soluzioni sanitarie in continuo cambiamento. Se siete pronti a fare un impatto significativo su pazienti e sistemi sanitari in tutto il mondo, questo è il posto per voi.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati

• Zielidentifizierung und -validierung: Verwenden und etablieren Sie fortschrittliche In-vitro- und In-vivo-Modelle von Augenerkrankungen und nutzen Sie verfügbare Patientenprobendatensätze, um neue therapeutische Wirkstoffziele zu identifizieren, zu validieren und zu charakterisieren.

• Therapeutische Ansatzentwicklung: Ich dentify und bewerten optimale therapeutische Modalitäten für ausgewählte Ziele.

• Projektleitung: Unabhängige Leitung und Verwaltung von Wirkstoffforschungsprojekten von der Zielinitiierung bis zu frühen klinischen Entwicklungsphasen (bis zur Phase-II-Bereitschaft).

• Funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Partnerschaft mit interdisziplinären Teams in pRED (einschließlich Bioinformatik, Sicherheit und translationale Medizin), um Pipeline-Programme voranzutreiben.

• Externe Zusammenarbeit: Initiierung und Leitung externer Kooperationsprojekte zur Stärkung interner Bemühungen. Verwalten Sie CRO-Aktivitäten, einschließlich Projektdesign, Zeitpläne und Qualität der Ergebnisse.

• Wissenschaftliche Kommunikation: Präsentieren Sie Forschungsergebnisse auf internen Entscheidungssitzungen, schreiben Sie einflussreiche Publikationen in erstklassigen, von Experten begutachteten Fachzeitschriften und vertreten Sie Roche auf internationalen wissenschaftlichen Konferenzen.

• Discovery Lab Management: Unterstützung und Koordination von Sicherheits-, Gesundheits- und Umweltprozessen im Labor.

Sie, die

• Sie haben einen PhD in Biologie, Neurowissenschaften, Biochemie oder einer verwandten Life-Science-Disziplin.

• Sie haben ein Postdoc-Stipendium in Vision Research, neuronaler Retina, Augenheilkunde oder einem eng verwandten Bereich abgeschlossen.

• Sie bringen umfassende Kenntnisse der neuronalen Netzhautbiologie und der Mechanismen, die der Pathogenese von Netzhauterkrankungen zugrunde liegen, zusammen mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz bei der Durchführung von Experimenten mit Modellen der Augenangiogenese, Fibrose, Entzündung oder Neurodegeneration.

• Sie haben direkte praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit Tieren und / oder Augenverfahren oder haben Fachwissen in der Entwicklung neuartiger 2D / 3D-Modellsysteme wie Organoide oder Organ-on-a-Chip gezeigt. Sie bringen auch Erfahrung in Zell- / Gewebekultur, -omik-Technologien und / oder grundlegende bioinformatische Werkzeuge mit.

• Sie zeigen hervorragende organisatorische Fähigkeiten, strenge Aufzeichnungen, außergewöhnliche mündliche und schriftliche englische Kommunikation und eine starke kollaborative Denkweise in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung.

• Sie bringen 2-3 Jahre zusätzliche Berufserfahrung in akademischen oder industriellen Drug Discovery-Einstellungen mit, zusammen mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz von führenden Forschungsprojekten und funktionsübergreifenden Projektteams und einer starken Publikationsbilanz in erstklassigen Visionen oder wissenschaftlichen Zeitschriften.

• Sie haben ein etabliertes professionelles Netzwerk innerhalb der globalen ophthalmologischen Forschungsgemeinschaft.

Bei Roche wollen wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern. Wenn Sie bereit sind, einen sinnvollen Einfluss auf Patienten und Gesundheitssysteme weltweit zu haben, ist dies der richtige Ort für Sie.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit engagieren sich
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Notre équipe d'ophtalmologie à Bâle se concentre sur la découverte de nouvelles approches thérapeutiques pour les principales maladies oculaires, incluant la DMLA sèche/atrophie géographique et les formes néovasculaires, ainsi que la rétinopathie diabétique et d'autres maladies vasculaires rétiniennes. Nous recherchons un chercheur hautement motivé ayant une expertise spécialisée dans la rétine neurale et la pathologie rétinienne, y compris des processus tels que l'inflammation, la dysfonction vasculaire, l'ischémie, la fibrose et la neurodégénérescence, pour stimuler nos efforts de découverte de médicaments en début de développement.

L'occasion :

Dans ce rôle, vos principales responsabilités comprennent, sans s'y limiter :

• Identification et validation des cibles : Utiliser et établir des modèles avancés de maladies oculaires in vitro et in vivo, et tirer parti des ensembles de données disponibles sur les patients pour identifier, valider et caractériser de nouvelles cibles thérapeutiques.

• Développement de l'approche thérapeutique : Je dentifie et évalue les modalités thérapeutiques optimales pour certaines cibles.

• Leadership du projet : Diriger et gérer de façon indépendante les projets de découverte de médicaments depuis le lancement de la cible jusqu'aux premières étapes du développement clinique (jusqu'à la phase II).

• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : S'associer à des équipes interdisciplinaires à travers le PRED (y compris la bioinformatique, la sécurité et la médecine translationnelle) pour faire progresser les programmes de pipelines.

• Collaboration externe : lancer et diriger des projets de collaboration externe pour renforcer les efforts internes. Gérer les activités du CRO, y compris la conception du projet, les échéanciers et la qualité des produits livrables.

• Communication scientifique : Présenter les résultats de la recherche lors des réunions internes de prise de décisions, rédiger des publications à fort impact dans des revues de premier ordre évaluées par des pairs et représenter Roche aux conférences scientifiques internationales.

• Gestion des laboratoires de découverte : Soutenir et coordonner les processus de sécurité, de santé et d'environnement dans le laboratoire.

Vous qui êtes :

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en biologie, en neuroscience, en biochimie ou dans une discipline connexe des sciences de la vie.

• Vous avez obtenu une bourse postdoctorale en recherche sur la vision, en rétine neurale, en ophtalmologie ou dans un domaine étroitement lié.

• Vous apportez une connaissance complète de la biologie de la rétine neurale et des mécanismes sous-jacents à la pathogenèse des maladies rétiniennes, ainsi qu'une expérience éprouvée de la conduite d'expériences utilisant des modèles d'angiogenèse oculaire, de fibrose, d'inflammation ou de neurodégénérescence.

• Vous avez une expérience pratique directe dans la manipulation des animaux et/ou les procédures oculaires, OU démontré une expertise dans le développement de nouveaux systèmes de modèles 2D/3D, tels que les organoïdes ou les organes sur puce. Vous apportez également de l'expérience dans la culture cellulaire ou tissulaire, les technologies -omiques et/ou les outils bio-informatiques de base.

• Vous faites preuve d'excellentes compétences organisationnelles, d'une tenue rigoureuse des dossiers, d'une communication orale et écrite exceptionnelle en anglais et d'une solide collaboration dans un environnement rapide.

• Vous apportez 2 à 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle supplémentaire dans des milieux universitaires ou industriels de découverte de médicaments, ainsi qu'une expérience éprouvée de projets de recherche de premier plan et d'équipes de projets interfonctionnelles et une solide publication dans des revues scientifiques ou de vision de haut niveau.

• Vous avez un réseau professionnel établi au sein de la communauté mondiale de recherche en ophtalmologie.

Chez Roche, nous visons des solutions de soins de santé qui changent la vie. Si vous êtes prêt à avoir un impact significatif sur les patients et les systèmes de santé dans le monde entier, c'est l'endroit pour vous.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde sont dédiés

jobs.title: DevOps Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The DevOps Infrastructure Engineer takes ownership and drives strategic technical initiatives, focusing on building, optimizing, and maintaining end-to-end lifecycle processes and developed orchestrations. In this role, you will challenge the status quo, foster collaboration, and mentor junior team members while focusing on making end-to-end processes more robust, resilient, and effortless for internal customers to consume. You will lead the development of custom operational tooling and workflow orchestrations (using engines like Temporal.io), manage infrastructure as code (IaC) for large workloads, and ensure robust security, monitoring, and logging practices are in place to maintain optimal system health and performance.

Job Responsibilities:

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Takes ownership of ambiguous topics ("grey zones") and successfully drives small to medium initiatives (Project/Squad/Product). Builds, hardens, and maintains end-to-end lifecycle processes and developed orchestrations. Develops custom internal tooling and self-service abstractions to ease service consumption for customers, manages infrastructure using IaC principles, and implements robust security and monitoring practices.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Performs complex troubleshooting across distributed environments, coordinates across multiple teams, and takes ownership of decisions that involve risk. Focuses on making end-to-end processes more robust, identifying process gaps at the company level, and bringing in outside best practices to eliminate operational friction and failure points.

• Stakeholder Management: Prioritizes and communicates effectively with stakeholders. Maintains a "bigger picture" view to thoroughly understand how various technical components fit into the overall product strategy, developer experience, and organizational goals.

• Impact/Strategy: Acts as a technical mentor to junior engineers and actively shares knowledge in internal and external events (e.g., DevOps Days, Tech Talks). Aligns personal and team development plans with the global strategy and participates in initiatives reaching outside the regular project scope.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates at the Product or Site level, managing complex infrastructures, workflow orchestrations, CI/CD pipelines, and scripts for large workloads and products in Production environments.

• Business / Technical ability: Possesses a deep understanding of the broader technical landscape beyond specific components. Formulates and implements technical strategies aligned with organizational objectives, investing time in initiatives that boost creativity, ease of service consumption, and innovation while maintaining the highest engineering quality.

Qualifications:

Education / Experience:

• Demonstrated experience in Production environments managing large workloads, complex workflow orchestrations, and end-to-end platform lifecycles.

• Proven track record of mentoring junior engineers, fostering good collaboration, and skillfully navigating group dynamics.

• Experience identifying gaps in Agile and DevOps principles at the company level and successfully implementing external best practices to harden operational workflows.

Technical Skills:

• Knowledge of stateful workflow orchestration engines, with direct experience or strong familiarity with Temporal.io (or similar systems like Cadence).

• Advanced knowledge of at least one programming language (Python, Go, Ruby, Rust, JavaScript) u

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

L'Ingegnere delle Infrastrutture DevOps prende la proprietà e guida iniziative tecniche strategiche, focalizzandosi sulla costruzione, l'ottimizzazione e il mantenimento dei processi di ciclo di vita end-to-end e le orchestre sviluppate. In questo ruolo, sfiderai lo status quo, la collaborazione adottiva e i membri del team di mentore junior, concentrandoti sul rendere i processi end-to-end più robusti, resilienti e senza sforzo per i clienti interni da consumare. Potrai condurre lo sviluppo di strumenti operativi personalizzati e orchestre di flusso di lavoro (utilizzando motori come Temporal.io), gestire l'infrastruttura come codice (IaC) per grandi carichi di lavoro, e garantire robusta sicurezza, monitoraggio e pratiche di registrazione sono in atto per mantenere la salute e le prestazioni del sistema ottimali.

Responsabilità del lavoro:

• Scope / (Content Leadership): prende la proprietà di argomenti ambigui ("zone grandi") e guida con successo piccole e medie iniziative (Progetto/Squad/Product). Costruisce, indurisce e mantiene i processi del ciclo di vita end-to-end e le orchestre sviluppate. Sviluppa strumenti interni personalizzati e astrazioni self-service per facilitare il consumo di servizi per i clienti, gestisce le infrastrutture utilizzando i principi IaC e implementa pratiche di sicurezza e monitoraggio robuste.

• Accountability/Problem Solving: Esegue la risoluzione dei problemi complessi in ambienti distribuiti, le coordinate in più squadre, e prende la proprietà di decisioni che coinvolgono il rischio. Si concentra sul rendere i processi end-to-end più robusti, identificare le lacune di processo a livello aziendale, e portare le migliori pratiche esterne per eliminare i punti di attrito e guasto operativi.

• Stakeholder Management: Priorizza e comunica efficacemente con gli stakeholder. Mantiene una visione "grande immagine" per capire a fondo come i vari componenti tecnici si adattano alla strategia generale del prodotto, all'esperienza dello sviluppatore e agli obiettivi organizzativi.

• Impact/Strategy: agisce come mentore tecnico per gli ingegneri junior e condivide attivamente le conoscenze in eventi interni ed esterni (ad esempio, DevOps Days, Tech Talks). Allinea i piani di sviluppo personale e di squadra con la strategia globale e partecipa a iniziative che raggiungono al di fuori della portata del progetto regolare.

• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): Funziona a livello del prodotto o del sito, gestione di infrastrutture complesse, orchestrazioni del flusso di lavoro, pipeline CI/CD, e script per grandi carichi di lavoro e prodotti in ambienti di produzione.

• Capacità commerciale / tecnica: Possede una profonda comprensione del paesaggio tecnico più ampio oltre componenti specifici. Formula e implementa strategie tecniche allineate agli obiettivi organizzativi, investendo il tempo in iniziative che incrementano la creatività, la facilità di consumo di servizi e l'innovazione mantenendo al contempo la massima qualità ingegneristica.

Qualifiche:

Istruzione / Esperienza:

• Esperienza dimostrata negli ambienti di produzione che gestiscono grandi carichi di lavoro, complesse orchestre del flusso di lavoro e cicli di vita della piattaforma end-to-end.

• Provato track record di mentoring ingegneri junior, promuovere una buona collaborazione, e abilmente navigare dinamica di gruppo.

• Prova a identificare le lacune nei principi Agile e DevOps a livello aziendale e implementare con successo le migliori pratiche esterne per indurire i flussi di lavoro operativi.

Competenze tecniche:

• Conoscenza dei motori di orchestrazione a flusso di lavoro di stato, con esperienza diretta o forte familiarità con Temporal.io (o sistemi simili come Cadence).

• Conoscenza avanzata di almeno un linguaggio di programmazione (Python, Go, Ruby, Rust, JavaScript) u

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

Der DevOps Infrastructure Engineer übernimmt Verantwortung und treibt strategische technische Initiativen voran, die sich auf den Aufbau, die Optimierung und die Wartung von End-to-End-Lifecycle-Prozessen und entwickelten Orchestrierungen konzentrieren. In dieser Rolle werden Sie den Status Quo herausfordern, die Zusammenarbeit fördern und Junior-Teammitglieder betreuen, während Sie sich darauf konzentrieren, End-to-End-Prozesse robuster, belastbarer und müheloser für interne Kunden zu machen. Sie leiten die Entwicklung von benutzerdefinierten Betriebswerkzeugen und Workflow-Orchestrierungen (unter Verwendung von Engines wie Temporal.io), verwalten die Infrastruktur als Code (IaC) für große Workloads und stellen sicher, dass robuste Sicherheits-, Überwachungs- und Protokollierungspraktiken vorhanden sind, um den optimalen Systemzustand und die optimale Leistung zu gewährleisten.

Aufgabenbereich:

• Scope / (Content Leadership): Übernimmt mehrdeutige Themen ("Grauzonen") und treibt erfolgreich kleine bis mittlere Initiativen voran (Project/Squad/Product). Baut, härtet und pflegt End-to-End-Lifecycle-Prozesse und entwickelte Orchestrierungen. Entwickelt kundenspezifische interne Tools und Self-Service-Abstraktionen, um den Serviceverbrauch für Kunden zu erleichtern, verwaltet die Infrastruktur nach IaC-Prinzipien und implementiert robuste Sicherheits- und Überwachungspraktiken.

• Verantwortlichkeit/Problemlösung: Führt komplexe Fehlersuche in verteilten Umgebungen durch, koordiniert über mehrere Teams hinweg und übernimmt die Verantwortung für Entscheidungen, die Risiken beinhalten. Konzentriert sich darauf, End-to-End-Prozesse robuster zu gestalten, Prozesslücken auf Unternehmensebene zu identifizieren und externe Best Practices einzuführen, um betriebliche Reibungs- und Fehlerpunkte zu beseitigen.

• Stakeholder Management: Priorisiert und kommuniziert effektiv mit Stakeholdern. Behält ein "größeres Bild" Ansicht, um gründlich zu verstehen, wie verschiedene technische Komponenten passen in die gesamte Produktstrategie, Entwicklererfahrung und organisatorische Ziele.

• Impact/Strategie: Funktioniert als technischer Mentor für Nachwuchsingenieure und teilt aktiv Wissen in internen und externen Veranstaltungen (z.B. DevOps Days, Tech Talks). Richtet die Personal- und Teamentwicklungspläne an der globalen Strategie aus und beteiligt sich an Initiativen, die außerhalb des regulären Projektumfangs liegen.

• Komplexität / (Produktgröße): Funktioniert auf Produkt- oder Site-Ebene und verwaltet komplexe Infrastrukturen, Workflow-Orchestrierungen, CI/CD-Pipelines und Skripte für große Workloads und Produkte in Produktionsumgebungen.

• Business / Technische Fähigkeiten: Verfügt über ein tiefes Verständnis der breiteren technischen Landschaft über bestimmte Komponenten hinaus. Formuliert und implementiert technische Strategien, die auf organisatorische Ziele ausgerichtet sind, und investiert Zeit in Initiativen, die Kreativität, Servicefreundlichkeit und Innovation fördern und gleichzeitig höchste technische Qualität gewährleisten.

Qualifikationen:

Bildung / Erfahrung:

• Demonstrierte Erfahrung in Produktionsumgebungen zur Verwaltung großer Workloads, komplexer Workflow-Orchestrierungen und End-to-End-Plattformlebenszyklen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Betreuung von Nachwuchsingenieuren, der Förderung einer guten Zusammenarbeit und der geschickten Navigation in der Gruppendynamik.

• Erleben Sie die Identifizierung von Lücken in Agile- und DevOps-Prinzipien auf Unternehmensebene und die erfolgreiche Implementierung externer Best Practices zur Verschärfung operativer Workflows.

Technische Fähigkeiten:

• Kenntnisse über Stateful Workflow Orchestrierungs-Engines, mit direkter Erfahrung oder starker Vertrautheit mit Temporal.io (oder ähnlichen Systemen wie Cadence).

• Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse in mindestens einer Programmiersprache (Python, Go, Ruby, Rust, JavaScript)

Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

L'ingénieur de l'infrastructure DevOps s'approprie et dirige des initiatives techniques stratégiques axées sur la construction, l'optimisation et le maintien des processus du cycle de vie de bout en bout et des orchestrations développées. Dans ce rôle, vous défierez le statu quo, favoriserez la collaboration et mentorez les membres de l'équipe junior tout en mettant l'accent sur le renforcement des processus de bout en bout, la résilience et l'absence de effort pour les clients internes à consommer. Vous dirigerez le développement d'outils opérationnels personnalisés et d'orchestrations de workflow (à l'aide de moteurs comme Temporal.io), gérerez l'infrastructure comme code (IaC) pour de grandes charges de travail, et assurez-vous que des pratiques robustes de sécurité, de surveillance et d'enregistrement sont en place pour maintenir une santé et des performances optimales du système.

Responsabilités professionnelles :

• Portée / ( Leadership du contenu) : s'approprie des sujets ambigus (« zones grises ») et mène avec succès des initiatives de petite à moyenne envergure (projet/équipe/produit). Construit, durcit et maintient les processus du cycle de vie de bout en bout et a développé des orchestrations. Développer des outils internes personnalisés et des abstractions en libre-service pour faciliter la consommation de services pour les clients, gérer l'infrastructure en utilisant les principes de la CAI et mettre en œuvre des pratiques de sécurité et de surveillance robustes.

• Responsabilisation et résolution des problèmes : Effectue des opérations complexes de dépannage dans des environnements distribués, coordonne plusieurs équipes et prend en charge les décisions qui comportent des risques. Il s'attache à rendre les processus de bout en bout plus robustes, à cerner les lacunes au niveau de l'entreprise et à mettre en place des pratiques exemplaires extérieures pour éliminer les frictions opérationnelles et les points de défaillance.

• Gestion des intervenants : Établir des priorités et communiquer efficacement avec les intervenants. Maintient une vue d'ensemble pour bien comprendre comment divers composants techniques s'inscrivent dans la stratégie globale du produit, l'expérience du développeur et les objectifs organisationnels.

• Impact/Stratégie : agit comme mentor technique auprès des ingénieurs subalternes et partage activement les connaissances dans les événements internes et externes (p. ex., DevOps Days, Tech Talks). Aligner les plans de développement personnel et en équipe sur la stratégie globale et participer à des initiatives qui ne relèvent pas de la portée régulière du projet.

• Complexité / (Taille du produit): Fonctionne au niveau du produit ou du site, gérant des infrastructures complexes, des orchestrations de flux de travail, des pipelines CI/CD et des scripts pour de grandes charges de travail et des produits dans les environnements de production.

• Capacités d'affaires / techniques: Possède une compréhension profonde du paysage technique plus large au-delà de composants spécifiques. Formule et met en oeuvre des stratégies techniques alignées sur les objectifs organisationnels, investissant du temps dans des initiatives qui stimulent la créativité, la facilité de la consommation de services et l'innovation tout en maintenant la plus haute qualité d'ingénierie.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Importante: Dopo la vostra applicazione, vi contatteremo via e-mail entro pochi giorni. Per assicurarti di non perdere un messaggio importante, ti chiediamo di controllare la cartella spam o spazzatura accanto alla tua casella di posta. Se non si sente da noi entro una settimana, contattare basel.berufslehre@roche.com .

Sai cosa farai dopo la laurea? Diventa un potenziatore del mondo o un salvagente? Non solo devi reinventare il tuo futuro. Anche noi. A Roche, lavoriamo con un unico obiettivo – sviluppare test innovativi e farmaci e utilizzare i dati in nuovi modi per aiutare le persone a vivere una vita più lunga e migliore. Vi ispiriamo chi siamo, cosa facciamo e come lo facciamo. Completa la tua formazione a Roche e quindi dare un contributo decisivo a beneficio del paziente!

Come assistente di laboratorio (m/f/d) EFZ specializzato in chimica, Du Roche supporta lo sviluppo di test e droghe innovativi per aiutare le persone a vivere una vita più lunga e migliore. Vi ispiriamo chi siamo, cosa facciamo e come lo facciamo.

Impara. Il futuro. Roche.

Argomenti principali per il lavoro

• Lavori in varie aree della divisione Pharma. Questo può essere in ricerca e sviluppo farmaceutico, ma anche nel controllo della qualità o nei laboratori di sicurezza ambientale/professionale.

• Lavori con attrezzature e metodi all'avanguardia in un team di chimici, biologi e farmacisti. Oltre a lavorare sui vostri progetti, siete anche responsabili della manutenzione del laboratorio e della prontezza operativa degli strumenti di analisi e misurazione e delle attrezzature generali.

• Per l'attività centrale in laboratorio, si è anche occupato sul computer. Con l'aiuto di software all'avanguardia, è possibile effettuare la preparazione e la pianificazione del lavoro, la valutazione dei dati e la registrazione degli esperimenti.

• Presenta il tuo lavoro e i tuoi risultati Si incontra regolarmente il vostro manager o direttamente in riunioni di team interdisciplinari.

Il tuo profilo

• Siete curiosi e godetevi domande scientifiche come biologia, chimica, fisica e matematica.

• Ti piace lavorare in un team, partecipare attivamente alle discussioni e divertirti a trovare le tue soluzioni creative, ma puoi anche lavorare in modo indipendente e concentrato per te.

• Affidabilità, buone capacità di osservazione e buone capacità manuali sono tre caratteristiche essenziali che si dovrebbe portare.

• Almeno livello scolastico Sek E (BS/BL/SO), Sek (AG), maturità media (D) o livelli scolastici superiori

• Buona prestazione in matematica e materie scientifiche

• Tedesco: lingua madre o livello B2 e inglese competenze di base

I vantaggi

• Lavori in un ambiente internazionale e ottieni informazioni di prima classe sull'azienda e sul lavoro quotidiano

• Frequenti una scuola di laboratorio orientata alla pratica

• Lavori con strutture all'avanguardia, attrezzature e strutture orientate al futuro

• Con i servizi corrispondenti, c'è la possibilità che vi supporteremo con varie ulteriori opportunità di istruzione dopo la formazione.

• A seconda della distanza dal luogo di lavoro, avete la possibilità di ottenere una stanza nell'edificio residenziale Roche a Basilea

L'applicazione completa contiene i seguenti documenti:

• CVC

• Certificati degli ultimi due semestri

• Controlla S2, se sei della zona di istruzione Svizzera nord-occidentale (se disponibile)

Importante: Si prega di prestare attenzione al completo

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Important: After your application, we will contact you by e-mail within a few days. To make sure you don’t miss an important message, we ask you to check the spam or junk folder next to your inbox. If you do not hear from us within a week, contact basel.berufslehre@roche.com .

Do you know what you will do after graduation? Become a world improver or a lifesaver? Not only do you need to reinvent your future. We too. At Roche, we work with one goal – to develop innovative tests and drugs and use data in new ways to help people live longer and better lives. Let us inspire you who we are, what we do and how we do it. Complete your education at Roche and thus make a decisive contribution to the benefit of the patient!

As a laboratory assistant (m/f/d) EFZ specialising in chemistry, Du Roche supports the development of innovative tests and drugs to help people live longer and better lives. Let us inspire you who we are, what we do and how we do it.

Learn. The future. Roche.

Top Arguments for the Job

• You work in various areas of the Pharma division. This can be in pharmaceutical research and development, but also in quality control or the environmental/occupational safety laboratories.

• You work with state-of-the-art equipment and methods in a team of chemists, biologists and pharmacists. In addition to working on your projects, you are also responsible for the laboratory maintenance and operational readiness of the analysis and measurement instruments and general equipment.

• For the central activity in the laboratory, you are also busy on the computer. With the help of state-of-the-art software, you can carry out work preparation and planning, data evaluation and logging of the experiments.

• Present your work and results You regularly meet your manager or directly in interdisciplinary team meetings.

Your profile

• You are curious and enjoy scientific questions such as biology, chemistry, physics and mathematics.

• You enjoy working in a team, actively participate in discussions and have fun finding your own creative solutions, but you can also work independently and concentrated for yourself.

• Reliability, good observation skills and good manual skills are three essential features you should bring.

• At least school level Sek E (BS/BL/SO), Sek (AG), Middle maturity (D) or higher school levels

• Good performance in mathematics and science subjects

• German: native language or level B2 and English skills Basic level

Your advantages

• You work in an international environment and get first-class insights into the company and everyday work

• You attend a practice-oriented workshop school

• You work with state-of-the-art facilities, equipment and future-oriented facilities

• With corresponding services, there is the possibility that we will support you with various further education opportunities after the training.

• Depending on the distance to the place of work, you have the opportunity to get a room in the Roche residential building in Basel

Your full application contains the following documents:

• CVC

• Certificates of the last two semesters

• Check S2, if you are from the education area Northwest Switzerland (if available)

jobs.title: Field Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Field Engineering Specialist

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity:

The Roche Support Network group is committed to providing industry-defining support to its customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel and demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and/or installation specialist for Roche assigned product lines and provide valued service to your laboratory customers in an assigned territory. This position serves as a technical repair or installation specialist for Roche products for assigned product lines and geographies.

• Provides routine technical support to customers on operational and maintenance aspects of system equipment.

• Performs on-site service, repair and/or installation of company product(s). This may include any aspect of field support and is not limited to mechanical/system hardware and software, networking/wireless networking.

• Serves as customer contact on routine technical and service-related problems. Receives training and delivers service within the normal scope of the position. Follows documented practices, policies and procedures in providing repair and installation support.

• Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, software and system failure, using established procedures. Determines the most cost-effective repair/resolution to minimize customer downtime.

• Provides analysis, feedback and recommendations on product failure trends and serviceability issues. Documents all activity in a manner compliant with the company's quality procedures. Specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system or equipment. Requires specific training and certification.

• Applies some advanced skills to the position or specialization. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks.

• Resolves most questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

​This is a field-based role - the territory is Chicago with the ideal candidate to live in the Northern or Northwest part of Chicago.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireles

Roche Support Network offre un'opportunità emozionante per le persone che sono appassionati di problem solving. In qualità di azienda sanitaria focalizzata sulla ricerca, Roche è dedicata alla scoperta, allo sviluppo e alla fornitura di prodotti diagnostici e terapeutici innovativi. Con un impegno per lo sviluppo dei dipendenti e un ambiente di lavoro che valorizza il rispetto e l'empowerment, Roche offre interessanti prospettive di carriera per coloro che cercano di avere un impatto significativo sulla cura dei pazienti.

L'opportunità:

Il gruppo Roche Support Network si impegna a fornire ai propri clienti un supporto a definizione industriale. In qualità di Field Engineering Specialist, avrai l'opportunità di viaggiare e dimostrare la tua esperienza come specialista tecnico di riparazione e/o installazione per le linee di prodotti Roche assegnate e fornire un servizio prezioso ai tuoi clienti di laboratorio in un territorio assegnato. Questa posizione funge da specialista tecnico di riparazione o installazione per i prodotti Roche per le linee di prodotto e geografie assegnate.

• Fornisce assistenza tecnica ordinaria ai clienti sugli aspetti operativi e di manutenzione delle apparecchiature di sistema.

• Esegue il servizio in loco, la riparazione e/o l'installazione dei prodotti aziendali. Ciò può includere qualsiasi aspetto del supporto sul campo e non è limitato a hardware e software meccanici/sistema, networking/wireless networking.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Field Engineering Specialist

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity:

The Roche Support Network group is committed to providing industry-defining support to its customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel and demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and/or installation specialist for Roche assigned product lines and provide valued service to your laboratory customers in an assigned territory. This position serves as a technical repair or installation specialist for Roche products for assigned product lines and geographies.

• Provides routine technical support to customers on operational and maintenance aspects of system equipment.

• Performs on-site service, repair and/or installation of company product(s). This may include any aspect of field support and is not limited to mechanical/system hardware and software, networking/wireless networking.

• Serves as customer contact on routine technical and service-related problems. Receives training and delivers service within the normal scope of the position. Follows documented practices, policies and procedures in providing repair and installation support.

• Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, software and system failure, using established procedures. Determines the most cost-effective repair/resolution to minimize customer downtime.

• Provides analysis, feedback and recommendations on product failure trends and serviceability issues. Documents all activity in a manner compliant with the company's quality procedures. Specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system or equipment. Requires specific training and certification.

• Applies some advanced skills to the position or specialization. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Duties are generally routine, but may include non-routine tasks.

• Resolves most questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

​This is a field-based role - the territory is Chicago with the ideal candidate to live in the Northern or Northwest part of Chicago.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireles

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Sequencing is not only changing science, but we are changing lives. Our software teams are laying the groundwork for the future by developing powerful bioinformatics algorithms, data analysis tools, and software/systems infrastructures so researchers and clinicians can make better health decisions faster. The path to curing cancer lies in ones and zeros as we work with next-generation genomic sequencing, a new frontier.

Do you want to develop software products that scientists and others in the life sciences will use to diagnose, find treatments, and eventually beat diseases like cancer? Our team builds highly scalable, reliable software and secure systems for better diagnostics. Come join us!

The Opportunity

• As a Bioinformatics Software Engineer, you will design and develop automated verification tests for the bioinformatics components and pipelines that are used in Roche Sequencing products. You will be part of the team developing cutting-edge, distributed, scale-out Next-Generation Sequencing data analysis software to ensure the highest possible software quality for gene sequencing research and disease diagnostics.

• Work closely with research and algorithm experts, accelerating bioinformatics techniques using GPU hardware. Support software development lifecycle and Design Control process, working closely with team members to continuously improve quality and feature sets of the software products, based on technical design and requirements specificationsWork closely with team members to continuously improve the quality and feature sets of software products. This includes supporting the software development lifecycle and Design Control process, based on technical design and requirements specifications.

Who You Are

• B.S. or M.S. or PhD in Software Engineering, Data Science or Computational Biology or related field.

• 5+ years of experience in working in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) using C++ and practical experience utilizing GPU-accelerated C/C++ libraries.

• Strong expertise in Python, including numerical computing and data science libraries.

• Experience with CI/CD tools and concepts.

• Experience designing, documenting and executing verification tests.

• Be self-driven, detail oriented, analytical and proven ability to learn quickly.

• Be a team player, customer focused with excellent interdisciplinary collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• NGS data and bioinformatics pipeline verification.

• Proficiency in AWS and Linux Shell environments

• Software verification experience focusing on medical device software or regulated applications.
