Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Dans l'organisation Recherche Pharmaceutique et Développement Débutal (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformateurs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires qui changent la vie.

PRED Cardiopathie, Métabolisme, Immunologie (CMI), située à Bâle, Suisse, se concentre sur la découverte et le développement précoce de traitements innovants pour des maladies spécifiques qui affectent la vie de millions de personnes. Au Département d'immunologie, nous développons des thérapies de pointe pour traiter les maladies inflammatoires chroniques, y compris de nouvelles options de traitement des maladies pulmonaires obstructives chroniques (MPOC).

L'opportunité

Pour compléter l'équipe d'immunologie du CMI PRED, nous recherchons un scientifique visionnaire, très motivé et expérimenté ayant une solide expérience universitaire en recherche pulmonaire, une expérience dans l'identification et la validation des cibles de médicaments et une capacité éprouvée de diriger efficacement des projets dans un contexte de découverte de médicaments.

En tant que chercheur principal au CMI PRED, vous ferez partie d'un groupe international et multidisciplinaire de scientifiques et de cliniciens engagés à fournir des solutions novatrices aux patients atteints de BPCO en combinant des approches de pointe en biologie, en pharmacologie et en recherche translationnelle.

Principales responsabilités :

• En utilisant des données sur les patients et des modèles translationnels, vous dirigerez des initiatives novatrices pour mieux comprendre la physiopathologie de la MPOC afin d'identifier de nouvelles cibles médicamenteuses et de générer des hypothèses thérapeutiques qui sont expérimentalement testables, toxicologiques et cliniquement exploitables.

• En collaboration avec une équipe dédiée d'associés de laboratoire et de scientifiques postdoctoraux, vous dirigerez, superviserez et interpréterez des études expérimentales précliniques complexes pour la validation et la caractérisation de cibles ou d'agents thérapeutiques en BPCO.

• Vous apporterez des cibles dans le premier pipeline de découverte de médicaments et dirigerez des équipes multidisciplinaires jusqu'à la génération de candidats cliniques.

• En travaillant en équipes multidisciplinaires, vous évaluerez avec diligence les possibilités externes et communiquerez clairement les résultats à la haute direction.

• Gestion des personnes, y compris l'encadrement et le mentorat des jeunes scientifiques et postdocs

Qui vous êtes

• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en sciences de la vie (biologie respiratoire, biologie cellulaire/ moléculaire, pharmacologie, immunologie - ou un domaine étroitement apparenté) et apportez 5 à 10 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Our Clinical Safety organisation is dedicated to delivering meaningful improvements to patients through medically-differentiated therapies. In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability.

As a Senior Safety Director at Roche, you'll be a recognized expert and strategic leader in drug safety, driving safety strategy for our most complex molecules while building organizational capability across the Clinical Safety organization. You'll provide expert mentorship to colleagues, lead high-stakes regulatory submissions, and represent Roche's safety expertise to regulatory authorities, governance committees, and senior leadership. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic influence. This is the perfect opportunity for a safety leader ready to shape the future of drug development and drive organizational excellence.

The Opportunity:

• Takes the lead in defining, owning, progressing, and guiding the defined safety strategy for their program(s)

• Accountable for establishing and maintaining the company position on the safety profile and shaping the proactive patient risk communication and risk management strategy.

• Must provide an objective and neutral position as a safety professional, even when facing conflicting business priorities or viewpoints.

• Is the expert content reviewer for safety aspects and must be consulted for safety profile decision-making across the product lifecycle (e.g., updates to the Investigator’s brochure (IB)/safety label, Integrated Safety Management Plan/Risk Management Plan (RMP)).

• Leads the development of the safety strategy by providing input into clinical development programs, Target Product Profiles (TPPs), Integrated Evidence Plans (IEPs), health technology assessment (HTA) dossier, and launch strategies.

• Provides critical safety input to inform decision-making on clinical development plans and individual study designs. Also provides requisite oversight and expert review for safety components of regulatory authority submissions (e.g., IND, NDA, MAA).

• Influences key stakeholders (e.g., triad or cross-functional development teams, regulatory leader, medical affairs). Works closely with PCS (Portfolio Clinical Safety) to meet Clinical Safety deliverables and provide medical and scientific interpretation of emerging clinical and nonclinical safety data.

Who you are:

• Qualified healthcare professional or Life Sciences graduate and a minimum 10+ years of drug development experience in pharmaceutical or related industry, including at least 5 years in drug safety; expert-level understanding of scientific aspects of safety, pharmacovigilance, and clinical/patient risk management with demonstrable knowledge of GVP, GCP, and CTR requirements;

• 10+ years of clinical drug development experience in the biopharmaceutical industry or a related sector (e.g. academia; CRO; etc); preferably including at least 5 years of experience in a clinical drug safety-related role.

• Demonstrate expert understanding of the scientific aspects of safety, PV and clinical/patient risk management (e.g. via demonstrable knowledge of the application of GVP, GCP & CTR requirements) is essential.

• Demonstrated ability to lead and influence, with and without authority, in a global matrix envir

In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability.

As a Senior Safety Director at Roche, you'll be a recognized expert and strategic leader in drug safety, driving safety strategy for our most complex molecules while building organizational capability across the Clinical Safety organization. You'll provide expert mentorship to colleagues, lead high-stakes regulatory submissions, and represent Roche's safety expertise to regulatory authorities, governance committees, and senior leadership. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic influence. This is the perfect opportunity for a safety leader ready to shape the future of drug development and drive organizational excellence.

The Opportunity:

• Takes the lead in defining, owning, progressing, and guiding the defined safety strategy for their program(s)

• Accountable for establishing and maintaining the company position on the safety profile and shaping the proactive patient risk communication and risk management strategy.

• Must provide an objective and neutral position as a safety professional, even when facing conflicting business priorities or viewpoints.

• Is the expert content reviewer for safety aspects and must be consulted for safety profile decision-making across the product lifecycle (e.g., updates to the Investigator’s brochure (IB)/safety label, Integrated Safety Management Plan/Risk Management Plan (RMP)).

• Leads the development of the safety strategy by providing input into clinical development programs, Target Product Profiles (TPPs), Integrated Evidence Plans (IEPs), health technology assessment (HTA) dossier, and launch strategies.

• Provides critical safety input to inform decision-making on clinical development plans and individual study designs. Also provides requisite oversight and expert review for safety components of regulatory authority submissions (e.g., IND, NDA, MAA).

• Influences key stakeholders (e.g., triad or cross-functional development teams, regulatory leader, medical affairs). Works closely with PCS (Portfolio Clinical Safety) to meet Clinical Safety deliverables and provide medical and scientific interpretation of emerging clinical and nonclinical safety data.

Who you are:

• Qualified healthcare professional or Life Sciences graduate and a minimum 10+ years of drug development experience in pharmaceutical or related industry, including at least 5 years in drug safety; expert-level understanding of scientific aspects of safety, pharmacovigilance, and clinical/patient risk management with demonstrable knowledge of GVP, GCP, and CTR requirements;

• Demonstrate expert understanding of the scientific aspects of safety, PV and clinical/patient risk management (e.g. via demonstrable knowledge of the application of GVP, GCP & CTR requirements) is essential.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Chez Roche, nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. Notre organisation de sécurité clinique se consacre à apporter des améliorations significatives aux patients grâce à des thérapies médicales différenciées. Dans ce rôle, vous fournirez aux molécules du portefeuille Roche un soutien essentiel en matière de sécurité et de pharmacovigilance, assurant ainsi les normes les plus élevées en matière de sécurité des participants et de fiabilité des données.

En tant que directeur principal de la sécurité chez Roche, vous serez un expert reconnu et un chef de file stratégique dans le domaine de la sécurité des médicaments. Vous offrirez un mentorat d'expert à vos collègues, dirigerez des présentations réglementaires à haut niveau et représenterez l'expertise de Roche en matière de sécurité auprès des organismes de réglementation, des comités de gouvernance et des cadres supérieurs. Ce rôle combine une expertise technique approfondie avec une influence stratégique. C'est l'occasion idéale pour un leader de la sécurité prêt à façonner l'avenir du développement des médicaments et à stimuler l'excellence organisationnelle.

La possibilité :

• Prend l'initiative de définir, de posséder, de progresser et d'orienter la stratégie de sécurité définie pour leurs programmes

• Responsable de l'établissement et du maintien de la position de l'entreprise sur le profil de sécurité et de l'élaboration de la stratégie proactive de communication et de gestion des risques pour les patients.

• Doit fournir une position objective et neutre en tant que professionnel de la sécurité, même lorsqu'il fait face à des priorités ou des points de vue commerciaux contradictoires.

• Est l'examinateur expert du contenu pour les aspects de sécurité et doit être consulté pour la prise de décision sur le profil de sécurité tout au long du cycle de vie du produit (p. ex. mises à jour de la brochure de l'enquêteur (IB)/étiquette de sécurité, Plan de gestion de la sécurité intégrée/Plan de gestion des risques (PGR)).

• Dirige l'élaboration de la stratégie de sécurité en fournissant une contribution aux programmes de développement clinique, aux profils de produits cibles (PPT), aux plans de données probantes intégrées (PEI), au dossier d'évaluation des technologies de la santé (AST) et aux stratégies de lancement.

• Fournit des données essentielles sur l'innocuité pour éclairer la prise de décisions sur les plans de développement clinique et les plans d'études individuels. Fournit également la surveillance et l'examen d'experts nécessaires pour les composantes de sécurité des présentations d'autorités réglementaires (p. ex., IND, NDA, AAM).

• Influence sur les intervenants clés (p. ex., équipes de développement triade ou interfonctionnelle, chef de la réglementation, affaires médicales). Collabore étroitement avec le SCP (Portfolio Clinical Safety) afin de répondre aux attentes en matière d'innocuité clinique et de fournir une interprétation médicale et scientifique des nouvelles données cliniques et non cliniques sur l'innocuité.

Qui vous êtes :

• un professionnel de la santé qualifié ou un diplômé en sciences de la vie et un minimum de 10 ans d'expérience en développement de médicaments dans l'industrie pharmaceutique ou l'industrie connexe, y compris au moins 5 ans en sécurité des médicaments; une compréhension par des experts des aspects scientifiques de l'innocuité, de la pharmacovigilance et de la gestion des risques cliniques/patients avec une connaissance démontrable des exigences en matière de VPH, de PCG et de RCT;

• 10 ans et plus d'expérience en développement de médicaments cliniques dans l'industrie biopharmaceutique ou dans un secteur connexe (p. ex. les universités, les ORC, etc.); de préférence, inclure au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle lié à l'innocuité des médicaments cliniques.

• Il est essentiel de démontrer que les experts comprennent les aspects scientifiques de la sécurité, du VP et de la gestion des risques cliniques/patients (p. ex., par une connaissance démontrable de l'application des exigences en matière de VPG, de PCG et de RTC).

• Capacité démontrée de diriger et d'influencer, avec et sans autorité, dans une matrice globale environnementale

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Internal Job Ad Text
A healthier future is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity
The Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Applications Specialist you will:

• Acting as the primary liaison/customer representative throughout the implementation process and future histology application support, Includes planning and coordination for the implementation and customer training, as well as problem-solving issues that arise for customers throughout the life cycle of the solution.

• Provide highly visible, self-supervised and self-directed, extensive on-site advisory customer support through the implementation of Roche Tissue instrumentation and tailored customer training on our Roche solutions to meet customer needs based on an individualized assessment of the customer’s personnel, organizational structure, workflow, and maximization of equipment capabilities, which may include: equipment, applications, systems, and IT solutions.

• Act as an advisor on customer issues and drive efficiencies & optimization for the customer and Roche through independent analysis and problem-solving. Additionally, will be responsible for increased sales revenue by identifying opportunities for new system consumables for clients (i.e. reagents, primary antibodies, bio-markers, software). Performs these job duties remotely and independently.

• Advanced and specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system, or equipment with regard to technologically advanced instruments and scientific applications. Requires specific training and certification.

• Utilizes independent judgment and discretion in the analysis of customer particularized needs and issues that arise both during and after the implementation process. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment, and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Independently analyzes and resolves most customer questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

• Regular and predictable attendance is an essential function of this highly responsible position.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.
The ideal candidate for this role will reside in Long Island, NY.
This is a field-based role on a national team - the primary territory is New York and out of state travel is expected for this position.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Information Technology, Computer Science, Chemistry, Biology or Clinical Laboratory or equivalent work experience.

• 3 + years of experience implementing and evaluating complex laboratory, IT products, medical diagnostic equipm

In qualità di azienda sanitaria focalizzata sulla ricerca, Roche è dedicata alla scoperta, allo sviluppo e alla fornitura di prodotti diagnostici e terapeutici innovativi. Con un impegno per lo sviluppo dei dipendenti e un ambiente di lavoro che valorizza il rispetto e l'empowerment, Roche offre interessanti prospettive di carriera per coloro che cercano di avere un impatto significativo sulla cura dei pazienti.

L'opportunità
La Roche Support Network è dedicata a fornire un supporto eccezionale ai clienti. Come specialista di applicazioni sul campo Lei:

• Agire come principale rappresentante di collegamento / cliente durante tutto il processo di implementazione e il futuro supporto di applicazione istologia, Include la pianificazione e il coordinamento per l'implementazione e la formazione dei clienti, nonché problemi di risoluzione che si presentano per i clienti durante tutto il ciclo di vita della soluzione.

• Fornire un supporto clienti altamente visibile, self-supervised e self-directed, ampio in loco attraverso l'implementazione della strumentazione Roche Tissue e la formazione su misura del cliente sulle nostre soluzioni Roche per soddisfare le esigenze del cliente in base a una valutazione individualizzata del personale del cliente, struttura organizzativa, flusso di lavoro, e la massimizzazione delle capacità di attrezzature, che possono includere: attrezzature, applicazioni, sistemi e soluzioni IT.

• Agire come consulente sui problemi del cliente e guidare le efficienze e l'ottimizzazione per il cliente e Roche attraverso l'analisi indipendente e problem-solving. Inoltre, sarà responsabile di maggiori ricavi di vendita identificando opportunità per nuovi materiali di consumo per i clienti (ossia reagenti, anticorpi primari, biomarcatori, software). Esegui questi compiti da remoto e indipendentemente.

• Conoscenza avanzata e specializzata in genere di una particolare area, sistema o attrezzature per quanto riguarda strumenti tecnologicamente avanzati e applicazioni scientifiche. Richiede formazione e certificazione specifici.

• Utilizza giudizio indipendente e discrezione nell'analisi delle esigenze e delle problematiche del cliente che si presentano sia durante che dopo il processo di implementazione. Può adattare procedure, processi, strumenti, attrezzature e tecniche per soddisfare i requisiti più complessi della posizione. Analizza e risolve in modo indipendente la maggior parte delle domande e dei problemi dei clienti e si riferisce solo ai problemi più complessi a livelli più elevati.

• Responsabile del mantenimento e del miglioramento continuo del sistema di qualità e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi di qualità attraverso azioni quotidiane.

• La frequenza regolare e prevedibile è una funzione essenziale di questa posizione altamente responsabile.

I benefici di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa pubblicazione di lavoro.
Il candidato ideale per questo ruolo risiederà a Long Island, NY.
Questo è un ruolo basato sul campo in una squadra nazionale - il territorio primario è New York e fuori dai viaggi statali è previsto per questa posizione.

Chi sei

• Laurea in tecnologia medica, tecnologia dell'informazione, informatica, chimica, biologia o laboratorio clinico o esperienza lavorativa equivalente.

• 3 + anni di esperienza di attuazione e valutazione di laboratorio complesso, prodotti IT, apparecchiature diagnostiche mediche

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Internal Job Ad Text
A healthier future is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

The Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

The Opportunity
The Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Applications Specialist you will:

• Acting as the primary liaison/customer representative throughout the implementation process and future histology application support, Includes planning and coordination for the implementation and customer training, as well as problem-solving issues that arise for customers throughout the life cycle of the solution.

• Provide highly visible, self-supervised and self-directed, extensive on-site advisory customer support through the implementation of Roche Tissue instrumentation and tailored customer training on our Roche solutions to meet customer needs based on an individualized assessment of the customer’s personnel, organizational structure, workflow, and maximization of equipment capabilities, which may include: equipment, applications, systems, and IT solutions.

• Act as an advisor on customer issues and drive efficiencies & optimization for the customer and Roche through independent analysis and problem-solving. Additionally, will be responsible for increased sales revenue by identifying opportunities for new system consumables for clients (i.e. reagents, primary antibodies, bio-markers, software). Performs these job duties remotely and independently.

• Advanced and specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system, or equipment with regard to technologically advanced instruments and scientific applications. Requires specific training and certification.

• Utilizes independent judgment and discretion in the analysis of customer particularized needs and issues that arise both during and after the implementation process. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment, and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Independently analyzes and resolves most customer questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.

• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.

• Regular and predictable attendance is an essential function of this highly responsible position.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.
The ideal candidate for this role will reside in Long Island, NY.
This is a field-based role on a national team - the primary territory is New York and out of state travel is expected for this position.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Information Technology, Computer Science, Chemistry, Biology or Clinical Laboratory or equivalent work experience.

• 3 + years of experience implementing and evaluating complex laboratory, IT products, medical diagnostic equipm
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

Interner Job Ad Text
Eine gesündere Zukunft ist es, die uns zu Innovationen antreibt. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Das Roche Support Network bietet eine spannende Gelegenheit für Menschen, die sich für Problemlösungen begeistern. Als forschungsorientiertes Gesundheitsunternehmen widmet sich Roche der Entdeckung, Entwicklung und Bereitstellung innovativer Diagnostik- und Therapieprodukte. Mit einem Engagement für die Mitarbeiterentwicklung und einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Respekt und Empowerment wertschätzt, bietet Roche spannende Karriereperspektiven für diejenigen, die einen signifikanten Einfluss auf die Patientenversorgung haben wollen.

Die Chance
Das Roche Support Network widmet sich der außergewöhnlichen Unterstützung der Kunden. Als Spezialist für Feldanwendungen werden Sie:

• Als primärer Verbindungspartner / Kundenvertreter während des gesamten Implementierungsprozesses und der zukünftigen Unterstützung von Histologieanwendungen umfasst dies die Planung und Koordination für die Implementierung und Kundenschulung sowie Problemlösungsprobleme, die sich für Kunden während des gesamten Lebenszyklus der Lösung ergeben.

• Bieten Sie eine gut sichtbare, selbstüberwachte und selbstgesteuerte, umfassende Kundenbetreuung vor Ort durch die Implementierung von Roche Tissue-Instrumenten und maßgeschneiderte Kundenschulungen für unsere Roche-Lösungen, um die Kundenbedürfnisse zu erfüllen, basierend auf einer individuellen Bewertung des Personals, der Organisationsstruktur, des Workflows und der Maximierung der Ausrüstungsfähigkeiten des Kunden, die Folgendes umfassen können: Ausrüstung, Anwendungen, Systeme und IT-Lösungen.

• Handeln Sie als Berater in Kundenfragen und steigern Sie die Effizienz und Optimierung für den Kunden und Roche durch unabhängige Analyse und Problemlösung. Darüber hinaus wird er für höhere Umsatzerlöse verantwortlich sein, indem er Möglichkeiten für neue Systemverbrauchsmaterialien für Kunden identifiziert (z. B. Reagenzien, Primärantikörper, Biomarker, Software). Führt diese Aufgaben aus der Ferne und unabhängig aus.

• Fortgeschrittene und spezialisierte Kenntnisse im Allgemeinen eines bestimmten Bereichs, Systems oder Geräts in Bezug auf technologisch fortschrittliche Instrumente und wissenschaftliche Anwendungen. Erfordert eine spezifische Ausbildung und Zertifizierung.

• Nutzt unabhängiges Urteilsvermögen und Diskretion bei der Analyse kundenspezifischer Bedürfnisse und Probleme, die sowohl während als auch nach dem Implementierungsprozess auftreten. Kann Verfahren, Prozesse, Werkzeuge, Ausrüstung und Techniken anpassen, um die komplexeren Anforderungen der Position zu erfüllen. Analysiert und löst unabhängig die meisten Kundenfragen und -probleme und verweist nur die komplexesten Probleme auf höhere Ebenen.

• Verantwortlich für die Aufrechterhaltung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung des Qualitätssystems und die Erreichung der Qualitätsziele durch tägliches Handeln.

• Regelmäßige und vorhersehbare Anwesenheit ist eine wesentliche Funktion dieser hochverantwortlichen Position.

Umzugsleistungen sind für diese Stellenausschreibung nicht verfügbar.
Der ideale Kandidat für diese Rolle wird in Long Island, NY, wohnen.
Dies ist eine feldbasierte Rolle in einer Nationalmannschaft - das primäre Territorium ist New York und für diese Position werden staatliche Reisen erwartet.

Wer du bist

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Medizintechnik, Informationstechnologie, Informatik, Chemie, Biologie oder Klinisches Labor oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung.

• 3 + Jahre Erfahrung bei der Implementierung und Bewertung komplexer Labore, IT-Produkte, medizinischer Diagnosegeräte
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Texte de la publicité interne
Un avenir plus sain est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

Le Roche Support Network offre une opportunité passionnante aux personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes. En tant qu'entreprise de santé axée sur la recherche, Roche se consacre à la découverte, au développement et à la fourniture de diagnostics et de produits thérapeutiques innovants. Avec un engagement envers le perfectionnement des employés et un milieu de travail qui valorise le respect et l'autonomisation, Roche offre des perspectives de carrière stimulantes à ceux qui cherchent à avoir un impact significatif sur les soins aux patients.

L'opportunité
Le Roche Support Network est dédié à fournir un soutien exceptionnel aux clients. En tant que spécialiste des applications sur le terrain, vous devrez :

• Fonctionnant en tant que principal représentant de liaison/client tout au long du processus de mise en oeuvre et du futur soutien à l'application en histologie, Comprend la planification et la coordination pour la mise en oeuvre et la formation des clients, ainsi que les problèmes de résolution de problèmes qui se posent aux clients tout au long du cycle de vie de la solution.

• Fournir un soutien client hautement visible, auto-supervisé et auto-dirigé, vaste conseil sur place grâce à la mise en œuvre de l'instrumentation Roche Tissue et une formation sur mesure sur nos solutions Roche pour répondre aux besoins des clients sur la base d'une évaluation individualisée du personnel du client, de la structure organisationnelle, du flux de travail et de la maximisation des capacités d'équipement, qui peuvent comprendre : équipements, applications, systèmes et solutions informatiques.

• Agir en tant que conseiller sur les questions client et stimuler l'efficacité et l'optimisation pour le client et Roche par une analyse indépendante et la résolution de problèmes. De plus, il sera responsable de l'augmentation des recettes de vente en identifiant les possibilités de nouveaux consommables pour les clients (réactifs, anticorps primaires, biomarqueurs, logiciels). Exécute ces tâches à distance et indépendamment.

• Connaissances avancées et spécialisées généralement d'un domaine, d'un système ou d'un équipement particulier en ce qui concerne les instruments et applications scientifiques technologiquement avancés. Nécessite une formation et une certification spécifiques.

• Utilise le jugement indépendant et la discrétion dans l'analyse des besoins et des problèmes particuliers des clients qui se posent pendant et après le processus de mise en oeuvre. Peut adapter les procédures, les processus, les outils, l'équipement et les techniques pour répondre aux exigences plus complexes du poste. Analyse et résout de façon indépendante la plupart des questions et des problèmes des clients et renvoie uniquement les problèmes les plus complexes à des niveaux plus élevés.

• Responsable du maintien et de l'amélioration continue du système de qualité et de la réalisation des objectifs de qualité par des actions quotidiennes.

• Une présence régulière et prévisible est une fonction essentielle de ce poste hautement responsable.

Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour cette affectation.
Le candidat idéal pour ce rôle résidera à Long Island, NY.
Il s'agit d'un rôle sur le terrain au sein d'une équipe nationale - le principal territoire est New York et les voyages hors État sont attendus pour ce poste.

Qui vous êtes

• Baccalauréat en technologie médicale, technologie de l'information, informatique, chimie, biologie ou laboratoire clinique ou expérience de travail équivalente.

• 3 + ans d'expérience dans la mise en œuvre et l'évaluation de laboratoires complexes, produits informatiques, équipement de diagnostic médical

jobs.title: MC Automation Intern
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

• Remains current in organic synthesis. Explores synthetic routes to specific target compounds with the assistance of supervisors. Has good understanding of the reactivity and functional group compatibility of intermediates and reagents employed, and is able to identify and solve many reaction problems.

• Prepares, scales up and purify new compounds and known compounds for in vitro and in vivo evaluation in a timely manner. Maintains an accurate and current lab notebook and analytical data according; records all necessary information.

• Understands and effectively conducts laboratory experiments utilizing established internal and existing literature procedures. Evaluates and solves synthetic problems with the assistance of supervisors; characterizes reaction products. Is a skilled user of all standard laboratory apparatus for synthesis and purification.

• Writes up experimental procedures and data for publication or patent filing.

• Shares information about results and status of work in an accurate, timely and proactive manner within the lab team, and upon request within the chemistry project team.

• Understands infrastructure of chemistry department and neighboring disciplines and knows whom to contact to find solutions. Demonstrates initiative, resourcefulness and teamwork.

• Daily operation of automation platform, consumables management.

• Assist automation team to arrange the work tasks of the platform.

• Participate in the automation platform maintenance.

• Maintains a safe and organized work environment. Complies with relevant SOP’s.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

• Rimane corrente nella sintesi organica. Esplora percorsi sintetici per specifici composti target con l'assistenza di supervisori. Ha una buona comprensione della reattività e della compatibilità del gruppo funzionale degli intermedi e dei reagenti impiegati, ed è in grado di identificare e risolvere molti problemi di reazione.

• Prepara, scala e purifica nuovi composti e composti noti per la valutazione in vitro e in vivo in modo tempestivo. Mantiene un taccuino di laboratorio accurato e attuale e dati analitici secondo; registra tutte le informazioni necessarie.

• Comprende e conduce efficacemente esperimenti di laboratorio utilizzando procedure di letteratura interne e esistenti stabilite. Valuta e risolve problemi sintetici con l'assistenza dei supervisori; caratterizza i prodotti di reazione. È un utente esperto di tutti gli apparati di laboratorio standard per la sintesi e la purificazione.

• Scrive procedure e dati sperimentali per la pubblicazione o il deposito di brevetti.

• Condivide informazioni sui risultati e lo stato del lavoro in modo accurato, tempestivo e proattivo all'interno del team di laboratorio, e su richiesta all'interno del team di progetto di chimica.

• Comprende l'infrastruttura del dipartimento di chimica e le discipline vicine e sa chi contattare per trovare soluzioni. Dimostra iniziativa, risorse e lavoro di squadra.

• Funzionamento quotidiano della piattaforma di automazione, gestione dei materiali di consumo.

• Assist team di automazione per organizzare i compiti di lavoro della piattaforma.

• Partecipa alla manutenzione della piattaforma di automazione.

• Mantiene un ambiente di lavoro sicuro e organizzato. Conforme a SOP rilevanti.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

Bewertet und löst synthetische Probleme mit Hilfe von Supervisoren; charakterisiert Reaktionsprodukte. Ist ein erfahrener Benutzer aller Standard-Laborgeräte für Synthese und Reinigung.

• Teilen Sie Informationen über Ergebnisse und Status der Arbeit in einer genauen, rechtzeitigen und proaktiven Weise innerhalb des Laborteams und auf Anfrage innerhalb des Chemie-Projektteams.

• Versteht die Infrastruktur der Chemieabteilung und der benachbarten Disziplinen und weiß, an wen Sie sich wenden müssen, um Lösungen zu finden. Zeigt Initiative, Einfallsreichtum und Teamwork.

• Täglicher Betrieb der Automatisierungsplattform, Verbrauchsmaterialmanagement.

• Unterstützen Sie das Automatisierungsteam bei der Organisation der Arbeitsaufgaben der Plattform.

• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Wartung der Automatisierungsplattform.

• Unterhält eine sichere und organisierte Arbeitsumgebung. Entspricht den relevanten SOPs.

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

jobs.title: Record to Report PEC SME
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Record to Report PEC SME, you will play a central role in guiding end-to-end month-end closing, financial reporting, and continuous improvement across our shared services environment. Operating within a collaborative regional hub, you will ensure high standards of financial control, coach operational team members, and drive process optimization that supports our broader mission in global healthcare.

In this impactful role, you will:

• Drive Financial & Close Accuracy: Monitor month-end, quarter-end, and year-end progress against close schedules, ensuring accurate journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and reporting deliverables.

• Manage Operational Issues & Risks: Act as the first point of escalation for complex accounting inquiries, guiding root-cause investigations and coordinating with cross-functional partners in Finance, Business, and IT.

• Oversee Financial Controls: Champion compliance with internal financial reporting controls, group policies, and statutory requirements, ensuring process documentation and audit trails remain current.

• Advance Transformation & CI: Identify recurring operational pain points and lead continuous improvement, automation, and standardization projects to increase efficiency and data quality.

• Coach & Support Team Capability: Provide daily coaching and technical guidance to financial analysts, reviewing work quality, facilitating cross-training, and fostering a collaborative team culture.

• Facilitate Audit & Governance: Coordinate internal and external audit requirements, ensuring timely submission of schedules, evidence, and clear responses to queries.

Who You Are
You are an analytical, solution-oriented finance professional with strong communication skills and an inspiring leadership approach. You excel at coaching peers, navigating complex accounting processes, and managing priorities in a dynamic, high-performing environment.

Your Qualifications:

• Educational Background: You hold a University Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. A professional accounting qualification (e.g., CPA, ACCA) is an advantage.

• Professional Experience: You bring a minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in financial accounting, general ledger operations, or financial reporting. Experience within a Shared Services Center (SSC) or Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) environment is highly desirable.

• Technical Savvy: You possess strong working knowledge of enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems (such as SAP) alongside advanced proficiency in spreadsheet software and digital productivity tools.

• Process Leadership: You demonstrate experience or strong capability in project management, operational issue resolution, or supervising financial close cycles.

• Communication & Collaboration: You have exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with a collaborative spirit and a customer-service mindset.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
À titre de document pour rapporter les PME PEC, vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'orientation de la clôture de fin de mois, de l'information financière et de l'amélioration continue de notre environnement de services partagés. Fonctionnant au sein d'un pôle régional collaboratif, vous assurerez des normes élevées de contrôle financier, coacherez les membres de l'équipe opérationnelle et pilotez l'optimisation des processus qui soutient notre mission plus large dans le domaine des soins de santé mondiaux.

Dans ce rôle déterminant, vous devrez :

• Inclure l'exactitude financière et de clôture : surveiller les progrès en fin de mois, en fin de trimestre et en fin d'exercice par rapport aux calendriers de clôture, en assurant l'exactitude des écritures des journaux, des rapprochements des bilans et des rapports livrables.

• Gérer les enjeux opérationnels et les risques : agir comme premier point d'escalade pour les enquêtes comptables complexes, orienter les enquêtes sur les causes profondes et coordonner avec les partenaires interfonctionnels des finances, des affaires et des TI.

• Advance Transformation & IC: Identifier des points de douleur opérationnelle récurrents et diriger des projets d'amélioration continue, d'automatisation et de normalisation pour accroître l'efficacité et la qualité des données.

• Capacité de l'équipe d'entraîneurs et de soutien : Fournir un encadrement quotidien et des conseils techniques aux analystes financiers, examiner la qualité du travail, faciliter la formation croisée et favoriser une culture d'équipe collaborative.

• Faciliter la vérification et la gouvernance : Coordonner les exigences en matière de vérification interne et externe, assurer la présentation en temps opportun des calendriers, des éléments probants et des réponses claires aux questions.

Qui vous êtes
Vous êtes un professionnel de la finance analytique, orienté vers la solution avec de solides compétences en communication et une approche de leadership inspirante. Vous excellez dans l'encadrement des pairs, la navigation des processus comptables complexes et la gestion des priorités dans un environnement dynamique et performant.

Vos qualifications :

• Contexte éducatif : Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire en comptabilité, en finances ou dans un domaine connexe. Une qualification en comptabilité professionnelle (p. ex. CPA, ACCA) est un avantage.

• Expérience professionnelle: Vous apportez un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience progressive dans la comptabilité financière, les opérations du grand livre général, ou l'information financière. L'expérience au sein d'un environnement de centre de services partagés (SSC) ou d'externalisation des processus opérationnels (BPO) est hautement souhaitable.

• Technical Savvy: Vous possédez une solide connaissance pratique des systèmes de planification des ressources (RPE) (comme SAP) ainsi qu'une compétence avancée dans les logiciels de tableur et les outils de productivité numérique.

• Leadership du processus : Vous démontrez votre expérience ou votre solide capacité en gestion de projet, en résolution de problèmes opérationnels ou en supervision des cycles de clôture financière.

• Communication et collaboration : Vous avez des compétences exceptionnelles en communication écrite et verbale en anglais, avec un esprit de collaboration et un état d'esprit de service client.

Laissez-les prospérer ensemble dans une culture fondée sur la confiance, la collaboration, le respect et la haute performance.

Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. The Position
Roche is a global healthcare company offering exceptional career paths for outstanding professionals to be inspired and empowered. Talents like you will make an impact that matters for society. We are continuously expanding and offer hybrid work arrangements with exciting opportunities to join our transforming team at Roche Diagnostics.
Grow with us and be part of a company where purpose, diversity, flexibility, equal opportunity, and benefits meet to create an amazing workplace for you .

About the Customer Innovation & Consulting Partner:

You will be reporting to Customer Innovation & Consulting Lead and this role required to have deep understanding and experience with In-Vitro Diagnostics Solutions and technology trends in the Healthcare industry and also will focus on strategic innovative products by

• Implementation, training and support the digital solution product

• Healthcare consulting for key stakeholders both external and internal with the aim of driving the transformation of Healthcare systems

• Digital product marketing in the Malaysia market.

In this position, you will be in a key role to help shape and enable the Roche Diagnostics Malaysia strategy, and contribute to the overall Roche Diagnostics vision.
You demonstrate personal purpose around improving the healthcare ecosystem thinking from an enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, to bring the best possible outcomes to the health environment; creating better health outcomes for more patients faster, and by bringing a strong entrepreneurial mentality with outstanding partnering capabilities.

As a qualified Partner, you:

• Proactively drives for continuous improvement and simplification of processes across the Digital IT support spectrum & get the good practices for Digital Solutions implementations.

• Able to analyze data generated from digital solutions and provide insights/action recommendations from the data analysis.

• Deliver consultancy services to the customers by providing the brief, reviewing the draft or drafting proposals and providing input.

• Create mutually beneficial business partnerships/arrangements with the customers by identifying, researching, analyzing and making recommendations and negotiating strategic alliances

• Drive new business by identifying, analyzing and comparing alternative opportunities for entering new markets and adopting new consulting services

• Create a shared vision with the customer team by supporting them with change management and implementation

• Resolve complex customer problems by looking beyond existing methodologies and own discipline to define and facilitate implementation of solutions

• Analyses the evolving market environment, develops the strategy such as customer segmentations, positioning, branding, messaging, PR/communications, pricing strategy and ensures effective rollout of strategy to the marketplace.

• Assist in the development of a yearly Marketing Plan which outlines marketing strategies and development and implementation of business strategies to achieve profitable relationships and identify potential opportunities with major accounts across the Business Area.

What can you bring to our team:

• Passion for the healthcare industry –good understanding of how the healthcare industry operates and the unique characteristics of the industry ecosystem

• Experience and success in negotiating complex deals & partnerships with customers and partners

• Consistent record of building collaborative relationships with pe

jobs.title: Marketing Partner - Digital Solutions
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position Purpose
The Marketing Partner – Digital Solutions drives the commercial success, tender readiness, and market adoption of the navify® digital portfolio within Roche Diagnostics Malaysia.
Bridging commercial strategy, healthcare IT, and digital trust, this role handles marketing, pre-sales support, product evaluations, tender submissions, and customer cybersecurity/data privacy inquiries. You will translate complex digital concepts into compelling commercial value propositions for laboratory leadership, clinicians, and hospital IT stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Marketing & Portfolio Management

• Drive strategic marketing and product lifecycle management for the navify® digital portfolio to drive local adoption and revenue growth in Malaysia.

• Translate complex digital and technical concepts into compelling commercial value propositions for both laboratory leadership and enterprise IT executives.

• Exercise customer-centric business thinking, addressing customer needs ranging from overarching commercial strategy to complex operational, technical integration, and IT security challenges.

• Conduct market intelligence, competitive analysis, and customer segment profiling to identify new growth opportunities across both public and private healthcare sectors.

• Lead promotional campaigns, customer workshops, participation in industry congresses, and capability building for local commercial teams to build brand authority in digital health.

2. Pre-Sales, Tender Execution & Security Compliance

• Drive end-to-end tender execution and pre-sales engagement, preparing technical and commercial proposals and organizing product evaluations.

• Address customer cybersecurity and data privacy requirements, acting as the primary point of contact for hospital vendor data security and data protection during tender and procurement processes.

• Define and present business ROI models, operational efficiency gains, and secure cloud/on-premise deployment benefits to customer decision-makers.

3. Launch Excellence

• Drive and support launch excellence across Malaysia using the Roche Launch Powerhouse (LPH) framework.

• Support local squad teams (including cross-functional teams from sales, IT, application specialists, and regulatory/quality) to ensure commercial readiness, technical compliance, and successful local market adoption of new navify® modules.

4. Lifecycle & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as the Single Point of Contact and Subject Matter Expert for all commercial and product discussions regarding the assigned navify® digital portfolio in Malaysia.

• Collect, synthesize, and prioritize inputs from local end-customers—covering customer/product requirements, release priorities, feature trade-offs, cybersecurity standards, data privacy considerations, and key technical issues—to share with regional (APAC) and global digital product teams.

• Facilitate seamless technical and commercial alignment between local customer IT/infosec teams and regional digital squads to ensure smooth software deployment and lifecycle maintenance.

Qualifications & Experienc e

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, Computer Science, Biomedical Science, Health Informatics, or a related field.

• Experience Level: Fresh graduates with a strong interest in healthcare technology, or candidates with 1–3 years of early career experience in commercial, pre-sales, IT consultancy, or product marketing roles.

• Commercial Mindset:

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Oggetto
Il Marketing Partner – Digital Solutions guida il successo commerciale, la disponibilità tenera e l'adozione di mercato del portafoglio digitale navify® all'interno di Roche Diagnostics Malesia.
La strategia commerciale, l'IT sanitario e la fiducia digitale, questo ruolo gestisce il marketing, il supporto pre-vendita, le valutazioni dei prodotti, le offerte, e le richieste di privacy per la sicurezza informatica/dati del cliente. Tradurrete concetti digitali complessi in convincenti proposizioni di valore commerciale per la leadership di laboratorio, medici e stakeholder IT ospedalieri.

Principali responsabilità

1. Marketing strategico e gestione del portafoglio

• Guidare il marketing strategico e la gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto per il portafoglio digitale navify® per guidare l'adozione locale e la crescita dei ricavi in Malesia.

• Traduci concetti digitali e tecnici complessi in convincenti proposizioni di valore commerciale sia per la leadership di laboratorio che per i dirigenti IT aziendali.

• Esercitare il pensiero aziendale orientato al cliente, affrontare le esigenze del cliente che vanno dalla strategia commerciale di overarching alle complesse sfide operative, di integrazione tecnica e di sicurezza IT.

• Condurre l'intelligenza del mercato, l'analisi competitiva e la profilazione del segmento cliente per identificare nuove opportunità di crescita sia nel settore sanitario pubblico che privato.

• Piombo campagne promozionali, workshop dei clienti, partecipazione ai congressi del settore e costruzione di capacità per i team commerciali locali per costruire l'autorità del marchio nella salute digitale.

2. Pre-Sales, Esecuzione e conformità di sicurezza

• Guidare l'esecuzione dell'offerta end-to-end e l'impegno pre-vendita, la preparazione di proposte tecniche e commerciali e l'organizzazione delle valutazioni dei prodotti.

• Rivolgersi ai requisiti di sicurezza informatica e privacy dei dati del cliente, agendo come punto primario di contatto per la sicurezza dei dati del fornitore dell'ospedale e la protezione dei dati durante i processi di appalto e di appalto.

• Definire e presentare modelli ROI aziendali, guadagni di efficienza operativa e vantaggi di distribuzione cloud/on-premise sicuro ai decisori del cliente.

3. Eccellenza del lancio

• Guida e supporta l'eccellenza di lancio in Malesia utilizzando il framework Roche Launch Powerhouse (LPH).

• Sostenere i team di squadra locali (inclusi i team interfunzionali delle vendite, IT, specialisti delle applicazioni e normativi/qualità) per garantire la disponibilità commerciale, la conformità tecnica e l'adozione del mercato locale di nuovi moduli navify®.

4. Gestione del ciclo di vita e degli stakeholder

• Servire come singolo punto di contatto e soggetto esperto di materia per tutte le discussioni commerciali e di prodotto relative al portafoglio digitale navify® assegnato in Malesia.

• Raccogliere, sintetizzare e dare priorità agli input dei clienti finali locali, coprendo i requisiti del cliente/prodotto, rilasciando priorità, caratteristiche trade-off, standard di sicurezza informatica, considerazioni sulla privacy dei dati e questioni tecniche chiave, per condividere con i team regionali (APAC) e di prodotti digitali globali.

• Facilita l'allineamento tecnico e commerciale senza soluzione di continuità tra i team IT/infosec del cliente locale e le squadre digitali regionali per garantire un'implementazione del software fluida e la manutenzione del ciclo di vita.

Qualifiche e competenze

• Istruzione: Laurea in Business, Marketing, Information Technology, Informatica, Scienza biomedica, Informatica sanitaria, o un campo relativo.

• Livello di esperienza: laureati freschi con un forte interesse per la tecnologia sanitaria, o candidati con 1-3 anni di esperienza di carriera precoce in ruoli commerciali, pre-vendita, consulenza IT o marketing prodotto.

La position
Fonction
Le partenaire marketing – Solutions numériques est à l'origine du succès commercial, de la disponibilité des appels d'offres et de l'adoption du portefeuille numérique navify® de Roche Diagnostics Malaysia.
Combler la stratégie commerciale, la TI des soins de santé et la confiance numérique, ce rôle s'occupe du marketing, du soutien prévente, de l'évaluation des produits, des soumissions et des demandes de renseignements sur la cybersécurité et la confidentialité des données des clients. Vous allez traduire des concepts numériques complexes en propositions de valeur commerciale convaincantes pour le leadership de laboratoire, les cliniciens et les intervenants en TI de l'hôpital.

Principales responsabilités

1. Marketing stratégique et gestion de portefeuille

• Diriger le marketing stratégique et la gestion du cycle de vie des produits pour le portefeuille numérique navify® afin de stimuler l'adoption locale et la croissance des revenus en Malaisie.

• Traduire des concepts numériques et techniques complexes en propositions de valeur commerciale convaincantes pour le leadership de laboratoire et les cadres informatiques d'entreprise.

• Exercer une réflexion d'affaires centrée sur le client, en répondant aux besoins du client, allant de la stratégie commerciale globale aux défis complexes d'exploitation, d'intégration technique et de sécurité informatique.

• Mener des activités d'intelligence du marché, d'analyse concurrentielle et de profilage du segment client afin de cerner de nouvelles possibilités de croissance dans les secteurs public et privé des soins de santé.

• Mener des campagnes promotionnelles, des ateliers pour les clients, participer à des congrès de l'industrie et renforcer les capacités des équipes commerciales locales pour renforcer l'autorité de la marque dans le domaine de la santé numérique.

2. Prévente, exécution des appels d'offres et conformité à la sécurité

• Conduire l'exécution des appels d'offres de bout en bout et l'engagement avant la vente, préparer des propositions techniques et commerciales et organiser des évaluations de produits.

• Répondre aux exigences des clients en matière de cybersécurité et de confidentialité des données, agissant en tant que principal point de contact pour la sécurité des données des fournisseurs d'hôpital et la protection des données pendant les processus d'appel d'offres et d'approvisionnement.

• Définir et présenter des modèles de ROI d'affaires, des gains d'efficacité opérationnelle et des avantages de déploiement sécurisés pour les décideurs clients.

3. Lancer Excellence

• Conduire et soutenir l'excellence de lancement dans toute la Malaisie en utilisant le cadre Roche Launch Powerhouse (LPH).

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Technical Product Owner - Digital Health Platform, Secure Cloud

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Roche’s expanding digital product portfolio demonstrates its commitment to provide healthcare professionals, laboratories, and patients with digital and digitally-enabled solutions that transform patient care. The existing product portfolio includes decision support systems, data management solutions, and workflow solutions. At the center of these diverse types of solutions is always patient data security and privacy as the highest priority for Roche.

In this context, Roche has built a global team that builds, secures, and operates infrastructure platforms (cloud and on-prem) for its digital products. This team is working with a high freedom to operate in a self-organized setup and is responsible for tackling the cybersecurity, compliance, and infrastructure challenges of the healthcare industry while enabling high-velocity product development.

The opportunity:
The Technical Product Owner will join the Secure Account Management (SAM) team - responsible for cloud infrastructure, account provisioning, security, and governance across Roche's digital product portfolio. The team manages 650+ AWS accounts and enables application teams to build and operate healthcare solutions by providing secure, standardized infrastructure while maintaining development and deployment autonomy.
This role sits at the intersection of product thinking and cloud engineering. You will own the product roadmap and backlog for SAM's cloud and services portfolio, translating the needs of digital health product teams into a platform that is secure, self-service, and well-documented. The platform delivers compliant AWS landing zones integrated with a modern cybersecurity backbone, providing guardrails for hosted applications across AWS regions worldwide - and is evolving toward supporting external partners and third-party consumers.

What you will do:

• Own, prioritise, and communicate the product roadmap for SAM's cloud landing zone and associated services - balancing security, compliance, developer experience, and self-service.

• Act as the voice of platform customers (internal product teams and, increasingly, external partners): gather feedback, represent the platform in PI planning sessions, and maintain transparency on request lifecycle and prioritisation decisions.

• Drive platform evolution toward self-service and automation - reducing manual ticket-based workflows in favour of programmatic access, Infrastructure-as-Code, and API-first interfaces.

La posizione

Titolare del prodotto tecnico - Digital Health Platform, Secure Cloud

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) è dove l'innovazione incontra lo scopo. Come team globale nel cuore di Roche, siamo una comunità di tecnologi business-minded impegnati a contribuire a plasmare il futuro digitale della salute di domani. La nostra missione è quella di alimentare Roche attraverso tecnologie digitali all'avanguardia, sfruttando le potenzialità dell'intelligenza artificiale, dei dati e delle innovazioni tecnologiche scalabili. Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo.

A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi.

Il portafoglio di prodotti digitali in espansione di Roche dimostra il suo impegno a fornire professionisti sanitari, laboratori e pazienti con soluzioni digitali e digitalmente abilitate che trasformano la cura del paziente. Il portafoglio di prodotti esistente comprende sistemi di supporto decisionale, soluzioni di gestione dei dati e soluzioni di flusso di lavoro. Al centro di questi diversi tipi di soluzioni è sempre paziente sicurezza dei dati e la privacy come la massima priorità per Roche.

In questo contesto, Roche ha costruito un team globale che costruisce, protegge e gestisce piattaforme infrastrutturali (cloud e on-prem) per i suoi prodotti digitali. Questo team sta lavorando con una grande libertà di operare in una configurazione auto-organizzata ed è responsabile per affrontare le sfide della sicurezza informatica, della conformità e delle infrastrutture del settore sanitario, consentendo allo sviluppo di prodotti ad alta velocità.

L'opportunità:
Il Titolare del Prodotto Tecnico si unirà al team Secure Account Management (SAM) - responsabile dell'infrastruttura cloud, dell'erogazione di account, della sicurezza e della governance nel portafoglio prodotti digitali di Roche. Il team gestisce 650+ account AWS e consente ai team applicativi di costruire e gestire soluzioni sanitarie fornendo infrastrutture sicure e standardizzate mantenendo allo stesso tempo l'autonomia di sviluppo e distribuzione.
Questo ruolo si trova all'incrocio tra pensiero del prodotto e ingegneria cloud. Avrete la roadmap del prodotto e il backlog per il portafoglio cloud e servizi di SAM, traducendo le esigenze dei team di prodotti per la salute digitale in una piattaforma sicura, self-service e ben documentata. La piattaforma offre zone di atterraggio AWS conformi integrate con una moderna spina dorsale di sicurezza informatica, fornendo guardrails per le applicazioni ospitate in tutte le regioni di AWS in tutto il mondo - e si sta evolvendo verso il supporto di partner esterni e consumatori di terze parti.

Cosa farai:

• Possedere, dare priorità e comunicare la roadmap del prodotto per la zona di atterraggio cloud di SAM e i servizi associati - bilanciamento della sicurezza, conformità, esperienza dello sviluppatore e self-service.

• Agire come voce dei clienti della piattaforma ( team di prodotti interni e, sempre più, partner esterni): raccogliere feedback, rappresentare la piattaforma nelle sessioni di pianificazione PI, e mantenere la trasparenza su richiesta ciclo di vita e decisioni di priorità.

• Evoluzione della piattaforma di trasmissione verso self-service e automazione - riduzione dei flussi di lavoro manuali basati sui biglietti a favore di accessi programmatici, interfacce Infrastructure-as-Code e API-first.

• Ah!
