Vous travaillerez de façon indépendante pour vous assurer que les études sont livrées, enregistrées et déclarées conformément aux protocoles, aux procédures opérationnelles normalisées et aux directives réglementaires mondiales.

• Travailler dans des équipes d'étude locales et mondiales, y compris des équipes virtuelles et exposer la diversité et la sensibilisation culturelle.

• Établir et maintenir des relations de collaboration solides avec les membres de l'équipe interfonctionnelle.

• Connaissance de l'organisation Roche et des principaux moteurs organisationnels ainsi que des processus, clients et produits pertinents liés à sa propre discipline

• Fournir des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe

• Résoudre les problèmes potentiellement complexes en analysant les solutions possibles en utilisant l'expérience, le jugement et les précédents

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Healthcare is changing: Novel personalized treatments, increasing patient empowerment, multiple channels of information, lack of resources in healthcare and pressure on public spending are key themes driving the change. As a result of this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.

As the Patient Journey Partner Hematology (PJP) you will collaborate closely with all Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) directly impacting the patient journey within a specific therapeutic or disease area. Operating within a cross-functional business team, you are accountable for gaining and applying a deep understanding of patient needs, their environment and the stakeholders who serve them. This deep understanding is crucial for driving maximum value for patients, the healthcare system and Roche.

You are the external face of Roche and a central link within the organization, bringing in actionable customer insights. Empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, this unique position allows you to drive value creation—by both offering world-class therapies and co-create with stakeholders on meaningful solutions. Ultimately, the PJP is directly accountable for delivering better outcomes for patients, the ecosystem and the organization faster. This is achieved primarily through consistent, strategic and high-impact external engagement with HCPs, aiming to accelerate the broad patient access and clinical adoption of Roche's therapies.

This role is local and field based, characterized by a high degree of external focus. A minimum of 80% of the working time is dedicated to customer-facing activities (e.g., meeting preparation, customer visits, and reporting of visits/insights).

The Opportunity

• Establish Strategic Networks & Partnerships: Act as the Primary Point of Contact (PPOC) and trusted partner for HCPs and key accounts across the patient journey. Build and nurture long-term external networks, ensuring positive engagement experiences with Roche's employees, products, and services.

• Drive Product Positioning and Clinical Adoption: Position Roche products appropriately and with conviction and confidence, catalysing necessary changes in clinical practice.

• Co-create Meaningful Solutions: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities. Co-create meaningful solutions that deliver maximum value for patients, the community, and Roche.

Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Das Gesundheitswesen verändert sich: Neuartige personalisierte Behandlungen, zunehmende Stärkung der Patientenkompetenz, mehrere Informationskanäle, fehlende Ressourcen im Gesundheitswesen und Druck auf die öffentlichen Ausgaben sind Schlüsselthemen, die den Wandel vorantreiben. Infolgedessen entwickeln sich die Bedürfnisse unserer Stakeholder weiter.

Als Patient Journey Partner Hematology (PJP) arbeiten Sie eng mit allen Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) zusammen, die sich direkt auf die Patientenreise in einem bestimmten Therapie- oder Krankheitsbereich auswirken. In einem funktionsübergreifenden Business-Team sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, ein tiefes Verständnis der Patientenbedürfnisse, ihrer Umgebung und der Stakeholder, die sie bedienen, zu erlangen und anzuwenden. Dieses tiefe Verständnis ist entscheidend für den maximalen Wert für Patienten, das Gesundheitssystem und Roche.

Sie sind das externe Gesicht von Roche und ein zentrales Bindeglied innerhalb der Organisation, das umsetzbare Kundeneinblicke einbringt. Diese einzigartige Position, die es Ihnen ermöglicht, Fachwissen und Ressourcen lokal und nach Bedarf aus dem Netzwerk zu beziehen, ermöglicht es Ihnen, die Wertschöpfung voranzutreiben - indem Sie sowohl Weltklasse-Therapien anbieten als auch gemeinsam mit Stakeholdern sinnvolle Lösungen entwickeln. Dazu gehört die Rechenschaftspflicht für Profiling, Segmentierung und Targeting von Kunden.

Construire et entretenir des réseaux externes à long terme, en assurant des expériences d'engagement positives auprès des employés, des produits et des services de Roche.

• Positionnement du produit et adoption clinique : Position Roche produits correctement et avec conviction et confiance, catalysant les changements nécessaires dans la pratique clinique.

• Co-créer des solutions significatives: Collaborer avec les intervenants internes et externes pour supprimer les barrages routiers et débloquer les possibilités. Co-créer des solutions significatives offrant une valeur maximale pour les patients, la communauté et Roche.

• Générer des points de vue concrets : identifier continuellement des points de vue de qualité sur les besoins du patient, du HCP et du marché. Agir en tant que lien essentiel, en apportant des connaissances externes à Roche pour éclairer les priorités stratégiques et la planification au niveau des comptes, tout en partageant l'expertise de Roche.

• Fournir une stratégie éclairée aux intervenants : En comprenant profondément les besoins des intervenants et les préférences en matière de communication, le PJP conseille les marketeurs sur la prestation de campagnes multicanaux essentielles et exécute ces livraisons, au besoin, afin d'éduquer et de mobiliser efficacement les intervenants.

• Maximiser l'engagement des clients : planifier et offrir des interactions significatives et régulières, alignées sur les préférences du PCH, afin d'accroître la confiance dans les thérapies Roche et d'obtenir de meilleurs résultats pour les patients.

The Position
IT Business Partner Lead - San Diego
The actual title, once hired, will be RDT DIA R&D Site Partner Lead - San Diego.

The Opportunity
The IT Business Partner Lead ​ is accountable for Business Partnering for the San Diego R&D sites across Carlsbad (GenMark) and Torrey Pines (GenMark/LumiraDx). This role drives local value realization for both R&D and Site Services and demands a distinctive combination of informal people leadership, deep domain expertise, technical proficiency, and business insights.

As the San Diego sites move from an M&A integration phase to standard RDT operations, you will work alongside M&A integration leaders through the end of the year to ensure a smooth handover, while actively advising stakeholders through organizational change, coordinating complex technical backlogs, and driving alignment toward long-term Roche RDT standards.

The IT Business Partner Lead ​ acts as the strategic liaison between RDT and local R&D organizations across Carlsbad and Torrey Pines, recognizing that supporting specialized local capabilities, unique instrumentation, and site-specific workflows is essential for the wider organization's success and competitive advantage in diagnostic development. The role operates across a multi-entity site ecosystem, guiding local environments through the final stages of M&A integration and establishing sustainable, standard operational models.

Job Responsibilities

• Senior Partnering & RDT Site Coordination: Collaborate with M&A leaders to ensure a seamless transition to standard RDT operations; act as the primary RDT liaison for site leadership; advise business leaders on technical debt and legacy GenMark app decommissionings, while safeguarding key operational milestones (such as the RP2 to RP3 assay transition) from an RDT perspective.

• Hands-On Technical Execution: Drive resolution of open technical backlogs in collaboration with domain experts (RCN network rollout and site infrastructure stabilization); facilitate system migrations from legacy domains and applications; manage technical site operations and local application inventories.

Who You Are

• Bachelor's degree in IT, Engineering, Science, Business or related field. Master/PhD is a plus.

• 8 years of related experience in Project Management or IT Business Partnering or IT Integration with a Bachelor’s degree;
or 6 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience.

• Senior experience in IT business partnering, technology consulting, or technical site management in life sciences/diagnostics.

• S trong stakeholder management skills with the ability to understand local site needs while balancing global platform strategies and organisational priorities and and driving business decisions through complex organizational change.

• Cross-functional coordination skill s, with demonstrated success managing complex dependencies across functions.

• Knowledge of regulatory requirements (GxP or 21 CFR Part 11) and their impact on research technology.

• Familiarity with global IT service management practices (ITIL) and support models.

• Location & Mobility: Ability to work flexibly across San Diego sites (Carlsbad and Torrey Pines) and participate in global planning sessions.

Preferred skills:

• Proven understanding of modern technology architecture (e.g., APIs, cloud platforms) is desirable.

• Familiarity with data science and AI/ML concepts is a major plus.

• Familiarity with sample and data lifecycle managemen t specific

ou 6 ans et une maîtrise; ou un doctorat avec 3 ans d'expérience; ou une expérience équivalente.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Cybersecurity Software Engineer

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

This role is based within the Network Security Product area, a team dedicated to making Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. By bridging the gap between rigorous infrastructure security and high-speed delivery, you will work alongside Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to protect our networks globally. The rapidly evolving threat landscape and our shift toward a software-driven engineering discipline offer you a unique opportunity to build scalable automation and drive continuous technical learning.

The opportunity:

As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Development Frameworks & Automation), your key responsibilities and priorities will include:

• Architecture & Design Baseline: Collaboratively building, designing, adapting, and standardizing internal security development frameworks and engineering practices, establishing consistent coding guidelines and architectural baselines across the product area.

• Structural Engineering & Guardrails: Contributing to structural engineering decisions by providing software design insights, defining secure control guardrails, and creating code abstraction layers to streamline the deployment of network controls.

• Product Lifecycle & Custom Automation: Driving code development to improve infrastructure services by writing robust scripts, modular automation blocks, and custom APIs to seamlessly scale connectivity safeguards.

• CI/CD Integration: Guiding technical implementations through all stages of the software engineering lifecycle—from defining structured automation frameworks to deploying tested, scalable security features using CI/CD.

• Operational Excellence & Code Quality: Standardizing core development workflows (such as version control frameworks, comprehensive testing, and peer review practices) to guarantee the reliability and code quality of live infrastructure configurations.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Working cross-functionally with internal stakeholders and platform teams to measure, monitor, and continuously improve the reliability, maintenance, and automated health checking of network infrastructure code.

• Continuous Improvement of Capabilities: Supporting the end-to-end delivery, design, and maintenance of technologies protecting Roche networks and the Internet (on-prem and cloud), including Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection, Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN), Network Access Control, and Deep Packet Inspect

Guidato da scopo e passione, stiamo costruendo un futuro in cui il digitale è una forza fondamentale in tutti i Roche, consentendo modi più intelligenti di lavorare, sbloccare il potenziale umano, e di condurre scoperte che veramente importano per milioni di pazienti in tutto il mondo.

A Roche, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici di ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi.

Questo ruolo si basa nell’area Network Security Product, un team dedicato a rendere la connettività di Roche accessibile e sicura attraverso piattaforme di sicurezza all’avanguardia e orchestrazione automatizzata. Attraverso il distacco tra la sicurezza delle infrastrutture rigorose e la consegna ad alta velocità, lavorerai insieme ai team Cloud, Infrastructure e Incident Response per proteggere le nostre reti a livello globale. Il panorama delle minacce in rapida evoluzione e il nostro spostamento verso una disciplina di ingegneria basata sul software offrono un'opportunità unica per costruire l'automazione scalabile e guidare l'apprendimento tecnico continuo.

L'opportunità:

In qualità di Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Development Frameworks & Automation), le tue responsabilità e priorità chiave includono:

• Architettura & Design Baseline: Costruire, progettare, adattare e standardizzare i quadri di sviluppo della sicurezza interna e le pratiche ingegneristiche, stabilendo linee guida di codifica coerenti e basi architettoniche in tutta l'area del prodotto.

• Ingegneria strutturale & Guardrails: Contribuire alle decisioni di ingegneria strutturale fornendo insights di progettazione del software, definendo guardrails di controllo sicuro e creando strati di astrazione del codice per semplificare la distribuzione dei controlli di rete.

• Lifecycle & Custom Automation: Sviluppo del codice di guida per migliorare i servizi infrastrutturali scrivendo script robusti, blocchi di automazione modulari e API personalizzate per garantire la connettività senza soluzione di continuità.

• Integrazione CI/CD: Guidare le implementazioni tecniche attraverso tutte le fasi del ciclo di vita dell'ingegneria software, dalla definizione di framework di automazione strutturati per implementare funzionalità di sicurezza testate e scalabili utilizzando CI/CD.

• Eccellenza operativa e qualità del codice: standardizzazione dei flussi di lavoro di sviluppo del core (come i quadri di controllo della versione, test completi e pratiche di revisione peer) per garantire l'affidabilità e la qualità del codice delle configurazioni delle infrastrutture dal vivo.

• Collaborazione interattiva: Lavorare in modo trasversale con gli stakeholder interni e i team di piattaforme per misurare, monitorare e migliorare continuamente l'affidabilità, la manutenzione e il controllo sanitario automatizzato del codice infrastruttura di rete.

• Miglioramento continuo delle capacità: Sostenere la consegna end-to-end, la progettazione e la manutenzione delle tecnologie che proteggono le reti Roche e Internet (on-prem e cloud), tra cui Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection, Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN), Network Access Control e Deep Packet Inspect

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Cybersecurity Software Engineer

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

This role is based within the Network Security Product area, a team dedicated to making Roche’s connectivity accessible and secure through leading-edge security platforms and automated orchestration. By bridging the gap between rigorous infrastructure security and high-speed delivery, you will work alongside Cloud, Infrastructure, and Incident Response teams to protect our networks globally. The rapidly evolving threat landscape and our shift toward a software-driven engineering discipline offer you a unique opportunity to build scalable automation and drive continuous technical learning.

The opportunity:

As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Development Frameworks & Automation), your key responsibilities and priorities will include:

• Architecture & Design Baseline: Collaboratively building, designing, adapting, and standardizing internal security development frameworks and engineering practices, establishing consistent coding guidelines and architectural baselines across the product area.

• Structural Engineering & Guardrails: Contributing to structural engineering decisions by providing software design insights, defining secure control guardrails, and creating code abstraction layers to streamline the deployment of network controls.

• Product Lifecycle & Custom Automation: Driving code development to improve infrastructure services by writing robust scripts, modular automation blocks, and custom APIs to seamlessly scale connectivity safeguards.

• CI/CD Integration: Guiding technical implementations through all stages of the software engineering lifecycle—from defining structured automation frameworks to deploying tested, scalable security features using CI/CD.

• Operational Excellence & Code Quality: Standardizing core development workflows (such as version control frameworks, comprehensive testing, and peer review practices) to guarantee the reliability and code quality of live infrastructure configurations.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Working cross-functionally with internal stakeholders and platform teams to measure, monitor, and continuously improve the reliability, maintenance, and automated health checking of network infrastructure code.

• Continuous Improvement of Capabilities: Supporting the end-to-end delivery, design, and maintenance of technologies protecting Roche networks and the Internet (on-prem and cloud), including Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection, Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN), Network Access Control, and Deep Packet Inspect

Die Position

Cybersecurity Software Engineer

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) ist der Ort, an dem Innovation ihren Zweck erfüllt. Als globales Team im Herzen von Roche sind wir eine Gemeinschaft von geschäftsorientierten Technologen, die sich dafür einsetzen, die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens von morgen mitzugestalten. Unsere Mission ist es, Roche durch modernste digitale Technologien zu unterstützen und das Potenzial von künstlicher Intelligenz, Daten und skalierbaren technischen Innovationen zu nutzen. Angetrieben von Zielstrebigkeit und Leidenschaft bauen wir eine Zukunft auf, in der Digital eine Kernstärke von Roche ist, intelligentere Arbeitsweisen ermöglicht, menschliches Potenzial erschließt und Durchbrüche ermöglicht, die für Millionen von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt von Bedeutung sind.

Bei Roche bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Im Moment verlangen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathäuser, Teamsitzungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen.

Diese Rolle ist im Bereich Network Security Product angesiedelt, einem Team, das sich dafür einsetzt, die Konnektivität von Roche durch hochmoderne Sicherheitsplattformen und automatisierte Orchestrierung zugänglich und sicher zu machen. Indem Sie die Lücke zwischen strenger Infrastruktursicherheit und Hochgeschwindigkeitsbereitstellung schließen, arbeiten Sie mit Cloud-, Infrastruktur- und Incident Response-Teams zusammen, um unsere Netzwerke weltweit zu schützen. Die sich schnell entwickelnde Bedrohungslandschaft und unsere Verlagerung hin zu einer softwaregesteuerten Ingenieurdisziplin bieten Ihnen eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, skalierbare Automatisierung aufzubauen und kontinuierliches technisches Lernen voranzutreiben.

Die Gelegenheit:

Als Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Development Frameworks & Automation) umfassen Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Prioritäten:

• Architektur & Design Baseline: Gemeinsames Erstellen, Entwerfen, Anpassen und Standardisieren interner Sicherheitsentwicklungs-Frameworks und Engineering-Praktiken, Etablieren einheitlicher Kodierungsrichtlinien und architektonischer Basislinien im gesamten Produktbereich.

• Structural Engineering & Guardrails: Beitrag zu strukturellen Engineering-Entscheidungen durch die Bereitstellung von Software-Design-Einblicken, die Definition sicherer Kontroll-Guardrails und die Erstellung von Code-Abstraktionsschichten zur Optimierung der Bereitstellung von Netzwerksteuerungen.

• Product Lifecycle & Custom Automation: Förderung der Codeentwicklung zur Verbesserung der Infrastrukturdienste durch das Schreiben robuster Skripte, modularer Automatisierungsblöcke und benutzerdefinierter APIs zur nahtlosen Skalierung von Konnektivitätssicherungen.

• CI/CD-Integration: Führen technischer Implementierungen durch alle Phasen des Software-Engineering-Lebenszyklus – von der Definition strukturierter Automatisierungs-Frameworks bis hin zur Bereitstellung getesteter, skalierbarer Sicherheitsfunktionen mit CI/CD.

• Operational Excellence & Code Quality: Standardisierung von Kernentwicklungsworkflows (wie Versionskontroll-Frameworks, umfassende Tests und Peer-Review-Praktiken), um die Zuverlässigkeit und Codequalität von Live-Infrastrukturkonfigurationen zu gewährleisten.

• Funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Arbeitet funktionsübergreifend mit internen Stakeholdern und Plattformteams zusammen, um die Zuverlässigkeit, Wartung und automatisierte Zustandsprüfung von Netzwerkinfrastrukturcode zu messen, zu überwachen und kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Funktionen: Unterstützung der End-to-End-Bereitstellung, des Designs und der Wartung von Technologien zum Schutz von Roche-Netzwerken und des Internets (vor Ort und in der Cloud), einschließlich Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection, Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN), Network Access Control und Deep Packet Inspect
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Ingénieur logiciel de cybersécurité

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) est l'endroit où l'innovation répond à des objectifs. En tant qu'équipe mondiale au cœur de Roche, nous sommes une communauté de technologues d'affaires engagés à aider à façonner demain l'avenir numérique des soins de santé. Notre mission est d'alimenter Roche par des technologies numériques de pointe, en exploitant le potentiel de l'intelligence artificielle, des données et des innovations technologiques évolutives. Poussé par le but et la passion, nous construisons un avenir où le numérique est une force fondamentale dans toute Roche, permettant des façons plus intelligentes de travailler, débloquant le potentiel humain et conduisant des percées qui comptent vraiment pour des millions de patients dans le monde.

Chez Roche, nous offrons un modèle de travail hybride qui combine flexibilité et collaboration en personne. Pour l'instant, nous exigeons que nos employés soient dans nos bureaux en moyenne deux jours par semaine. Les jours de bureau spécifiques peuvent varier selon les besoins des entreprises, comme les ateliers, les conférences, les mairies, les réunions d'équipe et d'autres événements en collaboration.

Ce rôle s'inscrit dans la zone du produit de sécurité réseau, une équipe dédiée à rendre la connectivité Roches accessible et sécurisée grâce à des plateformes de sécurité de pointe et à l'orchestration automatisée. En comblant l'écart entre la sécurité rigoureuse de l'infrastructure et la livraison à grande vitesse, vous travaillerez aux côtés des équipes Cloud, Infrastructure et Incident Response pour protéger nos réseaux à l'échelle mondiale. Le paysage des menaces en évolution rapide et notre transition vers une discipline d'ingénierie axée sur le logiciel vous offrent une occasion unique de construire une automatisation évolutive et de conduire un apprentissage technique continu.

L'occasion :

En tant qu'ingénieur principal en cybersécurité (cadres de développement et automatisation), vos principales responsabilités et priorités comprendront :

• Architecture et conception de base : Élaborer, concevoir, adapter et normaliser en collaboration des cadres de développement de la sécurité interne et des pratiques d'ingénierie, en établissant des lignes directrices cohérentes en matière de codage et des bases architecturales dans l'ensemble du secteur de produits.

• Ingénierie structurale et garde-corps : contribuer aux décisions d'ingénierie structurale en fournissant des idées de conception logicielle, en définissant des garde-corps sécurisés et en créant des couches d'abstraction de code pour rationaliser le déploiement des commandes réseau.

• Cycle de vie du produit & Automatisation personnalisée: Conduire le développement de code pour améliorer les services d'infrastructure en écrivant des scripts robustes, des blocs d'automatisation modulaires et des API personnalisées pour mettre en place des garanties de connectivité à une échelle transparente.

• Intégration CI/CD: Orientation des implémentations techniques à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie de l'ingénierie logicielle, de la définition de cadres d'automatisation structurés au déploiement de fonctionnalités de sécurité testées et évolutives à l'aide de CI/CD.

• Excellence opérationnelle et qualité du code: Normalisation des flux de travail de développement de base (tels que les cadres de contrôle des versions, les tests complets et les pratiques d'examen par les pairs) pour garantir la fiabilité et la qualité du code des configurations d'infrastructure en direct.

• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Travailler en collaboration avec des intervenants internes et des équipes de plate-forme pour mesurer, surveiller et améliorer continuellement la fiabilité, la maintenance et la vérification de la santé automatisée du code d'infrastructure du réseau.

• Amélioration continue des capacités : Soutenir la livraison, la conception et la maintenance de bout en bout de technologies protégeant les réseaux Roche et Internet (sur site et en nuage), y compris Internet Security Stack, DDoS Protection, Site-to-Site Connectivity (VPN), Network Access Control et Deep Packet Inspect

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.

Your Opportunity
Planning and Financial Management:

• Proactively acquires a deep understanding of the external environment (healthcare system, policies and reforms) to anticipate future trends and formulates a strategic view of market, competition and products erosion in short-term and long-term

• Localize and define life cycle management strategy for products in charge.

• Develop business models in different channels for products in charge

• Develop a deep understanding of key stakeholders, including key accounts, payers, patient advocacy groups, professional associations, and policymakers, and develop development plans for the top clinical opinion leaders for the therapy area.

• Build marketing plans analyzing the relevant markets and defining long- and short-term qualitative and quantitative objectives.

• Where relevant, implement the launch excellence framework to build leading launch plans.

• Translates the brand plan into a strong actionable operational plan with clear goals, actions, accountabilities, and measures across the cross-functional team.

• Sets responsible and challenging goals with appropriate KPIs for the brand that have a clear positive impact on business performance.

• Ensure brand-in-charge performance

Resource Management / Marketing Excellence

• Ensuring the good implementation of tactical plans by collaborating with cross-functional team (Sales Force/Market Access/Medical Affairs/SFE)

• Ensuring supply and healthy stock.

• Optimizing segmentation and targeting strategies for the products under management.

• Build brand communication package implement for activities to make sure quality and brand engagement & reach

• Key in charge for the Brand KPIs (Lead, Lag), sales performance, and A&P

Tactical Market Plan / Implementation

• Achieving Marketing objectives as agreed with management, managing the development and implementation of marketing plans consistent with approval strategy

• Ensuring the achievement of products’ budget in the approved BP and integrated marketing plan.

• Accountable for ensuring compliance’s rules & ethical code when working with healthcare professionals to strengthen the company’s image.

• Ensure all the support for the sales team/MA team comply with relevant acts, legal demand and ethical standards and in line with marketing plan

• Innovation and MCM apply in activities

Who you are

• Bachelor's or master's degree in Health/Science/Pharmaceutical or Medical disciplines

• Multinational companies' experiences in healthcare industry

• At least 5 years experience in product management

• MBA in Marketing will be a plus

• Marketing and business development experience will be a plus

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo.

La tua opportunità
Pianificazione e gestione finanziaria:

• Proattivamente acquisisce una profonda comprensione dell'ambiente esterno (sistema sanitario, politiche e riforme) per anticipare le tendenze future e formula una visione strategica del mercato, della concorrenza e dell'erosione dei prodotti a breve e a lungo termine

• Localizzare e definire la strategia di gestione del ciclo di vita per i prodotti responsabili.

• Sviluppare modelli di business in diversi canali per i prodotti a carico

• Sviluppare una profonda comprensione dei principali stakeholder, tra cui account chiave, payers, gruppi di advocacy pazienti, associazioni professionali e responsabili politici, e sviluppare piani di sviluppo per i migliori leader di opinione clinica per l'area della terapia.

• Costruire piani di marketing analizzando i mercati pertinenti e definendo obiettivi qualitativi e quantitativi a lungo e a breve termine.

• Dove rilevante, implementare il framework di eccellenza di lancio per costruire i principali piani di lancio.

• Traduci il brand plan in un forte piano operativo attuabile con obiettivi chiari, azioni, responsabilità e misure attraverso il team interfunzionale.

• Imposta obiettivi responsabili e impegnativi con i KPI appropriati per il marchio che hanno un chiaro impatto positivo sulle prestazioni aziendali.

• Assicurare prestazioni di marca in carica

Gestione delle risorse / Eccellenza di marketing

• Garantire la buona attuazione dei piani tattici collaborando con il team interfunzionale (Sales Force/Market Access/Medical Affairs/SFE)

• Assicurare la fornitura e la scorta sana.

• Ottimizzare le strategie di segmentazione e di targeting per i prodotti in gestione.

• Costruire il pacchetto di comunicazione del marchio per le attività per assicurarsi qualità e impegno del marchio & raggiungere

• Key in carica per i Brand KPI (Lead, Lag), le prestazioni di vendita e A&P

Piano di mercato tattico / Attuazione

• Raggiungere gli obiettivi di marketing concordati con la gestione, la gestione dello sviluppo e l'attuazione di piani di marketing coerenti con la strategia di approvazione

• Garantire il raggiungimento del bilancio dei prodotti nel BP approvato e nel piano di marketing integrato.

• Contabile per garantire le regole di conformità e il codice etico quando si lavora con i professionisti del settore sanitario per rafforzare l’immagine dell’azienda.

• Assicurarsi che tutto il supporto per il team di vendita/MA sia conforme agli atti pertinenti, alla domanda legale e agli standard etici e in linea con il piano di marketing

• Innovazione e MCM si applicano nelle attività

Chi sei

• Corso di laurea o master in Scienze della salute / Scienza/Pharmaceutica o discipline mediche

• Esperienze multinazionali nell'industria sanitaria

• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti

• MBA in Marketing sarà un plus

• Marketing e business development experience sarà un plus

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben.

Ihre Chance
Planung und Finanzmanagement:

• Erwirbt proaktiv ein tiefes Verständnis des externen Umfelds (Gesundheitssystem, Politik und Reformen), um zukünftige Trends zu antizipieren, und formuliert einen strategischen Blick auf kurz- und langfristige Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Produkterosion

• Lokalisieren und definieren Sie die Life-Cycle-Management-Strategie für die verantwortlichen Produkte.

• Entwicklung von Geschäftsmodellen in verschiedenen Kanälen für verantwortliche Produkte

• Entwickeln Sie ein tiefes Verständnis der wichtigsten Stakeholder, einschließlich Key Accounts, Kostenträger, Patientenvertretungsgruppen, Berufsverbände und politische Entscheidungsträger, und entwickeln Sie Entwicklungspläne für die wichtigsten klinischen Meinungsführer für den Therapiebereich.

• Erstellen Sie Marketingpläne, die die relevanten Märkte analysieren und langfristige und kurzfristige qualitative und quantitative Ziele definieren.

• Gegebenenfalls Umsetzung des Exzellenzrahmens für den Start, um führende Startpläne zu erstellen.

• Übersetzt den Markenplan in einen umsetzbaren Betriebsplan mit klaren Zielen, Maßnahmen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Maßnahmen im gesamten funktionsübergreifenden Team.

• Setzt verantwortungsvolle und anspruchsvolle Ziele mit geeigneten KPIs für die Marke, die sich eindeutig positiv auf die Geschäftsentwicklung auswirken.

• Gewährleistung der Brand-in-Charge-Leistung

Resource Management / Marketing Excellence

• Sicherstellung der guten Umsetzung taktischer Pläne durch die Zusammenarbeit mit dem funktionsübergreifenden Team (Sales Force / Market Access / Medical Affairs / SFE)

• Versorgungssicherheit und gesunde Bestände.

• Optimierung von Segmentierungs- und Targetingstrategien für die verwalteten Produkte.

• Erstellen Sie ein Markenkommunikationspaket für Aktivitäten, um Qualität und Markenbindung und -reichweite sicherzustellen

• Verantwortlich für die Marken-KPIs (Lead, Lag), die Verkaufsleistung und A&P

Taktischer Marktplan / Umsetzung

• Erreichung der mit dem Management vereinbarten Marketingziele, Verwaltung der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Marketingplänen im Einklang mit der Genehmigungsstrategie

• Sicherstellung der Erreichung des Produktbudgets im genehmigten BP und integrierten Marketingplan.

• Verantwortlich für die Gewährleistung der Compliance-Regeln und des Ethikkodex bei der Zusammenarbeit mit Gesundheitsexperten, um das Image des Unternehmens zu stärken.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die gesamte Unterstützung für das Verkaufsteam / MA-Team den einschlägigen Gesetzen, gesetzlichen Anforderungen und ethischen Standards sowie dem Marketingplan entspricht

• Innovation und MCM gelten in Aktivitäten

Wer du bist

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Gesundheits-/Wissenschafts-/Pharma- oder Medizindisziplinen

• Erfahrungen multinationaler Unternehmen in der Gesundheitsbranche

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement

• MBA in Marketing wird ein Plus sein

• Marketing und Business Development Erfahrung wird ein Plus sein

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

La position
Nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons.

Votre opportunité
Planification et gestion financière :

• Acquérir une connaissance approfondie de l'environnement extérieur (système de soins de santé, politiques et réformes) pour anticiper les tendances futures et formuler une vision stratégique de l'érosion du marché, de la concurrence et des produits à court et à long terme

• Développer des modèles d'affaires dans différents canaux pour les produits en charge

• Développer une compréhension approfondie des principaux intervenants, y compris les comptes clés, les payeurs, les groupes de défense des patients, les associations professionnelles et les décideurs, et élaborer des plans de développement pour les principaux leaders d'opinion clinique dans le domaine de la thérapie.

• Élaborer des plans de marketing analysant les marchés pertinents et définissant des objectifs qualitatifs et quantitatifs à long et à court terme.

• Le cas échéant, mettre en œuvre le cadre d'excellence du lancement pour élaborer des plans de lancement de premier plan.

• Clé en charge des KPI de marque (Lead, Lag), performance des ventes, et A&P

• Veiller à ce que tout le soutien apporté à l'équipe de vente/l'équipe de l'AMA soit conforme aux lois pertinentes, aux exigences légales et aux normes éthiques et conforme au plan de marketing

• Innovation et MCM s'appliquent aux activités

Qui vous êtes

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences de la santé/pharmaceutique ou en médecine

• Expériences des entreprises multinationales dans le secteur de la santé

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en gestion de produits

jobs.title: Business Development Partner
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Business Development Partner
Introduction A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we l ove. That’s what makes us Roche. As a dynamic and results-driven Business Development Partner in our Business Partnering team, you will manage and develop relationships with our key business partners, including distributors and dealers . In this role, you will be responsible for driving sales growth, ensuring excellent customer service, and fostering long-term partnerships while aligning partner activities with our strategic objectives .

The Opportunity:

• Cultivate Partner Relationships: Serve as the primary, high-touch contact to build and sustain collaborative relationships with assigned business partner accounts .

• Execute Sales Strategies: Develop and execute robust, targeted sales strategies to consistently exceed performance goals for business partner accounts .

• Optimize Channel Performance: Monitor and optimize distributor performance, providing structured onboarding and continuous support to expand market reach .

• Empower Business Partners: Deliver impactful training, commercial tools, and market insights to empower partners while conducting joint customer visits to deepen engagement .

• Drive Strategic Alignment: Stay ahead of healthcare market trends and competitive dynamics, working closely with cross-functional internal teams to align partner initiatives .

• Deliver Market Intelligence: Generate insightful performance reports and data analytics on sales metrics, market conditions, and partner engagement .

• Govern Partner Compliance: Ensure all business partner activities adhere strictly to internal company policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements .

• Support Audit Processes: Monitor audit workflows, provide active guidance on compliance matters, and swiftly address and resolve operational issues .

Who you are:

• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Medical Science, Marketing, or a related commercial or scientific field.

• Experienced Channel Manager: You bring 5+ years of progressive experience in the diagnostics or healthcare industry, with a primary focus on Sales Channel Management .

• Regional Market Specialist: You possess strong, proven knowledge of the Thailand and Indochina medical device and diagnostics business partner landscape .

• Strategic Account Planner: You demonstrate a proven ability to develop and implement strategic account plans, distribution management frameworks, and go-to-market strategies .

• Cross-Functional Collaborator: You excel at working collaboratively within a matrix, cross-functional environment to align partner initiatives with organizational goals .

• Compliance & Audit Mindset: You possess a solid understanding of regulatory standards, commercial risk management, and compliance governance within distribution networks .

• Bilingual Communicator: You exhibit excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with full proficiency in Thai and a strong conversational command of written and spoken English .

Why Join Us?

• Remuneration: Competitive base salary paired with an attractive performance incentive scheme.

• Security: Premium health insurance covering you and your family, alongside a high-matching Provident Fund.

• Well-being: Flexible working

La posizione
Partner di sviluppo aziendale
Introduzione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che abbiamo. Ecco cosa ci rende Roche. Come partner di sviluppo aziendale dinamico e guidato dai risultati nel nostro team di Business Partnering, gestirai e svilupperai relazioni con i nostri principali partner commerciali, inclusi distributori e rivenditori. In questo ruolo, sarai responsabile per la crescita delle vendite, assicurando un servizio clienti eccellente e promuovendo partnership a lungo termine, allineando le attività dei partner con i nostri obiettivi strategici .

L'opportunità:

• Coltivare i Partner Relationships: Servire come contatto primario e veloce per costruire e sostenere relazioni collaborative con account partner aziendali assegnati.

• Esegui strategie di vendita: sviluppare ed eseguire strategie di vendita robuste e mirate per superare costantemente gli obiettivi di performance per gli account dei partner aziendali.

• Ottimizzare le prestazioni del canale: monitorare e ottimizzare le prestazioni del distributore, fornendo supporto strutturato e continuo per espandere la portata del mercato.

• Affidare partner commerciali: fornire formazione efficace, strumenti commerciali e informazioni di mercato per potenziare i partner durante la conduzione di visite congiunte al cliente per approfondire l'impegno .

• Guida Allineamento Strategico: Mantenere in anticipo le tendenze del mercato sanitario e le dinamiche competitive, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team interfunzionali interni per allineare le iniziative dei partner.

• Fornire Market Intelligence: Genera report sulle prestazioni intuitivi e analisi dei dati sulle metriche di vendita, le condizioni di mercato e l'impegno dei partner.

• Govern Partner Compliance: Assicurarsi che tutte le attività dei partner commerciali aderiscano strettamente alle politiche aziendali interne, ai regolamenti del settore e ai requisiti legali.

• Support Audit Processes: Monitorare i flussi di lavoro di audit, fornire una guida attiva in materia di conformità, e affrontare rapidamente e risolvere i problemi operativi.

Chi sei:

• Professionista Educato: Hai una laurea in Business Administration, Scienza Medica, Marketing, o un campo commerciale o scientifico correlato.

• Gestore del canale esperto: porti 5+ anni di esperienza progressiva nel settore diagnostico o sanitario, con un focus primario sulla gestione del canale di vendita .

• Specialista di mercato regionale: Possiedi una forte, comprovata conoscenza della Thailandia e del dispositivo medico di Indochina e la diagnostica business partner paesaggio .

• Strategic Account Planner: Si dimostra una comprovata capacità di sviluppare e implementare piani di account strategici, quadri di gestione della distribuzione e strategie di go-to-market .

• Collaboratore Cross-Functional: Lei eccelle nel lavorare in collaborazione all'interno di un ambiente matrice e interfunzionale per allineare le iniziative dei partner con obiettivi organizzativi.

• Compliance & Audit Mindset: Possiedi una solida comprensione degli standard normativi, della gestione dei rischi commerciali e della governance della conformità all'interno delle reti di distribuzione.

• Bilingual Communicator: Lei esibisce una comunicazione eccellente e competenze interpersonali, con piena competenza in Thai e un forte comando di conversazione di inglese scritto e parlato.

Perché unirsi a noi?

• Remunerazione: stipendio base competitivo abbinato ad un attraente schema di incentivazione delle prestazioni.

• Sicurezza: Assicurazione sanitaria Premium che copre voi e la vostra famiglia, accanto a un alto-matching Provident Fund.

• Benessere: Lavoro flessibile

jobs.title: Hybrid Service Engineer - Huế
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love.
The Hybrid Service Engineer's main responsibility is customer facing, field service and application support. The major focuses are on timely repair, and installing new and older Roche’s instruments, to ensure minimum instrument downtime and foster work efficiency. Complete full service reports and complete all paperwork associated with each service activity. A high level of communication within the department with accurate and relevant feedback to the proper departments related to equipment performance.

Our Opportunities

• Perform preventive maintenance or service repairs such as cleaning, lubricating and adjusting equipment as per the annual planning of the department.

• Inspect, test, and repair Roche diagnostic instruments and related equipment following manufacturers' specifications, by testing and analyzing the instruments performance.

• Remote and on-site support related to Roche diagnostic products such as instruments, reagents or user’s handling.

• Develop effective troubleshooting strategies and training activities to minimize repeated errors.

• Install and de-install equipment at the customer's facility to ensure full functionality according to manufacturer's specifications.

• Collaborate within Professional Service and across departments to provide a consolidated solution to customers and increase customer satisfaction.

• Keep accurate and timely records of all service activities but not limited to maintenance, repair, installations and required software/ hardware updates of equipment.

• Diligently manage spare parts submissions with compliance to spare parts processes for stock, installations and return of old spare parts to the department.

• Actively participate to improve resolution rate, instrument up time, department collaboration and support services towards customer satisfaction

• Commitment to meet the customers’ demands regarding travel, after hours working schedule as requested by the line managers and department managers

• Provide a communication link between the customer and the company to help ensure that effective service is provided to the customer

• Conduct business in full compliance to Behavior in Business, Behavior in Competition, Online and compliant post sale service support

Who You Are

• Minimum qualification required is diploma in Electronic, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering and preferably 1 year related experience.

• Clinical laboratory and/or quality management experience will be an added advantage.

• Effective Communication & Customer care handling skills

• Good interpersonal skills & ability to work independently and as team player

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Avviamo la scienza in modo che tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo.
La responsabilità principale dell'Ingegnere di Servizio Ibrido è il servizio clienti, il servizio sul campo e il supporto delle applicazioni. I principali focus sono sulla riparazione tempestiva e l'installazione di strumenti Roche nuovi e vecchi, per garantire il tempo di fermo dello strumento minimo e favorire l'efficienza del lavoro. Completa i rapporti di servizio completi e completa tutti i documenti associati ad ogni attività di servizio. Un elevato livello di comunicazione all'interno del dipartimento con un feedback accurato e rilevante ai reparti appropriati relativi alle prestazioni dell'attrezzatura.

Le nostre opportunità

• Eseguire la manutenzione preventiva o riparazioni di servizio come pulizia, lubrificanti e attrezzature di regolazione secondo la pianificazione annuale del dipartimento.

• Ispezionare, testare e riparare gli strumenti diagnostici Roche e le relative attrezzature secondo le specifiche dei produttori, testando e analizzando le prestazioni degli strumenti.

• Supporto remoto e in loco relativo a prodotti diagnostici Roche come strumenti, reagenti o manipolazione dell'utente.

• Sviluppare efficaci strategie di risoluzione dei problemi e attività di formazione per ridurre al minimo gli errori ripetuti.

• Installare e disinstallare le attrezzature presso la struttura del cliente per garantire la piena funzionalità secondo le specifiche del produttore.

• Collabora all'interno del Servizio Professionale e di tutti i dipartimenti per fornire una soluzione consolidata ai clienti e aumentare la soddisfazione del cliente.

• Mantenere registrazioni accurate e tempestive di tutte le attività di servizio, ma non limitate a manutenzione, riparazione, installazioni e aggiornamenti software/hardware necessari di apparecchiature.

• Diligentemente gestire le presentazioni dei pezzi di ricambio con la conformità ai processi dei pezzi di ricambio per magazzino, impianti e ritorno di pezzi di ricambio vecchi al reparto.

• Partecipa attivamente per migliorare il tasso di risoluzione, il tempo di elaborazione degli strumenti, la collaborazione di reparto e i servizi di supporto verso la soddisfazione del cliente

• Impegno di soddisfare le richieste dei clienti per quanto riguarda i viaggi, dopo orario di lavoro come richiesto dai gestori di linea e dai gestori di reparto

• Fornire un collegamento di comunicazione tra il cliente e la società per contribuire a garantire che il servizio efficace è fornito al cliente

• Condurre business in piena conformità a Behavior in Business, Behavior in Competition, Online e conforme servizio post vendita supporto

Chi sei

• La qualifica minima richiesta è il diploma in Ingegneria Elettronica, Elettrica o Meccanica e preferibilmente l'esperienza relativa a 1 anno.

• Il laboratorio clinico e/o l'esperienza di gestione della qualità saranno un vantaggio aggiuntivo.

• Efficace capacità di gestione della comunicazione e della customer care

• Buone abilità interpersonali e capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come giocatore di squadra

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben.
Die Hauptverantwortung des Hybrid Service Engineers liegt in Kundennähe, Außendienst und Anwendungsunterstützung. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf der rechtzeitigen Reparatur und der Installation neuer und älterer Roche-Instrumente, um minimale Ausfallzeiten zu gewährleisten und die Arbeitseffizienz zu fördern. Füllen Sie vollständige Serviceberichte aus und füllen Sie alle Unterlagen aus, die mit jeder Serviceaktivität verbunden sind. Ein hohes Maß an Kommunikation innerhalb der Abteilung mit genauem und relevantem Feedback an die richtigen Abteilungen in Bezug auf die Leistung der Ausrüstung.

Unsere Chancen

• Führen Sie vorbeugende Wartungs- oder Servicereparaturen wie Reinigungs-, Schmier- und Einstellgeräte gemäß der jährlichen Planung der Abteilung durch.

• Inspizieren, testen und reparieren Sie Roche Diagnosegeräte und zugehörige Geräte nach Herstellerspezifikationen, indem Sie die Leistung der Geräte testen und analysieren.

• Remote- und On-Site-Support im Zusammenhang mit Roche-Diagnoseprodukten wie Instrumenten, Reagenzien oder der Handhabung durch den Benutzer.

• Entwickeln Sie effektive Strategien zur Fehlerbehebung und Schulungen, um wiederholte Fehler zu minimieren.

• Installieren und Deinstallieren von Geräten beim Kunden, um die volle Funktionalität gemäß den Herstellerspezifikationen zu gewährleisten.

• Arbeiten Sie im Professional Service und abteilungsübergreifend zusammen, um den Kunden eine konsolidierte Lösung zu bieten und die Kundenzufriedenheit zu erhöhen.

• Führen Sie genaue und zeitnahe Aufzeichnungen über alle Serviceaktivitäten, aber nicht beschränkt auf Wartung, Reparatur, Installationen und erforderliche Software- / Hardware-Updates der Ausrüstung.

• Verwalten Sie sorgfältig die Einreichung von Ersatzteilen unter Einhaltung der Ersatzteilprozesse für Lager, Installationen und Rückgabe alter Ersatzteile an die Abteilung.

• Aktiv teilnehmen, um die Auflösungsrate, Instrument-up-Zeit, Abteilung Zusammenarbeit und Support-Services für die Kundenzufriedenheit zu verbessern

• Verpflichtung, die Anforderungen der Kunden in Bezug auf Reisen zu erfüllen, nach stundenlangem Arbeitszeitplan, wie von den Linienleitern und Abteilungsleitern verlangt

• Bereitstellung einer Kommunikationsverbindung zwischen dem Kunden und dem Unternehmen, um sicherzustellen, dass dem Kunden ein effektiver Service zur Verfügung gestellt wird

• Führen Sie Geschäfte in voller Übereinstimmung mit Behavior in Business, Behavior in Competition, Online und konformem Post-Sale-Service-Support durch

Wer du bist

• Mindestqualifikation erforderlich ist Diplom in Elektrotechnik, Elektrotechnik oder Maschinenbau und vorzugsweise 1 Jahr verwandte Erfahrung.

• Klinisches Labor und / oder Qualitätsmanagement Erfahrung wird ein zusätzlicher Vorteil sein.

• Effektive Kommunikation & Customer Care Handling Fähigkeiten

• Gute zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten & Fähigkeit, unabhängig und als Teamplayer zu arbeiten

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Nous faisons avancer la science pour que nous ayons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons.
La principale responsabilité de l'ingénieur de service hybride est de faire face aux clients, de fournir un service sur le terrain et de fournir un soutien aux applications. L'accent est mis sur la réparation en temps opportun et l'installation de nouveaux et anciens instruments Roches, afin d'assurer un temps minimum d'arrêt des instruments et de favoriser l'efficacité du travail. Remplir tous les rapports de service et remplir tous les documents associés à chaque activité de service. Un niveau élevé de communication au sein du ministère avec une rétroaction précise et pertinente aux ministères concernés en ce qui a trait au rendement de l'équipement.

Nos possibilités

• Effectuer des travaux d'entretien préventif ou des réparations de service, comme le nettoyage, le lubrification et l'ajustement du matériel, conformément à la planification annuelle du ministère.

• Inspecter, tester et réparer les instruments de diagnostic Roche et les équipements connexes selon les spécifications du fabricant, en testant et en analysant les performances des instruments.

• Support à distance et sur place lié aux produits de diagnostic Roche tels que les instruments, les réactifs ou la manipulation de l'utilisateur.

• Élaborer des stratégies efficaces de dépannage et des activités de formation pour minimiser les erreurs répétées.

• Installez et désinstallez des équipements à l'installation du client afin d'assurer la pleine fonctionnalité conformément aux spécifications du fabricant.

• Engagement à répondre aux demandes des clients concernant les voyages, après les heures de travail comme demandé par les gestionnaires hiérarchiques et les gestionnaires de département

• Fournir un lien de communication entre le client et l'entreprise afin d'assurer un service efficace au client

• Mener des activités en pleine conformité avec le comportement en affaires, comportement en concurrence, soutien de service après-vente en ligne et conforme

Qui vous êtes

• La qualification minimale requise est un diplôme en génie électronique, électrique ou mécanique et de préférence une expérience liée à un an.

• L'expérience de laboratoire clinique et/ou de gestion de la qualité sera un avantage supplémentaire.

• Capacités efficaces de communication et de gestion des soins à la clientèle

• Bonnes compétences interpersonnelles et capacité à travailler de façon indépendante et en tant que joueur d'équipe

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Come Senior Business Analyst, gestirai in modo indipendente flussi di lavoro di analisi aziendali end-to-end, affrontando problemi aziendali complessi con l'ambiguità emergente. Dimostrerai una forte comprensione del dominio aziendale, delle tecnologie correlate e delle loro interdipendenze, applicando strumenti e tecniche avanzate per tradurre i requisiti in piani di implementazione strategici. In questo ruolo, si agirà come consulente affidabile per i team interfunzionali, modellando le prospettive degli stakeholder, gestire le interdipendenze di processo, e contribuire in modo significativo alla progettazione e validazione di soluzioni efficaci. Responsabilità del lavoro

• Scope / (Content Leadership): gestisce autonomamente flussi di lavoro di analisi aziendali end-to-end senza guida, affrontando problemi con l'ambiguità emergente. • Accountability/Problem Solving: conduce l'analisi dei problemi aziendali, esegue una ricerca approfondita del dominio e guida l'analisi delle cause root. Contabile per fornire requisiti completi, contribuendo in modo significativo alla selezione delle soluzioni, e identificare proattivamente discrepanze di risoluzione delle esigenze per proporre miglioramenti creativi.

• Stakeholder Management: Identificare una gamma diversificata di stakeholder interfunzionali e costruisce affidamento attraverso una profonda comprensione aziendale per agire come consulente affidabile. Facilita i workshop, risolve i conflitti e forma proattivamente le prospettive degli stakeholder per gestire strategicamente le aspettative e allinearle agli obiettivi del progetto.

• Impatto/Strategia: Fornisce impatto che si estende a un prodotto specifico, iniziativa o cluster, contribuendo a obiettivi di dominio garantendo soluzioni che forniscono un valore aziendale dimostrabile. • Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): Funziona a una soluzione o a livello di prodotto che coinvolge più soluzioni, gestire requisiti ambigui e interagire sistematicamente con gli stakeholder in un ambiente di prodotto più ampio. Valuta gli impatti della soluzione considerando le implicazioni aziendali immediate e a lungo termine.

• Capacità commerciale / tecnica: dimostra una profonda comprensione dei domini aziendali e tecnici, delle tecnologie e delle loro interdipendenze. Applica in modo indipendente strumenti, principi e tecniche relative a requisiti, dati, usabilità e analisi dei processi per gestire le interconnessioni e migliorare l'efficienza complessiva.

Qualifiche
Istruzione / Esperienza

• 5+ anni di Business Analysis / Esperienza di consulenza, con almeno 3+ anni di scienze della vita / farmaci o la funzione aziendale assegnata essere supportata.

• Esperienza comprovata indipendentemente la gestione dei flussi di lavoro BA end-to-end, la navigazione di requisiti ambigui e la valutazione delle opzioni di soluzione strategica.

• Esperienza dimostrata nel tradurre i requisiti in piani di implementazione strategici che si allineano con gli obiettivi aziendali globali.

Competenze tecniche

• Conoscenza avanzata dei concetti e delle pratiche di Business Analysis/Consultancy, con esperienza intermedia in almeno una capacità BA.

• Forte competenza nei requisiti di elicitazione e documentazione, assicurando la tracciabilità e la coerenza dei requisiti
