descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Un futuro più sano. E' questo che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire l'accesso quotidiano alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui passiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. E' questo che ci rende Roche.

Il dipartimento Global Operational Excellence è dedicato all'architettura e alla scalazione del miglioramento continuo della nostra rete globale. Guidando la trasformazione strategica e incorporando quadri operativi maturi, il team garantisce consistenza, efficienza e prestazioni ad alto impatto. Questo ruolo opera in un ambiente di matrice dinamica, riportando al Global Head Operational Excellence con una linea tratteggiata al Global Head of Quality .

In qualità di Capo di Eccellenza Operativa per la Qualità Globale, entrerai in un ruolo di leadership ad alto impatto, focalizzato sull'esecuzione, progettato per costruire e scalare una funzione di Eccellenza Operativa dedicata all'interno dell'unità di Qualità Globale. Potrai testare la trasformazione delle capacità operative di Global l Quality orchestrando e stando su risorse dedicate in vari capitoli e siti di produzione. Il vostro mandato primario e immediato sarà quello di sostenere e accelerare il programma Quality Unites Us, eseguendo, scalando, e guidando i cambiamenti comportamentali tangibili e le pietre miliari del progetto già definite dalla Quality roadmap.

L'opportunità

In questo ruolo, avrete l'opportunità di guidare l'ottimizzazione dei processi quantificabili, distribuire i principi Lean, contribuire a obiettivi finanziari con chiara responsabilitÃ e incorporare una cultura sostenibile del miglioramento continuo attraverso le seguenti responsabilitÃ chiave:

• Deployment di sistema: guidare il rollout degli standard Lean, identificare la produttività misurabile e le iniziative di ottimizzazione dei costi, e incorporare il programma Lean Leadership per agire come allenatore e guidare la certificazione proattiva dei Leader di qualità.

• Capability Building: Campione e sostenere un modello di formazione a livello di rete per sviluppare, certificare e mentore futuro Lean Practitioners.

• Accelerazione e allineamento delle unità di qualità: Ancora tutte le attività di Eccellenza Operativa per mirare ai cambiamenti comportamentali, progettare la roadmap strategica per costruire una comunità di eccellenza operativa di Global Quality e stabilire un quadro di governance collaborativo hub-and-spoke per allineare la strategia centrale con il capitolo incorporato e le risorse del sito.

• Roadmap Execution: Traduci gli obiettivi di qualità e di business in piani di azione di eccellenza operativa concreti e misurabili, incentrati sulla fornitura di miglioramenti immediati e tangibili delle prestazioni per i materiali di consegna definiti.

• Ottimizzazione del processo: Diagnosi dei colli di bottiglia tra i flussi di lavoro, dispiega le metodologie magre e digitali per semplificare i processi e scalare le metodologie standardizzate, i toolkit e le prestazioni KPI nei capitoli che sfruttano le strutture delle unità di qualità esistenti.

• Risolvere i problemi: Personalmente guidare e facilitare ad alta priorità, iniziative di analisi a causa delle radici interfunzionali per smantellare complessi, strozzature operative sistemiche e garantire una solida conferma del processo.

• La gestione dei cambiamenti e dei cambiamenti comportamentali: agire come campione delle unità di qualità incaricate dei turni culturali, integrare questi nelle routine quotidiane su tutti i livelli (tra cui i membri del team di leadership Global Quality), e fornire coaching e mentorship di campo diretto e pratico per risorse incorporate e leadership più ampia.

• Questo ruolo richiede circa il 20% di viaggi internazionali all'anno, soprattutto in Europa

Chi sei

Stiamo cercando un'esecuzione-o

Die Position
Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns zu Innovationen antreibt. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und den täglichen Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung sicherzustellen, die sie heute und für die kommenden Generationen benötigen. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Die Abteilung Global Operational Excellence widmet sich der Architektur und Skalierung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungen in unserem globalen Netzwerk. Durch die Förderung der strategischen Transformation und die Einbettung ausgereifter operativer Rahmenbedingungen sorgt das Team für Konsistenz, Effizienz und eine leistungsstarke Leistung. Diese Rolle arbeitet in einer dynamischen Matrixumgebung und berichtet an den Global Head Operational Excellence mit einer gestrichelten Linie an den Global Head of Quality.

Als Head of Operational Excellence for Global Quality treten Sie in eine einflussreiche, auf die Ausführung ausgerichtete Führungsrolle ein, die darauf abzielt, eine dedizierte Operational Excellence-Funktion innerhalb der Global Quality-Einheit aufzubauen und zu skalieren. Sie werden die Transformation der operativen Fähigkeiten von Global l Quality vorantreiben, indem Sie dedizierte Ressourcen in verschiedenen Kapiteln und Fertigungsstätten orchestrieren und aufstellen. Ihr primäres, unmittelbares Mandat besteht darin, das Quality Unites Us-Programm zu unterstützen und zu beschleunigen, indem Sie die bereits in der Quality Roadmap definierten greifbaren Verhaltensänderungen und Projektmeilensteine ausführen, skalieren und vorantreiben.

Die Chance

In dieser Rolle haben Sie die Möglichkeit, eine quantifizierbare Prozessoptimierung voranzutreiben, Lean-Prinzipien einzusetzen, mit klarer Rechenschaftspflicht zu finanziellen Zielen beizutragen und eine nachhaltige Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung durch die folgenden Schlüsselaufgaben einzubetten:

• Systembereitstellung: Führen Sie die Einführung von Lean-Standards, identifizieren Sie messbare Produktivitäts- und Kostenoptimierungsinitiativen und betten Sie das Lean Leadership-Programm ein, um als Coach zu fungieren und die proaktive Zertifizierung von Qualitätsführern voranzutreiben.

• Capability Building: Champion und Pflege eines netzwerkweiten Trainingsmodells, um zukünftige Lean Practitioners zu entwickeln, zu zertifizieren und zu betreuen.

• Beschleunigung und Ausrichtung von Qualitätseinheiten: Verankern Sie alle Aktivitäten von Operational Excellence, um Verhaltensänderungen anzuvisieren, entwerfen Sie die strategische Roadmap, um eine zentrale operative Qualitäts-Community aufzubauen, und erstellen Sie ein kollaboratives Hub-and-Spoke-Governance-Framework, um die zentrale Strategie mit eingebetteten Kapitel- und Site-Ressourcen auszurichten.

• Roadmap Execution: Übersetzen von Qualitäts- und Geschäftszielen in konkrete, messbare operative Exzellenz-Aktionspläne, die sich auf die Bereitstellung sofortiger, greifbarer Leistungsverbesserungen für definierte Ergebnisse konzentrieren.

• Prozessoptimierung: Diagnose von Engpässen über Workflows hinweg, Bereitstellung von Lean- und digitalen Methoden zur Optimierung von Prozessen und Skalierung standardisierter Methoden, Toolkits und Performance-KPIs über Kapitel hinweg unter Nutzung bestehender Strukturen von Qualitätseinheiten.

• Hands-On-Problemlösung: Persönlich führen und ermöglichen Sie hochpriore, funktionsübergreifende Ursachenanalyseinitiativen, um komplexe, systemische betriebliche Engpässe abzubauen und eine robuste Prozessbestätigung sicherzustellen.

• Behavior Shifts und Change Management: Handeln Sie als Champion für qualitätsorientierte kulturelle Veränderungen, integrieren Sie diese in tägliche Routinen auf allen Ebenen (einschließlich der Mitglieder des Global Quality Leadership Teams) und bieten Sie direktes, praktisches Field Coaching und Mentoring für eingebettete Ressourcen und eine breitere Führung.

• Diese Rolle erfordert etwa 20% internationale Reisen pro Jahr, vor allem nach Europa

Wer du bist

Wir suchen eine Execution-O

En favorisant la transformation stratégique et en intégrant des cadres opérationnels matures, l'équipe assure la cohérence, l'efficacité et les performances à fort impact. Ce rôle fonctionne dans un environnement matriciel dynamique, relevant de l'Excellence opérationnelle Global Head avec une ligne pointillée au Chef Global de la Qualité .

En tant que chef de l'excellence opérationnelle pour la qualité mondiale, vous entrerez dans un rôle de leadership à impact élevé, axé sur l'exécution, conçu pour construire et à l'échelle une fonction d'excellence opérationnelle dédiée au sein de l'unité qualité mondiale. Vous dirigerez la transformation des capacités opérationnelles de la qualité globale en orchestrant et en mettant en valeur des ressources dédiées à différents chapitres et sites de fabrication. Votre mandat principal et immédiat sera de soutenir et d'accélérer le programme Quality Unites Us en exécutant, à l'échelle et en conduisant les changements de comportement tangibles et les jalons du projet déjà définis par la feuille de route Qualité.

L'opportunité

Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion de stimuler l'optimisation quantifiable des processus, de déployer les principes Lean, de contribuer à des objectifs financiers avec une reddition de comptes claire et d'intégrer une culture durable d'amélioration continue grâce aux responsabilités clés suivantes :

• Déploiement du système : Diriger la mise en oeuvre des normes Lean, identifier des initiatives mesurables en matière de productivité et d'optimisation des coûts, et intégrer le programme Lean Leadership pour agir comme entraîneur et diriger la certification proactive des leaders de la qualité.

• Renforcement des capacités : Championne et maintient un modèle de formation à l'échelle du réseau pour élaborer, certifier et encadrer les futurs praticiens de Lean.

• Accélération et alignement des unités de qualité : Anchor toutes les activités d'excellence opérationnelle pour cibler les changements de comportement, concevoir la feuille de route stratégique pour construire une communauté d'excellence opérationnelle de la qualité mondiale, et établir un cadre de gouvernance axé sur la collaboration afin d'harmoniser la stratégie centrale avec les ressources intégrées du chapitre et du site.

• Exécution de la feuille de route: Traduire des objectifs de qualité et d'affaires en plans d'action concrets et mesurables d'excellence opérationnelle axés sur l'amélioration immédiate et tangible du rendement pour des produits livrables définis.

• Optimisation des processus : Diagnostiquer les goulots d'étranglement à travers les flux de travail, déployer des méthodologies lean et numériques pour rationaliser les processus, et mettre à l'échelle les méthodologies normalisées, les trousses d'outils et les ICR de performance dans tous les chapitres en tirant parti des structures d'unités de qualité existantes.

• Résoudre les problèmes : Diriger et faciliter personnellement des initiatives d'analyse de causes profondes interfonctionnelles hautement prioritaires afin de démanteler les goulets d'étranglement opérationnels complexes et systémiques et d'assurer une confirmation solide du processus.

• Changements de comportement et gestion du changement : Agir en tant que champion des changements culturels prescrits par les unités de qualité, les intégrer dans les routines quotidiennes à tous les niveaux (y compris les membres de l'équipe de leadership de la qualité mondiale) et fournir un encadrement direct et pratique sur le terrain et un mentorat pour les ressources intégrées et un leadership plus large.

• Ce rôle nécessite environ 20 % de voyages internationaux par an, principalement en Europe.

Qui vous êtes

Nous cherchons une exécution-o

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
ASPIRE is a multi-year program that will define, design, and deploy Future ERP solutions based on SAP S/4 HANA and other cloud/on-premise technology platforms. The program will enable simplified, standardized, and harmonized global business processes by capitalizing on SAP, Life Science Industry and Roche effective practices.

The opportunity:

• Preparation and leading of FIT-to-Template (assessment of the current business processes compared and aligned against the future Aspire Global Template) and scoping workshops for Financial Compliance

• Liaising with local affiliate Finance stakeholders for the implementation of Financial Compliance requirements

• Assessment of localization requirements for Authorization

• Execution of Testing Activities during the deployment (UT, SAT, UAT, REG)

• Go Live & Hyper care (incl. Month end closing ) support

• Ensure template governance within the project including change control management in line with the respective GBPMs/GBPOs and the overall Finance governance concept

Who you are

• You have a university degree in Business Administration, Accounting or a related field.

• 5+ years related business experience or equivalent Project Management skills in the area of SAP Authorization

• Broad knowledge of business processes, policies and programs

• Strong Project Management , business partner management, communication and change management skills. Experience in Agile Project Methodologies is a plus

• Strong people skill s are required as the role is highly consultative, interacting with staff at all levels across an organization

• Proficiency in English

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, language allowance (if the position requires extra language), annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice ( 2 office days/week on average) . We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.

• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion.

Duration: This position is temporary for 2 years.

So far, so good?
It gets even better. We offer you a wide range of top benefits at our sites. Only together with you can we improve patients' lives. Your contribution makes Roche unique. That’s why we provide extraordinary benefits that empower you to design your life, finances, and health just the way you want. Find out more here: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Your Application
We kindly ask you to submit the following documents:

• Current resume (CV) or Workday profile

• Your official (educational) certificates and transcripts

Additional documents are currently not strictly required. Please note that no further documents can be added after submitting your application.

Dort, wo

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
ASPIRE è un programma pluriennale che definirà, progetta e distribuirà soluzioni future ERP basate su SAP S/4 HANA e su altre piattaforme tecnologiche cloud/on-premise. Il programma consentirà processi aziendali globali semplificati, standardizzati e armonizzati, capitalizzando le pratiche efficaci di SAP, Life Science Industry e Roche.

L'opportunità:

• Preparazione e guida di FIT-to-Template (valutazione dei processi aziendali attuali confrontati e allineati contro il futuro Aspire Global Template) e workshop di valutazione per la conformità finanziaria

• Liaising con gli stakeholder di finanza locale per l'attuazione dei requisiti di conformità finanziaria

• Valutazione dei requisiti di localizzazione per l'autorizzazione

• Esecuzione delle attività di test durante l'implementazione (UT, SAT, UAT, REG)

• Vai Live & Hyper care (incl. Chiusura mensile ) supporto

• Assicurare la governance dei modelli all'interno del progetto, compresa la gestione del controllo dei cambiamenti in linea con i rispettivi GBPM/GBPO e il concetto di governance finanziaria generale

Chi sei

• Hai una laurea in Business Administration, Contabilità o un campo correlato.

• 5+ anni di esperienza aziendale o equivalenti competenze di Project Management nell'area di SAP Authorization

• Conoscenza di processi aziendali, politiche e programmi

• Strong Project Management, business partner management, capacità di comunicazione e gestione dei cambiamenti. Esperienza in Agile Project Methodologies è un plus

• Le competenze delle persone forti sono richieste in quanto il ruolo è altamente consultivo, interagire con il personale a tutti i livelli di un'organizzazione

• Proficienza in inglese

In cambio vi forniamo:

• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.

• Vantaggi eccellenti & flessibilità: pacchetto salariale competitivo e caffetteria, indennità di lingua (se la posizione richiede lingua extra), bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare Sportpass, coaching / opportunità di mentoring, programma amico, team building, festa. Garantiamo anche la flessibilità, per aiutarvi a trovare il vostro equilibrio: l'ufficio di casa è una pratica comune (in media 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana) . Creiamo l'opportunità per la libertà di lavoro, dove la vostra vita aziendale e privata coesistono in armonia.

• Una comunità globale inclusiva, dove impariamo l'uno dall'altro. A Roche, collaboriamo, dibattiamo, prendiamo decisioni, festeggiamo i successi e ci divertiamo come squadra. La nostra leadership è molto focalizzata sulle persone, creando una cultura forte e inclusiva, quindi hai sempre la possibilità di condividere la tua opinione.

Durata: Questa posizione è temporanea per 2 anni.

Finora, così bene?
E' ancora meglio. Vi offriamo una vasta gamma di migliori vantaggi nei nostri siti. Solo insieme a voi possiamo migliorare la vita dei pazienti. Il tuo contributo rende Roche unico. Ecco perché forniamo benefici straordinari che ti permettono di progettare la tua vita, le finanze e la salute proprio come vuoi. Maggiori informazioni qui: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

La tua domanda
Vi preghiamo di presentare i seguenti documenti:

• Ripristino corrente (CV) o Profilo Workday

• I tuoi certificati e trascrizioni ufficiali (educativi)

Attualmente non sono strettamente necessari ulteriori documenti. Si prega di notare che non è possibile aggiungere ulteriori documenti dopo la presentazione della domanda.

Dort, wo
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
ASPIRE ist ein mehrjähriges Programm, das zukünftige ERP-Lösungen auf Basis von SAP S/4 HANA und anderen Cloud-/On-Premise-Technologieplattformen definieren, entwerfen und bereitstellen wird. Das Programm ermöglicht vereinfachte, standardisierte und harmonisierte globale Geschäftsprozesse, indem es auf SAP, Life Science Industry und Roche effektive Praktiken nutzt.

Die Gelegenheit:

• Vorbereitung und Leitung von FIT-to-Template (Bewertung der aktuellen Geschäftsprozesse im Vergleich zum zukünftigen Aspire Global Template) und Scoping-Workshops für Financial Compliance

• Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Affiliate-Finanzen für die Umsetzung der Financial Compliance-Anforderungen

• Bewertung der Lokalisierungsanforderungen für die Autorisierung

• Durchführung von Testaktivitäten während des Einsatzes (UT, SAT, UAT, REG)

• Go Live & Hyper Care (inkl.) Monatsabschluss ) Unterstützung

• Gewährleistung der Vorlagen-Governance innerhalb des Projekts, einschließlich des Change Control Managements im Einklang mit den jeweiligen GBPMs/GBPOs und dem Gesamtkonzept der Finanz-Governance

Wer du bist

• Sie haben einen Universitätsabschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Rechnungswesen oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• 5+ Jahre Geschäftserfahrung oder gleichwertige Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten im Bereich SAP Authorization

• Breites Wissen über Geschäftsprozesse, Richtlinien und Programme

• Starkes Projektmanagement, Geschäftspartnermanagement, Kommunikation und Change Management Fähigkeiten. Erfahrung in agilen Projektmethoden ist ein Plus

• Starke Fähigkeiten für Menschen sind erforderlich, da die Rolle sehr beratend ist und mit Mitarbeitern auf allen Ebenen einer Organisation interagiert.

• Englischkenntnisse

Im Gegenzug bieten wir Ihnen:

• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Roche ist reich an Lernressourcen. Wir bieten ständige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, kostenlose Sprachkurse & Trainings, die Möglichkeit internationaler Einsätze, interne Positionswechsel und die Möglichkeit, die eigene Karriere zu gestalten.

• Ausgezeichnete Vorteile & Flexibilität: wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Cafeteria-Paket, Sprachzulage (wenn die Position zusätzliche Sprache erfordert), Jahresbonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, Coaching / Mentoring-Möglichkeit, Buddy-Programm, Teamgebäude, Feiertagsparty. Wir sorgen auch für Flexibilität, um Ihnen zu helfen, Ihr Gleichgewicht zu finden: Home Office ist eine gängige Praxis (durchschnittlich 2 Bürotage / Woche). Wir schaffen die Möglichkeit zur Arbeitsfreiheit, in der Ihr Firmen- und Privatleben in Harmonie koexistieren.

• Eine globale inklusive Gemeinschaft, in der wir voneinander lernen. Bei Roche kooperieren, diskutieren, treffen Entscheidungen, feiern Erfolge und haben Spaß als Team. Unsere Führung ist sehr auf Menschen ausgerichtet und schafft eine starke, integrative Kultur, so dass Sie immer die Chance haben, Ihre Meinung zu teilen.

Dauer: Diese Position ist vorübergehend für 2 Jahre.

So weit, so gut?
Es wird noch besser. Wir bieten Ihnen eine breite Palette von Top-Vorteilen an unseren Standorten. Nur gemeinsam mit Ihnen können wir das Leben der Patienten verbessern. Ihr Beitrag macht Roche einzigartig. Deshalb bieten wir außergewöhnliche Vorteile, die es Ihnen ermöglichen, Ihr Leben, Ihre Finanzen und Ihre Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Sie es möchten. Mehr dazu finden Sie hier: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE

Ihre Bewerbung
Wir bitten Sie, folgende Unterlagen einzureichen:

• Aktueller Lebenslauf (CV) oder Workday-Profil

• Ihre offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zertifikate und Transkripte

Zusätzliche Dokumente sind derzeit nicht unbedingt erforderlich. Bitte beachten Sie, dass nach Einreichung Ihrer Bewerbung keine weiteren Unterlagen hinzugefügt werden können.

The Position
Roche PD’s mission is to improve patients’ lives around the world through unique medicines that have a meaningful impact. Cross functionally we conduct global clinical trials, analyse results, monitor safety and work with regulatory authorities to provide truly differentiated medicines to patients. Our primary disease focus areas are Oncology, Hematology, Neurology, Immunology, Ophthalmology and Cardiovascular, Renal, and Metabolism (CVRM).

The Product Development Global Clinical Operations team is at the heart of this mission, and we aspire to be leaders in Clinical Operations. We are responsible for providing operational project management, leadership and expertise. We act as the interface between Roche and external parties for optimal study delivery emphasising the importance of speed and cost-effectiveness. We instill an enterprise-wide perspective in all our work so that we continue to deliver for patients and Roche in accordance with regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) standards.

As an Industrial Placement Student (IPS) in Clinical Operations, you will get involved in supporting key tasks across a broad range of topics with potential to build your network outside of the department, ultimately helping accelerate drug development and the successful execution of clinical trials.
We want you to join our mission and be part of our passionate, collaborative, dynamic Clinical Operations community!

The Opportunity :

We are offering an outstanding 13 month placement opportunity for up to six Industrial Placement Students (IPS), who will be based in Welwyn Garden City, UK .
The IPS-COA will sit within Clinical Operations and be assigned to a clinical trial as well as be a valued part of a supportive and collaborative study community. The IPS-COA will be included in working groups where they will do meaningful work and have the opportunity to develop their skills and knowledge as well as connect and collaborate with individuals in other functions outside of Operations. The IPS-COA will work closely with the Global Studies Leader (GSL) and the Global Studies Asset Manager (GSAM), who are responsible for effective and efficient leadership and delivery of all operational components of a clinical trial across study start up, conduct and close-out in accordance with the appropriate quality standards including Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and applicable regulations.

Students may also have the opportunity to work alongside the Country and Study Start-Up Teams. In this capacity they will strengthen site engagement, ensure effective communication and collaboration with clinical trial sites, and add value to Roche’s portfolio, from early to late-stage development across Roche assets.

Key activities include:

• Day-to-Day Operations: Support the study team with daily operational tasks to ensure the clinical trial runs smoothly (e.g., patient recruitment, problem-solving, and working with contracts).

• Vendor Management: Assist in managing external vendors and Contract Research Organisations (CROs).

• Drug Supply: Support the management of clinical drug supply and shipments.

• Site Engagement: Work with the local study team to support effective study start-up strategies and assist in developing strong relationships with trial sites (including potential site visit opportunities).

• Compliance: Ensure study adherence to GCP and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche PD’s mission is to improve patients’ lives around the world through unique medicines that have a meaningful impact. Cross functionally we conduct global clinical trials, analyse results, monitor safety and work with regulatory authorities to provide truly differentiated medicines to patients. Our primary disease focus areas are Oncology, Hematology, Neurology, Immunology, Ophthalmology and Cardiovascular, Renal, and Metabolism (CVRM).

The Product Development Global Clinical Operations team is at the heart of this mission, and we aspire to be leaders in Clinical Operations. We are responsible for providing operational project management, leadership and expertise. We act as the interface between Roche and external parties for optimal study delivery emphasising the importance of speed and cost-effectiveness. We instill an enterprise-wide perspective in all our work so that we continue to deliver for patients and Roche in accordance with regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) standards.

As an Industrial Placement Student (IPS) in Clinical Operations, you will get involved in supporting key tasks across a broad range of topics with potential to build your network outside of the department, ultimately helping accelerate drug development and the successful execution of clinical trials.
We want you to join our mission and be part of our passionate, collaborative, dynamic Clinical Operations community!

The Opportunity :

We are offering an outstanding 13 month placement opportunity for up to six Industrial Placement Students (IPS), who will be based in Welwyn Garden City, UK .
The IPS-COA will sit within Clinical Operations and be assigned to a clinical trial as well as be a valued part of a supportive and collaborative study community. The IPS-COA will be included in working groups where they will do meaningful work and have the opportunity to develop their skills and knowledge as well as connect and collaborate with individuals in other functions outside of Operations. The IPS-COA will work closely with the Global Studies Leader (GSL) and the Global Studies Asset Manager (GSAM), who are responsible for effective and efficient leadership and delivery of all operational components of a clinical trial across study start up, conduct and close-out in accordance with the appropriate quality standards including Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and applicable regulations.

Students may also have the opportunity to work alongside the Country and Study Start-Up Teams. In this capacity they will strengthen site engagement, ensure effective communication and collaboration with clinical trial sites, and add value to Roche’s portfolio, from early to late-stage development across Roche assets.

Key activities include:

• Day-to-Day Operations: Support the study team with daily operational tasks to ensure the clinical trial runs smoothly (e.g., patient recruitment, problem-solving, and working with contracts).

• Vendor Management: Assist in managing external vendors and Contract Research Organisations (CROs).

• Drug Supply: Support the management of clinical drug supply and shipments.

• Site Engagement: Work with the local study team to support effective study start-up strategies and assist in developing strong relationships with trial sites (including potential site visit opportunities).

• Compliance: Ensure study adherence to GCP and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Networking: Attend and actively participate in non-stud
descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
La missione di Roche PD è di migliorare la vita dei pazienti in tutto il mondo attraverso farmaci unici che hanno un impatto significativo. Attraversiamo funzionale studi clinici globali, analisi dei risultati, monitoraggio della sicurezza e lavoro con le autorità di regolamentazione per fornire farmaci veramente differenziati ai pazienti. Le nostre aree principali sono Oncologia, Ematologia, Neurologia, Immunologia, Oftalmologia e Cardiovascolare, Renale e Metabolismo (CVRM).

Il team Global Clinical Operations è al centro di questa missione, e aspiriamo ad essere leader nelle Operazioni Cliniche. Siamo responsabili della gestione operativa dei progetti, della leadership e della competenza. Agiamo come interfaccia tra Roche e parti esterne per una consegna ottimale dello studio che sottolinea l'importanza della velocità e dell'efficacia dei costi. Instilliamo una prospettiva a livello aziendale in tutto il nostro lavoro in modo che continuiamo a fornire per i pazienti e Roche in conformità con le normative, buona pratica clinica (GCP) e buone pratiche di farmacovigilanza (GVP) standard.

In qualità di studente di collocamento industriale (IPS) nelle operazioni cliniche, sarete coinvolti nel sostenere i compiti chiave in una vasta gamma di argomenti con il potenziale di costruire la vostra rete al di fuori del dipartimento, in ultima analisi, aiutando ad accelerare lo sviluppo della droga e l'esecuzione riuscita di studi clinici.
Vogliamo che si unisca alla nostra missione e faccia parte della nostra appassionata, collaborativa, dinamica comunità di Operazioni Cliniche!

L'opportunità :

Stiamo offrendo una straordinaria opportunità di collocamento di 13 mesi per un massimo di sei studenti di collocamento industriale (IPS), che saranno basati in Welwyn Garden City, Regno Unito .
La IPS-COA siederà all'interno delle Operazioni Cliniche e sarà assegnata ad una sperimentazione clinica e sarà una parte preziosa di una comunità di studio solidale e collaborativa. L'IPS-COA sarà incluso in gruppi di lavoro dove faranno un lavoro significativo e avranno l'opportunità di sviluppare le proprie competenze e conoscenze, nonché di connettersi e collaborare con gli individui in altre funzioni al di fuori delle Operazioni. L'IPS-COA lavorerà a stretto contatto con il Global Studies Leader (GSL) e il Global Studies Asset Manager (GSAM), che sono responsabili di una leadership efficace ed efficiente e la consegna di tutti i componenti operativi di uno studio clinico attraverso l'avvio, la condotta e la chiusura in conformità con gli standard di qualità appropriati, tra cui la buona pratica clinica (GCP) e le normative applicabili.

Gli studenti possono anche avere l'opportunità di lavorare accanto al Paese e Studio Start-Up Teams. In questa capacità rafforzeranno l’impegno del sito, garantiranno una comunicazione efficace e una collaborazione con i siti di sperimentazione clinica, e aggiungeranno valore al portafoglio di Roche, dal primo al tardo stadio dello sviluppo dei beni Roche.

Le attività principali includono:

• Operazioni giornaliere: Sostenere il team di studio con compiti operativi giornalieri per garantire che la sperimentazione clinica funzioni senza intoppi (ad esempio, il reclutamento dei pazienti, la risoluzione dei problemi e il lavoro con i contratti).

• Gestione del Fornitore: Assist nella gestione di fornitori esterni e organizzazioni di ricerca dei contratti (CRO).

• Droga: Supporta la gestione dell'approvvigionamento e delle spedizioni di farmaci clinici.

• Engagement del sito: lavorare con il team di studio locale per sostenere strategie di avvio di studio efficaci e aiutare a sviluppare relazioni forti con i siti di prova (incluse le potenziali opportunità di visita del sito).

• Compliance: Assicurare l'adesione di studio a GCP e procedure operative standard (SOP).

• Networking: Partecipare e partecipare attivamente al non-stud
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Die Mission von Roche PD ist es, das Leben von Patienten auf der ganzen Welt durch einzigartige Medikamente zu verbessern, die eine bedeutende Wirkung haben. Funktionell führen wir globale klinische Studien durch, analysieren Ergebnisse, überwachen die Sicherheit und arbeiten mit Regulierungsbehörden zusammen, um Patienten wirklich differenzierte Medikamente zur Verfügung zu stellen. Unsere primären Krankheitsschwerpunkte sind Onkologie, Hämatologie, Neurologie, Immunologie, Augenheilkunde und Herz-Kreislauf-, Nieren- und Stoffwechsel (CVRM).

Das Product Development Global Clinical Operations Team steht im Mittelpunkt dieser Mission, und wir streben danach, führend in Clinical Operations zu sein. Wir sind verantwortlich für die Bereitstellung von operativem Projektmanagement, Führung und Expertise. Wir fungieren als Schnittstelle zwischen Roche und externen Parteien für eine optimale Studienabwicklung und betonen die Bedeutung von Geschwindigkeit und Wirtschaftlichkeit. Wir vermitteln bei all unserer Arbeit eine unternehmensweite Perspektive, so dass wir weiterhin für Patienten und Roche gemäß den Standards Good Clinical Practice (GCP) und Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) liefern.

Als Industrial Placement Student (IPS) in Clinical Operations werden Sie in die Unterstützung von Schlüsselaufgaben in einem breiten Spektrum von Themen mit dem Potenzial, Ihr Netzwerk außerhalb der Abteilung aufzubauen, letztlich helfen, die Medikamentenentwicklung und die erfolgreiche Durchführung von klinischen Studien zu beschleunigen.
Wir möchten, dass Sie sich unserer Mission anschließen und Teil unserer leidenschaftlichen, kooperativen, dynamischen Clinical Operations Community werden!

Die Gelegenheit:

Wir bieten eine hervorragende 13-monatige Praktikumsmöglichkeit für bis zu sechs Industrial Placement Students (IPS), die in Welwyn Garden City, Großbritannien, ansässig sein werden.
Die IPS-COA wird innerhalb der Clinical Operations angesiedelt und einer klinischen Studie zugewiesen sowie ein geschätzter Teil einer unterstützenden und kooperativen Studiengemeinschaft sein. Die IPS-COA wird in Arbeitsgruppen aufgenommen, in denen sie sinnvolle Arbeit leisten und die Möglichkeit haben, ihre Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse zu entwickeln und sich mit Einzelpersonen in anderen Funktionen außerhalb von Operations zu verbinden und zusammenzuarbeiten. Die IPS-COA wird eng mit dem Global Studies Leader (GSL) und dem Global Studies Asset Manager (GSAM) zusammenarbeiten, die für die effektive und effiziente Führung und Durchführung aller operativen Komponenten einer klinischen Studie in Übereinstimmung mit den entsprechenden Qualitätsstandards, einschließlich Good Clinical Practice (GCP) und den geltenden Vorschriften, verantwortlich sind.

Die Studierenden können auch die Möglichkeit haben, neben dem Land und Study Start-Up Teams zu arbeiten. In dieser Eigenschaft werden sie die Standortbindung stärken, eine effektive Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit mit klinischen Studienstandorten sicherstellen und das Portfolio von Roche von der frühen bis zur späten Entwicklungsphase in allen Roche-Vermögensbereichen bereichern.

Zu den wichtigsten Aktivitäten gehören:

• Tagesgeschäft: Unterstützen Sie das Studienteam bei täglichen operativen Aufgaben, um sicherzustellen, dass die klinische Studie reibungslos abläuft (z. B. Patientenrekrutierung, Problemlösung und Arbeit mit Verträgen).

• Vendor Management: Unterstützung bei der Verwaltung externer Anbieter und Contract Research Organisations (CROs).

• Drug Supply: Unterstützung des Managements der klinischen Arzneimittelversorgung und -lieferungen.

• Site Engagement: Arbeiten Sie mit dem lokalen Studienteam zusammen, um effektive Startstrategien für Studien zu unterstützen und dabei zu helfen, starke Beziehungen zu Studienstandorten aufzubauen (einschließlich potenzieller Besuchsmöglichkeiten).

• Compliance: Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von GCP und Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Networking: Beteiligen und aktiv an Non-Stud
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Roche a pour mission d'améliorer la vie des patients à travers le monde grâce à des médicaments uniques qui ont un impact significatif. Nous menons des essais cliniques mondiaux, analysons les résultats, surveillons la sécurité et travaillons avec les autorités de régulation pour fournir des médicaments vraiment différenciés aux patients. Nos principaux domaines d'intervention pour les maladies sont l'oncologie, l'hématologie, la neurologie, l'immunologie, l'ophtalmologie et le cardiovasculaire, le renal et le métabolisme (CVRM).

L'équipe Développement de produits Opérations cliniques mondiales est au cœur de cette mission, et nous aspirons à être des leaders en Opérations cliniques. Nous sommes responsables de la gestion opérationnelle des projets, du leadership et de l'expertise. Nous agissons en tant qu'interface entre Roche et les parties externes pour une prestation optimale de l'étude en soulignant l'importance de la rapidité et de la rentabilité. Nous instilisons une perspective globale dans tous nos travaux afin que nous continuions à fournir pour les patients et Roche conformément aux règlements, aux bonnes pratiques cliniques (BCP) et aux bonnes pratiques de pharmacovigilance (GVP).

En tant qu'étudiant en placement industriel (IPS) en opérations cliniques, vous participerez à l'appui de tâches clés sur un large éventail de sujets susceptibles de créer votre réseau à l'extérieur du ministère, en fin de compte aider à accélérer le développement de médicaments et la réussite des essais cliniques.
Nous voulons que vous rejoigniez notre mission et participiez à notre communauté d'opérations cliniques passionnée, collaborative et dynamique!

La possibilité :

Nous offrons une occasion exceptionnelle de placement de 13 mois pour jusqu'à six étudiants en placement industriel (IPS), qui seront basés à Welwyn Garden City, Royaume-Uni .
L'IPS-COA siégera dans le cadre des Opérations cliniques et sera affecté à un essai clinique ainsi qu'à une partie précieuse d'une communauté d'étude solidaire. L'IPS-COA sera inclus dans des groupes de travail où ils feront un travail significatif et auront la possibilité de développer leurs compétences et leurs connaissances ainsi que de communiquer et de collaborer avec des personnes dans d'autres fonctions en dehors des opérations. L'IPS-COA travaillera en étroite collaboration avec le responsable des études mondiales et le gestionnaire des biens d'études mondiales (GSAM), qui sont responsables de la direction et de la prestation efficaces et efficientes de toutes les composantes opérationnelles d'un essai clinique tout au long du démarrage, de la conduite et de la clôture de l'étude, conformément aux normes de qualité appropriées, y compris les bonnes pratiques cliniques (BCP) et les règlements applicables.

Les étudiants peuvent également avoir la possibilité de travailler avec les équipes de démarrage de pays et d'études. À ce titre, ils renforceront l'engagement du site, assureront une communication et une collaboration efficaces avec les sites d'essais cliniques et ajouteront de la valeur au portefeuille de Roches, du début à la fin du développement de l'ensemble des actifs de Roche.

Les principales activités sont les suivantes :

• Opérations quotidiennes : Appuyer l'équipe d'étude avec des tâches opérationnelles quotidiennes pour assurer le bon déroulement de l'essai clinique (p. ex. recrutement de patients, résolution de problèmes et travail avec des contrats).

• Gestion des fournisseurs : Aider à gérer les fournisseurs externes et les organismes de recherche contractuels (ORC).

• Offre de médicaments : Appuyer la gestion de l'offre et des expéditions de médicaments cliniques.

• Engagement sur place : Collaborer avec l'équipe d'étude locale pour appuyer des stratégies de démarrage efficaces et aider à établir des relations solides avec les sites d'essai (y compris les possibilités de visite sur place).

• Conformité : Veiller à ce que l'étude respecte le PSG et les procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON).

• Réseautage: Participer et participer activement à des activités non-stud

jobs.title: Intern - Brand & Customer Management
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Le Poste
Au sein du département Business Operations de Roche, le/la stagiaire sera intégré(e) à l’équipe Marketing (Hémophilie ou Oncologie).
Le stage permettra de contribuer à la mise en œuvre de stratégies marketing innovantes visant à améliorer l’engagement des professionnels de santé et le parcours patient en Hémophilie. Il offre une immersion complète dans un environnement dynamique, à l’interface entre marketing, médical et stratégie, avec une forte orientation patient-centric.

Tâches Principales
- Contribuer au développement d’une stratégie multicanal et à l’exécution de campagnes marketing (digital, supports promotionnels, contenus éducatifs)
- Participer aux tâches administratives liées aux campagnes (process de validation, coordination logistique, impression)
- Assurer le suivi des performances des campagnes en lien avec les équipes terrain et proposer des recommandations d’optimisation
- Collaborer avec les équipes internes pour développer des contenus adaptés aux différents canaux d’engagement
- Participer à l’organisation d’événements scientifiques (congrès, symposiums, séminaires)
- Participer à la gestion de projets marketing (conception, initiation, coordination et suivi)
- Travailler en transverse avec les équipes médicales, réglementaires et accès au marché
- Contribuer aux réflexions stratégiques (plan stratégique, initiatives d’amélioration du parcours patient)

Qui vous etes?
- Vous avez une formation scientifique (Pharmacie, Médecine, Biologie) doublée d’une spécialisation en Marketing
- Vous avez une première expérience en marketing en industrie pharmaceutique, en conseil ou stratégie.
- Vous faites preuve de rigueur et d’organisation, et vous aimez le travail en équipe et êtes doté(e) de bonnes aptitudes relationnelles et de communication.
- Développement d’une approche customer-centric et patient-centric
- Analyse de la performance des campagnes marketing et génération d’insights
- Gestion de projet (planning, coordination, suivi)
- Collaboration cross-fonctionnelle (médical, réglementaire, market access)
- Développement de contenus marketing et scientifiques
- Rigueur, organisation et capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités

Durée du stage: 6 mois avec possibilité de renouvellement selon les besoins de l'entreprise.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete stimati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di tre sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui amiamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Ufficio postale
All'interno del reparto Operazioni Commerciali Roche, lo stage sarà integrato nel team Marketing (Hemophilia o Oncology).
Il corso contribuirà all'implementazione di strategie di marketing innovative per migliorare l'impegno dei professionisti del settore sanitario e il viaggio paziente in Hemophilia. Offre un'immersione completa in un ambiente dinamico, all'interfaccia tra marketing, medicina e strategia, con un forte orientamento paziente-centrico.

Principali compiti
- Contribuire allo sviluppo di una strategia multicanale e campagne di marketing (materiali digitali, promozionali, contenuti educativi)
- Partecipazione ai compiti amministrativi relativi alle campagne (processi di valutazione, coordinamento logistico, stampa)
- Monitorare le prestazioni della campagna in relazione ai team di campo e proporre raccomandazioni per l'ottimizzazione
- Collabora con i team interni per sviluppare contenuti adattati a diversi canali di fidanzamento
- Partecipazione all'organizzazione di eventi scientifici (congressi, simposi, seminari)
- Partecipazione alla gestione dei progetti di marketing (design, iniziazione, coordinamento e follow-up)
- Lavora con i team di accesso medico, normativo e di mercato
- Contribuire al pensiero strategico (piano strategico, iniziative di miglioramento del percorso paziente)

Chi sei?
- Hai una formazione scientifica (Pharmacy, Medicine, Biologia) accoppiata con una specializzazione in Marketing
- Hai la prima esperienza nel marketing nel settore farmaceutico, consulenza o strategia.
- Sei rigoroso e organizzativo, e ami il lavoro di squadra e hai buone capacità relazionali e di comunicazione.
- Sviluppo di un approccio customer-centric e paziente-centric
- Analisi delle prestazioni delle campagne di marketing e generazione di approfondimenti
- Gestione del progetto (pianificazione, coordinamento, monitoraggio)
- Collaborazione interfunzionale (medico, normativo, accesso al mercato)
- Sviluppo del marketing e del contenuto scientifico
- Rigor, organizzazione e capacità di gestire più priorità

Durata dello stage: 6 mesi con possibilità di rinnovo secondo le esigenze dell'azienda.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati all'avanzamento della scienza, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 trilioni di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un dipendente di pari opportunità.

- Monitor campaign performance in relation to field teams and propose recommendations for optimization
- Collaborate with internal teams to develop content adapted to different engagement channels
- Participate in the organisation of scientific events (congresses, symposia, seminars)
- Participate in the management of marketing projects (design, initiation, coordination and follow-up)
- Work with medical, regulatory and market access teams
- Contribute to strategic thinking (strategic plan, patient path improvement initiatives)

Who are you?
- You have a scientific training (Pharmacy, Medicine, Biology) coupled with a specialization in Marketing
- You have first experience in marketing in the pharmaceutical industry, consulting or strategy.
- You are rigorous and organizational, and you love teamwork and have good relational and communication skills.
- Development of a customer-centric and patient-centric approach
- Analysis of the performance of marketing campaigns and generation of insights
- Project management (planning, coordination, monitoring)
- Cross-functional collaboration (medical, regulatory, market access)
- Development of marketing and scientific content
- Rigor, organization and ability to manage multiple priorities

Duration of the internship: 6 months with possibility of renewal according to the needs of the company.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100,000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 trillion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Lets build a future healthier, together.

Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As an Engineering Manager you will focus on capabilities development of your team members that align with the function’s vision. You will encourage your team to self-define their career journey and seek ways to enable development opportunities in the direction of the journey. You will support them in removing roadblocks and by setting focus in their performance management. You make sure to develop your team with the right skills, healthy dynamics and a sustainable pace. You support the software and/or service delivery as a leader setting focus, removing impediments, managing stakeholders and creating efficiencies in collaboration wherever possible.

What you’ll be working on

People Management

• Responsible for providing a wide range of leadership for the team including but not limited to: Provide proactive feedback and coaching to responsible employees and provide feedback to leadership. Provide development support, performance evaluation, compensation, support, succession and talent management, conflict handling, and performance improvement planning with the support of the operation managers. Foster's a healthy, trusted environment, positive, energetic, inclusive, and enthusiastic environment to ensure people's engagement and a high sense of morale. Leaders will also ensure that People & Culture and compliance policies are adhered to by their team.

• Service Management : Responsible for achieving the agreed Service Level and ensuring operational KPIs are met with excellence by leveraging the right people and capabilities to provide the best user experience possible. Ensures the right people are in the right jobs and staffing levels are maintained according to requirements. Ensures that the units, processes, services & activities are fulfilling the defined objectives & targets, making improvements as required. Participates in collaborative regional and global squads to support the organization. Ensure ongoing monitoring of service level daily, proactively highlight any issue to create the proper actions

• Account Management : In account management, the leader would be the point of contact for assigned and designated site(s). The leader will provide: Monthly service reviews. 1st point of contact for escalation management.. Assist in new account transition and knowledge transfer. Proactively communicating with Stakeholders on any changes and potential issues - addressing difficult situations upfront. Support account improvement plan and coordinate actions with the respective teams

• Project Management : In project management, the leader would participate or sometimes lead certain projects. This includes : The new system goes live. New scope transition. New site transition. The leader would be expected to: Support/Lead transition activities (including knowledge transfer, hiring, training, etc). Support the transition team in resource allocation/management. Involve in Hypercare

• People-oriented mindset, highly accountable, agile, and results-oriented. Acts as a servant leader. Lives the Roche values and leadership commitments, has a growth mindset and drives a collaborative culture in the organization. Represent and support the desired ways of working (Agile, LEAN, ITIL, VACC). Ability to work in, co-create and contribute to a highly complex and team-oriented global environment.

• Ability to work in, and contribute to, a fast-paced and changing environment, where multiple priorities need to be effectively managed, while maintaining composure and flexibility

A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
In qualità di Engineering Manager ti concentrerai sullo sviluppo delle funzionalità dei membri del tuo team che si allineano alla visione della funzione. Incoraggiate il vostro team a autodefinire il loro viaggio di carriera e cercare modi per consentire opportunità di sviluppo nella direzione del viaggio. Li supporterete nella rimozione dei blocchi stradali e impostando l'attenzione nella loro gestione delle prestazioni. Assicurati di sviluppare il tuo team con le giuste competenze, dinamiche sane e un ritmo sostenibile. Supporti il software e/o la fornitura di servizi come un focus di impostazione leader, la rimozione di impedimenti, la gestione delle parti interessate e la creazione di efficienze in collaborazione laddove possibile.

Su cosa lavorerai

Gestione delle persone

• Responsabile per la fornitura di una vasta gamma di leadership per il team, tra cui ma non solo: fornire feedback proattivo e coaching ai dipendenti responsabili e fornire feedback alla leadership. Fornire supporto allo sviluppo, valutazione delle prestazioni, compensazione, supporto, successione e gestione dei talenti, gestione dei conflitti e pianificazione del miglioramento delle prestazioni con il supporto dei gestori operativi. Foster è un ambiente sano, affidabile, positivo, energico, inclusivo ed entusiasta per garantire il coinvolgimento delle persone e un alto senso di morale. I leader garantiranno inoltre che le politiche di People & Culture e compliance siano rispettate dal loro team.

• Gestione del servizio: Responsabile per il raggiungimento del livello di servizio concordato e garantire che i KPI operativi siano soddisfatti con l'eccellenza sfruttando le persone e le capacità giuste per fornire la migliore esperienza possibile dell'utente. Assicura che le persone giuste siano nel giusto lavoro e i livelli di personale sono mantenuti secondo i requisiti. Assicura che le unità, i processi, i servizi e le attività soddisfino gli obiettivi e gli obiettivi definiti, apportando miglioramenti come richiesto. Partecipa a squadre regionali e globali collaborative per sostenere l'organizzazione. Assicurare il monitoraggio continuo del livello di servizio quotidiano, evidenziare proattivamente qualsiasi problema per creare azioni adeguate

• Gestione account: Nella gestione account, il leader sarebbe il punto di contatto per i siti/i assegnati e designati. Il leader fornirà: recensioni mensili di servizio. 1° punto di contatto per la gestione dell'escalation.. Assistere nella transizione di nuovi account e trasferimento di conoscenze. Proattivamente comunicare con Stakeholders su eventuali cambiamenti e potenziali problemi - affrontare situazioni difficili in anticipo. Supporta il piano di miglioramento del conto e coordina le azioni con le rispettive squadre

• Gestione dei progetti: nella gestione dei progetti, il leader parteciperà o a volte guiderà alcuni progetti. Questo include: il nuovo sistema va in diretta. Nuova transizione di portata. Nuova transizione del sito. Si prevede che il leader: Support/Lead attività di transizione (tra cui trasferimento di conoscenze, assunzione, formazione, ecc.). Sostenere il team di transizione in allocazione delle risorse / gestione. Coinvolgere in Hypercare

• mentalità orientata alla gente, altamente responsabile, agile e orientata ai risultati. Agisce come un capo servo. Vive i valori Roche e gli impegni di leadership, ha una mentalità di crescita e guida una cultura collaborativa nell'organizzazione. Rappresentare e sostenere le modalità di lavoro desiderate (Agile, LEAN, ITIL, VACC). Capacità di lavorare, co-creare e contribuire a un ambiente globale altamente complesso e orientato al team.

• Capacità di lavorare e contribuire a un ambiente veloce e mutevole, in cui più priorità devono essere gestite in modo efficace, pur mantenendo la compostezza e la flessibilità

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Data Science - Engagement Lead , you will join the Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) within Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) in San José, Costa Rica . In this high-impact, technical leadership role, you will architect advanced enterprise AI solutions, mentor data science talent, and serve as a strategic consultant across global business divisions (Commercial, R&D, Diagnostics). Operating in an agile environment, you will drive predictive, causal, and generative AI initiatives while shaping GATE-level product strategy, talent enablement, and cross-center innovation.

The Opportunity

• Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Lead and mentor Senior Data Scientists across Predictive AI and Causal & Experimentation AI sub-teams, fostering modular coding standards, MLOps best practices, and agile delivery.

• Strategic Business Consulting: Act as a trusted AI consultant to global executive stakeholders, translating complex healthcare and business challenges into actionable Data Science and AI strategies.

• GATE Strategy & Product Roadmap: Drive GATE-wide center initiatives, shaping AI product development strategy, talent enablement programs, and standard methodologies across the ecosystem.

• Rapid Prototyping & ROI: Design and build Proofs of Concept (POCs), prototypes, and business cases to demonstrate tangible value and secure executive buy-in.

• Advanced AI Architecture: Architect robust predictive models, causal inference frameworks (A/B testing, quasi-experiments), and Enterprise Generative AI solutions (RAG, fine-tuning, Agentic AI workflows).

• End-to-End MLOps & Delivery: Partner with Data Engineering and MLOps teams to design, operationalize, and maintain scalable ML/AI pipelines, ensuring automated deployment and monitoring.

• Agile Collaboration: Collaborate across global cross-functional teams, facilitating reviews, demos, and retrospectives to continuously enhance solution delivery.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, AI/ML, Computer Science, Quantitative Analytics, or a related field. Professional certifications in Data Science, Cloud AI, or GenAI are advantageous.

• 12+ years of overall experience in Data Science/AI, including 5+ years leading AI product lifecycles and mentoring data science teams.

• Proven track record in predictive modeling, causal inference, LLMs, RAG, and Agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI).

• Hands-on experience with Python, SQL, modern pipeline tools (dbt, PySpark), MLOps platforms (MLflow, Kubeflow, AWS SageMaker), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and AWS.

• Exceptional communication and consulting skills with a demonstrated ability to present business cases to executive leadership (pharmaceutical or healthcare domain experience is a plus).

• Must be currently based in Costa Rica or hold valid work authorization for San José.

No relocation benefits are offered for this position.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Die Position
Als Data Science - Engagement Lead treten Sie dem Global Analytics and Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) innerhalb von Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) in San José, Costa Rica, bei. In dieser einflussreichen, technischen Führungsrolle werden Sie fortschrittliche Unternehmens-KI-Lösungen entwickeln, Data Science-Talente betreuen und als strategischer Berater in globalen Geschäftsbereichen (Commercial, R & D, Diagnostics) tätig sein. In einer agilen Umgebung werden Sie prädiktive, kausale und generative KI-Initiativen vorantreiben und gleichzeitig die Produktstrategie auf GATE-Ebene, Talent Enablement und Cross-Center-Innovation gestalten.

Die Chance

• Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Lead und Mentor Senior Data Scientists in den Unterteams Predictive AI und Causal & Experimentation AI, die modulare Kodierungsstandards, Best Practices von MLOps und agile Lieferung fördern.

• Strategische Unternehmensberatung: Handeln Sie als vertrauenswürdiger KI-Berater für globale Führungskräfte und übersetzen Sie komplexe Gesundheits- und Geschäftsherausforderungen in umsetzbare Data Science- und KI-Strategien.

• GATE Strategy & Product Roadmap: GATE-weite Center-Initiativen vorantreiben, KI-Produktentwicklungsstrategie, Talent-Enablement-Programme und Standardmethoden im gesamten Ökosystem gestalten.

• Rapid Prototyping & ROI: Design und Build Proofs of Concept (POCs), Prototypen und Business Cases, um einen greifbaren Wert und ein sicheres Executive Buy-in zu demonstrieren.

• Fortgeschrittene KI-Architektur: Architekten robuste prädiktive Modelle, kausale Inferenz-Frameworks (A/B-Tests, Quasi-Experimente) und Enterprise Generative AI-Lösungen (RAG, Feinabstimmung, Agentic AI-Workflows).

• End-to-End MLOps & Delivery: Partnerschaft mit Data Engineering- und MLOps-Teams, um skalierbare ML / AI-Pipelines zu entwerfen, zu operationalisieren und zu warten, um eine automatisierte Bereitstellung und Überwachung zu gewährleisten.

• Agile Collaboration: Arbeiten Sie in globalen, funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen und ermöglichen Sie Reviews, Demos und Retrospektiven, um die Bereitstellung von Lösungen kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Wer du bist

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Data Science, Statistik, AI / ML, Informatik, Quantitative Analytics oder einem verwandten Bereich. Professionelle Zertifizierungen in Data Science, Cloud AI oder GenAI sind vorteilhaft.

• 12+ Jahre Gesamterfahrung in Data Science / AI, darunter 5+ Jahre führende KI-Produktlebenszyklen und Mentoring-Data-Science-Teams.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in den Bereichen prädiktive Modellierung, kausale Inferenz, LLMs, RAG und Agentic AI Frameworks (z. B. LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI).

• Praktische Erfahrung mit Python, SQL, modernen Pipeline-Tools (dbt, PySpark), MLOps-Plattformen (MLflow, Kubeflow, AWS SageMaker), Containerisierung (Docker, Kubernetes) und AWS.

• Außergewöhnliche Kommunikations- und Beratungsfähigkeiten mit einer nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, Geschäftsfälle an die Führungskräfte zu präsentieren (Pharma- oder Gesundheitsbereichserfahrung ist ein Plus).

• Muss derzeit in Costa Rica ansässig sein oder über eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für San José verfügen.

Für diese Position werden keine Umzugsvorteile angeboten.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit für die Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Dans le cadre de ce rôle de leadership technique à fort impact, vous concevrez des solutions d'IA d'entreprise de pointe, mentorez les talents en sciences des données et servirez de consultant stratégique dans les divisions commerciales mondiales (Commerce, R-D, Diagnostics). Fonctionnant dans un environnement agile, vous piloterez des initiatives prédictives, causales et génératrices d'IA tout en concevant une stratégie de produit au niveau GATE, une capacité de talent et une innovation intercentrique.

L'opportunité

• Leadership technique et mentorat : Responsable et mentor Données supérieures Scientifiques dans les sous-équipes de l'IA prédictive et de l'IA causale et expérimentation, favorisant les normes modulaires de codage, les meilleures pratiques de MLOps et la prestation agile.

• MLOps et livraison de bout en bout: partenaire avec les équipes de Data Engineering et MLOps pour concevoir, opérationnaliser et entretenir des pipelines ML/AI évolutives, assurant un déploiement et une surveillance automatisés.

• Collaboration Agile : Collaborer entre les équipes interfonctionnelles mondiales, faciliter les examens, les démonstrations et les rétrospectives pour améliorer continuellement la prestation des solutions.

Qui vous êtes

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en Data Science, Statistiques, AI/ML, Informatique, Analyse quantitative, ou un domaine connexe. Les certifications professionnelles en Data Science, Cloud AI ou GenAI sont avantageuses.

• 12 ans et plus d'expérience globale en Data Science/AI, dont 5 ans et plus de cycle de vie des produits d'IA et de mentorat des équipes de Data Science.

• Expérience éprouvée dans la modélisation prédictive, l'inférence causale, les LLM, le RAG et les cadres d'IA Agentique (p. ex. LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI).

• Expérience pratique avec Python, SQL, outils de pipeline modernes (dbt, PySpark), plates-formes MLOps (MLflow, Kubeflow, AWS SageMaker), conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes) et AWS.

• Compétences exceptionnelles en communication et en consultation avec une capacité démontrée de présenter des analyses de rentabilisation à la direction (l'expérience du domaine pharmaceutique ou de la santé est un plus).

• Doit être actuellement basé au Costa Rica ou détenir une autorisation de travail valide pour San José.

Aucune prestation de réinstallation n'est offerte pour ce poste.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun un accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à favoriser la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions élevées, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

jobs.title: AWS Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

AWS Cloud Engineer

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week . The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

We are looking for an experienced AWS Cloud Engineer to design, build, and evolve secure, scalable, and automated cloud solutions on AWS.

You will work as part of a team of Cloud Engineers, taking ownership of solutions from design through implementation and operation. This is a hands-on engineering role : we are looking for someone who enjoys staying close to the technology, solving complex technical challenges, and turning architectural concepts into reliable production solutions.

The role has a strong focus on Amazon EKS, AWS Bedrock, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD , as well as cloud networking and security .

The opportunity:

• Design and implement end-to-end AWS solutions , translating business and technical requirements into secure, scalable, resilient, and maintainable architectures.

• Design, build, and operate Amazon EKS environments and Kubernetes-based workloads, including cluster architecture, workload deployment, networking, security, observability, and lifecycle management.

• Design and implement solutions leveraging AWS Bedrock and related AWS services for generative AI workloads, with particular attention to secure integration, access control, networking, scalability, and operational readiness.

• Build cloud infrastructure using AWS CDK , applying Infrastructure as Code principles to create reusable, maintainable, and automated infrastructure components.

• Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments using GitLab CI/CD and/or GitHub Actions .

• Design and implement AWS networking architectures , including VPCs, subnets, routing, private connectivity, DNS, load balancing, ingress/egress patterns, and integration across cloud environments.

• Embed security by design across cloud solutions, including IAM, least-privilege access, secrets and key management, network security, encryption, and security controls.

• Implement robust logging, monitoring, alerting, and observability to ensure production environments are transparent, reliable, and supportable.

• Build and integrate solutions using additional AWS services such as Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch, S3, API Gateway , and other services as appropriate.

• Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, security, Kubernetes, and deployment issues across the technology stack.

• Contribute to engineering standards, reusable patterns, automation, technical documentation, and cloud best practices.

• Collaborate closely with other Cloud Engineers, application teams, architec
