The Position Principle Roles &
• Responsibilities / Accountabilities Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness: ● Participate in new facility design and construction, including but not limited to process design, FAT, SAT, IOPQ, smoke study, VHP, Isolator EMPQ, APS etc. to contribute to project delivery. ● Support the initial development and optimization of aseptic filling processes. ● Participate in the implementation of operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, machine cleaning according to readiness plan. ● Trained and qualified on equipment operation and aseptic techniques. ● Perform other duties as assigned. Routine Operation: ● Ensure routine operation in compliance with Roche’s GMP/SHE and regulation requirements. ● Performing the following tasks: e.g. vial washing, filling and stoppering, capping. ● Train new employees and enhance the professional capabilities of the team. ● Support environmental monitoring activities to ensure that the Isolatore environment meets aseptic standards. ● Handle deviations during production and implement CAPA. ● Diagnose and resolve equipment malfunctions promptly with the support of maintenance engineers to minimize downtime. ● Execute regular validation activities, such as APS. ● Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and traceability for the activities in the GMP area. ● Related IT system operations, such as SAP, MES, Veeva, Cornerstone. ● Perform other duties as assigned. Qualification and Experience Education/
• Qualifications ● College’s Degree (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) and above. Job Required Competencies ● 5 or more years’ operation experience in the injection pharmaceutical industry, MNC Bio-pharma preferred. ● Experienced in strategic projects of Aseptic Filling facility including design, commissioning & qualification，Isolator filling line is preferred. ● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry. ● Fluent communications skills in English is preferred and the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and foster positive interactions with team members and stakeholders. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
About Our Team

We at Diagnostics Direct Procurement (DOP) are a team of about 200 enthusiastic professionals, committed to driving value with our suppliers worldwide. From locations around the world and with a diverse and multicultural team, we source, manage our supplier base, develop & execute category strategies and constantly develop & digitize processes that enable us to best support our business to grow sustainably. If you aspire to make an impact and want to be part of a high performing and world-class Procurement team, this is for you.
We are DOP. At Roche, we do now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to steer the long-term category roadmap and command the high-value supplier ecosystems that drive our global Instrument development projects? As our Global Category Manager for Engineering Services based out of Sant Cugat, Spain, you will take ultimate accountability for developing strategies and leading strategic initiatives for this complex, high-value category. In this role, you will manage major engineering consultancies, technical suppliers, and service networks to ensure maximum value delivery across global business sites.

• Reporting Line: Directly reports to the Global Category Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT within the Category organization.

• Wider Team and Stakeholders: Engages directly with cross-functional teams composed of representatives from Category,, Procurement Center of Excellence, R&D and other global business partners. Serves as a key business partner contact point for senior functional and business stakeholders in R&D.

• Role Type: An Individual Contributor role with global category leadership position focused on strategic vision, category development, pipeline building, and relationship ecosystem management

• Impact: You deliver commercial impact by anchoring cost and developing a resilience pipeline of projects, in addition to securing our sustainability priorities. Specifically, you are accountable for:

• Strategy & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, supplier data, and business requirements to formulate a formalized, global Category Strategy and initiative pipeline, to be aligned with leaders across the organization.

• Commercial Negotiations: Leading high-value commercial and contractual negotiations for strategic suppliers within the category.

• Supplier Ecosystems: Managing key global suppliers, establishing development and innovation programs, monitoring value targets, and managing supplier risks.

• Guidance & Content: Developing and maintaining category guidance documents to translate strategy into clear, executable content for procurement colleagues and business users.

• Business Partnering: Building deep relationships with senior stakeholders, particularly in R&D, challenging demand/specifications to maximize value, and managing risk/CSR reviews.

• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching procurement colleagues, providing professional development, managing a shared Associate Category Manager within the team, and tracking budget spend.

Who you are

We look for strategic procurement champions with extensive knowledge of the global instruments development (SW development and HW engineering) markets and the matrix leadership skills needed to drive complex organizational change.

• Education: University degree required (Business or Life Sciences focus preferred); a post-graduate business-related qualification is preferred.

• Experience: 5+ years of in-depth strategic and operat

La posizione Informazioni sul nostro team Noi di Diagnostics Direct Procurement (DOP) siamo un team di circa 200 professionisti entusiasti, impegnati a guidare il valore con i nostri fornitori in tutto il mondo. Dai luoghi di tutto il mondo e con un team diversificato e multiculturale, forniamo, gestiamo la nostra base di fornitori, sviluppiamo ed eseguono strategie di categoria e sviluppiamo costantemente e digitalizzano processi che ci permettono di supportare al meglio la nostra attività per crescere in modo sostenibile. Se aspiri a fare un impatto e vuoi far parte di un team di appalti di alto livello e performante, questo è per te. Siamo delle DOP. A Roche, facciamo ora quello che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. L'opportunità Siete pronti a guidare la roadmap di categoria a lungo termine e a comandare gli ecosistemi fornitori ad alto valore che guidano i nostri progetti globali di sviluppo degli strumenti? Come nostro Global Categoria Manager per i Servizi di Ingegneria con sede a Sant Cugat, in Spagna, si terrà la massima responsabilità per lo sviluppo di strategie e principali iniziative strategiche per questa categoria complessa e di alto valore. In questo ruolo, gestirete importanti consulenze ingegneristiche, fornitori tecnici e reti di servizi per garantire il massimo valore di consegna nei siti aziendali globali.
• Reporting Line: Referisce direttamente al Global Categoria Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT all'interno dell'organizzazione Categoria.
• Wider Team e Stakeholders: Engages direttamente con team interfunzionali composti da rappresentanti di Categoria,, Centro di Eccellenza, R&D e altri partner commerciali globali. Serve come punto di contatto chiave del partner commerciale per gli stakeholder senior funzionali e aziendali in R&D.
• Tipo di ruolo: Un ruolo di Contributor individuale con la posizione di leadership di categoria globale focalizzata sulla visione strategica, lo sviluppo di categoria, la costruzione di pipeline e la gestione dell'ecosistema di relazione
• Impatto: si ottiene un impatto commerciale ancorando i costi e sviluppando una pipeline di resilienza di progetti, oltre a garantire le nostre priorità di sostenibilità. In particolare, sei responsabile per:
• Strategia & Annual Pipeline: Collating market intelligence, dati dei fornitori e requisiti aziendali per formulare un pipeline di strategia e iniziativa di categoria formalizzata e globale, da allineare con i leader di tutta l'organizzazione.
• Negoziati commerciali: negoziati commerciali e contrattuali di alto valore per i fornitori strategici all'interno della categoria.
• Ecosistemi del fornitore: Gestire fornitori globali chiave, stabilire programmi di sviluppo e innovazione, monitorare obiettivi di valore e gestire i rischi dei fornitori.
• Orientamento e contenuto: Sviluppare e mantenere i documenti di orientamento della categoria per tradurre la strategia in contenuti chiari ed eseguibili per l'approvvigionamento di colleghi e utenti aziendali.
• Business Partnering: Costruire relazioni profonde con gli stakeholder senior, in particolare in R&D, sfidando la domanda/specificazioni per massimizzare il valore e gestire le recensioni di rischio/CSR.
• Team & Budget Oversight: Coaching colleghi di approvvigionamento, fornendo lo sviluppo professionale, la gestione di un Associate Categoria Manager condiviso all'interno del team, e il monitoraggio della spesa di bilancio. Chi sei Cerchiamo campioni strategici di approvvigionamento con una vasta conoscenza dei mercati globali di sviluppo degli strumenti (SW development and HW engineering) e delle competenze di leadership matrice necessarie per guidare il cambiamento organizzativo complesso.
• Istruzione: diploma universitario richiesto (Business o Scienze della vita si concentrano preferito); una qualifica post-laurea legata al business è preferito.
• Esperienza: 5+ anni di approfondimento strategico e operativo

Von Standorten auf der ganzen Welt und mit einem vielfältigen und multikulturellen Team beziehen, verwalten wir unsere Lieferantenbasis, entwickeln und führen Kategoriestrategien aus und entwickeln und digitalisieren ständig Prozesse, die es uns ermöglichen, unser Geschäft bestmöglich zu unterstützen, um nachhaltig zu wachsen. Bei Roche tun wir jetzt, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen. Die Chance Sind Sie bereit, die langfristige Kategorie-Roadmap zu steuern und die hochwertigen Lieferanten-Ökosysteme zu beherrschen, die unsere globalen Instrument-Entwicklungsprojekte vorantreiben? Als Global Category Manager für Engineering Services mit Sitz in Sant Cugat, Spanien, übernehmen Sie die ultimative Verantwortung für die Entwicklung von Strategien und strategischen Initiativen für diese komplexe, hochwertige Kategorie. In dieser Funktion verwalten Sie wichtige Ingenieurberatungen, technische Lieferanten und Servicenetzwerke, um eine maximale Wertschöpfung an globalen Geschäftsstandorten zu gewährleisten.
• Reporting Line: Direkt an die Global Category Lead Capex / Engineering Services / IT innerhalb der Kategorieorganisation berichtet.
• Breiteres Team und Stakeholder: Engagiert direkt mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, die sich aus Vertretern der Kategorie, des Procurement Center of Excellence, der F & E und anderer globaler Geschäftspartner zusammensetzen. Funktioniert als wichtiger Ansprechpartner für Geschäftspartner für leitende funktionale und geschäftliche Stakeholder in Forschung und Entwicklung.
• Rollentyp: Rolle eines einzelnen Mitwirkenden mit globaler Führungsposition in den Bereichen strategische Vision, Kategorieentwicklung, Pipelineaufbau und Beziehungs-Ökosystemmanagement
• Auswirkungen: Sie erzielen kommerzielle Auswirkungen, indem Sie Kosten verankern und eine Resilienz-Pipeline von Projekten entwickeln, zusätzlich zur Sicherung unserer Nachhaltigkeitsprioritäten. Insbesondere sind Sie verantwortlich für:
• Strategie & Jahrespipeline: Zusammenstellung von Marktinformationen, Lieferantendaten und Geschäftsanforderungen, um eine formalisierte, globale Kategoriestrategie und Initiativespipeline zu formulieren, die an Führungskräften im gesamten Unternehmen ausgerichtet ist.
• Kommerzielle Verhandlungen: Führen von hochwertigen kommerziellen und vertraglichen Verhandlungen für strategische Lieferanten innerhalb der Kategorie.
• Lieferanten-Ökosysteme: Management wichtiger globaler Lieferanten, Einrichtung von Entwicklungs- und Innovationsprogrammen, Überwachung von Wertzielen und Management von Lieferantenrisiken.

• Business Partnering: Aufbau enger Beziehungen zu hochrangigen Stakeholdern, insbesondere in der Forschung und Entwicklung, Herausforderung der Nachfrage/Spezifikationen zur Wertmaximierung und Verwaltung von Risiko-/CSR-Bewertungen.

Chez Roche, nous faisons maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin. L'opportunité Êtes-vous prêt à piloter la feuille de route de la catégorie à long terme et à commander les écosystèmes fournisseurs de haute valeur qui animent nos projets mondiaux de développement d'instruments? En tant que Global Category Manager pour les services d'ingénierie basés à Sant Cugat, en Espagne, vous aurez la responsabilité ultime de développer des stratégies et de diriger des initiatives stratégiques pour cette catégorie complexe et de grande valeur. Dans ce rôle, vous gérerez les principaux cabinets de conseil en ingénierie, fournisseurs techniques et réseaux de services afin d'assurer une prestation de valeur maximale sur les sites d'affaires mondiaux.

Il sert de point de contact principal des partenaires commerciaux pour les principaux intervenants fonctionnels et commerciaux en R-D.
• Type de rôle : Un intervenant individuel avec un poste de leadership de catégorie mondiale axé sur la vision stratégique, le développement de catégories, la construction de pipelines et la gestion des rapports écosystémiques
• Impact: Vous produisez un impact commercial en ancrage des coûts et en développant un pipeline de résilience de projets, en plus de garantir nos priorités de durabilité. Plus précisément, vous êtes responsable :
• Stratégie et pipeline annuel : Rassembler les renseignements sur les marchés, les données sur les fournisseurs et les exigences opérationnelles afin de formuler un pipeline officiel de la Stratégie et de l'initiative de catégorie mondiale, qui sera aligné sur les dirigeants de l'ensemble de l'organisation.

• Orientation et contenu : Élaborer et tenir à jour des documents d'orientation de catégorie afin de traduire la stratégie en contenu clair et exécutable pour les collègues et les utilisateurs commerciaux.
• Partenariats d'affaires : Établir des relations étroites avec les intervenants supérieurs, en particulier en R-D, mettre la demande et les particularités au défi pour maximiser la valeur et gérer les examens des risques et des RSC.
• Surveillance de l'équipe et du budget : Encadrer les collègues en approvisionnement, assurer le perfectionnement professionnel, gérer un gestionnaire de catégorie associé partagé au sein de l'équipe et suivre les dépenses budgétaires. Qui vous êtes Nous recherchons des champions stratégiques de l'approvisionnement possédant une connaissance approfondie des marchés mondiaux du développement d'instruments (développement de SW et ingénierie de HW) et des compétences de leadership matriciel nécessaires pour stimuler un changement organisationnel complexe.
• Études : Diplôme universitaire requis (priorité de l'accent sur les affaires ou les sciences de la vie); une qualification liée aux affaires de troisième cycle est préférée.
• Expérience : 5 ans et plus de stratégie et d'opéra en profondeur

jobs.title: Patient Journey Partner, Oncology (Sumatra)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of Roche organization, directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organization, faster. The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.

Your Opportunity
The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) acts as a trusted partner and key point of contact for stakeholders involved in the Oncology patient journey across Sumatera. As the local face of Roche, the PJP works closely with healthcare professionals, healthcare institutions, and cross-functional Roche teams to better understand patient and healthcare system needs and improve patient outcomes.

In this role, you will:

• Build and maintain strong relationships with healthcare professionals and relevant stakeholders across the healthcare ecosystem to better understand patient and healthcare system needs

• Develop a deep understanding of the patient journey, including key challenges, unmet needs, and opportunities to improve patient care and access within the assigned therapeutic area

• Collaborate with cross-functional Roche teams to identify, develop, and implement solutions that create meaningful value for patients, stakeholders, and the broader healthcare community

• Support the appropriate and compliant use of Roche products by sharing scientific and product information in a truthful, balanced, and patient-focused manner

• Lead stakeholder engagement planning and execution based on customer insights, healthcare landscape understanding, and evolving patient needs

• Identify opportunities for collaboration that help address barriers within the healthcare system and improve patient outcomes and experiences

• Coordinate and mobilize the appropriate internal expertise, resources, and support to respond effectively to stakeholder needs while ensuring a positive experience with Roche’s people, products, and services

Who you are
You are passionate about improving patient outcomes and building meaningful partnerships across the healthcare ecosystem. You bring a collaborative mindset, strong stakeholder engagement capabilities, and the ability to navigate a dynamic and evolving healthcare environment.
You bring:

• A university degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Business, Economics, or a related field; an advanced degree such as an MBA is a plus

• Experience in stakeholder engagement within the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or related industry, with the ability to build trusted long-term partnerships

• Good understanding of the Indonesia healthcare system and the broader healthcare ecosystem

• Knowledge of pharmaceutical industry regulations, ethical standards, and compliance requirements in Indonesia

• Understanding of patient journeys, treatment pathways, and stakeholder dynamics within the Oncology area

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple stakeholders and functions

• Strategic thinking, learning agility, and an interest in innovation and healthcare transformation to help improve patient outcomes

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Paziente Viaggio Partner (PJP) è al centro dell'organizzazione Roche, direttamente responsabile per fornire migliori risultati per i pazienti, la loro comunità, l'ecosistema e l'organizzazione, più veloce. Il PJP è un leader potenziato e il volto locale di Roche. Collabora a stretto contatto con tutte le parti interessate, toccando direttamente il percorso del paziente (in una data area terapeutica o malattia), acquisendo una profonda comprensione delle loro esigenze per collegare le capacità di Roche per creare soluzioni significative. La tua opportunità Il Partner del Viaggio Paziente (PJP) agisce come partner affidabile e punto chiave di contatto per gli stakeholder coinvolti nel viaggio paziente Oncology attraverso Sumatera. Come la faccia locale di Roche, il PJP lavora a stretto contatto con professionisti sanitari, istituzioni sanitarie e team Roche interfunzionali per comprendere meglio le esigenze del sistema sanitario e del paziente e migliorare i risultati dei pazienti. In questo ruolo, voi:
• Costruire e mantenere forti relazioni con i professionisti del settore sanitario e con le parti interessate pertinenti in tutto l'ecosistema sanitario per comprendere meglio le esigenze del sistema sanitario e del paziente
• Sviluppare una profonda comprensione del viaggio del paziente, comprese le sfide chiave, le esigenze non soddisfatte e le opportunità per migliorare la cura del paziente e l'accesso all'interno dell'area terapeutica assegnata
• Collabora con i team Roche interfunzionali per identificare, sviluppare e implementare soluzioni che creano un valore significativo per pazienti, stakeholder e la più ampia comunità sanitaria
• Sostenere l'uso appropriato e conforme dei prodotti Roche condividendo le informazioni scientifiche e di prodotto in modo veritiero, equilibrato e orientato al paziente
• Pianificazione e esecuzione del coinvolgimento degli stakeholder basati sulle intuizioni dei clienti, sulla comprensione del paesaggio sanitario e sulle esigenze dei pazienti in evoluzione
• Identificare opportunità di collaborazione che aiutano ad affrontare le barriere all'interno del sistema sanitario e migliorare i risultati e le esperienze dei pazienti
• Coordinare e mobilitare l’adeguata competenza interna, le risorse e il supporto per rispondere efficacemente alle esigenze degli stakeholder garantendo al contempo un’esperienza positiva con le persone, i prodotti e i servizi di Roche Chi sei Sei appassionato di migliorare i risultati dei pazienti e costruire partnership significative in tutto l'ecosistema sanitario. Porti una mentalità collaborativa, forti capacità di coinvolgimento degli stakeholder e la capacità di navigare in un ambiente sanitario dinamico ed in evoluzione. Tu porti:
• Una laurea in Scienze della vita, Assistenza sanitaria, Affari, Economia o un campo correlato; un grado avanzato come un MBA è un plus
• Esperienza nell'impegno degli stakeholder all'interno del settore sanitario, farmaceutico o relativo, con la capacità di costruire partnership a lungo termine affidabili
• Buona comprensione del sistema sanitario indonesiano e dell'ecosistema sanitario più ampio
• Conoscenza delle normative dell'industria farmaceutica, degli standard etici e dei requisiti di conformità in Indonesia
• Comprensione dei viaggi dei pazienti, delle vie di trattamento e delle dinamiche degli stakeholder nell'area Oncologia
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente su più stakeholder e funzioni
• Il pensiero strategico, l'agilità di apprendimento e l'interesse per l'innovazione e la trasformazione sanitaria per contribuire a migliorare i risultati dei pazienti Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla sanità oggi

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Der Patient Journey Partner (PJP) steht im Zentrum der Roche-Organisation und ist direkt dafür verantwortlich, Patienten, ihrer Gemeinschaft, dem Ökosystem und der Organisation schneller bessere Ergebnisse zu liefern. Die PJP ist eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit und das lokale Gesicht von Roche. Sie arbeitet eng mit allen Interessengruppen zusammen, die die Patientenreise (in einem bestimmten Therapie- oder Krankheitsbereich) direkt berühren, um ein tiefes Verständnis ihrer Bedürfnisse zu erlangen, um die Fähigkeiten von Roche zu verbinden und sinnvolle Lösungen zu entwickeln. Ihre Chance Der Patient Journey Partner (PJP) fungiert als vertrauenswürdiger Partner und wichtiger Ansprechpartner für Interessengruppen, die an der Oncology-Patientenreise in Sumatera beteiligt sind. Als lokales Gesicht von Roche arbeitet die PJP eng mit Gesundheitsexperten, Gesundheitseinrichtungen und funktionsübergreifenden Roche-Teams zusammen, um die Bedürfnisse von Patienten und Gesundheitssystemen besser zu verstehen und die Patientenergebnisse zu verbessern. In dieser Rolle werden Sie:
• Aufbau und Pflege starker Beziehungen zu medizinischen Fachkräften und relevanten Interessengruppen im gesamten Ökosystem des Gesundheitswesens, um die Bedürfnisse von Patienten und Gesundheitssystemen besser zu verstehen
• Entwicklung eines tiefen Verständnisses der Patientenreise, einschließlich wichtiger Herausforderungen, unerfüllter Bedürfnisse und Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Patientenversorgung und des Zugangs innerhalb des zugewiesenen therapeutischen Bereichs
• Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Roche-Teams zusammen, um Lösungen zu identifizieren, zu entwickeln und zu implementieren, die einen sinnvollen Mehrwert für Patienten, Interessengruppen und die breitere Gesundheitsgemeinschaft schaffen.
• Unterstützung der angemessenen und konformen Nutzung von Roche-Produkten durch den Austausch wissenschaftlicher und Produktinformationen in einer wahrheitsgetreuen, ausgewogenen und patientenorientierten Weise
• Führen Sie die Planung und Ausführung des Stakeholder-Engagements auf der Grundlage von Kundeninformationen, dem Verständnis der Gesundheitslandschaft und sich entwickelnden Patientenbedürfnissen
• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten für die Zusammenarbeit, die dazu beitragen, Barrieren innerhalb des Gesundheitssystems zu beseitigen und die Ergebnisse und Erfahrungen der Patienten zu verbessern
• Koordination und Mobilisierung der entsprechenden internen Expertise, Ressourcen und Unterstützung, um effektiv auf die Bedürfnisse der Stakeholder zu reagieren und gleichzeitig eine positive Erfahrung mit den Mitarbeitern, Produkten und Dienstleistungen von Roche zu gewährleisten Wer du bist Sie haben eine Leidenschaft für die Verbesserung der Patientenergebnisse und den Aufbau sinnvoller Partnerschaften im gesamten Ökosystem des Gesundheitswesens. Sie bringen eine kollaborative Denkweise, starke Stakeholder-Engagement-Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen und sich entwickelnden Gesundheitsumfeld zu navigieren. Sie bringen:
• Ein Universitätsabschluss in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Business, Economics oder einem verwandten Bereich; ein fortgeschrittener Abschluss wie ein MBA ist ein Plus
• Erfahrung im Stakeholder-Engagement in der Gesundheits-, Pharma- oder verwandten Industrie mit der Fähigkeit, vertrauenswürdige langfristige Partnerschaften aufzubauen
• Gutes Verständnis des indonesischen Gesundheitssystems und des breiteren Gesundheitsökosystems
• Kenntnisse der pharmazeutischen Industrie Vorschriften, ethischen Standards und Compliance-Anforderungen in Indonesien
• Verständnis von Patientenreisen, Behandlungswegen und Stakeholder-Dynamik im Onkologie-Bereich
• Starke Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv über mehrere Stakeholder und Funktionen zu arbeiten
• Strategisches Denken, Lernagilität und Interesse an Innovation und Gesundheitstransformation zur Verbesserung der Patientenergebnisse Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft und stellen sicher, dass heute jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
At Roche, we believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are
passionate about transforming patients’ lives and we are brave in both decision and action. And we believe that good business
means a better world.

Join Our Team: Make a Difference in International Regulatory Affairs!

Roche is seeking a dynamic and highly motivated individual to join our team as an International Regulatory Affairs
Professional. We are looking for candidates who bring an innovative and creative mindset to the table, along with a proven
track record in the Regulatory Affairs field. If you are passionate about making a positive impact on global healthcare through
regulatory excellence, we invite you to be part of our dedicated team.

Key Responsibilities

As an International Regulatory Affairs Professional at Roche, you will be responsible for:

• Leading and supporting regulatory strategies for global IVD/MD instruments and software submissions

• Ensuring compliance with international regulatory requirements and standards

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including R&D, Quality, and Clinical, to drive regulatory initiatives

• Providing regulatory guidance to support product development and lifecycle management

• Staying abreast of evolving regulatory trends and up‐ dates, and implementing best practices

Requirements

• Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Regulatory Affairs, or a related field

• 5 to 7 years of experience in Regulatory Affairs ( Regulatory, R&D, Quality and/or Clinical), with some experience in healthcare regulatory affairs

• In-depth knowledge of global regulatory requirements, guidelines, and procedures especially for IVD instruments & software

• Strong organizational and communication skills

• Ability to multitask and effectively manage multiple projects simultaneously

• Self-motivated and capable of working independently in a self-management environment

• Experience in IVD instrument and/or software development

Why Roche

• Collaborative and innovative work environment

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary, life-changing innovation at speed.

At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED’s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars—Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers—we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support. Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

This position is located in Pathology and Applied Safety Science, a department within the Pharmaceutical Sciences function. We drive the non-clinical safety assessment of drug candidates from small molecules to complex biological products during the discovery and development phases at Roche.

The Opportunity

As an engaged Pathology and Applied Safety Science Hematology & Safety Biomarker Expert, you will play a pivotal role in the development, validation, and implementation of assays for translational safety assessment. Your primary responsibility will be to propose, conduct and report relevant assays to understand mechanisms of toxicity, leveraging modern tools to maximise scientific insights, drive innovation, and advance our therapeutic pipeline in a highly collaborative environment.

• Strategic Biomarker Integration & Translational Safety: Collaborate with experts to develop and execute integrated in vitro and in vivo hematology and safety biomarker strategies, provide subject matter expertise for clinical candidate selection, and deliver comprehensive safety risk assessments for regulatory documentation (e.g., IND/CTA).

• Multi-Disciplinary Laboratory Expertise: Allocate approximately 50% of working time to wet-lab work, focusing on the development and implementation of tailored in vitro and ex vivo hematology and fluid-based safety biomarker assays, as well as generating and compiling clinical pathology data (hematology, coagulation, clinical chemistry, urinalysis) for the responsible pathologist.

• Digitisation, Image Analysis, and Automation: Partner with Digital Pathology and modelling experts to develop screening assays, utilise digital and data curation platforms (e.g., LIMS, SLIMS, Arvados) to ensure streamlined data transfer and harmonised datasets, and optimise workflow integration to maximise operational efficiency.

• Vendor Management, Quality, & Compliance Outsourcing & CRO Coordination: Manage external partnerships and drive the outsourcing of relevant assays to contract research laboratories (CROs), ensuring strict adherence to timelines and data quality standards.

• Safety Standards: Maintain strict compliance with Safety, Health, and Environmental (SHE) regulations, actively fostering a culture of safe and res

All’intersezione della scienza e dell’innovazione, l’organizzazione Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione alla traduzione di potere, migliorando continuamente l’accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerando lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. Integrando senza soluzione di continuità i nostri tre pilastri principali: sicurezza relazionale, farmacologia traduttiva e biomarcatori, guidiamo lo sviluppo end-to-end di asset in tutta la catena del valore, dalla valutazione target al supporto on-market. La nostra missione è di migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza predittiva, ottimizzare le strategie di dosaggio per le popolazioni giuste dei pazienti e accelerare lo sviluppo dei terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci di domani. Questa posizione si trova in Patologia e Scienze della Sicurezza Applicata, un dipartimento all'interno della funzione Scienze Farmaceutiche. Noi guidiamo la valutazione di sicurezza non ciclica dei candidati alla droga da piccole molecole a prodotti biologici complessi durante le fasi di scoperta e sviluppo a Roche. L'opportunità Come esperto di patologia e scienza della sicurezza applicata ematologia & sicurezza Biomarker, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nello sviluppo, nella convalida e nell'implementazione di saggi per la valutazione della sicurezza traduttiva. La vostra responsabilità primaria sarà quella di proporre, condurre e segnalare saggi rilevanti per comprendere meccanismi di tossicità, sfruttando strumenti moderni per massimizzare le intuizioni scientifiche, guidare l'innovazione, e avanzare il nostro pipeline terapeutico in un ambiente altamente collaborativo.
• Strategic Biomarker Integration & Translational Safety: Collabora con gli esperti per sviluppare ed eseguire strategie integrate in vitro e in vivo di ematologia e biomarcazione, fornire competenze in materia per la selezione dei candidati clinici, e fornire valutazioni complete di rischio di sicurezza per la documentazione normativa (ad esempio, IND/CTA).
• Multi-Disciplinary Laboratory Expertise: Legare circa il 50% del tempo di lavoro al lavoro a lastra bagnata, concentrandosi sullo sviluppo e l'implementazione di ematologia su misura in vitro ed ex vivo e saggi biomarcatori di sicurezza basati sui fluidi, oltre a generare e compilare dati di patologia clinica (ematologia, coagulazione, chimica clinica, analisi urinaria) per il patologo responsabile.
• Digitisation, Image Analysis, and Automation: Partner con la Patologia Digitale e gli esperti di modellazione per lo sviluppo di saggi di screening, l'utilizzo di piattaforme digitali e di cura dei dati (ad esempio, LIMS, SLIMS, Arvados) per garantire il trasferimento e l'armonizzazione dei dati, e ottimizzare l'integrazione del flusso di lavoro per massimizzare l'efficienza operativa.
• Gestione del Fornitore, Qualità, & Compliance Outsourcing & CRO Coordinamento: Gestire partnership esterne e guidare l'outsourcing di saggi rilevanti ai laboratori di ricerca di contratto (CRO), garantendo una rigorosa adesione alle linee temporali e agli standard di qualità dei dati.
• Norme di sicurezza: Mantenere il rigoroso rispetto delle normative sulla sicurezza, la salute e l'ambiente (SHE), promuovendo attivamente una cultura di sicurezza e res

An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft und Innovation ermöglicht die pRED-Organisation Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) die Entdeckung und Entwicklung sicherer und wirksamer Therapeutika in optimalen Dosen in relevanten Populationen mit einer Vision für die Energieübersetzung, die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Genauigkeit unserer Vorhersagen und die Beschleunigung der Entwicklung von Medikamenten von morgen. Durch die nahtlose Integration unserer drei Kernsäulen Translationale Sicherheit, Translationale Pharmakologie und Biomarker treiben wir die End-to-End-Anlagenentwicklung entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette voran, von der Zielbewertung bis hin zur On-Market-Unterstützung. Unsere Mission ist es, die prädiktive Genauigkeit kontinuierlich zu verbessern, Dosierungsstrategien für die richtigen Patientengruppen zu optimieren und die Entwicklung der sicheren und wirksamen Therapeutika von morgen zu beschleunigen. Diese Position befindet sich in Pathology and Applied Safety Science, einer Abteilung innerhalb der Pharmaceutical Sciences Funktion. Wir fördern die nichtklinische Sicherheitsbewertung von Wirkstoffkandidaten von kleinen Molekülen bis hin zu komplexen biologischen Produkten während der Entdeckungs- und Entwicklungsphase bei Roche. Die Chance Als engagierter Experte für Pathologie und angewandte Sicherheitswissenschaft Hämatologie & Sicherheits-Biomarker spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Entwicklung, Validierung und Implementierung von Assays für die translationale Sicherheitsbewertung. Ihre Hauptaufgabe wird es sein, relevante Assays vorzuschlagen, durchzuführen und zu berichten, um die Mechanismen der Toxizität zu verstehen, moderne Werkzeuge zu nutzen, um wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse zu maximieren, Innovationen voranzutreiben und unsere therapeutische Pipeline in einem hochgradig kooperativen Umfeld voranzutreiben.
• Strategische Biomarker-Integration & Translationale Sicherheit: Arbeiten Sie mit Experten zusammen, um integrierte In-vitro- und In-vivo-Hämatologie- und Sicherheits-Biomarker-Strategien zu entwickeln und durchzuführen, Fachwissen für die klinische Kandidatenauswahl bereitzustellen und umfassende Sicherheitsrisikobewertungen für die regulatorische Dokumentation (z. B. IND / CTA) durchzuführen.
• Multidisziplinäre Laborexpertise: Geben Sie etwa 50% der Arbeitszeit für Nasslaborarbeiten zu und konzentrieren sich auf die Entwicklung und Umsetzung maßgeschneiderter In-vitro- und Ex-vivo-Hämatologie- und fluidbasierter Sicherheits-Biomarker-Assays sowie die Erstellung und Zusammenstellung klinischer Pathologiedaten (Hämatologie, Gerinnung, klinische Chemie, Urinanalyse) für den verantwortlichen Pathologen.
• Digitalisierung, Bildanalyse und Automatisierung: Partnerschaft mit Experten für digitale Pathologie und Modellierung, um Screening-Assays zu entwickeln, digitale und Datenkurationsplattformen (z. B. LIMS, SLIMS, Arvados) zu nutzen, um eine optimierte Datenübertragung und harmonisierte Datensätze zu gewährleisten und die Workflow-Integration zu optimieren, um die betriebliche Effizienz zu maximieren.
• Vendor Management, Quality & Compliance Outsourcing & CRO Coordination: Verwalten Sie externe Partnerschaften und treiben Sie die Auslagerung relevanter Assays an Auftragsforschungslaboratorien (CROs) voran, um die strikte Einhaltung von Zeitplänen und Datenqualitätsstandards sicherzustellen.
• Sicherheitsstandards: Einhaltung der Vorschriften für Sicherheit, Gesundheit und Umwelt (SHE) und aktive Förderung einer Kultur der Sicherheit

La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED), nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement des innovations extraordinaires et changeantes. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design.

As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist - French speaking in the Global Digital Hub, you ensure the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. The role plays a crucial role in ensuring timely and high-quality digital campaigns content creation coordination and completion.

The Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist may collaborate closely with affiliate business teams or brand teams, third-party-vendors, campaign and global campaign coordinators in the organization, related to project requirements, objectives, and timelines.

The Opportunity:

• Manage the affiliate or global digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, ensuring timely and successful completion of any projects from initiation to final implementation, while ensuring delivery standards are met.

• Incorporate feedback from stakeholders and revise digital campaigns content requests accordingly to ensure alignment with their expectations.

• Instructs stakeholders on new process or requirements that would increase efficiency in the ways of working in subject matter area

• Supports Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators in client communications in the area of service offering, change management or communication

• Adoption and Center of Excellence: follow existing processes, establish process governance principles and maintain proper documentation and implementation within the scope of responsibility

Who you are :

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field; you are highly creative, innovative, forward thinking marketer with the ability to demonstrate awareness of digital trends.

• You have a solid understanding of digital marketing principles, content creation, and campaign management and 3+ years of experience in content production, project management, or digital campaign management, with a focus on coordinating digital marketing initiatives across multiple channels.

• You own excellent communication skills in English and French , and you have experience in stakeholder management and incorporating feedback into content strategies.

• You have a customer-focused behavior in everything you do and ability to create and maintain well-functioning relationships with internal stakeholders and other 3rd party providers.

• You have proficiency in project management tools and software, with a readiness to learn new systems as needed.

• You possess strong organizational and multitasking abilities, with a proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.

• Flexibility: We also support flexibil

• Incorporare feedback da parte degli stakeholder e rivedere le richieste di contenuti delle campagne digitali per garantire l'allineamento con le loro aspettative.

• Hai una solida comprensione dei principi di marketing digitale, la creazione di contenuti e la gestione delle campagne e 3+ anni di esperienza nella produzione dei contenuti, nella gestione dei progetti o nella gestione delle campagne digitali, con l'obiettivo di coordinare le iniziative di marketing digitale su più canali.
• Possiedi eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese e in italiano, e hai esperienza nella gestione degli stakeholder e incorporando feedback nelle strategie di contenuto.
• Hai un comportamento focalizzato sul cliente in tutto ciò che fai e la capacità di creare e mantenere relazioni ben funzionanti con gli stakeholder interni e altri fornitori di terze parti.
• Hai competenza negli strumenti di gestione del progetto e nel software, con una disponibilità ad imparare nuovi sistemi come necessario.
• Possiedi forti capacità organizzative e multitasking, con una comprovata esperienza di gestione simultanea di più progetti. In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e corsi di formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Join Roche Product Development Regulatory Affairs (PDR), a flexible, bold, and distinctive regulatory organization where we make strategic decisions quickly, innovate boldly, and deliver insights that shape our portfolio development. We are seeking a talented professional to help build, mature, and sustain our regulatory business capabilities while fostering a culture of continuous learning and meaningful impact for patients.

The Opportunity:

• Support complex and higher exposure quality and compliance activities , providing guidance and risk assessment to PDR staff on GCP, GVP, MDR, and IVDR compliance issues, and serving as advisor and subject matter expert for Quality and Compliance-related processes

• Lead deviation management and process management activities, updating and maintaining regulatory documents while sustaining Quality and Compliance operational activities required for maintaining Roche's license to operate and Quality Management System (QMS)

• Oversee training management , scheduling training sessions and ensuring completion across PDR to support our commitment to regulatory compliance and continuous learning

• Prepare and manage compliance reports , monitoring trends in the external compliance environment

• Partner across the enterprise with stakeholders within and beyond PDR (including affiliates, PD quality organizations, and the broader Roche group) to unlock company-wide benefits and ensure regulatory compliance

• Lead increasingly complex deliverables while collaborating cross-functionally with key stakeholders, generating insights, and mentoring peers to foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

• Monitor and respond to trends in innovation and the external compliance environment, anticipating changes in the regulatory landscape and assessing future business needs

• Contribute to initiatives that shape our technical, business, and healthcare environments , bringing new ideas into the business and leading them with entrepreneurial mindset

Who You Are:

• 5+ years of relevant regulatory affairs, quality, or compliance experience in the Pharma or Medical Device space, with a proven ability to independently deliver and lead increasingly complex projects and initiatives

• Experience working with health authorities , understanding the global regulatory environment

• Strategic and systems thinker with strong data management, content management, and knowledge management capabilities; experienced in change leadership and operating effectively in matrix environments

• Cross-functional collaboration expert with demonstrated experience in building trusted partnerships across internal and external stakeholders, including health authorities

• Compliance-focused professional with a deep understanding of the global regulatory environment, GCP, GVP, MDR, and IVDR requirements, and a commitment to maintaining license to operate and integrity

• Continuous learner with a growth mindset, strong communication skills, and ability to seek and act on feedback

In exchange we provide you with:

• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist. Die Position Treten Sie Roche Product Development Regulatory Affairs (PDR) bei, einer flexiblen, mutigen und unverwechselbaren Regulierungsorganisation, in der wir schnell strategische Entscheidungen treffen, mutig Innovationen einführen und Erkenntnisse liefern, die unsere Portfolioentwicklung prägen. Wir suchen einen talentierten Fachmann, der dabei hilft, unsere regulatorischen Geschäftsfähigkeiten aufzubauen, zu reifen und zu erhalten und gleichzeitig eine Kultur des kontinuierlichen Lernens und der sinnvollen Auswirkungen für Patienten zu fördern. • Unterstützung komplexer und stärker exponierter Qualitäts- und Compliance-Aktivitäten, Bereitstellung von Beratung und Risikobewertung für PDR-Mitarbeiter zu GCP-, GVP-, MDR- und IVDR-Compliance-Fragen sowie als Berater und Fachexperte für Qualitäts- und Compliance-bezogene Prozesse

• Beaufsichtigen Sie das Schulungsmanagement, die Planung von Schulungen und die Sicherstellung des Abschlusses in der gesamten PDR, um unser Engagement für die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften und kontinuierliches Lernen zu unterstützen

• Überwachung und Reaktion auf Innovationstrends und das externe Compliance-Umfeld, Antizipation von Veränderungen in der Regulierungslandschaft und Bewertung zukünftiger Geschäftsanforderungen
• Tragen Sie zu Initiativen bei, die unser technisches, geschäftliches und medizinisches Umfeld prägen, neue Ideen in das Unternehmen bringen und sie mit unternehmerischer Denkweise führen Wer Du bist:
• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in relevanten regulatorischen Angelegenheiten, Qualität oder Compliance im Bereich Pharma oder Medizinprodukte mit der nachgewiesenen Fähigkeit, immer komplexere Projekte und Initiativen unabhängig zu liefern und zu leiten
• Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Gesundheitsbehörden, Verständnis des globalen regulatorischen Umfelds
• Strategischer und System-Thinker mit starken Datenmanagement-, Content-Management- und Wissensmanagement-Fähigkeiten; Erfahrung in Change Leadership und effektivem Betrieb in Matrix-Umgebungen
• Experte für funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung beim Aufbau vertrauenswürdiger Partnerschaften zwischen internen und externen Stakeholdern, einschließlich Gesundheitsbehörden
• Compliance-orientierter Fachmann mit einem tiefen Verständnis des globalen regulatorischen Umfelds, der GCP-, GVP-, MDR- und IVDR-Anforderungen und einer Verpflichtung zur Aufrechterhaltung der Betriebslizenz und Integrität
• Kontinuierlicher Lernender mit einer Wachstumsmentalität, starken Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und der Fähigkeit, Feedback zu suchen und darauf zu reagieren Im Gegenzug bieten wir Ihnen:
• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Roche ist reich an Lernressourcen. Wir bieten ständige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, kostenlose Sprachkurse & Schulungen, die Möglichkeit internationaler Einsätze, interne Positionsänderungen und die Möglichkeit, die eigene Karriere zu gestalten.

• Surveiller les tendances en matière d'innovation et de conformité externe et y répondre, anticiper les changements dans le paysage réglementaire et évaluer les besoins futurs des entreprises
• Contribuer à des initiatives qui façonnent nos environnements techniques, commerciaux et de santé, en apportant de nouvelles idées dans l'entreprise et en les dirigeant avec esprit d'entreprise Qui vous êtes :
• 5 ans et plus d'expérience en matière de réglementation, de qualité ou de conformité dans l'espace Pharma ou Appareil médical, avec une capacité prouvée de livrer et de diriger des projets et des initiatives de plus en plus complexes
• Expérience de travail avec les autorités sanitaires , compréhension de l'environnement réglementaire mondial
• Thinker stratégique et système doté de solides capacités de gestion des données, de gestion du contenu et de gestion des connaissances; expérimenté dans le leadership en matière de changement et fonctionnant efficacement dans des environnements matriciaux
• Expert en collaboration interfonctionnelle ayant une expérience démontrée de l'établissement de partenariats de confiance entre les intervenants internes et externes, y compris les autorités sanitaires
• Professionnel axé sur la conformité ayant une connaissance approfondie de l'environnement réglementaire mondial, GCP, GVP, MDR et IVDR, et un engagement à maintenir la licence d'exploitation et d'intégrité
• Apprentissage continu avec un état d'esprit de croissance, de solides compétences en communication et la capacité de rechercher et d'agir sur la rétroaction En échange, nous vous fournissons:
• Possibilités de développement : Roche est riche en ressources d'apprentissage. Nous offrons des possibilités de développement constantes, des cours de langues et de formation gratuits, la possibilité d'affectations internationales, des changements de position interne et la possibilité de façonner votre propre carrière.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job Profile:
Role Summary:
The Finance & Operations Coordinator will play a central role in ensuring the financial and operational efficiency of Roche Kazakhstan. This role acts as a bridge between local operations and the Roche Shared Services Centre in Budapest, ensuring accurate financial posting, compliance with tax regulations, and procurement coordination. The position also supports local product teams by providing financial insights and modeling to drive data-based decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Financial Coordination with Shared Services Centre (SSC):

• Act as the primary liaison between Roche Kazakhstan and the SSC in Budapest for all accounting-related matters.

• Monitor the accuracy and timeliness of financial postings, including journal entries, accruals, and reclassifications.

• Review and validate financial reports and statements to ensure they align with local and corporate accounting standards.

• Coordinate with local agency and ensure compliance with Kazakhstan’s local tax regulations (VAT, CIT, WHT, etc.)

• Coordinate with SSC and external tax advisors for tax filings and audits.

• Support the month-end and year-end closing processes by providing local context, resolving discrepancies, and ensuring proper documentation.

• Collaborate with internal and external auditors by providing required financial data and explanations during audit cycles.
2. Business Partnering & Financial Insights:

• Work closely with product team - medical and commercial teams to provide financial support for key business initiatives and decision-making.

• Build and maintain financial models for product performance, pricing scenarios and new launch planning.

• Deliver timely, relevant, and actionable insights on revenue, cost structure, profitability, and financial risks/opportunities.

• Assist in the preparation of business cases, budget planning, and forecasting processes.

• Translate complex financial data into business language for non-finance stakeholders, helping them make informed strategic and operational decisions.
3. Procurement Coordination:

• Act as the point of contact for local procurement activities, ensuring alignment with global procurement policies and local regulations.

• Guide internal stakeholders on purchasing procedures, vendor onboarding, and contract compliance.

• Support tendering processes, vendor selection, negotiation input, and supplier performance monitoring.

• Collaborate with finance and legal teams to ensure contracts are financially and legally sound.

• Monitor procurement KPIs and help identify cost-saving opportunities and process improvements.
4. Cross-functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement:

• Serve as a cross-functional facilitator to improve coordination between finance, procurement, and commercial teams.

• Identify opportunities to streamline and automate finance and procurement processes at the local level.

• Promote compliance with internal controls, financial policies, and ethical procurement practices.

• Provide training or guidance to colleagues on basic finance and procurement principles as needed.

Qualifications:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

• Recognition and International Certificates (Chamber of Professional Accountants, ACCA , CIPA , CPA , DipIFR , or equivalent).

• Proven experience in finance operations, preferably in a multinational or shared services environment.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles and tax regulations.

•

La posizione supporta anche i team di prodotti locali fornendo informazioni finanziarie e modellazione per guidare il processo decisionale basato sui dati. Responsabilità chiave: 1. Coordinamento finanziario con Centro Servizi condivisi (SSC):
• Agire come collegamento primario tra Roche Kazakhstan e SSC a Budapest per tutte le questioni relative alla contabilità.
• Monitorare l'accuratezza e la tempestività delle postazioni finanziarie, comprese le voci di giornale, le accruals e le riclassificazioni.
• Verificare e convalidare le relazioni finanziarie e le dichiarazioni per garantire che si allineano con gli standard contabili locali e aziendali.
• Coordinare con l’agenzia locale e garantire il rispetto delle normative fiscali locali del Kazakistan (VAT, CIT, WHT, ecc.)
• Coordinate con SSC e consulenti fiscali esterni per i depositi fiscali e gli audit.
• Sostenere i processi di chiusura di fine mese e fine anno, fornendo contesto locale, risolvendo discrepanze e garantendo una corretta documentazione.
• Collabora con i revisori interni ed esterni fornendo i dati finanziari e le spiegazioni necessarie durante i cicli di audit. 2. Business Partnering & Financial Insights:
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il team di prodotti - team medici e commerciali per fornire supporto finanziario per le iniziative aziendali chiave e il processo decisionale.
• Costruire e mantenere modelli finanziari per le prestazioni del prodotto, scenari di prezzi e nuova pianificazione di lancio.
• Fornire informazioni tempestive, pertinenti e attuabili su ricavi, struttura dei costi, redditività e rischi finanziari/opportunità.
• Assistere nella preparazione di casi aziendali, pianificazione del bilancio e processi di previsione.
• Traduci dati finanziari complessi in linguaggio aziendale per gli stakeholder non finanziari, aiutandoli a prendere decisioni strategiche e operative informate. 3. Coordinamento degli appalti:
• Agire come punto di contatto per le attività di approvvigionamento locale, garantendo l'allineamento con le politiche di approvvigionamento globale e le normative locali.
• Guida le parti interessate interne alle procedure di acquisto, all'imbarco dei fornitori e alla conformità dei contratti.
• Supporta processi di appalto, selezione dei fornitori, input di negoziazione e monitoraggio delle prestazioni dei fornitori.
• Collaborare con team finanziari e legali per garantire che i contratti siano finanziariamente e legalmente validi.
• Monitorare i KPI di approvvigionamento e aiutare a identificare le opportunità di risparmio dei costi e i miglioramenti dei processi. 4. Collaborazione trasversale e miglioramento continuo:
• Servire come facilitatore interfunzionale per migliorare il coordinamento tra finanza, appalti e team commerciali.
• Identificare le opportunità di semplificare e automatizzare i processi di finanza e di approvvigionamento a livello locale.
• Promuovere il rispetto dei controlli interni, delle politiche finanziarie e delle pratiche di approvvigionamento etico.
• Fornire formazione o orientamento ai colleghi sui principi fondamentali della finanza e dell'approvvigionamento. Qualifiche:
• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, economia o un campo relativo.
• Riconoscimento e Certificati Internazionali (Camera dei Contabili Professionali, ACCA , CIPA , CPA , DipIFR , o equivalente).
• Esperienza comprovata nelle operazioni finanziarie, preferibilmente in un ambiente di servizi multinazionale o condiviso.
• Forte comprensione dei principi contabili e delle normative fiscali. •

Key Responsibilities:
1. Financial Coordination with Shared Services Centre (SSC):

• Act as the primary liaison between Roche Kazakhstan and the SSC in Budapest for all accounting-related matters.

• Monitor the accuracy and timeliness of financial postings, including journal entries, accruals, and reclassifications.

• Review and validate financial reports and statements to ensure they align with local and corporate accounting standards.

• Coordinate with local agency and ensure compliance with Kazakhstan’s local tax regulations (VAT, CIT, WHT, etc.)

• Coordinate with SSC and external tax advisors for tax filings and audits.

• Support the month-end and year-end closing processes by providing local context, resolving discrepancies, and ensuring proper documentation.

• Collaborate with internal and external auditors by providing required financial data and explanations during audit cycles.
2. Business Partnering & Financial Insights:

• Work closely with product team - medical and commercial teams to provide financial support for key business initiatives and decision-making.

• Build and maintain financial models for product performance, pricing scenarios and new launch planning.

• Deliver timely, relevant, and actionable insights on revenue, cost structure, profitability, and financial risks/opportunities.

• Assist in the preparation of business cases, budget planning, and forecasting processes.

• Translate complex financial data into business language for non-finance stakeholders, helping them make informed strategic and operational decisions.
3. Procurement Coordination:

• Act as the point of contact for local procurement activities, ensuring alignment with global procurement policies and local regulations.

• Guide internal stakeholders on purchasing procedures, vendor onboarding, and contract compliance.

• Support tendering processes, vendor selection, negotiation input, and supplier performance monitoring.

• Collaborate with finance and legal teams to ensure contracts are financially and legally sound.

• Monitor procurement KPIs and help identify cost-saving opportunities and process improvements.
4. Cross-functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement:

• Serve as a cross-functional facilitator to improve coordination between finance, procurement, and commercial teams.

• Identify opportunities to streamline and automate finance and procurement processes at the local level.

• Promote compliance with internal controls, financial policies, and ethical procurement practices.

• Provide training or guidance to colleagues on basic finance and procurement principles as needed.

Qualifications:

• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

• Recognition and International Certificates (Chamber of Professional Accountants, ACCA , CIPA , CPA , DipIFR , or equivalent).

• Proven experience in finance operations, preferably in a multinational or shared services environment.

• Strong understanding of accounting principles and tax regulations.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Shape the Future of Secure Engineering with Roche

Are you ready to tackle bold challenges and make a real impact? At Roche, we’re not just building IT infrastructure — we’re engineering secure, scalable, and highly innovative software solutions that protect and empower digital health systems globally. We're looking for passionate and driven individuals to join our Certman PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) team as a Software Engineer and help us lead the way in cutting-edge, trust-based technology.

Who We Are: A Better Tomorrow Starts Today

At Roche, everything we do is powered by our passion to transform patients’ lives. We embrace science, ethics, and innovation. We're bold in our decisions and actions because we know a brighter future depends on it. Every day, we show up to build that future — for a better world, for humankind.

Diversity and inclusion aren’t just buzzwords here; they’re essential to who we are. We believe that unique perspectives breed innovation and creativity, which is why we are committed to building teams that reflect the extraordinary range of human potential.

Your Role: Redefine Excellence in Secure Software Engineering

As a Software Engineer within Roche's Certman PKI team, you will become a driving force behind the design, development, and evolution of our mission-critical enterprise trust and identity software. Working closely with latest technology trends, you will build the software layer that manages digital certificate lifecycles, cryptographic keys, and secure authentication. Every feature you code, every system you architect, and every application you optimize will contribute directly to safeguarding the technology that enhances people’s lives worldwide.

A Key Element of Your Contribution: As an experience C# engineer, you will design and deliver high-performance, resilient software services that power Roche's global operations. This role demands deep expertise across the full .NET stack — from advanced memory management and asynchronous programming patterns to designing secure, scalable backend systems and orchestrating containerized microservices across AWS and Kubernetes at enterprise scale. You'll apply asynchronous programming practices and design excellence to build high-throughput, low-latency APIs that meet the reliability and compliance requirements of medical devices serving patients worldwide. Your commitment to software engineering excellence, clean code principles, and robust design patterns will be fundamental to delivering seamless and secure experiences that uphold Roche's standards of quality and trust.

What You’ll Do:

As a Software Engineer in the Certman PKI team, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and evolving our certificate issuance API using ASP.NET Core (C#). You will own the end-to-end quality of the service.

You will design and implement well-versioned REST APIs, automate cryptographic and certificate lifecycle workflows, and diagnose and resolve complex performance, concurrency, or architectural bottlenecks using profiling and observability tooling.

You will deploy and operate our services natively on AWS and AliCloud, working hands-on with EKS/Kubernetes, KMS for key operations, EC2, IAM, and other core AWS building blocks. You will own and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines on GitLab and GitHub Actions — building reproducible, secure, and fully automated build, test, scan, and deploy workflows for containerized .NET services.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Position
We are building a global Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team to support critical commercial and internal platforms and applications. As an SRE, you will help design, build, and scale reliable distributed systems that power healthcare innovation worldwide.
This role is focused on reliability, scalability, automation and operational excellence. You will influence system design, define reliability standards and reduce operational toil through engineering solutions.
This role includes participation in a structured on-call rotation.

Who We Are
At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow.
Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients.

Step into the Future of IT with Roche!
As a seasoned Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at Roche, you will leverage your deep software engineering expertise to propel our products to new heights of robustness, scalability and reliability. This isn't just a role—it's an invitation to shape the backbone of technological innovations forward.

Your Mission
Design and maintain cutting-edge tools, scripts and frameworks that automate repetitive tasks, streamline software deployment and manage expansive systems with unparalleled efficiency. Partner closely with forward-thinking development teams to architect and implement high-performance solutions that elevate system efficiency, optimize resource utilization and enhance deployment processes for superior uptime and user satisfaction.

Your Impact
Lead the charge in incident management and response. Detect system anomalies, troubleshoot swiftly and conduct thorough root cause analyses to prevent recurring issues.
Champion continuous improvement by refining monitoring and alerting mechanisms, conducting insightful post-incident reviews and embedding best practices in software lifecycle management. Your strategic foresight and meticulous planning will ensure our systems are not only reliable but also superlatively performant.
By joining our elite team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering seamless experiences to our end-users, exceeding business and customer demands, and solidifying Roche's reputation as a leader in IT innovation.

Your Core Responsibilities
Reliability Engineering & Architecture

• Define and implement SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with product and engineering teams

• Conduct reliability reviews for new and existing services

• Design scalable, fault-tolerant architectures in AWS and Azure environments

• Lead capacity planning, performance and cost optimization initiatives

• Improve system resilience through automation and self-healing patterns

• Drive organizational observability maturity (metrics, logs, traces, alert quality)

Incident Management & Continuous Improvement

• Perform complex root cause analysis and drive rapid mitigation

• Participate in blameless postmortems and follow-through

• Improve MTTR, reduce incident frequency, and elevate production standards

• Collaborate seamlessly with engineering teams to enable timely and effective

Questo non è solo un ruolo: è un invito a modellare la spina dorsale delle innovazioni tecnologiche in avanti. La tua missione Progettare e mantenere strumenti all'avanguardia, script e framework che automatizzano le attività ripetitive, semplificano l'implementazione del software e gestiscono sistemi espansivi con efficienza senza pari. Affidatevi a stretto contatto con i team di sviluppo avanzati per l'architettura e l'implementazione di soluzioni ad alte prestazioni che elevano l'efficienza del sistema, ottimizzano l'utilizzo delle risorse e migliorano i processi di implementazione per una migliore soddisfazione degli utenti. Il tuo impatto Guidare l'accusa nella gestione e risposta degli incidenti. Campione continuo miglioramento raffinando i meccanismi di monitoraggio e di avviso, conducendo approfondite recensioni post-incidenti e incorporando le migliori pratiche nella gestione del ciclo di vita del software. La vostra visione strategica e la pianificazione meticolosa garantiranno che i nostri sistemi non siano solo affidabili ma anche superlativamente performanti. Unendo il nostro team di élite, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nel fornire esperienze senza soluzione di continuità ai nostri utenti finali, superando le richieste di business e clienti, e consolidando la reputazione di Roche come leader nell'innovazione IT. • Definire e implementare SLIs, SLOs e budget di errore con team di prodotto e ingegneria
• Condurre recensioni di affidabilità per i servizi nuovi e esistenti
• Design architetture scalabili e tolleranti ai guasti in ambienti AWS e Azure
• Iniziative di pianificazione, performance e ottimizzazione dei costi
• Migliorare la resilienza del sistema attraverso l'automazione e i modelli di autoguarigione
• Maturazione dell'osservanza organizzativa dell'azionamento (metri, registri, tracce, qualità dell'avviso) Gestione degli incidenti e miglioramento continuo
• Eseguire analisi complesse cause radice e guidare la mitigazione rapida
• Partecipare a postmortems e follow-through senza colpa
• Migliorare il MTTR, ridurre la frequenza degli incidenti e elevati standard di produzione
• Collaborare senza soluzione di continuità con i team di ingegneria per consentire tempestive ed efficaci

The Opportunity

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen.
