jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Como Estagiário(a) de Compliance, Riscos e Auditoria, você fará parte de uma equipe dedicada à ética corporativa, governança e integridade. Você interagirá com áreas internas e participará de reuniões com times regionais e globais, contribuindo diretamente para o alinhamento e a troca de boas práticas na nossa cultura de integridade.

A Oportunidade:

• Você apoia a organização do cronograma, consolidação de dados e preenchimento de templates do ciclo anual de Riscos e Oportunidades.

• Você auxilia no acompanhamento do status das ações de mitigação de riscos junto às áreas de negócio e mantém as planilhas de controle atualizadas.

• Você dá suporte na revisão e formatação de políticas internas, além de apoiar a coleta e arquivo de evidências documentais para auditorias internas e monitoramentos.

• Você apoia a triagem inicial para análises de due diligence de terceiros (parceiros de negócio, HCPs, HCOs) e acompanha os prazos das ações de remediação de compliance.

• Você auxilia na logística de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e atua como canal de suporte inicial para direcionar dúvidas operacionais.

• Você ajuda na atualização das bases de dados que alimentam os indicadores de performance (KPIs) e apoia a formatação visual de relatórios e apresentações.

Quem é você:

• Você estuda no período noturno e cursa a partir do 2º ano de Finanças, Economia, Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Relações Internacionais, Direito ou áreas correlatas.

• Você tem previsão de formatura a partir de dezembro de 2028 e disponibilidade para cumprir um contrato de estágio de 1 ano e meio a 2 anos.

• Você possui inglês a partir do nível intermediário-avançado.

• Você possui domínio completo das ferramentas do Pacote Office.

• Você demonstra boa comunicação, atenção a detalhes e organização no seu dia a dia.

• Você tem um interesse genuíno por temas ligados à ética corporativa, governança e integridade.

Benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam engagieren sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit für die Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Senior Data Center Network Engineer (d/f/m)
Introduction At Roche, we believe that every voice matters, and we invite you to bring your unique perspective to our team. As a Senior Data Center Network Engineer, you will join a culture of technical excellence, architecting resilient, high-performance infrastructures that empower our global mission. You will act as a technical expert, leveraging advanced automation to solve critical business challenges and drive our digital evolution.
The Opportunity:

• Architect Scalable Networks: Lead the end-to-end design and deployment of "first-time-right" network solutions, specifically focusing on Spine-Leaf topologies and L2/L3 fabrics.

• Drive Technical Leadership: Act as a Solution Architect for large initiatives, managing resource estimation, dependencies, and risk mitigation across technical teams.

• Implement Network as Code: Modernize operations by developing and maintaining Arista AVD, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure scalable, repeatable deployments.

• Master Complex Problem Solving: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to diagnose complex network incidents, performing deep root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence.

• Maximize System Reliability: Define and maintain Service Level Objectives (SLOs) through advanced telemetry and streaming analytics to ensure "five-nines" availability.

• Influence Strategic Roadmaps: Translate technical roadmaps into business value for stakeholders and steer vendor product evaluations to align with long-term strategy.

• Lead Seamless Migrations: Oversee high-stakes brownfield-to-greenfield migrations with a focus on hitless cutovers and zero-downtime execution.

• Foster Innovation and Growth: Proactively refine fabric performance and mentor junior engineers, contributing to a workplace culture of continuous learning.

Who you are:

• Experienced Architect: You bring deep mastery of Arista EOS and EVPN-VXLAN architectures, with a proven track record of designing large-scale fabrics.

• Educated Professional: You hold a Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and bring years of relevant industry experience; CCIE-level expertise is highly desirable.

• Automation Expert: You are proficient in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), specifically using Arista AVD, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines for network automation.

• Strategic Thinker: You possess the ability to translate complex system concepts into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Resilient Problem Solver: You demonstrate expert-level troubleshooting skills and remain decisive in high-pressure, complex technical scenarios.

• Project Leader: You have significant experience leading technical teams through complex project dependencies and risk management.

• Visionary Engineer: You are a proactive learner who stays ahead of industry trends to maintain architectural excellence in modern fabric environments.

Call to Action: Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.

La posizione
Senior Data Center Network Engineer (d/f/m)
Introduzione A Roche, crediamo che ogni voce conta, e vi invitiamo a portare la vostra prospettiva unica al nostro team. In qualità di Senior Data Center Network Engineer, ti unirai a una cultura di eccellenza tecnica, progettando infrastrutture resistenti e ad alte prestazioni che potenziano la nostra missione globale. Potrai agire come esperto tecnico, sfruttando l'automazione avanzata per risolvere le sfide aziendali critiche e guidare la nostra evoluzione digitale.
L'opportunità:

• Architetto Scalable Networks: guidare il design end-to-end e la distribuzione di soluzioni di rete "first-time-right", in particolare focalizzandosi sulle topologie Spine-Leaf e sui tessuti L2/L3.

• Guidare la leadership tecnica: Agire come Solution Architect per grandi iniziative, gestire la stima delle risorse, le dipendenze e la mitigazione dei rischi in team tecnici.

• Implement Network come Codice: Modernizzare le operazioni sviluppando e mantenendo le pipeline Arista AVD, Ansible e CI/CD per garantire implementazioni scalabili e ripetibili.

• Master Complex Problem Solving: Collabora con team interfunzionali per diagnosticare complessi incidenti di rete, eseguendo un'analisi profonda causa radice per prevenire la ricorrenza.

• Massimizzare l'affidabilità del sistema: Definire e mantenere gli obiettivi del livello di servizio (SLO) attraverso la telemetria avanzata e l'analisi di streaming per garantire la disponibilità di "cinque-nines".

• Strade strategiche di influenza: Tradurre roadmap tecniche in valore aziendale per le parti interessate e le valutazioni dei prodotti del fornitore steer allineare con la strategia a lungo termine.

• Migrazioni senza cuciture di piombo: supervisionare le migrazioni di campionamento marrone-verde con un focus su tagli senza successo e l'esecuzione zero-downtime.

• Foster Innovation and Growth: Proattivamente affinare le prestazioni del tessuto e gli ingegneri junior del mentore, contribuendo a una cultura del posto di lavoro di apprendimento continuo.

Chi sei:

• Architetto esperto: Porti una profonda padronanza delle architetture Arista EOS e EVPN-VXLAN, con una comprovata traccia di progettazione di tessuti su larga scala.

• Professionista Educato: Hai una laurea in un campo tecnico e portare anni di esperienza nel settore rilevante; la competenza a livello CCIE è altamente auspicabile.

• Automation Expert: Lei è competente in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), in particolare utilizzando le tubazioni Arista AVD, Ansible e CI/CD per l'automazione di rete.

• Pensatore Strategico: Possiedi la capacità di tradurre concetti di sistema complessi in chiare e attuabili intuizioni per gli stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici.

• Resilient Problem Solver: Lei dimostra le abilità di risoluzione dei problemi di livello esperto e rimane decisivo in scenari tecnici di alta pressione e complessi.

• Leader del progetto: Hai una significativa esperienza di team tecnici leader attraverso complesse dipendenze del progetto e gestione dei rischi.

• Visionary Engineer: Sei un apprendista proattivo che sta davanti alle tendenze del settore per mantenere l'eccellenza architettonica in ambienti di tessuto moderni.

La position
Ingénieur principal du réseau de centres de données (d/f/m)
Introduction Chez Roche, nous croyons que chaque voix compte, et nous vous invitons à apporter votre point de vue unique à notre équipe. En tant qu'ingénieur principal du réseau Data Center, vous vous joignez à une culture d'excellence technique, d'architecture d'infrastructures résistantes et performantes qui responsabilisent notre mission mondiale. Vous agirez comme un expert technique, en tirant parti de l'automatisation avancée pour résoudre des défis commerciaux critiques et piloter notre évolution numérique.
La possibilité :

• Architect Scalable Networks : Dirigez la conception et le déploiement de solutions réseau « première fois à droite », axées spécifiquement sur les topologies Spine-Leaf et les tissus L2/L3.

• Diriger le leadership technique : agir en tant qu'architecte de solutions pour les grandes initiatives, gérer l'estimation des ressources, les dépendances et l'atténuation des risques entre les équipes techniques.

• Mettre en oeuvre le réseau en tant que code : Moderniser les opérations en développant et en maintenant des pipelines Arista AVD, Ansible et CI/CD pour assurer des déploiements évolutifs et répétables.

• Résoudre les problèmes complexes : Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour diagnostiquer les incidents complexes du réseau, effectuer une analyse profonde des causes profondes pour prévenir les récidives.

• Maximiser la fiabilité du système : Définir et maintenir des objectifs de niveau de service (ALS) grâce à la télémétrie avancée et à l'analyse en continu pour assurer la disponibilité des « cinq-neuf ».

• Influencer les feuilles de route stratégiques : Traduire les feuilles de route techniques en valeur opérationnelle pour les parties prenantes et orienter les évaluations des produits des fournisseurs pour les aligner sur la stratégie à long terme.

• Lead Seamless Migrations: Surveiller les migrations à fort débit de friches vers des champs verts, en mettant l'accent sur les coupes sans impact et l'exécution à temps zéro.

• Favoriser l'innovation et la croissance : Raffiner proactivement la performance des tissus et encadrer les ingénieurs subalternes, contribuant ainsi à une culture de l'apprentissage continu en milieu de travail.

Qui vous êtes :

• Architecte expérimenté: Vous apportez une maîtrise profonde des architectures Arista EOS et EVPN-VXLAN, avec une expérience éprouvée de la conception de tissus à grande échelle.

• Professionnel formé: Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat dans un domaine technique et apportez des années d'expérience pertinente de l'industrie; l'expertise de niveau CCIE est hautement souhaitable.

• Automation Expert: Vous êtes compétent en Infrastructure comme code (IaC), en particulier en utilisant Arista AVD, Ansible, et CI/CD pipelines pour l'automatisation de réseau.

• Penseur stratégique : Vous avez la capacité de traduire des concepts de système complexes en idées claires et réalisables pour les intervenants techniques et non techniques.

• Résilient Problem Solver: Vous démontrez des compétences de dépannage de niveau expert et restez décisif dans des scénarios techniques complexes et à haute pression.

• Chef de projet : Vous avez une expérience importante en matière d'équipes techniques à travers des dépendances complexes de projet et de gestion des risques.

• Ingénieur visionnaire: Vous êtes un apprenant proactif qui reste en avance sur les tendances de l'industrie pour maintenir l'excellence architecturale dans les environnements de tissus modernes.

Appel à l'action : Prêt à apporter vos qualités uniques à Roche et à faire un impact ? Postulez maintenant et rejoignez-nous dans notre mission de façonner l'avenir des soins de santé.
#RDT2026

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités

jobs.title: Global Product Planner - Fixed Term
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Are you ready to take your career to the next level with a dynamic and global role? As a Global Product Planner, you will be at the forefront of supply chain management, driving operational excellence and ensuring product availability across our Indianapolis and Mannheim, Germany hubs. You will develop and manage supply plans utilizing both affiliate and statistical forecasts to create accurate and efficient supply chains. By proactively addressing supply and demand planning issues, you will maintain seamless operations and ensure the accuracy and continuous optimization of MRP master data. Leading bottleneck management, allocation, reserve management, and scrap mitigation across the network will be vital components of your role.

In this position, you will be the primary point of contact for product supply-related communications with suppliers, regions, business areas, and affiliates. You will guarantee the timely supply of finished goods to regional and local warehouses, aligning with service level agreements (SLAs), and strive to meet customer service objectives at the lowest possible total costs, including distribution, inventory, and write-offs.

We are looking for someone with specialized and comprehensive knowledge in supply chain management or a related business area. Your analytical and problem-solving skills will be engaged in varied and complex duties involving research, analysis, and solution development. You will provide expert guidance to department leadership in setting strategic direction and utilize originality and ingenuity in your daily responsibilities and decision-making processes. Applying a wide range of principles, practices, and procedures to navigate more complex and challenging assignments will be crucial. Additionally, your commitment to maintaining and continuously improving the planning objectives and goals through daily actions will be key.

This is your opportunity to make a significant impact in a highly professional and strategic role. Join us and contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional service and operational efficiency. Apply now to be part of a global team committed to excellence!

The Opportunity

• Supply Planning: Develops global supply plan based on affiliate forecasts and GSC strategic guidance. Delivers supply plans to Manufacturing and supplier partners. Works with external suppliers to ensure agreed plans are met. In case of exception, works with partners to resolve situations with the least disruption to customers. Monitors cycle time, critical batches and the optimization of planning parameter settings to avoid destruction costs or stock outs. Monitors schedule adherence and discusses if below target during Supply Review meetings (S&OP). Monitors system alerts for potential / actual supply issues throughout the global network. Makes recommendations to provide timely resolution with minimum impact to customers: Works with IBL/IPM to define regional/country product allocations in case of bottleneck; Keeps Regions / Affiliates / BAs informed as to potential and actual product bottlenecks.

• Inventory & Product availability management: Manages inventories at global distribution centers to ensure high service level to customers at low

主要职责/责任：

A. 目标与计划管理

• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性

• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划

• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益

• 和准入团队合作提升区域内治疗药物的可及性。

C. 团队管理

• 参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划

• 吸引、招聘、辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展

• 打造绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，创新工作模式，以实现公司愿景

D. 财务和合规管理

• 分配并管理公司资源、预算以实现生态圈目标

• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境

能力与要求：

• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先

• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者

• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质

• 思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维

• 领导力特质：系统思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养

• 业务及资源规划能力

La position
La nourriture est notre affaire quotidienne

À Bâle et Kaiseraugst, nous employons environ 350 personnes de plus de 37 pays.
Notre offre comprend à la fois des restaurants du personnel qui live variété et restaurants gastronomiques avec une cuisine haut de gamme et un excellent service. En outre, nous offrons des restaurants avec des spécialités du monde entier, du café dans toutes les variantes, charmés par nos baristi, ainsi que les plus hauts salons en Suisse – des endroits fantastiques après le travail au-dessus des toits de la ville. En outre, nous offrons à nos invités une salle de réunion et un événement pour accueillir jusqu'à 1 500 personnes. Les restaurants publics, le Schöpfli dans le parc et le Chez Jeannot dans le Musée Tinguely complètent notre offre.

Vos tâches

• Cuisine froide ou chaude, restaurant libre ou personnel

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Position: People Relations Partner
Location: Shanghai, China
Scope: All legal entities of China

About the Role We are looking for a proactive and collaborative People Relations (PR) Partner. By collaborating with People & Culture (P&C) colleagues, you will provide trusted solutions to elevate the employee experience, empower business leaders to support and drive organizational changes, and ensure a fair, inclusive, and psychologically safe workplace.

Key Responsibilities

• Change Management: Work together with other P&C colleagues and act as a sparring partner to drive organizational transformation and business changes.

• Employee Relations & Conflict Resolution: Consult on complex performance and health issues; lead conflict prevention and resolution; and address general employee queries regarding working relationships.

• Policy & Compliance: Review HR contracts/agreements, design and evaluate PR policies, and manage communications with employee representative bodies (e.g., labor unions) and relevant government authorities.

• Investigations & Corrective Actions: Conduct workplace incident investigations, provide compliance-based corrective recommendations, and prepare for potential labor dispute litigation.

• Enablement & Insights: Deliver PR-related training, and leverage data and technology to generate insights that inform management decision-making.

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree or above in Law, Business, or related fields.

• 8+ years of working experience in multinational companies, including at least 3 years dedicated to Employee/Labor Relations. Experience in a healthcare commercial organization is highly preferred.

• Fluent English skills (reading, writing, listening, speaking); experience in designing and drafting corporate-level policies is preferred.

• Expert knowledge of relevant employment legislation, with proven success in leading organizational transformations or reorganizations.

• Outstanding consultation, influencing, and negotiation skills; an enterprise mindset with the ability to properly handle highly sensitive employee relations crises.

• Passionate about building a diverse and inclusive work culture, and enhancing psychological safety and a sense of belonging within the team.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Posizione: People Relations Partner
Ubicazione: Shanghai, Cina
Ambito: Tutte le entità legali della Cina

Siamo alla ricerca di un partner proattivo e collaborativo People Relations (PR). Collaborando con colleghi di People & Culture (P&C), fornirete soluzioni affidabili per elevare l'esperienza dei dipendenti, rafforzare i leader aziendali per sostenere e guidare i cambiamenti organizzativi, e garantire un posto di lavoro equo, inclusivo e psicologicamente sicuro.

Principali responsabilità

• Change Management: Lavorare insieme ad altri colleghi P&C e agire come partner risparmiatore per guidare la trasformazione organizzativa e i cambiamenti di business.

• Rapporti dei dipendenti & Risoluzione dei conflitti: Consultare su complesse questioni di prestazioni e salute; prevenire e risoluzione dei conflitti; e affrontare le domande generali dei dipendenti in materia di rapporti di lavoro.

• Politica & Compliance: Review HR contratti / accordi, progettazione e valutazione delle politiche di PR, e gestire le comunicazioni con i rappresentanti dei dipendenti (ad esempio, sindacati del lavoro) e le autorità governative competenti.

• Investigazioni e azioni correttive: condurre indagini sugli incidenti sul posto di lavoro, fornire raccomandazioni correttive basate sulla conformità, e prepararsi a potenziali contenziosi di controversie sul lavoro.

• Abilitazione & Insights: Fornire formazione relativa alle PR, e sfruttare i dati e la tecnologia per generare intuizioni che informano il processo decisionale di gestione.

Qualifiche e esperienza

• Corso di laurea o superiore in Diritto, Affari o campi correlati.

• 8+ anni di esperienza lavorativa nelle aziende multinazionali, tra cui almeno 3 anni dedicati ai Rapporti dipendenti/lavori. L'esperienza in un'organizzazione commerciale sanitaria è molto preferita.

• Competenze fluenti in inglese (lettura, scrittura, ascolto, parlare); è preferibile l'esperienza nella progettazione e nella stesura di politiche di livello aziendale.

• Conoscenza esperta della legislazione in materia di occupazione, con successo dimostrato nelle principali trasformazioni organizzative o riorganizzazione.

• Straordinarie capacità di consultazione, di influenza e di negoziazione; una mentalità aziendale con la capacità di gestire correttamente crisi di relazioni dei dipendenti altamente sensibili.

• Appassionato a costruire una cultura del lavoro diversificata e inclusiva, e a migliorare la sicurezza psicologica e il senso di appartenenza all'interno del team.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Position: People Relations Partner
Standort: Shanghai, China
Anwendungsbereich: Alle juristischen Personen Chinas

Über die Rolle Wir suchen einen proaktiven und kooperativen People Relations (PR) Partner. Durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen von People & Culture (P&C) bieten Sie vertrauenswürdige Lösungen, um die Mitarbeitererfahrung zu verbessern, Führungskräfte in die Lage zu versetzen, organisatorische Veränderungen zu unterstützen und voranzutreiben und einen fairen, integrativen und psychologisch sicheren Arbeitsplatz zu gewährleisten.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Change Management: Arbeiten Sie mit anderen P&C-Kollegen zusammen und agieren Sie als Sparringspartner, um organisatorische Transformation und geschäftliche Veränderungen voranzutreiben.

• Mitarbeiterbeziehungen & Konfliktlösung: Konsultieren Sie zu komplexen Leistungs- und Gesundheitsfragen; führen Sie Konfliktprävention und -lösung; und behandeln Sie allgemeine Mitarbeiteranfragen zu Arbeitsbeziehungen.

• Policy & Compliance: Überprüfen Sie HR-Verträge, entwerfen und bewerten Sie PR-Richtlinien und verwalten Sie die Kommunikation mit Arbeitnehmervertretungen (z. B. Gewerkschaften) und relevanten Regierungsbehörden.

• Untersuchungen und Korrekturmaßnahmen: Durchführung von Untersuchungen zu Vorfällen am Arbeitsplatz, Bereitstellung von Compliance-basierten Korrekturempfehlungen und Vorbereitung auf mögliche Arbeitsstreitigkeiten.

• Enablement & Insights: Liefern Sie PR-bezogene Schulungen und nutzen Sie Daten und Technologien, um Erkenntnisse zu generieren, die die Entscheidungsfindung des Managements beeinflussen.

Qualifikationen & Erfahrung

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder höher in Law, Business oder verwandten Bereichen.

• 8+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in multinationalen Unternehmen, davon mindestens 3 Jahre für Mitarbeiter / Arbeitsbeziehungen. Erfahrung in einer kommerziellen Gesundheitsorganisation ist sehr bevorzugt.

• Fließende Englischkenntnisse (Lesen, Schreiben, Hören, Sprechen); Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Ausarbeitung von Richtlinien auf Unternehmensebene wird bevorzugt.

• Expertenwissen über relevante Arbeitsgesetzgebung, mit nachgewiesenem Erfolg bei der Leitung von organisatorischen Transformationen oder Reorganisationen.

• Herausragende Beratungs-, Einfluss- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten; eine Unternehmensmentalität mit der Fähigkeit, hochsensible Mitarbeiterbeziehungskrisen richtig zu bewältigen.

• Leidenschaft für den Aufbau einer vielfältigen und integrativen Arbeitskultur und die Verbesserung der psychologischen Sicherheit und des Zugehörigkeitsgefühls im Team.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. Gemeinsam widmen sich mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter weltweit der Förderung der Wissenschaft, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Unsere Bemühungen führen dazu, dass mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden und über 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostikprodukten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die globale Auswirkungen haben.

Lasst uns gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft aufbauen.

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit.

Principales responsabilités

• Gestion du changement : Collaborer avec d'autres collègues de P et C et agir à titre de partenaire de partage pour favoriser la transformation organisationnelle et les changements opérationnels.

• Relations de travail et règlement des conflits : Consulter sur des questions complexes de rendement et de santé; diriger la prévention et le règlement des conflits; et répondre aux questions générales des employés concernant les relations de travail.

• Politique et conformité : Examiner les contrats/ententes en matière de RH, concevoir et évaluer les politiques en matière de relations publiques et gérer les communications avec les organismes représentatifs des employés (p. ex. les syndicats) et les autorités gouvernementales compétentes.

• Enquêtes et mesures correctives : Mener des enquêtes sur les incidents en milieu de travail, formuler des recommandations correctives fondées sur la conformité et se préparer à des litiges éventuels.

• Activement & Insights: Offrir une formation liée aux relations publiques et tirer parti des données et de la technologie pour générer des idées qui éclairent la prise de décisions par la direction.

Qualifications et expérience

• Baccalauréat en droit, affaires ou domaines connexes.

• 8 ans et plus d'expérience de travail dans des entreprises multinationales, dont au moins 3 ans consacrés aux relations entre employés et laboratoires. L'expérience d'une organisation commerciale de soins de santé est hautement préférée.

• Des compétences en anglais (lecture, écriture, écoute, expression orale); l'expérience dans la conception et la rédaction de politiques au niveau de l'entreprise est préférée.

• Connaissances spécialisées de la législation pertinente en matière d'emploi, avec succès prouvé dans les transformations organisationnelles ou les réorganisations.

• Des compétences exceptionnelles en matière de consultation, d'influence et de négociation; un état d'esprit d'entreprise capable de gérer correctement les crises hautement sensibles liées aux relations de travail.

• Passionné de construire une culture du travail diversifiée et inclusive, et d'améliorer la sécurité psychologique et le sentiment d'appartenance au sein de l'équipe.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. The Position
Wichtig: Nach deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns innerhalb weniger Tage per E-Mail bei dir. Um sicherzustellen, dass du keine wichtige Nachricht verpasst, bitten wir dich, neben deinem Posteingang auch den Spam- oder Junk-Ordner zu prüfen. Falls du innerhalb einer Woche nichts von uns hörst, melde dich unter basel.berufslehre@roche.com .

Weisst Du bereits, was du nach deinem Abschluss machen wirst? Weltverbesserer oder Lebensretterin werden? Nicht nur Du musst Deine Zukunft neu erfinden. Auch wir. Wir bei Roche arbeiten mit einem Ziel - innovative Tests und Medikamente zu entwickeln und Daten auf neue Weise zu nutzen, um Menschen zu einem längeren und besseren Leben zu verhelfen. Lass Dich inspirieren, wer wir sind, was wir tun und wie wir es tun. Absolviere Deine Ausbildung bei Roche und leiste damit einen entscheidenden Beitrag zum Wohle des Patienten!

Lernen. Zukunft. Roche.

Top Argumente für den Job

• Du betreust und beratest Patienten und Patientinnen in Arztpraxen und anderen ambulanten Institutionen.

• Du assistierst dem Arzt/ der Ärztin bei operativen Eingriffen wie zB Punktionen bei Abszessen oder beim Nähen der Wunde und speziellen Untersuchungen wie zB Ergospirometrie

• Du bist für die Koordination und Organisation diverser Abläufe während den Sprechstunden zuständig

• Du erstellst EKG's (Elektrokardiogramme) , Lungenfunktionstests und Hörstests

• Du untersuchst Blut und Urin indem du Blutzellen differenzierst und die Qualität und Plausibilität der Testresultate bewertest

• Du arbeitest mit Mikroskopen, Chemikalien und Apparaturen

• Du lernst die fachgerechte Technik mit den Röntgenapparaten kennen und lernst den Umgang mit dem Strahlenschutz

• Administrative Tätigkeiten wie zum Beispiel Abrechnungen verwalten, den Zahlungsverkehr abwickeln, Verwaltung der Patientendaten, Bestellung von Medikamenten und Verbrauchsmaterialien

• Zusätzlich lernst du bei Roche im Medizinischen Dienst den Bereich der Arbeits-und Notfallmedizin kennen

Dein Profil

Du bist gerne mit Menschen im Kontakt und bist hilfsbereits und zuverlässig? Prima!
Du bist schonmal gescheitert, wieder aufgestanden und hast weitergemacht? Perfekt!
Du möchtest dein Wissen rund um die Themen Medizin und medizinische Abläufe ausbauen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!

• Es macht dir Freude anderen zu helfen und dich verantwortungsvoll um sie zu kümmern

• Du bist empathisch, kommunikativ und unterhältst dich gerne auch mit fremden Personen

• Du bist ein Multitasking Talent, bist gut organisiert und verlierst auch in stressigen Situationen nicht den Überblick

• Du arbeitest gerne im Team und beteiligst dich aktiv an Diskussionen

• Mindestens Schulniveau Sek E (BS/BL/SO), Sek (AG), Mittlere Reife (D) oder höhere Schulstufen

• Deutsch Muttersprache oder Niveau B2

Deine Vorteile

• Du arbeitest in einer internationalen Umgebung und erhältst erstklassige Einblicke in die Unternehmung und den Berufsalltag

• Du besuchst eine praxisorientierte Werkschule

• Du arbeitest mit hochmodernen Anlagen, Geräten und zukunftsorientierten Einrichtungen

• Bei entsprechenden Leistungen besteht die Möglichkeit, dass wir dich nach der Ausbildung bei diversen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten unterstützen

• Je nach Distanz zum Arbeitsort hast du die Möglichkeit in Basel ein Zimmer im Roche Wohnhaus zu bekommen

Deine vollständige Bewerbung enthält folgende Dokumente:

• Lebenslauf

• Zeugnisse der letzten zwei Semester

• Check S2, falls du aus dem Bildungsraum Nordwestsc

• Lei sostiene e consiglia i pazienti in pratiche mediche e altre istituzioni ambulatoriale.

• Si assiste il medico in procedure chirurgiche come punture in ascessi o quando cucire la ferita e esami speciali come l'ergospirometria

• Sei responsabile del coordinamento e dell'organizzazione di vari processi durante le ore di ufficio

• Si crea ECG (elettrocardiogrammi), test di funzione polmonare e test dell'udito

• Si esamina il sangue e l'urina differenziando le cellule del sangue e valutando la qualità e la plausibilità dei risultati del test

• Lavori con microscopi, prodotti chimici e attrezzature

• Si arriva a conoscere la tecnologia professionale con l'apparato a raggi X e imparare a trattare con la protezione dalle radiazioni

• Attività amministrative come la gestione della fatturazione, la gestione dei pagamenti, la gestione dei dati dei pazienti, l'ordinazione di medicinali e materiali di consumo

• Inoltre, si arriva a conoscere il campo di medicina professionale e di emergenza a Roche nel servizio medico.

Ti piace essere in contatto con le persone e sono utili e affidabili? Fantastico!
Hai mai fallito, ti sei alzato di nuovo e hai continuato? Perfetto!
Vuoi espandere le tue conoscenze sulla medicina e sui processi medici? Allora dovremmo conoscerci!

Cosa dovreste portare:

• Ti dà il piacere di aiutare gli altri e prendersi cura di loro responsabilmente

• Sei empatico, comunicativo e anche godere di parlare con gli sconosciuti

• Sei un talento multitasking, sei ben organizzato e non perdere traccia anche in situazioni stressanti

• Ti piace lavorare in una squadra e partecipare attivamente alle discussioni

• Almeno livello scolastico Sek E (BS/BL/SO), Sek (AG), maturità media (D) o livelli scolastici superiori

• Lingua madre tedesca o livello B2

I vantaggi

• Lavori in un ambiente internazionale e ottieni informazioni di prima classe sull'azienda e sul lavoro quotidiano

• Frequenti una scuola di laboratorio orientata alla pratica

• Lavori con strutture all'avanguardia, attrezzature e strutture orientate al futuro

• Con i servizi corrispondenti, c'è la possibilità che vi supporteremo con varie ulteriori opportunità di istruzione dopo la formazione.

• A seconda della distanza dal luogo di lavoro, avete la possibilità di ottenere una stanza nell'edificio residenziale Roche a Basilea

L'applicazione completa contiene i seguenti documenti:

• CVC

• Certificati degli ultimi due semestri

• Controlla S2, se sei dall'area di istruzione nord-occidentale
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Important: After your application, we will contact you by e-mail within a few days. To make sure you don’t miss an important message, we ask you to check the spam or junk folder next to your inbox. If you do not hear from us within a week, contact basel.berufslehre@roche.com .

Do you know what you will do after graduation? Become a world improver or a lifesaver? Not only do you need to reinvent your future. We too. At Roche, we work with one goal – to develop innovative tests and drugs and use data in new ways to help people live longer and better lives. Let us inspire you who we are, what we do and how we do it. Complete your education at Roche and thus make a decisive contribution to the benefit of the patient!

Learning. The future. Roche.

Top Arguments for the Job

• You support and advise patients in medical practices and other outpatient institutions.

• You assist the doctor in surgical procedures such as punctures in abscesses or when sewing the wound and special examinations such as ergospirometry

• You are responsible for the coordination and organization of various processes during the office hours

• You create ECGs (electrocardiograms), lung function tests and hearing tests

• You examine blood and urine by differentiating blood cells and evaluating the quality and plausibility of the test results

• You work with microscopes, chemicals and equipment

• You get to know the professional technology with the X-ray apparatus and learn how to deal with radiation protection

• Administrative activities such as managing billing, handling payments, managing patient data, ordering medicines and consumables

• In addition, you will get to know the field of occupational and emergency medicine at Roche in the medical service.

Your profile

You like to be in contact with people and are helpful and reliable? Great!
Have you ever failed, got up again and continued? Perfect!
Do you want to expand your knowledge about medicine and medical processes? Then we should get to know each other!

What you should bring:

• It gives you pleasure to help others and take care of them responsibly

• You are empathetic, communicative and also enjoy talking to strangers

• You are a multitasking talent, are well organized and do not lose track even in stressful situations

• You enjoy working in a team and actively participate in discussions

• At least school level Sek E (BS/BL/SO), Sek (AG), Middle maturity (D) or higher school levels

• German native language or level B2

Your advantages

• You work in an international environment and get first-class insights into the company and everyday work

• You attend a practice-oriented workshop school

• You work with state-of-the-art facilities, equipment and future-oriented facilities

• With corresponding services, there is the possibility that we will support you with various further education opportunities after the training.

• Depending on the distance to the place of work, you have the opportunity to get a room in the Roche residential building in Basel

Your full application contains the following documents:

• CVC

• Certificates of the last two semesters

• Check S2, if you are from the Northwest Education Area

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Employee Experience Operations Travel & Expense Specialist as part of the Global Customer Experience (GCX) department will maintain and support the daily activities of the Travel and Entertainment associated with Roche. This role is expected to offer a high level of customer service as this is the first point of contact for our internal customers.

As a team member of Roche Services Solutions - Global Customer Experience Department you will be responsible for providing customer service support to Roche affiliates in relations to the Travel & Expense Application (SAP Concur). You will follow the instructions in the timely manner of the Cluster Section Lead and key contacts regarding the daily work coordination. You will contribute continuously to the improvement of the performance of Roche Services Solutions.

The Opportunity:

• Deliver Exceptional Customer Support – Serve as the first point of contact for Travel & Expense (SAP Concur) inquiries via phone, live chat, and ServiceNow, providing timely, accurate, and customer-focused support.

• Manage Travel & Expense Operations – Perform day-to-day administration of the SAP Concur system, resolve user issues, process access requests, and ensure service delivery meets established SLAs and KPIs.

• Drive Issue Resolution & Continuous Improvement – Investigate and resolve first-level system issues, maintain accurate documentation, monitor system performance, and identify opportunities to enhance processes and user experience.

• Collaborate Across Global Teams – Partner closely with cross-functional teams, including T&E Compliance and Concur Technical Support, to ensure efficient issue resolution and seamless service delivery.

• Support Business Excellence – Deliver end-user training, prepare operational reports, contribute to knowledge management, and actively participate in new initiatives to improve Travel & Expense services and operations.

Who you are:

• You hold a college or University degree in finance, informatics, business administration or economics subject is desirable

• 1-3 years of related experience in T&E System Support

• Communicate effectively both verbally and written in English and Mandarin (to support China counterpart). Additional language skills is a plus.

• Demonstrate strong customer service skills including timeliness, and follow-ups

• Collaborative and team-oriented; you have the ability to work with cross functional team with different cultures

• Familiar with ticketing tools - ServiceNow, good numerical and analytical skills with a strong attention to details

• React to problems fast and easy and in an appropriate manner and behavior

• Ability to work in a fast paced environment

• Experience and knowledge of expense reporting software, preferably Concur and in Shared Service or Customer Service Centre in a support function is a plus

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
L'Employee Experience Operations Travel & Expense Specialist nell'ambito del dipartimento Global Customer Experience (GCX) manterrà e sosterrà le attività quotidiane del Travel and Entertainment associate a Roche. Questo ruolo è previsto per offrire un alto livello di servizio al cliente in quanto questo è il primo punto di contatto per i nostri clienti interni.

In qualità di membro del team di Roche Services Solutions - Global Customer Experience Department sarai responsabile della fornitura di assistenza clienti agli affiliati Roche nelle relazioni con l'applicazione Travel & Expense (SAP Concur). Seguirete le istruzioni nel modo tempestivo della sezione Cluster Lead e i contatti chiave per quanto riguarda il coordinamento quotidiano del lavoro. Contribuirai continuamente al miglioramento delle prestazioni di Roche Services Solutions.

L'opportunità:

• Fornire il supporto clienti eccezionale – Servire come primo punto di contatto per le richieste di viaggio e spesa (SAP Concur) via telefono, chat dal vivo e ServiceNow, fornendo il supporto tempestivo, preciso e orientato al cliente.

• Gestire le operazioni di viaggio e di spesa – Eseguire l'amministrazione quotidiana del sistema SAP Concur, risolvere i problemi dell'utente, le richieste di accesso ai processi e garantire la consegna dei servizi soddisfa le SLA e i KPI consolidati.

• Risoluzione dei problemi di trasmissione e miglioramento continuo – Indagare e risolvere problemi di sistema di primo livello, mantenere la documentazione accurata, monitorare le prestazioni del sistema e identificare le opportunità per migliorare i processi e l'esperienza degli utenti.

• Collaborate Across Global Teams – Collaborate a stretto contatto con team interfunzionali, tra cui T&E Compliance e Concur Technical Support, per garantire una risoluzione efficiente dei problemi e una consegna senza soluzione di continuità dei servizi.

• Support Business Excellence – Offrire formazione agli utenti finali, preparare report operativi, contribuire alla gestione della conoscenza e partecipare attivamente a nuove iniziative per migliorare i servizi e le operazioni di Travel & Expense.

Chi sei:

• Hai una laurea in finanza, informatica, amministrazione aziendale o soggetto economico è auspicabile

• 1-3 anni di esperienza in T&E System Support

• Comunicare efficacemente sia verbalmente che scritto in inglese e mandarino (per sostenere la controparte cinese). Ulteriori competenze linguistiche è un plus.

• Dimostrare forti competenze di servizio al cliente tra cui tempestività, e follow-up

• Collaborativo e orientato al team; si ha la capacità di lavorare con team cross funzionale con culture diverse

• Familiare con strumenti di biglietteria - ServiceNow, buone capacità numeriche e analitiche con una forte attenzione ai dettagli

• Reagire a problemi veloci e facili e in modo appropriato e comportamento

• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente veloce

• Esperienza e conoscenza del software di reporting delle spese, preferibilmente Concur e in Servizio condiviso o Centro assistenza clienti in una funzione di supporto è un plus

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datore di lavoro di parità di opportunità.

• Erfahrung und Kenntnis der Spesenabrechnungssoftware, vorzugsweise Concur und in Shared Service oder Customer Service Center in einer Supportfunktion ist ein Plus

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zu Innovationen an. jobs.title: Sr Product Manager_ Immu
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a strategic and experienced Senior Product Manager to play a key leadership role in shaping the launch strategy and commercial lifecycle of Gazyva® (Obinutuzumab). You will lead core brand workstreams, define target market segmentation, drive multi-channel engagement strategies, and partner with cross-functional leadership to navigate market access and clinical positioning. This role offers high visibility and the opportunity to establish Gazyva® as a foundational therapy in renal care.
Key Responsibilities

• Brand Strategy & Positioning: Co-lead the development of the annual brand strategy, key messaging, and positioning for Gazyva® in nephrology indications.

• KOL & Ecosystem Management: Engage top-tier Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and national nephrology societies to build strategic partnerships and drive scientific advocacy.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Medical Affairs, Market Access, and Regulatory teams to ensure commercial plans are aligned with clinical data and market access timelines.

• Market Intelligence & ROI: Conduct deep-dive market analyses, patient pathway mapping, and competitive tracking to optimize resource allocation and commercial ROI.
Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Pharmacy, Medicine, Life Sciences, or Marketing (MBA or Advanced Science degree preferred).

• 5+ years of pharmaceutical brand management experience, including successful product launch management.

• Demonstrated track record in Nephrology , Immunology , or specialty biologics.

• Outstanding strategic thinking, cross-functional leadership, and stakeholder management skills.

• Native fluency in Mandarin and excellent written and spoken English.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Engineer (Software/Data), AI-Native Data & Applications
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Engineer (Software/Data), AI-Native Data & Applications

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to helping shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

This role is based in the Dia R&D Portfolio & Project Management (PPM) division, which is dedicated to enabling data-driven decisions for life-saving diagnostic solutions. You will join us on the journey to transform enterprise IT in the era of AI, building AI-native solutions, from the digital data products that power PPM decision-making to the custom applications becoming a core part of our tech stack. Operating within a modern Data Mesh framework, you will act as a core data product expert, designing, building, and owning digital data products in Snowflake and AWS. Your engineering work will directly enable Roche to prioritize clinical innovations and bring them to market faster, transforming patient care.

The Opportunity:

• AI-Native Software Development: Use AI-assisted development as the default way you build, across data pipelines, transformations, and applications alike, helping define what modern, AI-native engineering looks like inside a large enterprise.

• Build & Architect Modern Data Products: Design, develop, and support scalable data products within Snowflake deployed on AWS, leveraging DBT for sophisticated transformation workflows and managing/deploying Data Vault architectures.

• Custom, AI-Native Applications: Build and grow a custom application platform that extends what's possible beyond our enterprise systems and is becoming a core part of our tech stack, directly shaping how PPM delivers new solutions to the business.

• Release Management & Automation: Design and monitor automated releases of new data product versions, including managing change request processes and maintaining comprehensive release documentation.

• Ensure Data Quality, Observability & Security: Guarantee data product health through Monte Carlo-based observability (SLOs, SLIs), automated QA testing, and implement strict data governance/access policies using Collibra and IMMUTA.

• Strategic Partnering & Business Integration: Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Data Architects, and Solution Architects to co-create tailored data solutions while acting as the domain expert in extracting and maintaining data from vital systems like Planisware (ORION), Risk Management (ROMA), and Portfolio Management (DP360).

• Community Leadership & Best Practices: Work actively within the Data Engineering community to establish engineering standards and share knowledge across data product, platform, and infrastructure teams.

Who You Are:

• Curiosity for AI-A

Operando all'interno di un moderno framework Data Mesh sotto la guida di Jason Hankins, si agirà come un core data product expert per progettare, costruire e propri prodotti di dati digitali in Snowflake e AWS. • Advanced Engineering Stack (préféré): Expérience pratique avec Python, Collibra (catalogage des données), Monte Carlo (observation des données) et IMMUTA (sécurité des données)

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Our Building and Facility Engineering department is responsible for the delivery of capital projects and engineering services that support our global manufacturing network, including CMOs and affiliates. We provide discipline-focused technical leadership and accountability across single and multidisciplinary projects, ensuring that our infrastructure meets the highest standards of safety, reliability, and efficiency within the European regulatory framework.

The Opportunity

• Lead the engineering and specification of medium-voltage and low-voltage power distribution systems in accordance with IEC/EN standards and local European regulations.

• Take full ownership of critical infrastructure such as MCCs, main distribution boards, UPS systems, and emergency standby generators (DIN/VDE compliance where applicable).

• Perform technical load calculations, short-circuit studies, and selectivity analyses to ensure high availability and redundancy for European grid connections.

• Direct the engineering and integration of ELV systems, including structured cabling, IT networks, and security systems such as access control and CCTV.

• Ensure system interoperability and cybersecurity alignment for all low-voltage and communication systems according to European data protection and safety norms.

• Act as the technical lead for fire detection and alarm systems, ensuring full compliance with EN 54 standards and local fire protection directives.

• Manage the technical integration between fire alarm systems and fire suppression/sprinkler systems according to VdS or equivalent European guidelines.

• Serve as the primary technical interface to local authorities (AHJ), notified bodies, and insurance auditors for all electrical and life safety approvals.

• Oversee external engineering firms and contractors throughout the design, construction, and commissioning phases (SAT/FAT) to ensure quality-compliant execution.

Who you are
You are a highly independent and proactive leader with a strong sense of accountability and ownership. You possess exceptional communication skills, allowing you to align complex technical requirements with various stakeholders, and you thrive in operationally demanding environments where analytical problem-solving is key. Your leadership style is characterized by the ability to give clear guidance to multidisciplinary teams while maintaining a focus on quality and reliability.
Further you possess the following qualifications and experience:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering with 5 or more years of experience in industrial or pharmaceutical environments.

• Proficient in English and German

• Deep technical expertise in European medium/low voltage power systems and EN-standard fire alarm engineering.

• Solid understanding of European electrical and safety codes (IEC 60364 series, EN 54, and local transposition such as VDE or NF).

• Proven track record in managing complex sub-projects, including risk management and stakeholder engagement in an international context.

• Professional engineering registration or equivalent European certification (e.g., Eur Ing) and ideally PMP certification.

This role involves 50% or more business travel.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Il nostro dipartimento di Building and Facility Engineering è responsabile della fornitura di progetti di capitale e servizi di ingegneria che supportano la nostra rete di produzione globale, tra cui CMO e affiliati. Forniamo leadership e responsabilità tecniche focalizzate sulla disciplina in progetti singoli e multidisciplinari, garantendo che la nostra infrastruttura soddisfi i più elevati standard di sicurezza, affidabilità ed efficienza nel quadro normativo europeo.

L'opportunità

• Guidare l'ingegneria e le specifiche dei sistemi di distribuzione di energia a media tensione e a bassa tensione in conformità alle norme IEC/EN e alle normative europee locali.

• Assumere la piena proprietà di infrastrutture critiche come MCC, schede di distribuzione principali, sistemi UPS e generatori di standby di emergenza (conformità DIN/VDE, se applicabile).

• Eseguire calcoli di carico tecnico, studi di cortocircuito e analisi di selettività per garantire elevata disponibilità e ridondanza per connessioni a griglia europee.

• Dirigere l'ingegneria e l'integrazione dei sistemi ELV, inclusi i cablaggi strutturati, le reti IT e i sistemi di sicurezza come il controllo degli accessi e la TVCC.

• Assicurare l'interoperabilità del sistema e l'allineamento della sicurezza informatica per tutti i sistemi di bassa tensione e comunicazione secondo le norme europee sulla protezione dei dati e sulla sicurezza.

• Agire come il piombo tecnico per il rilevamento del fuoco e sistemi di allarme, assicurando il pieno rispetto delle norme EN 54 e le direttive di protezione antincendio locali.

• Gestire l'integrazione tecnica tra sistemi antincendio e sistemi antincendio/sprinkler secondo VdS o linee guida europee equivalenti.

• Servire come interfaccia tecnica primaria alle autorità locali (AHJ), agli organismi notificati e ai revisori assicurativi per tutte le approvazioni di sicurezza elettrica e di vita.

• Superare le aziende di ingegneria e gli appaltatori esterni durante le fasi di progettazione, costruzione e messa in servizio (SAT/FAT) per garantire l'esecuzione conforme alla qualità.

Chi sei
Sei un leader altamente indipendente e proattivo con un forte senso di responsabilità e di proprietà. Possiedi eccezionali capacità di comunicazione, permettendoti di allineare i complessi requisiti tecnici con vari stakeholder, e prosperi in ambienti operativamente esigenti dove la risoluzione dei problemi analitici è fondamentale. Il tuo stile di leadership è caratterizzato dalla capacità di dare una guida chiara ai team multidisciplinari mantenendo al contempo un focus sulla qualità e l'affidabilità.
Inoltre possiedi le seguenti qualifiche ed esperienza:

• Laurea o Master in Ingegneria Elettrica con 7 o più anni di esperienza in ambienti industriali o farmaceutici.

• Profonda competenza tecnica nei sistemi europei di potenza a media/bassa tensione e ingegneria antincendio EN-standard.

• Comprensione solida dei codici elettrici e di sicurezza europei (serie IEC 60364, EN 54 e transposition locale come VDE o NF).

• Provato record di traccia nella gestione di sottoprogetti complessi, tra cui la gestione del rischio e l'impegno degli stakeholder in un contesto internazionale.

• Registrazione di ingegneria professionale o certificazione europea equivalente (ad esempio, Eur Ing) e la certificazione PMP idealmente.

• Volontà per un viaggio significativo del 50% o più.

Sei pronto a fare la differenza per i nostri pazienti? Non vediamo l'ora della tua applicazione – unisciti a noi ora e diventi parte del nostro viaggio!

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso a Healthca

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Country Analytics and Portfolio Optimization Lead

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

We offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

The position is a fixed-term contract until October 31, 2027.

The Opportunity

At Roche Pharma Product Development Global Clinical Operations (PDG), we are determined to transform drug development and realize our Pharma Ambition to deliver 20 transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden by 2029.

As a Country Analytics and Portfolio Optimization Lead, you will play a critical role in ensuring that operational analytics are effectively utilized and implemented to support business objectives and decision making. You will implement APO solutions, ensure data-driven decisions, and monitor portfolio performance for proactive mitigation. Operating at a project-specific or departmental level, you will tackle complex business problems and deliver quality outputs that drive short-term outcomes and improvements.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead with Analytics: You will translate business requirements into technological solutions. You will proactively identify complex business problems that may benefit from analytical applications.

• Drive Performance: You will continuously monitor and optimize the performance and efficiency of portfolio delivery. You will assess portfolio performance and develop meaningful operational KPIs based on internal and external data.

• Foster Data Literacy: You will serve as the primary contact for portfolio analytics questions. You will foster data literacy by helping teams understand and confidently use data, building a culture of trust through improved data transparency.

• Collaborate and Partner: You will build effective partnerships and collaborations within and outside of the home function. You will lead or co-lead cross-functional teams that deliver analytical solutions designed to address a specific business problem.

• Champion Patient-Centricity: You will drive patient-centricity throughout clinical operations by always putting the needs of the patient and the investigator first.

Who You Are

• Education & Experience: You hold a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Life Sciences, Education, Business). You possess 7+ years of work experience with a Bachelor's, 5+ years with a Master's, or 3+ years with a PhD/JD.

• Clinical Operations Expertise: You have an in-depth understanding of clinical operations and the drug development process. You possess knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

• Data & Technology Proficiency: You have a solid grasp of Roche's data architecture, including databases and analytics platforms. You apply standard statistical and data analysis techniques to process data and derive insights. You show a willingness to adapt to new tools, techniques, and methodologies, and are highly proficient in leveraging modern technology—including AI agents—to drive data analysis and operational efficiency.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche potete presentarvi come voi stessi, abbracciati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Leader di analisi e ottimizzazione del portafoglio

Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche.

Offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido che combina flessibilità con la collaborazione in-persona. Per ora, abbiamo bisogno che i nostri dipendenti siano nei nostri uffici in media due giorni alla settimana. I giorni specifici dell'ufficio possono variare a seconda delle esigenze aziendali, come workshop, conferenze, sale comunali, riunioni di team e altri eventi collaborativi.

La posizione è un contratto a tempo determinato fino al 31 ottobre 2027.

L'opportunità

A Roche Pharma Product Development Global Clinical Operations (PDG), siamo determinati a trasformare lo sviluppo della droga e realizzare il nostro Pharma Ambition per fornire 20 farmaci trasformativi che affrontano le malattie con il più alto peso sociale entro il 2029.

In qualità di leader di analisi e ottimizzazione del portafoglio di paese, si svolgerÃ un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire che le analisi operative siano effettivamente utilizzate e implementate per supportare gli obiettivi aziendali e il processo decisionale. Realizzerai soluzioni APO, garantirai decisioni basate sui dati e monitorerai le prestazioni del portafoglio per la mitigazione proattiva. Operando a livello di progetto-specifico o dipartimentale, affronterete problemi di business complessi e fornire risultati di qualità che guidano risultati a breve termine e miglioramenti.

Principali responsabilità

• Guidare con Analytics: Tradurrete i requisiti aziendali in soluzioni tecnologiche. Si identificherà proattivamente problemi di business complessi che possono beneficiare di applicazioni analitiche.

• Prestazioni di trasmissione: monitorerai continuamente e ottimizza le prestazioni e l'efficienza della consegna del portafoglio. Valuterai le prestazioni del portafoglio e svilupperai KPI operativi significativi basati su dati interni ed esterni.

• Foster Data Literacy: Lei sarà il contatto principale per le domande di analisi del portafoglio. Abiliterà l'alfabetizzazione dei dati aiutando i team a comprendere e utilizzare con fiducia i dati, costruendo una cultura della fiducia attraverso una migliore trasparenza dei dati.

• Collaborate e Partner: Costruirete partnership e collaborazioni efficaci all'interno e all'esterno della funzione domestica. Condurrai o co-lead team cross-functional che offrono soluzioni analitiche progettate per affrontare un problema di business specifico.

• Campione Paziente-Centricità: Lei guiderà il paziente-centricità durante le operazioni cliniche mettendo sempre le esigenze del paziente e dell'investigatore prima.

Chi sei

• Istruzione e Esperienza: Lei ha una laurea in un campo rilevante (ad esempio, Scienze della Vita, Istruzione, Business). Possiedi 7+ anni di esperienza lavorativa con una laurea, 5+ anni con un Master, o 3+ anni con un dottorato / JD.

• Esperienza delle operazioni cliniche: Hai una comprensione approfondita delle operazioni cliniche e del processo di sviluppo della droga. Possiedi la conoscenza dei requisiti normativi e delle best practice del settore.

• Data & Technology Proficiency: Hai una solida conoscenza dell'architettura dei dati di Roche, inclusi database e piattaforme di analisi. Si applicano tecniche di analisi statistica e dati standard per elaborare i dati e ricavare informazioni. Si mostra la volontà di adattarsi a nuovi strumenti, tecniche e metodologie, e sono altamente competenti nel sfruttare la tecnologia moderna, inclusi gli agenti dell'AI, per guidare l'analisi dei dati e l'efficienza operativa.

Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

Lead für Country Analytics und Portfoliooptimierung

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Wir bieten ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das Flexibilität mit persönlicher Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Im Moment verlangen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter durchschnittlich zwei Tage pro Woche in unseren Büros sind. Die spezifischen Bürotage können je nach Geschäftsanforderungen variieren, z. B. Workshops, Konferenzen, Rathäuser, Teamsitzungen und andere gemeinsame Veranstaltungen.

Die Position ist ein befristeter Vertrag bis zum 31. Oktober 2027.

Die Chance

Bei Roche Pharma Product Development Global Clinical Operations (PDG) sind wir entschlossen, die Arzneimittelentwicklung zu verändern und unsere Pharma Ambition zu verwirklichen, um bis 2029 20 transformative Medikamente gegen Krankheiten mit der höchsten gesellschaftlichen Belastung zu liefern.

Als Lead für Länderanalytik und Portfoliooptimierung spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Sicherstellung, dass operative Analysen effektiv genutzt und implementiert werden, um Geschäftsziele und Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen. Sie implementieren APO-Lösungen, stellen datengesteuerte Entscheidungen sicher und überwachen die Portfolioleistung für eine proaktive Minderung. Auf projektspezifischer oder Abteilungsebene werden Sie komplexe Geschäftsprobleme angehen und Qualitätsergebnisse liefern, die kurzfristige Ergebnisse und Verbesserungen erzielen.

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

• Lead mit Analytics: Sie werden Geschäftsanforderungen in technologische Lösungen übersetzen. Sie identifizieren proaktiv komplexe Geschäftsprobleme, die von analytischen Anwendungen profitieren können.

• Drive Performance: Sie überwachen und optimieren kontinuierlich die Performance und Effizienz der Portfoliobereitstellung. Sie bewerten die Portfolio-Performance und entwickeln aussagekräftige operative KPIs basierend auf internen und externen Daten.

• Foster Data Literacy: Sie werden als primärer Ansprechpartner für Portfolioanalyse-Fragen dienen. Sie fördern die Datenkompetenz, indem Sie Teams dabei helfen, Daten zu verstehen und sicher zu nutzen, und bauen eine Kultur des Vertrauens durch verbesserte Datentransparenz auf.

• Zusammenarbeit und Partner: Sie werden effektive Partnerschaften und Kooperationen innerhalb und außerhalb der Heimfunktion aufbauen. Sie leiten oder leiten funktionsübergreifende Teams, die analytische Lösungen für ein bestimmtes Geschäftsproblem liefern.

• Champion Patient-Centricity: Sie werden die Patientenorientierung während der gesamten klinischen Operationen vorantreiben, indem Sie immer die Bedürfnisse des Patienten und des Prüfers an die erste Stelle setzen.

Wer du bist

• Bildung & Erfahrung: Sie haben einen Bachelor-Abschluss in einem relevanten Bereich (z. B. Life Sciences, Education, Business). Sie haben 7+ Jahre Berufserfahrung mit einem Bachelor, 5+ Jahre mit einem Master oder 3+ Jahre mit einem PhD / JD.

• Clinical Operations Expertise: Sie haben ein tiefes Verständnis der klinischen Operationen und der Arzneimittelentwicklung. Sie verfügen über Kenntnisse der regulatorischen Anforderungen und Best Practices der Branche.

• Data & Technology Proficiency: Sie haben ein solides Verständnis der Datenarchitektur von Roche, einschließlich Datenbanken und Analyseplattformen. Sie wenden standardisierte statistische und Datenanalysetechniken an, um Daten zu verarbeiten und Erkenntnisse abzuleiten. Sie zeigen die Bereitschaft, sich an neue Tools, Techniken und Methoden anzupassen, und sind sehr gut in der Nutzung moderner Technologien - einschließlich KI-Agenten -, um Datenanalyse und operative Effizienz zu fördern.
