jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Location: Western Canada

A Healthier Future, It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

We are Medical Science Partners. In Canada, we are at the forefront of transforming clinical practice. We serve as the vital bridge between Roche and the Canadian medical community, bringing the "outside-in" perspective to everything we do. By ensuring our science is effectively communicated and deeply understood by decision makers across the country, we act as a trusted partner in improving patient outcomes from coast to coast.

The Vision

Roche is embarking on a bold journey to transform care in obesity and cardio-metabolic disorders. As we expand our scientific focus into these interconnected therapeutic areas, we are building a dedicated medical team to lay the groundwork for our emerging clinical portfolio.

Addressing metabolic health requires navigating complex, evolving care pathways across both traditional clinical care and emerging patient-driven healthcare models. To support this expanding pipeline, we are seeking Medical Science Partners (MSP), dedicated to early scientific exchange and ecosystem readiness. This team will impact care paradigms, build foundational partnerships with key healthcare leaders, and ensure the Canadian healthcare system is prepared for the next generation of metabolic innovations.This is a rare opportunity to build our Roche presence, in the critical pre-launch window where the groundwork you lay determines the difference we make.

The Opportunity:

As an MSP in Cardio-Metabolic, you will operate as an agile, collaborative, entrepreneurial medical professional with high functional mastery and creative thinking. Rather than executing a standard playbook, you will use ambiguity as a strategic advantage, uncovering novel landscape realities, uncovering emerging clinical trends, translating medical insights into care transformation, and fostering healthcare system readiness to improve long-term patient outcomes. Every conversation you have, every insight you surface, and every piece of evidence you translate helps Roche deliver better outcomes to more patients, faster and helps healthcare providers prepare to change lives at scale.

Specifically you will:

• Develop and apply scientific expertise to advance clinical practice across a multi-specialty landscape

• Understand, establish and maintain network connections to maximize potential and prioritize patient impact

• Display high business acumen by translating healthcare ecosystem insights into disciplined territory plans. Make clear trade-offs, prioritize high impact initiatives, and establish long term clinical readiness.

• Rapidly onboard across our expanding Metabolism, Obesity, MASH, and Cardiovascular portfolio to deliver sophisticated scientific exchange

• Collaborate with external stakeholders to co-create solutions for improved patient care

• Fosters a culture of trust, empowerment, and shared leadership through peer-to-peer coaching and mentorship

• Continuously learn and grow through transparent and productive feedback while delivering on executional excellence and upholding compliance, ethics, and safety standards and grow in a self-directed way by giving and receiving transparent & productive feedback

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione

Posizione: Western Canada

Un futuro più sano, è ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Ecco cosa ci rende Roche.

Siamo soci di scienze mediche. In Canada, siamo in prima linea nella trasformazione della pratica clinica. Serviamo come ponte vitale tra Roche e la comunità medica canadese, portando la prospettiva "outside-in" a tutto ciò che facciamo. Assicurando che la nostra scienza sia effettivamente comunicata e profondamente compresa dai decisori di tutto il paese, agiamo come partner affidabile per migliorare i risultati dei pazienti dalla costa alla costa.

La visione

Roche sta intraprendendo un viaggio audace per trasformare la cura in obesità e disturbi cardio-metabolici. Mentre espandiamo la nostra attenzione scientifica in queste aree terapeutiche interconnesse, stiamo costruendo un team medico dedicato per porre le basi per il nostro portafoglio clinico emergente.

Affrontare la salute metabolica richiede la navigazione di percorsi di cura complessi e in evoluzione attraverso sia la cura clinica tradizionale e modelli di assistenza medica emergenti. Per sostenere questa pipeline in espansione, siamo alla ricerca di Medical Science Partners (MSP), dedicato al primo scambio scientifico e alla disponibilità di ecosistemi. Questo team influenzerà i paradigmi della cura, costruirà partnership di base con i leader sanitari chiave, e garantire che il sistema sanitario canadese è preparato per la prossima generazione di innovazioni metaboliche. Questa è una rara opportunità per costruire la nostra presenza Roche, nella finestra critica pre-lancio in cui le basi che lavate determinano la differenza che facciamo.

L'opportunità:

Come MSP in Cardio-Metabolic, si opererà come un professionista medico agile, collaborativo e imprenditoriale con elevata padronanza funzionale e pensiero creativo. Invece di eseguire un playbook standard, si utilizzerà l'ambiguità come vantaggio strategico, scoprire nuove realtà paesaggistiche, scoprire le tendenze cliniche emergenti, tradurre intuizioni mediche nella trasformazione della cura, e promuovere la prontezza del sistema sanitario per migliorare i risultati del paziente a lungo termine. Ogni conversazione che hai, ogni intuizione di superficie e ogni prova che traduci aiuta Roche a fornire risultati migliori a più pazienti, più veloce e aiuta i fornitori di assistenza sanitaria a preparare a cambiare la vita in scala.

In particolare:

• Sviluppare e applicare competenze scientifiche per promuovere la pratica clinica in un paesaggio multi-specialistico

• Comprendere, stabilire e mantenere le connessioni di rete per massimizzare il potenziale e privilegiare l'impatto del paziente

• Mostrare acume ad alto business traducendo intuizioni ecosistema sanitario nei piani del territorio disciplinato. Sgomberare i trade-off, priorità iniziative ad alto impatto, e stabilire la prontezza clinica a lungo termine.

• Rapidamente a bordo attraverso il nostro crescente Metabolismo, Obesità, MASH e Cardiovascolare portafoglio per fornire sofisticato scambio scientifico

• Collaborare con gli stakeholder esterni per creare soluzioni per migliorare la cura dei pazienti

• Favorisce una cultura della fiducia, dell'empowerment e della leadership condivisa attraverso il coaching peer-to-peer e la mentorship

• Impara e cresci continuamente attraverso un feedback trasparente e produttivo, offrendo al contempo un'eccellenza esecutiva e rispettando la conformità, l'etica e gli standard di sicurezza e crescendo in modo autodiretto dando e ricevendo feedback trasparenti e produttivi

Chi sei:

Sei un esperto campo medico p

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für kommende Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position

Standort: Westkanada

Eine gesündere Zukunft, das ist es, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Wir sind Medical Science Partner. In Kanada sind wir an der Spitze der Transformation der klinischen Praxis. Wir dienen als wichtige Brücke zwischen Roche und der kanadischen medizinischen Gemeinschaft und bringen die "Outside-In" -Perspektive zu allem, was wir tun. Indem wir sicherstellen, dass unsere Wissenschaft von Entscheidungsträgern im ganzen Land effektiv kommuniziert und verstanden wird, agieren wir als vertrauenswürdiger Partner bei der Verbesserung der Patientenergebnisse von Küste zu Küste.

Die Vision

Roche begibt sich auf eine mutige Reise, um die Pflege bei Fettleibigkeit und kardio-metabolen Störungen zu verändern. Während wir unseren wissenschaftlichen Fokus auf diese miteinander verbundenen therapeutischen Bereiche ausweiten, bauen wir ein engagiertes medizinisches Team auf, um die Grundlagen für unser aufstrebendes klinisches Portfolio zu legen.

Die Bewältigung der metabolischen Gesundheit erfordert die Navigation komplexer, sich entwickelnder Versorgungswege sowohl in der traditionellen klinischen Versorgung als auch in neuen patientenorientierten Gesundheitsmodellen. Um diese expandierende Pipeline zu unterstützen, suchen wir Medical Science Partners (MSP), die sich dem frühen wissenschaftlichen Austausch und der Bereitschaft für Ökosysteme widmen. Dieses Team wird die Paradigmen der Pflege beeinflussen, grundlegende Partnerschaften mit führenden Gesundheitsexperten aufbauen und sicherstellen, dass das kanadische Gesundheitssystem auf die nächste Generation metabolischer Innovationen vorbereitet ist. Dies ist eine seltene Gelegenheit, unsere Roche-Präsenz im kritischen Pre-Launch-Fenster aufzubauen, in dem die Grundlagen, die Sie legen, den Unterschied bestimmen, den wir machen.

Die Gelegenheit:

Als MSP in Cardio-Metabolic arbeiten Sie als agiler, kollaborativer, unternehmerischer Mediziner mit hoher funktionaler Beherrschung und kreativem Denken. Anstatt ein Standard-Spielbuch auszuführen, werden Sie Mehrdeutigkeit als strategischen Vorteil nutzen, neue Landschaftsrealitäten aufdecken, aufkommende klinische Trends aufdecken, medizinische Erkenntnisse in die Pflegetransformation übersetzen und die Bereitschaft des Gesundheitssystems fördern, um langfristige Patientenergebnisse zu verbessern. Jedes Gespräch, das Sie führen, jede Einsicht, die Sie aufdecken, und jedes Beweisstück, das Sie übersetzen, hilft Roche, bessere Ergebnisse für mehr Patienten zu liefern, schneller und hilft Gesundheitsdienstleistern, sich darauf vorzubereiten, das Leben in großem Maßstab zu verändern.

Konkret werden Sie:

• Entwicklung und Anwendung wissenschaftlicher Expertise zur Förderung der klinischen Praxis in einer Multi-Speziallandschaft

• Verstehen, Aufbauen und Pflegen von Netzwerkverbindungen, um das Potenzial zu maximieren und die Auswirkungen des Patienten zu priorisieren

• Zeigen Sie einen hohen Geschäftssinn, indem Sie Erkenntnisse aus dem Gesundheitswesen in disziplinierte Gebietspläne übersetzen. Machen Sie klare Kompromisse, priorisieren Sie Initiativen mit hoher Wirkung und etablieren Sie langfristige klinische Bereitschaft.

• Schnell an Bord unseres expandierenden Metabolismus-, Adipositas-, MASH- und Herz-Kreislauf-Portfolios, um einen ausgeklügelten wissenschaftlichen Austausch zu ermöglichen

• Zusammenarbeit mit externen Stakeholdern, um gemeinsam Lösungen für eine verbesserte Patientenversorgung zu entwickeln

• Fördert eine Kultur des Vertrauens, der Stärkung und der gemeinsamen Führung durch Peer-to-Peer-Coaching und Mentoring

• Lernen und wachsen Sie kontinuierlich durch transparentes und produktives Feedback, während Sie exekutive Exzellenz liefern und Compliance-, Ethik- und Sicherheitsstandards einhalten, und wachsen Sie selbstgesteuert durch transparentes und produktives Feedback

Wer du bist:

Sie sind ein erfahrenes Feld medizinischen p
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position

Lieu : Ouest canadien

Un avenir plus sain, c'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

Nous sommes partenaires en sciences médicales. Au Canada, nous sommes à l'avant-garde de la transformation de la pratique clinique. Nous sommes le pont vital entre Roche et la communauté médicale canadienne, ce qui nous permet d'avoir une perspective « extérieure » à tout ce que nous faisons. En s'assurant que notre science est efficacement communiquée et bien comprise par les décideurs partout au pays, nous agissons comme un partenaire de confiance pour améliorer les résultats des patients d'un océan à l'autre.

La vision

Roche entreprend un voyage audacieux pour transformer les soins dans l'obésité et les troubles cardio-métaboliques. À mesure que nous étendons notre attention scientifique à ces domaines thérapeutiques interconnectés, nous construisons une équipe médicale dédiée pour jeter les bases de notre portefeuille clinique émergent.

Pour s'attaquer à la santé métabolique, il faut naviguer sur des voies de soins complexes et évolutives à la fois dans les soins cliniques traditionnels et dans les nouveaux modèles de soins axés sur le patient. Pour soutenir ce pipeline en expansion, nous recherchons des partenaires en sciences médicales (MSP) dédiés aux premiers échanges scientifiques et à la préparation des écosystèmes. Cette équipe aura un impact sur les paradigmes de soins, établira des partenariats fondamentaux avec les principaux leaders en matière de soins de santé et veillera à ce que le système de soins de santé canadien soit préparé pour la prochaine génération d'innovations métaboliques. C'est une occasion rare de construire notre présence Roche, dans la fenêtre critique de pré-lancement où les bases que vous posez déterminent la différence que nous faisons.

La possibilité :

En tant que MSP en cardio-métabolique, vous fonctionnerez comme un professionnel de la médecine agile, collaborative et entrepreneuriale avec une maîtrise fonctionnelle élevée et une pensée créative. Plutôt que d'exécuter un manuel de lecture standard, vous utiliserez l'ambiguïté comme avantage stratégique, en découvrant de nouvelles réalités du paysage, en découvrant les nouvelles tendances cliniques, en transformant les connaissances médicales en transformation des soins et en encourageant le système de santé à être prêt à améliorer les résultats à long terme des patients. Chaque conversation que vous avez, chaque perspicacité que vous ressentez et chaque preuve que vous traduisez aide Roche à obtenir de meilleurs résultats pour plus de patients, plus rapidement et aide les fournisseurs de soins de santé à se préparer à changer les vies à l'échelle.

Plus précisément, vous devrez :

• Développer et appliquer l'expertise scientifique pour faire progresser la pratique clinique dans un paysage multispécialisé

• Comprendre, établir et maintenir des connexions réseau pour maximiser le potentiel et prioriser l'impact des patients

• Display high business acumen en transformant les connaissances écosystémiques en plans de territoire disciplinés. Faire des compromis clairs, prioriser les initiatives à impact élevé et établir une préparation clinique à long terme.

• Rapidement à bord de notre portefeuille élargi de Métabolisme, d'obésité, de MASH et de cardiologie pour offrir des échanges scientifiques sophistiqués

• Collaborer avec des intervenants externes pour créer des solutions pour améliorer les soins aux patients

• Favoriser une culture de confiance, d'autonomisation et de leadership partagé grâce à l'encadrement et au mentorat entre pairs

• Apprendre et se développer continuellement grâce à une rétroaction transparente et productive tout en assurant l'excellence de l'exécution et en respectant les normes de conformité, d'éthique et de sécurité et en se développant de façon autonome en donnant et en recevant une rétroaction transparente et productive

Qui vous êtes :

Vous êtes un médecin de terrain expérimenté p

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Head of Indirect Procurement Operations
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche.

Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next.

The Opportunity

This role sits within the Indirect Procurement Delivery Chapter, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution.

The Indirect Procurement Delivery Chapter comprises many groupings of categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including R&D, Corporate & Commercial Services, Digital & Technology, Facilities & Utilities.

These communities are key enablers of strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers.

As the Head of Indirect Procurement Operations, you report to the Chapter Lead of Indirect Procurement Delivery and serve as a key member of the leadership team. You will provide vision and guidance to the Delivery Operational procurement capability area while driving operational excellence (across People, Process and Technology) and harmonization across all categories.

Core Responsibilities

As the Head of Indirect Procurement Operations, you provide the vision and structural leadership for the delivery of indirect services globally. You lead multiple teams of Procurement Experts and Managers, ensuring that the bridge between global strategy and execution is seamless.
According to your experience, knowledge, and the general business/team requirements, your role encompasses, but is not limited to, these core responsibilities:

Strategic Operations & Visionary Leadership

• Indirect Operations Strategy: Act as a thought leader on operational delivery and best practices, shaping the capability area’s vision and our long-term roadmap for Indirect Procurement Operations in alignment with the broader Global Procurement vision.

• Service Delivery Model: Continuous refinement of the service delivery model to ensure it remains agile and responsive to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.

• Value Creation: Drive cost-reduction initiatives and value-improvement programs across the operational lifecycle, ensuring procurement activities contribute directly to Roche’s financial and patient-outcome goals.

• Design and drive Cross- Category operations approach across Indirect and MMC chapters

• Design and drive Cross- Category Delivery Support across Indirect and MMC chapters

• Global Leadership from India Hub: Based in India, provide direct leadership and team management for a truly global, geographically distributed procurement operations team across multiple locations (most sub-team leads in this person’s team are also not based in India).

Operational Excellence

• Performance Accountabilit

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Leiterin der indirekten Beschaffung
Roche India – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns antreibt, innovativ zu sein. Die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzubringen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die er heute und für kommende Generationen benötigt. Eine Welt schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben.

Das macht uns zu Roche.

Das Gesundheitswesen entwickelt sich weiter, und Global Procurement reagiert darauf, indem es kontinuierlich nach höchstmöglicher Leistung strebt und innovative und strategische Ansätze für Geschäfts- und Lieferantenpartnerschaften verfolgt. Global Procurement verwaltet proaktiv das gesamte Lieferanten-Ökosystem und leistet einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Verbesserung der Gesundheitsergebnisse, zur Senkung der Kosten für Patienten und globale Gesundheitssysteme und stellt sicher, dass Roche weiterhin das tut, was Patienten als nächstes brauchen.

Die Chance

Diese Rolle liegt im Indirect Procurement Delivery Chapter, das die wichtigsten Beschaffungsaktivitäten von Category Management, strategischem und operativem Sourcing, Lieferantenmanagement, Contracting, Content Strategy Definition und Ausführung abdeckt.

Das Kapitel über die indirekte Beschaffung umfasst viele Gruppierungen von Kategorien derselben Wertschöpfungskette oder mit Gemeinsamkeiten, einschließlich F & E, Corporate & Commercial Services, Digital & Technology, Facilities & Utilities.

Diese Gemeinschaften sind wichtige Wegbereiter für eine starke Kategoriekompetenz und ermöglichen gleichzeitig Flexibilität bei der Bereitstellung von Aufträgen, um auf die sich ändernden Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden zu reagieren.

Als Head of Indirect Procurement Operations berichten Sie dem Chapter Lead of Indirect Procurement Delivery und sind ein wichtiges Mitglied des Führungsteams. Sie bieten eine Vision und Anleitung für den Bereich Delivery Operational Procurement Capacity und fördern gleichzeitig die operative Exzellenz (für Menschen, Prozesse und Technologien) und die Harmonisierung in allen Kategorien.

Kernaufgaben

Als Head of Indirect Procurement Operations bieten Sie die Vision und strukturelle Führung für die Bereitstellung indirekter Dienstleistungen weltweit. Sie leiten mehrere Teams von Beschaffungsexperten und -managern und stellen sicher, dass die Brücke zwischen globaler Strategie und Umsetzung nahtlos ist.

Strategische Operationen und visionäre Führung

• Indirekte Geschäftsstrategie: Handeln Sie als Vordenker in Bezug auf die operative Bereitstellung und Best Practices und gestalten Sie die Vision des Fähigkeitsbereichs und unsere langfristige Roadmap für indirekte Beschaffungsvorgänge in Übereinstimmung mit der umfassenderen globalen Beschaffungsvision.

• Servicebereitstellungsmodell: Kontinuierliche Verfeinerung des Servicebereitstellungsmodells, um sicherzustellen, dass es agil bleibt und auf die Bedürfnisse interner und externer Stakeholder eingeht.

• Wertschöpfung: Kostensenkungsinitiativen und Wertverbesserungsprogramme über den gesamten operativen Lebenszyklus hinweg vorantreiben, um sicherzustellen, dass die Beschaffungsaktivitäten direkt zu den Finanz- und Ergebniszielen von Roche beitragen.

• Konzipieren und Antreiben eines kategorieübergreifenden Operationsansatzes in indirekten und MMC-Kapiteln

• Konzipieren und treiben Sie die kategorieübergreifende Bereitstellungsunterstützung in indirekten und MMC-Kapiteln voran

• Global Leadership vom India Hub: Mit Sitz in Indien bieten Sie direkte Führung und Teammanagement für ein wirklich globales, geografisch verteiltes Beschaffungsteam an mehreren Standorten (die meisten Unterteamleiter im Team dieser Person sind auch nicht in Indien ansässig).

Operative Exzellenz

• Leistungsbilanzierbarkeit

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes appréciés, acceptés et respectés pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Chef des opérations d ' achat indirectes
Roche Inde – Roche Services & Solutions
Hyderabad

Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons.

C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche.

Les soins de santé évoluent, et Global Approvisionnement répond en s'efforçant constamment d'obtenir les meilleurs résultats possibles, en adoptant des approches novatrices et stratégiques pour les partenariats entre entreprises et fournisseurs. Global Approvisionnement gère de façon proactive l'ensemble de l'écosystème fournisseur, contribuant de façon essentielle à l'amélioration des résultats en matière de santé, réduisant les coûts pour les patients et les systèmes de santé mondiaux, et faisant en sorte que Roche continue de faire maintenant ce dont les patients ont besoin.

L'opportunité

Ce rôle fait partie du chapitre sur l'exécution des achats indirects, qui porte sur les principales activités d'approvisionnement liées à la gestion des catégories, à l'approvisionnement stratégique et opérationnel, à la gestion des fournisseurs, à la passation des marchés, à la définition de la stratégie de contenu et à l'exécution.

Le chapitre sur la prestation des approvisionnements indirects comprend de nombreux regroupements de catégories de la même chaîne de valeur ou ayant un caractère commun, y compris la R-D, les services corporatifs et commerciaux, le numérique et la technologie, les installations et les services publics.

Ces collectivités sont des catalyseurs clés d'une solide expertise de catégorie tout en permettant de répondre avec souplesse aux besoins changeants de nos clients.

À titre de chef des opérations d'approvisionnement indirect, vous faites rapport au chef de chapitre de la livraison d'approvisionnement indirect et vous êtes un membre clé de l'équipe de direction. Vous fournirez une vision et une orientation au domaine de la capacité d'approvisionnement opérationnel, tout en favorisant l'excellence opérationnelle (à l'échelle des personnes, des processus et de la technologie) et l'harmonisation dans toutes les catégories.

Responsabilités essentielles

En tant que chef des opérations d'approvisionnement indirect, vous fournissez la vision et le leadership structurel pour la prestation de services indirects à l'échelle mondiale. Vous dirigez plusieurs équipes d'experts et de gestionnaires en matière d'approvisionnement, vous assurant que le pont entre la stratégie globale et l'exécution est transparent.
Selon votre expérience, vos connaissances et les exigences générales de votre entreprise/équipe, votre rôle englobe, sans s'y limiter, ces responsabilités fondamentales :

Opérations stratégiques et leadership visionnaire

• Stratégie d'opérations indirectes : Agir en tant que chef de file en matière de prestation opérationnelle et de pratiques exemplaires, façonner la vision du domaine de capacité et notre feuille de route à long terme pour les opérations d'approvisionnement indirect, conformément à la vision globale d'approvisionnement.

• Modèle de prestation de services : Perfectionnement continu du modèle de prestation de services pour s'assurer qu'il demeure agile et adapté aux besoins des intervenants internes et externes.

• Création de valeur : Diriger les initiatives de réduction des coûts et les programmes d'amélioration de la valeur tout au long du cycle de vie opérationnel, en veillant à ce que les activités d'approvisionnement contribuent directement aux objectifs financiers et aux résultats de Roche.

• Conception et conduite Approche des opérations trans-catégories dans les chapitres indirect et MMC

• Conception et conduite Soutien de la livraison par catégorie dans les chapitres indirect et MMC

• Global Leadership from India Hub: Basé en Inde, fournir un leadership direct et la gestion d'équipe pour une équipe d'opérations d'approvisionnement véritablement mondiale et géographiquement répartie dans plusieurs endroits (la plupart des chefs d'équipe de cette équipe de personnes ne sont pas basés en Inde).

Excellence opérationnelle

• Comptabilité du rendement

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Senior Lead Engineer defines tasks for others and drives medium to large-scale initiatives across a product or product line. In this strategic role, you will coach and lead other engineers, excel in stakeholder negotiations, and provide direction for mid to long-term goals. You will actively contribute to technical knowledge through publications, inspire innovation, and lead the design of complex multi-service solutions. With expertise in advanced cloud features and Kubernetes, you will promote architectural consistency, drive technical strategy for major components, and mentor senior engineers to ensure the highest standards of engineering quality across the organization.
Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Scope / (Content Leadership) & Accountability/Problem Solving: Defines tasks for others and successfully drives medium to large (M/L) initiatives across a Product or Product Line. Challenges others in a growth-enabling way, effectively leverages team strengths, and acts as a coach and lead for other engineers.

• Stakeholder Management: Demonstrates a strong grasp of stakeholder ecosystems and their needs, excelling in negotiations and partnerships for mutual benefits. Provides clear direction to mid- to long-term goals and objectives.

• Impact/Strategy: Provides global-level support for innovative and technological initiatives. Actively gives speeches and shares knowledge at global and international events, and drives tech universities, Centers of Excellence (CoEs), and knowledge-sharing initiatives. Engaged in Chapter/Site related activities.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates at the Product Line, Chapter, Domain, or Site level, making a direct impact on the growth and engagement of other chapter members.

• Business / Technical ability: Actively contributes to the advancement of technical knowledge within the field through publications, presentations, and mentorship (e.g., playing the role of capability owner/hero). Inspires innovation, drives innovative solutions in line with emerging technology trends, and engages in building new approaches to existing problems.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Demonstrated experience defining tasks, coaching engineers, and successfully driving medium to large-scale initiatives across a product or product line.

• Proven track record of contributing to the technical strategy for major components/services and participating in global knowledge-sharing events.

Technical Skills

• Deep, hands-on experience designing and implementing Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud and/or Salesforce Health Cloud.

• Strong understanding of the core Salesforce platform (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud) and how to extend it for patient support services.

• Proficiency with declarative tools like Flow Builder, and deep familiarity with OmniStudio (FlexCards, OmniScripts, DataRaptors) for building industry-specific UI/UX.

• Hands-on experience configuring and deploying Agentforce to build custom, autonomous AI agents for life sciences use cases (e.g., patient program enrollment, MSL support, or clinical trial screening). Ability to define agent actions, set strict compliance guardrails, and utilize prompt builder.

• Experience with Einstein AI capabilities for next-best-action or patient insights

• Proven experience implementing Salesforce Shield (Platform Encryption, Field Audit Trail, Event Monitoring) to secure sensitive Patient Health Information (PHI)

• Working knowledge of M

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Descrizione del lavoro
L'Ingegnere di Piombo Senior definisce i compiti per gli altri e guida iniziative su larga scala attraverso una linea di prodotti o prodotti. In questo ruolo strategico, istruirai e guiderai altri ingegneri, eccellerai nei negoziati con le parti interessate, e fornirai una direzione per obiettivi a medio e lungo termine. Contribuirai attivamente alla conoscenza tecnica attraverso pubblicazioni, ispirare l'innovazione e guidare il design di soluzioni multi-servizio complesse. Con competenze nelle funzioni cloud avanzate e Kubernetes, promuoverete la coerenza architettonica, guidare la strategia tecnica per i principali componenti, e gli ingegneri senior mentor per garantire i più elevati standard di qualità ingegneristica in tutta l'organizzazione.
Descrizione della zona
Responsabilità del lavoro

• Scope / (Content Leadership) & Accountability/Problem Solving: Definisce i compiti per gli altri e guida con successo iniziative (M/F) di medie e grandi dimensioni in una linea di prodotto o prodotto. Sfida gli altri in modo favorevole alla crescita, sfrutta efficacemente i punti di forza del team, e agisce come allenatore e guida per altri ingegneri.

• Stakeholder Management: dimostra una forte comprensione degli ecosistemi delle parti interessate e delle loro esigenze, eccellendo nei negoziati e nelle partnership per i benefici reciproci. Fornisce una direzione chiara a obiettivi e obiettivi a medio-lungo termine.

• Impact/Strategy: fornisce supporto a livello globale per iniziative innovative e tecnologiche. Attivo dà discorsi e condivide le conoscenze in eventi globali e internazionali, e guida università tecnologiche, centri di eccellenza (CoEs), e le iniziative di condivisione delle conoscenze. Impegnato nelle attività relative al Capitolo/Sito.

• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): Funziona alla linea di prodotto, capitolo, dominio o livello del sito, facendo un impatto diretto sulla crescita e l'impegno di altri membri del capitolo.

• Capacità commerciale / tecnica: contribuisce attivamente al progresso della conoscenza tecnica all'interno del campo attraverso pubblicazioni, presentazioni e mentorship (ad esempio, giocando il ruolo di proprietario/eroe di capacità). Ispira innovazione, guida soluzioni innovative in linea con le tendenze tecnologiche emergenti, e si impegna a costruire nuovi approcci ai problemi esistenti.

Qualifiche
Istruzione / Esperienza

• Esperienza dimostrata che definisce i compiti, gli ingegneri di coaching, e guida con successo iniziative su larga scala attraverso una linea di prodotti o prodotti.

• Provato record di contribuire alla strategia tecnica per i principali componenti / servizi e partecipare a eventi di condivisione della conoscenza globale.

Competenze tecniche

• Profonda esperienza nella progettazione e nell'implementazione di Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud e/o Salesforce Health Cloud.

• Forte comprensione della piattaforma base Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud) e come estenderla per i servizi di supporto dei pazienti.

• Proficienza di strumenti dichiarativi come Flow Builder e profonda familiarità con OmniStudio (FlexCards, OmniScripts, DataRaptors) per la costruzione dell'interfaccia UI/UX.

• Hands-on esperienza di configurazione e distribuzione di Agentforce per costruire agenti AI personalizzati, autonomi per le scienze della vita casi di uso (ad esempio, l'iscrizione del programma paziente, il supporto MSL, o screening clinico di prova). Capacità di definire le azioni dell'agente, impostare rigorosi guardrails di conformità, e utilizzare pronta costruttore.

• Esperienza con le capacità di Einstein AI per le intuizioni future-best-action o paziente

• Esperienza comprovata che implementa Salesforce Shield (Platform Encryption, Field Audit Trail, Event Monitoring) per proteggere le informazioni sensibili sulla salute dei pazienti (PHI)

• Conoscenze di lavoro di M

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a Neurology Disease Area Lead to join our team at Roche Turkiye Pharma.

Disease Area Lead is an empowered leader responsible for the respective DA business in Roche Turkiye, leveraging the global Roche network as an active catalyst. In this role, you will report to the Leadership Team Member responsible for all disease areas and develop a clear business strategy for identifying, leveraging, scaling, adapting, and executing the business by providing launch and commercial excellence for the DA portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Establish strategic direction and lead the execution of the Strategy

• Responsible for setting the DA vision, high ambitions, and outcomes for the squad by harnessing insights from Patient Journey Partners (PJP) and other key stakeholders across the enterprise. Holding overall accountability for delivering market leadership and the P&L, whilst working in the context of shared responsibility.

• Responsible for developing effective strategies to manage the lifecycle and the financial and resource planning for the products.

• Promote innovation and the development of projects and pull in resources from the broader Roche network to deliver value-added solutions.

• Maximize opportunities and synergize across other disease areas and establish a strong collaboration within the affiliate and cross-affiliates within Pharma International.

• Closely collaborate with stakeholders and customer-facing teams to translate disease area needs into clear execution.

• Ensure Cross-Functional Leadership by inspiring teams to meet ambitious outcomes, fostering an environment where cross-functional teams can collaborate, develop, and achieve outcomes

• Manage DA Members by embracing the role of recruiter, coach, and retainer of talent & performance, sharing the responsibility with leaders in other disciplines.

• Ensure the right resource prioritization, with an enterprise mindset, taking into account the affiliate strategy and portfolio priorities. Within this context, effectively prioritize DA outcomes and ensure resource requirements are met to deliver outcomes

• In collaboration with the PPOCs, ensure that key stakeholders are well-supported and view us as their preferred partner. Mobilize the network with speed when necessary to meet the urgent needs of these key stakeholders.

People Leadership & Mindset

• Provide Inspirational leadership by uniting people around a shared vision and a common purpose, inspiring them to achieve squad-aligned outcomes. Ensure individuals and teams are developing and growing in line with the needs of the organization

• Build high-performing teams that deliver business outcomes by promoting a collaborative, innovative & creative environment

• Stay at the leading edge of learning & adapting according to external insights (strategy, outcomes & execution) for impact

• Ensure clarification of outcomes for the team so everyone is aligned on their role in delivering ambitious outcomes and should play an active role in execution as required.

• Act as a People Manager of Patient Journey Partners (PJP) and you are a thought partner for all DA members and others in the DA to bring perspective as a matrix lead. The role embraces the performance dynamics of all members.

• Have a very strong Entrepreneurial Mindset (We before Me) with outstanding partnering & leadership capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question, and understand).

• A catalyst and mobilize appropriate resources around

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Stiamo cercando un'Area Malattia di Neurologia Condurre ad unirsi al nostro team di Roche Turkiye Pharma.

L'Area Malattia Lead è un leader responsabile per le rispettive attività DA a Roche Turkiye, sfruttando la rete Roche globale come catalizzatore attivo. In questo ruolo, riferirai al Leadership Team Member responsabile di tutte le aree di malattia e svilupperai una chiara strategia di business per identificare, sfruttare, scalare, adattare e eseguire l'attività fornendo il lancio e l'eccellenza commerciale per il portafoglio DA.

Principali responsabilità

Stabilire la direzione strategica e condurre l'esecuzione della Strategia

• Responsabile per l'impostazione della visione DA, delle ambizioni elevate e dei risultati per la squadra sfruttando le intuizioni dei partner del viaggio paziente (PJP) e di altri stakeholder chiave in tutta l'azienda. Mantenere la responsabilità generale per la realizzazione della leadership di mercato e della P&L, lavorando nel contesto della responsabilità condivisa.

• Responsabile per lo sviluppo di strategie efficaci per gestire il ciclo di vita e la pianificazione finanziaria e delle risorse per i prodotti.

• Promuovere l'innovazione e lo sviluppo di progetti e raccogliere risorse dalla più ampia rete Roche per fornire soluzioni a valore aggiunto.

• Ottimizzare opportunità e sinergizzare in altre aree di malattia e stabilire una forte collaborazione all'interno della filiale e cross-affiliati all'interno di Pharma International.

• Collaborare con le parti interessate e i team di clienti per tradurre le esigenze dell'area della malattia in una chiara esecuzione.

• Assicurare la Leadership Cross-Functional da team ispiranti per incontrare risultati ambiziosi, promuovendo un ambiente in cui i team interfunzionali possono collaborare, sviluppare e raggiungere i risultati

• Gestisci i membri del DA abbracciando il ruolo di reclutatore, allenatore e custode di talenti e prestazioni, condividendo la responsabilità con i leader in altre discipline.

• Assicurare la giusta priorità delle risorse, con una mentalità aziendale, tenendo conto della strategia di affiliazione e delle priorità del portafoglio. In questo contesto, priorità efficace i risultati DA e garantire i requisiti delle risorse sono soddisfatti per fornire i risultati

• In collaborazione con i PPOC, assicurarsi che i principali stakeholder siano ben sostenuti e ci vedano come loro partner preferito. Mobilitare la rete con velocità quando necessario per soddisfare le esigenze urgenti di questi stakeholder chiave.

Leadership e Mindset

• Fornire leadership inspirativa unendo le persone intorno a una visione condivisa e uno scopo comune, ispirandole a raggiungere i risultati squad-aligned. Assicurare agli individui e ai team di sviluppare e crescere in linea con le esigenze dell'organizzazione

• Costruire team altamente performanti che forniscono risultati aziendali promuovendo un ambiente collaborativo, innovativo e creativo

• Soggiorna all'avanguardia nell'apprendimento e nell'adattamento in base alle intuizioni esterne (strategia, risultati ed esecuzione) per l'impatto

• Assicurare chiarificazione dei risultati per il team in modo che tutti siano allineati sul loro ruolo nel fornire risultati ambiziosi e dovrebbe svolgere un ruolo attivo nell'esecuzione come richiesto.

• Agite come People Manager dei Partner di Viaggio Paziente (PJP) e siete un partner di pensiero per tutti i membri del DA e gli altri nel DA per portare la prospettiva come vantaggio di matrice. Il ruolo abbraccia le dinamiche di performance di tutti i membri.

• Avere un Mindset Entrepreneurial molto forte (Noi prima di me) con eccellenti capacità di partner & leadership (coaching, consulenza, capacità di ascoltare profondamente, domanda, e capire).

• Un catalizzatore e mobilitare risorse appropriate intorno

Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung hat. Mach mit bei Roche, wo jede Stimme wichtig ist.

Die Position
Wir suchen einen Neurology Disease Area Lead, um unserem Team bei Roche Turkiye Pharma beizutreten.

Disease Area Lead ist eine führende Führungskraft, die für das jeweilige DA-Geschäft bei Roche Turkiye verantwortlich ist und das globale Roche-Netzwerk als aktiven Katalysator nutzt. In dieser Funktion berichten Sie dem für alle Krankheitsbereiche zuständigen Mitglied des Führungsteams und entwickeln eine klare Geschäftsstrategie für die Identifizierung, Nutzung, Skalierung, Anpassung und Durchführung des Geschäfts, indem Sie die Einführung und kommerzielle Exzellenz für das DA-Portfolio bereitstellen.

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

Festlegung der strategischen Ausrichtung und Leitung der Umsetzung der Strategie

• Verantwortlich für die Festlegung der DA-Vision, der hohen Ambitionen und der Ergebnisse für das Team, indem Erkenntnisse von Patient Journey Partners (PJP) und anderen wichtigen Stakeholdern im gesamten Unternehmen genutzt werden. Gesamtverantwortung für die Bereitstellung von Marktführerschaft und P&L, während im Rahmen der gemeinsamen Verantwortung gearbeitet wird.

• Verantwortlich für die Entwicklung effektiver Strategien zur Verwaltung des Lebenszyklus und der Finanz- und Ressourcenplanung für die Produkte.

• Förderung von Innovationen und der Entwicklung von Projekten und Einbezug von Ressourcen aus dem breiteren Roche-Netzwerk, um Mehrwertlösungen zu liefern.

• Maximieren Sie die Chancen und Synergien in anderen Krankheitsbereichen und etablieren Sie eine starke Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Tochtergesellschaft und der Cross-Affiliates innerhalb von Pharma International.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Stakeholdern und kundenorientierten Teams, um die Bedürfnisse des Krankheitsbereichs in eine klare Umsetzung zu überführen.

• Sicherstellung einer funktionsübergreifenden Führung, indem Teams dazu inspiriert werden, ehrgeizige Ergebnisse zu erzielen und ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem funktionsübergreifende Teams zusammenarbeiten, sich entwickeln und Ergebnisse erzielen können

• Verwalten Sie DA-Mitglieder, indem Sie die Rolle des Recruiters, Trainers und Erhalters von Talent und Leistung übernehmen und die Verantwortung mit Führungskräften in anderen Disziplinen teilen.

• Sicherstellen der richtigen Ressourcenpriorisierung mit einer Unternehmensmentalität unter Berücksichtigung der Affiliate-Strategie und Portfolioprioritäten. In diesem Zusammenhang priorisieren Sie die DA-Ergebnisse effektiv und stellen sicher, dass die Ressourcenanforderungen erfüllt werden, um Ergebnisse zu liefern

• Stellen Sie in Zusammenarbeit mit den PPOCs sicher, dass wichtige Stakeholder gut unterstützt werden und sehen Sie uns als ihren bevorzugten Partner an. Mobilisieren Sie das Netzwerk bei Bedarf schnell, um die dringenden Bedürfnisse dieser wichtigen Interessengruppen zu erfüllen.

Menschenführung & Mindset

• Bieten Sie inspirierende Führung, indem Sie Menschen um eine gemeinsame Vision und einen gemeinsamen Zweck vereinen und sie dazu inspirieren, Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Stellen Sie sicher, dass sich Einzelpersonen und Teams im Einklang mit den Bedürfnissen der Organisation entwickeln und wachsen

• Aufbau leistungsstarker Teams, die durch die Förderung eines kollaborativen, innovativen und kreativen Umfelds Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen

• Bleiben Sie an der Spitze des Lernens & Anpassen nach externen Erkenntnissen (Strategie, Ergebnisse & Ausführung) für Auswirkungen

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Ergebnisse für das Team geklärt werden, damit alle auf ihre Rolle bei der Bereitstellung ehrgeiziger Ergebnisse ausgerichtet sind und bei Bedarf eine aktive Rolle bei der Ausführung spielen sollten.

• Handeln Sie als People Manager von Patient Journey Partners (PJP) und Sie sind ein Vordenker für alle DA-Mitglieder und andere in der DA, um eine Perspektive als Matrix-Lead zu bringen. Die Rolle umfasst die Leistungsdynamik aller Mitglieder.

• Haben Sie ein sehr starkes unternehmerisches Mindset (Wir vor mir) mit hervorragenden Partnering- und Führungsfähigkeiten (Coaching, Beratung, Fähigkeit, tief zuzuhören, zu hinterfragen und zu verstehen).

• Katalysator und Mobilisierung geeigneter Ressourcen

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring.

Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience.

As a Field Applications Specialist , you will be a key member of our Customer Support team as the primary scientific and technical representative in the Northeast region primarily supporting the Central and Northeast New York area for Roche systems in customer laboratories within the Core Lab space. You will be responsible for providing best-in-class on-site customer support, including activities such as, application implementation, operator training, and troubleshooting for diagnostic instrumentation and assays throughout the entire product life cycle.

The Opportunity:

• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with customer stakeholders, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and creating value within the customer’s lab operations. Consult with customers on lab needs and act as a partner by supporting the customer throughout the product lifecycle which could include supporting product upgrades and other changes.

• Perform and/or assist with the installation of complex diagnostic instruments, software, and reagent applications in customer laboratories. Validate system performance to ensure it meets manufacturer specifications. Ensure effective and cohesive application of the newly installed solutions.

• Deliver and, in some cases develop, comprehensive on-site training to laboratory personnel on the proper use and maintenance of Roche systems, including theory of operation, workflow, quality control, and data interpretation.

• Act as the primary on-site resource for resolving complex technical issues related to instrumentation, software, and assay performance. Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to minimize instrument downtime. Partner with other Roche team members to implement and support total solutions, such as automation, digital tools, etc.

• Provide scientific and applications expertise to laboratory stakeholders (this could include supervisors, managers, directors, technologists) and medical professionals (this could include pathologists, doctors), helping them ensure cohesive lab operations by optimizing workflows, implementing new assays, and interpreting results for Roche's portfolio.

• Serve as the customer liaison and collect feedback from customers on product performance, features, and usability, and then relay this information back to support and commercial teams, maintaining a competitive advantage.

• Partner with the sales team and leverage in-depth technical knowledge during pre-sales activities, including product demonstrations, technical consultations, menu optimization, and other post-sales, revenue-generating opportunities.

• Ensure cons

En tant qu'entreprise de soins de santé axée sur la recherche, Roche découvre, développe et fournit des produits et des services diagnostiques et thérapeutiques innovants qui procurent des avantages importants aux patients et aux professionnels de la santé, depuis la détection précoce et la prévention des maladies jusqu'au diagnostic, au traitement et au suivi du traitement.

jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Job description
The Senior Lead Engineer defines tasks for others and drives medium to large-scale initiatives across a product or product line. In this strategic role, you will coach and lead other engineers, excel in stakeholder negotiations, and provide direction for mid to long-term goals. You will actively contribute to technical knowledge through publications, inspire innovation, and lead the design of complex multi-service solutions. With expertise in advanced cloud features and Kubernetes, you will promote architectural consistency, drive technical strategy for major components, and mentor senior engineers to ensure the highest standards of engineering quality across the organization.
Description of the area
Job Responsibilities

• Design and maintain end-to-end data solutions using AWS ensuring alignment with business goals and technical requirements.

• Develop scalable and efficient data models, pipelines, and workflows within the AWS environment.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into technical requirements and solutions.

• As needed, collaborate with other team members and external contractors to enhance technical solutions. Coordinate their work, provide guidance, and ensure alignment with project goals.

• Data Integration:

• Implement data integration solutions to ingest, transform, and manage large datasets from various sources into AWS and Snowflake.

• Ensure data quality, consistency, and security throughout the data life cycle.

• Develop documentation related to data management processes, procedures, and data dictionaries.

• Scope / Accountability/Problem Solving: Defines tasks for others and successfully drives medium to large (M/L) initiatives across a Product or Product Line. Challenges others in a growth-enabling way, effectively leverages team strengths, and acts as a coach and lead for other engineers.

• Stakeholder Management: Demonstrates a strong grasp of stakeholder ecosystems and their needs, excelling in negotiations and partnerships for mutual benefits. Provides clear direction to mid- to long-term goals and objectives.

• Impact/Strategy: Provides global-level support for innovative and technological initiatives. Actively gives speeches and shares knowledge at global and international events, and drives tech universities, Centers of Excellence (CoEs), and knowledge-sharing initiatives. Engaged in Chapter/Site related activities.

• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates at the Product, Product Line, Domain, or Site level, making a direct impact on the growth and engagement of other chapter members.

• Business / Technical ability: Actively contributes to the advancement of technical knowledge within the field through publications, presentations, and mentorship (e.g., playing the role of capability owner/hero). Inspires innovation, drives innovative solutions in line with emerging technology trends, and engages in building new approaches to existing problems.

Qualifications
Education / Experience

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field , or equivalent practical experience.

• Demonstrated experience leading complex AWS/cloud-native solutions and mentoring senior engineers.

• Proven track record of contributing to the technical strategy for major components/services and participating in global knowledge-sharing events.

Technical Skills

• Strong experience as a Lead Engineer, Tech Lead, Cloud Architect, or simil

Descrizione del lavoro

• Sviluppa modelli di dati scalabili ed efficienti, pipeline e flussi di lavoro all'interno dell'ambiente AWS.

• Collabora con gli stakeholder per comprendere le esigenze aziendali e tradurli in requisiti tecnici e soluzioni.

• Come necessario, collaborare con altri membri del team e appaltatori esterni per migliorare le soluzioni tecniche. Coordinare il loro lavoro, fornire indicazioni e garantire l'allineamento con gli obiettivi del progetto.

• Integrazione dei dati:

• Implementare soluzioni di integrazione dei dati per ingerire, trasformare e gestire grandi set di dati da varie fonti in AWS e Snowflake.

• Assicurare qualità, coerenza e sicurezza dei dati durante il ciclo di vita dei dati.

• Sviluppare la documentazione relativa ai processi di gestione dei dati, alle procedure e ai dizionari di dati.

• Scope / Accountability/Problem Solving: Definisce i compiti per altri e guida con successo iniziative (M/F) di medie e grandi dimensioni su una linea di prodotto o di prodotto. Sfida gli altri in modo che la crescita consenta, sfrutta efficacemente i punti di forza del team, e agisce come allenatore e guida per altri ingegneri.

• Stakeholder Management: dimostra una forte comprensione degli ecosistemi delle parti interessate e delle loro esigenze, eccellendo nei negoziati e nelle partnership per i benefici reciproci. Fornisce una direzione chiara a obiettivi e obiettivi a medio-lungo termine.

• Impact/Strategy: fornisce supporto a livello globale per iniziative innovative e tecnologiche. Attivo dà discorsi e condivide la conoscenza a eventi globali e internazionali, e guida università tecnologiche, centri di eccellenza (CoEs), e le iniziative di condivisione della conoscenza. Impegnato nelle attività relative al Capitolo/Sito.

• Complessità / (dimensione del prodotto): Funziona al livello del prodotto, della linea di prodotto, del dominio o del sito, rendendo un impatto diretto sulla crescita e l'impegno di altri membri del capitolo.

• Capacità commerciale / tecnica: contribuisce attivamente al progresso della conoscenza tecnica all'interno del campo attraverso pubblicazioni, presentazioni e mentorship (ad esempio, giocando il ruolo di proprietario/eroe di capacità). Ispira innovazione, spinge soluzioni innovative in linea con le tendenze tecnologiche emergenti, e si impegna a costruire nuovi approcci ai problemi esistenti.

Qualifiche
Istruzione / Esperienza

• Corso di laurea o master in Informatica, ingegneria del software, o un campo tecnico correlato, o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• Esperienza dimostrata leader complesse soluzioni AWS/cloud-native e mentoring ingegneri senior.

• Provato record di contribuire alla strategia tecnica per i principali componenti / servizi e partecipare a eventi di condivisione della conoscenza globale.

Competenze tecniche

• Forte esperienza come Lead Engineer, Tech Lead, Cloud Architect, o simil

• Élaborer des modèles de données, des pipelines et des workflows évolutifs et efficaces dans l'environnement du SSFE.

• Collaborer avec les intervenants pour comprendre les besoins des entreprises et les traduire en exigences et solutions techniques.

• Au besoin, collaborer avec d'autres membres de l'équipe et des entrepreneurs externes pour améliorer les solutions techniques. Coordonner leur travail, fournir des conseils et assurer l'harmonisation avec les objectifs du projet.

• Mettre en oeuvre des solutions d'intégration de données pour ingérer, transformer et gérer de grands ensembles de données provenant de diverses sources en AWS et en Snowflake.

• Assurer la qualité, l'uniformité et la sécurité des données tout au long du cycle de vie.

• Élaborer de la documentation sur les processus, les procédures et les dictionnaires de la gestion des données.

Défis d'autres de manière à favoriser la croissance, exploite efficacement les forces de l'équipe, et agit comme entraîneur et chef de file pour d'autres ingénieurs.

• Gestion des intervenants: Démontre une forte compréhension des écosystèmes des intervenants et de leurs besoins, excellant dans les négociations et les partenariats pour des avantages mutuels. Fournit une orientation claire vers les buts et objectifs à moyen et à long terme.

• Impact/Stratégie: Apporte un soutien mondial aux initiatives technologiques et innovantes. Donner activement des discours et partager des connaissances lors d'événements mondiaux et internationaux, et animer des universités de technologie, des centres d'excellence et des initiatives de partage des connaissances. Activités liées au chapitre ou au site.

• Complexité / (Taille du produit): Fonctionne au niveau du produit, de la gamme de produits, du domaine ou du site, ce qui a un impact direct sur la croissance et l'engagement des autres membres du chapitre.

• Capacités d'affaires et techniques: contribue activement à l'avancement des connaissances techniques sur le terrain au moyen de publications, de présentations et de mentorat (p. ex., en jouant le rôle de propriétaire/héros des capacités). Inspire l'innovation, lance des solutions innovantes conformes aux nouvelles tendances technologiques, et s'engage dans l'élaboration de nouvelles approches des problèmes existants.

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, génie logiciel, ou un domaine technique connexe, ou une expérience pratique équivalente.

• Expérience démontrée menant des solutions complexes de SSFE/cloud-native et mentorant des ingénieurs chevronnés.

• Expérience éprouvée de la contribution à la stratégie technique pour les principaux composants/services et de la participation à des manifestations mondiales de partage des connaissances.

jobs.title: Inventory Analyst
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As our Inventory Analyst, you will play a key role in balancing supply and demand to maximize operational efficiency and profitability. Leveraging inventory data, you will forecast future needs, collaborate across supply chain, procurement, and warehouse teams, and provide actionable insights to streamline operations. Your overarching goal will be to minimize costs caused by excess or insufficient stock while ensuring optimal product availability.

Key Responsibilities

• Analyze inventory trends to improve stock management and forecast accuracy.

• Collaborate across supply chain, procurement, warehouse, and sales functions to maintain optimal balance between service levels and costs.

• Monitor, investigate, and resolve inventory system variances across warehouses and 3PL service provider systems.

• Address and correct SAP IDoc interface issues to ensure seamless data integration and accurate inventory records.

• Develop inventory optimization strategies to reduce costs and prevent stockouts or overstock situations.

• Conduct regular inventory counts (cycle and full) and implement corrective actions based on findings.

• Generate and review month-end inventory reports, identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and propose solutions.

• Validate adjustments, rectify errors, and maintain accurate records in the ERP and warehouse management systems in line with SOPs.

Key Challenges

• Ensuring seamless integration and synchronization of inventory data across multiple systems, including SAP and 3PL providers.

• Balancing inventory costs while maintaining optimal service levels and product availability.

• Identifying and proactively addressing inventory variances and data integrity issues in real-time.

• Managing and resolving inbound, outbound, and delivery process variations affecting inventory accuracy.

• Driving process improvements and implementing inventory best practices in a high-paced and detail-oriented environment.

Who You Are as Our Ideal Candidate
We are seeking a self-driven and detail-oriented professional with a strong analytical mindset and a passion for optimizing inventory processes. Here’s what we’re looking for:

Experience:

• Proven experience in inventory management, supply chain, or a related field.

• Proficiency with ERP (preferably SAP) and warehouse management systems.

Skills:

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to draw actionable insights from data.

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in monitoring and reconciling inventory variances.

• Capability to identify root causes of inventory deviations and implement corrective actions.

Personal Characteristics:

• A proactive and results-driven mindset with the ability to work effectively under pressure.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills to partner across multiple functions effectively.

• Adept at balancing competing priorities while staying organized and meeting deadlines.

Technical Proficiency:

• Comfortable navigating complex systems and resolving integration errors (e.g., SAP IDoc issues).

• Advanced Excel skills and familiarity with other reporting tools.

Education:

• A tertiary qualification in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Management, or a related field is preferred.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. O

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
L'opportunità

Come nostro Inventory Analyst, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel bilanciare l'offerta e la domanda per massimizzare l'efficienza operativa e la redditività. Grazie ai dati dell'inventario, prevedrai le esigenze future, collaborerai tra i team della supply chain, dell'approvvigionamento e del magazzino e fornirai informazioni utili per ottimizzare le operazioni. Il vostro obiettivo di overarching sarà quello di ridurre al minimo i costi causati da eccesso o insufficiente azione, assicurando la disponibilità ottimale del prodotto.

Principali responsabilità

• Analizzare le tendenze dell'inventario per migliorare la gestione delle scorte e la precisione delle previsioni.

• Collabora tra le funzioni di supply chain, approvvigionamento, magazzino e vendita per mantenere un equilibrio ottimale tra i livelli di servizio e i costi.

• Monitorare, indagare e risolvere le variazioni del sistema di inventario tra magazzini e sistemi di fornitori di servizi 3PL.

• Indirizzo e correggere i problemi di interfaccia SAP IDoc per garantire l'integrazione dei dati senza soluzione di continuità e i record di inventario accurati.

• Sviluppare strategie di ottimizzazione dell'inventario per ridurre i costi e prevenire stockouts o situazioni sovrapposte.

• Condurre conteggi regolari dell'inventario (ciclo e completo) e implementare azioni correttive basate sui risultati.

• Generare e rivedere report di inventario di fine mese, identificare discrepanze, indagare cause radice e proporre soluzioni.

• Convalidare le regolazioni, correggere gli errori e mantenere i record accurati nei sistemi di gestione ERP e magazzino in linea con le SOP.

Le sfide chiave

• Garantire l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità e la sincronizzazione dei dati dell'inventario su più sistemi, compresi i fornitori SAP e 3PL.

• Bilanciare i costi dell'inventario mantenendo livelli di servizio ottimali e la disponibilità del prodotto.

• Identificare e affrontare proattivamente variazioni di inventario e problemi di integrità dei dati in tempo reale.

• Gestione e risoluzione delle variazioni di processo in entrata, uscita e consegna che interessano l'accuratezza dell'inventario.

• Miglioramento del processo di guida e implementazione delle migliori pratiche di inventario in un ambiente altamente trattato e orientato al dettaglio.

Chi sei come il nostro candidato ideale
Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista self-driven e orientato al dettaglio con una forte mentalità analitica e una passione per l'ottimizzazione dei processi di inventario. Ecco cosa stiamo cercando:

Esperienza:

• Esperienza comprovata nella gestione dell'inventario, nella supply chain o in un campo relativo.

• Proficienza con ERP (preferibilmente SAP) e sistemi di gestione del magazzino.

Competenze:

• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con la capacità di trarre intuizioni attuabili dai dati.

• Eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli e accuratezza nel monitoraggio e nella riconciliazione delle variazioni dell'inventario.

• Capacità di identificare le cause principali delle deviazioni di inventario e implementare azioni correttive.

Caratteristiche personali:

• Una mentalità proattiva e orientata ai risultati con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente sotto pressione.

• Forte collaborazione e capacità di comunicazione per collaborare in più funzioni in modo efficace.

• Adept al bilanciamento delle priorità concorrenti durante il soggiorno organizzato e rispettare le scadenze.

Proficienza tecnica:

• Comodi sistemi di navigazione complessi e risoluzione degli errori di integrazione (ad esempio, problemi SAP IDoc).

• Avanzate competenze di Excel e familiarità con altri strumenti di reporting.

Istruzione:

• Una qualifica terziaria in Supply Chain, Logistica, Business Management, o un campo relativo è preferito.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, oltre 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati all’avanzamento della scienza, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni future. O
